name: Sister-in-Law Is at Home!
description: "Bhabiji Ghar Par Hain!" is a popular Hindi sitcom that premiered in 2015 on And TV and is available on ZEE5. Produced by Binaifer Kohli, the show follows two neighboring couples—the Mishras and the Tiwaris. The husbands, Vibhuti Narayan Mishra and Manmohan Tiwari are dissatisfied in their marriages and secretly admire each other's wives. Manmohan, a successful undergarment businessman, is married to Angoori, a simple and naive housewife. Vibhuti, an unemployed former insurance agent, is married to Anita, a confident and modern woman who runs grooming classes. Their constant scheming to impress each other's wives leads to comedic conflicts and chaotic situations, mostly taking place in their homes. The show, inspired by the 1990s sitcom Shrimaan Shrimati, has been well received by both critics and audiences for its humor and engaging storyline.

videos.title: A Big Misunderstanding
videos.overview: Pandit Ji predicts a change in the life of Manmohan Tiwari, an undergarment businessman. Vibhuti Mishra, a policy agent, and his wife Anita Mishra, a grooming teacher, are about to relocate to Tiwari's locality. Manmohan gets an undergarment order of INR 5 lakhs from Mr Agarwal, who is about to visit him with his wife. Manmohan and his housewife Angoori are excited. The Mishras mistake the Tiwari house for theirs. The Tiwaris mistake the Mishras for the Agarwals. A misunderstanding ensues.

videos.title: Manmohan Fakes a Fall
videos.overview: As Vibhuti dreams about romancing Angoori, Anita wakes him up and asks him to get milk. On his way, he sees Angoori praying in the verandah and stops to talk. Manmohan wants to bathe, but the water supply has stopped. So, Manmohan decides to bathe at Anita's home. Vibhuti rushes to use the loo but finds it occupied by Manmohan. Manmohan pretends to fall in the bathroom, and a doctor is called. Manmohan asks the doctor to lie that his hip is fractured and that he should not be moved at all.

videos.title: Saxena Decides to Teach Vibhuti a Lesson
videos.overview: Dr Gupta leaves and thinks about Manmohan's plan. Laddoo, Manmohan's younger brother who can hear what people are thinking, reads his mind. Laddoo goes to Manmohan and confronts him. Manmohan bribes him with new shoes. Saxena, a neighbour, bumps into Angoori and apologises. Vibhuti slaps Saxena. Anita serves turmeric milk to Manmohan. Vibhuti cooks, and the Tiwaris and the Mishras have dinner together. Anita goes with Angoori to sleep at Tiwari's home. Saxena decides to teach Vibhuti a lesson.

videos.title: Saxena Mistakenly Beats Up Manmohan
videos.overview: Vibhuti can't sleep with Manmohan as he snores. Vibhuti eventually goes to sleep in the living room. Saxena enters Vibhuti's bedroom and beats up Manmohan under the blanket thinking that he is Vibhuti. When Manmohan takes off the blanket, Saxena has gone, and there is no one. The next day, Manmohan asks Vibhuti if he has vengeful foes. Manmohan decides to go back to his house but is unable to. Saxena overhears Vibhuti and Angoori's conversation and finds out that it was Manmohan in the bedroom.

videos.title: Angoori Sees Manmohan Following Anita
videos.overview: Manmohan asks Vibhuti to sleep in the bedroom and he sleeps in the living room. Saxena enters Vibhuti's home and beats up Manmohan thinking that he is Vibhuti. Manmohan shouts, and Vibhuti comes with a stick. Manmohan thinks that Vibhuti is hitting him. Anita shouts at Vibhuti, but Angoori thanks him for curing Manmohan. Angoori sees Manmohan following Anita and confronts him. Angoori wonders what makes Anita special. Ammaji, Manmohan's mother, explains that she needs to groom herself.

videos.title: Manmohan Assumes Angoori has Changed Her Form
videos.overview: As Anita and Vibhuti try to catch a rat, Manmohan enters. Vibhuti throws a fork on the rat, but it hits Manmohan. Manmohan offers to get rid of the rat without harming it. He gets a snake charmer's instrument to lure the rat, but it instead attracts a snake. Laddoo and Pandit Ji say that this snake's bite could turn humans into serpentine creatures. Manmohan finds Angoori applying ointment on her skin. He notices that her eye colour has changed and assumes that she has become a serpentine woman.

videos.title: Amma Ji's Cure For Angoori
videos.overview: Vibhuti and Manmohan go to Pandit Ji to seek a cure for Angoori. Pandit Ji tells them that Angoori will be cured only if she bites someone. Manmohan tries to get Saxena bitten by Angoori but fails. A confused Angoori calls Amma Ji, who tells her to pray to a serpentine god. When Vibhuti goes to talk to Angoori, he finds her dancing in front of a snake's photo. Angoori clarifies what is happening. A happy Vibhuti doesn't tell Manmohan and instead sends him to Agra to look for a solution.

videos.title: Manmohan Receives The Wrong Courier
videos.overview: Manmohan sees Anita and Angoori from afar and pushes Anita behind, stating that Angoori is a snake person. Angoori informs Manmohan that she is not a snake person. Manmohan is shocked but relieved. As Angoori goes through fashion magazines, Vibhuti comes and asks her why she does not wear such clothes. He then buys a dress for her and sends it to her house via a courier boy, who ends up giving it to Manmohan. Manmohan thinks that it is from Anita and is shocked to find a nightgown in it.

videos.title: Saxena to Take Revenge On Manmohan
videos.overview: Vibhuti gets a call saying that his dress was accidentally exchanged for a nightgown. He fears that Manmohan will tell Anita. Manmohan calls Anita, and she confirms that the gift is for him. When Saxena comes to seek red chilli powder, Manmohan is in a nightgown. A shocked Manmohan unintentionally ends up burning Saxena's eyes with the chilli powder. Saxena decides to take revenge. Vibhuti sees Manmohan in the nightgown. Saxena tells the neighbourhood that there is a function at Manmohan's home.

videos.title: Manmohan Tries Spending Time With Anita
videos.overview: Seeing Manmohan in a nightgown shocks Vibhuti, Anita and Pandit Ji. When Anita clarifies that she had gifted a tie, they realise that the confusion has been created by Vibhuti. Vibhuti goes to meet Angoori in the morning and is shocked to find Manmohan home. Vibhuti feigns being a customer and calls Manmohan to lure him out of the home in order to spend time with Angoori. Manmohan pretends to be a policy buyer and calls Vibhuti to lure him out of the house so that he can spend time with Anita.

videos.title: Anita Agrees to Groom Manmohan
videos.overview: Vibhuti returns and says that the policy call was a prank. Anita wants Vibhuti to take up a permanent job. Manmohan finds a job for Vibhuti to keep him busy the whole day. As Manmohan is going to meet Anita, Vibhuti comes to his house with sweets and a large undergarment order for Manmohan from his uncle in London. As Manmohan is sceptical about visiting London, Vibhuti makes him talk to Saxena on the phone, who pretends to be Vibhuti's uncle. Anita agrees to groom Manmohan for his London trip.

videos.title: Saxena Continues to Prank Manmohan
videos.overview: Angoori thanks Vibhuti for helping Manmohan with the London order. Vibhuti feels guilty and decides to finish the London trip prank. Anita grooms Manmohan for his London trip. Manmohan asks Anita to teach him ball dance. As Anita is about to hold his hand, Angoori walks in. So, she demonstrates using Angoori. Vibhuti goes to Manmohan's house and informs that the trip is cancelled as his uncle has become comatose. Though Vibhuti tells Saxena to stop calling Manmohan, Saxena continues to do so.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Uncle Arrives From London
videos.overview: Saxena calls Manmohan as Vibhuti's uncle to pester Vibhuti. Vibhuti tells Angoori that she should worry about women in London luring Manmohan. Angoori talks to Amma Ji, and she suggests that Angoori also go to London. Angoori informs Vibhuti and Anita that she is going to London. Manmohan and Vibhuti decide to help each other by stopping the London trip and getting rid of Vibhuti's job. Saxena continues to refer to Manmohan as Vibhuti's uncle. Vibhuti's uncle from London comes over for real.

videos.title: Vibhuti Asks His Uncle to Offer a Fake Order
videos.overview: As Vibhuti's uncle from London sits in the living room, Manmohan walks in and invites the uncle over to his place for snacks. Manmohan mentions to him their earlier telephonic conversations, which confuses the uncle. The uncle then asks Vibhuti, who informs the uncle that Manmohan has mental issues and that he should offer him a fake order of undergarments. Manmohan follows Anita for a jog. Vibhuti goes to meet Angoori and compliments her singing and hopes to sing with her.

videos.title: Vibhuti Uses Saxena
videos.overview: Vibhuti decides to use the service of a good playback singer while he pretends to sing. He finds out that Saxena sings really well and includes Saxena in his plan. Vibhuti pretends to sing in the verandah while Saxena actually sings for him from behind. Angoori becomes impressed and invites Vibhuti to teach music to Manmohan. Manmohan refuses to be a student at first but later agrees after Amma Ji's order. Vibhuti takes Manmohan and Angoori to the verandah and pretends to sing.

videos.title: Anita Learns The Truth About Vibhuti's Singing Skills
videos.overview: Angoori informs Anita about Vibhuti's singing skills. Anita does not believe that Vibhuti sings well and questions him. He tells Anita the whole truth of him trying to prank Manmohan with the help of Saxena to earn some money. Vibhuti decides to stop, in which Anita helps him. As Angoori prays, her brother-in-law Laddoo gives her a birthday card. Manmohan forgets her birthday, about which she informs Anita. Manmohan overhears the conversation and assumes that it is Anita's birthday.

videos.title: Angoori Waits For Manmohan to Wish Her
videos.overview: Manmohan feels that Vibhuti has forgotten Anita's birthday. Anita informs Vibhuti that it is Angoori's birthday and that Manmohan has forgotten it. Angoori waits for Manmohan to wish her. As Vibhuti buys flowers for Angoori, Manmohan visits the shop to buy flowers for Anita. When Vibhuti orders a cake for Angoori, he sees Manmohan carrying a cake too. Angoori assumes that Manmohan is going to surprise her when she sees a cake in his hand. Vibhuti is busy hiding the cake when Anita catches him.

videos.title: Manmohan Suspects Anita is Having an Affair
videos.overview: Angoori and Anita assume that Vibhuti and Manmohan are planning a surprise for Angoori and decide to go away for a few hours. Manmohan and Vibhuti decorate their respective homes for birthday celebrations. Vibhuti finally informs Manmohan that it is Angoori's birthday and not Anita's. They both surprise their own wives in the end. When Manmohan goes to meet Anita, he overhears her phone conversation and assumes that she is having an affair with someone named Jasveer. He informs Vibhuti about it.

videos.title: Manmohan Suspects Anita Of Having an Affair
videos.overview: Vibhuti and Manmohan are sad that Anita is having an affair with Jasveer. Vibhuti offers to take Anita out for dinner, but she is uninterested. Angoori is confused about Manmohan's upset mood and informs Amma Ji about it. Vibhuti overhears Anita talking to Jasveer at night. Manmohan tells Vibhuti to get a grip on his life and not lose hope so easily. Vibhuti asks Manmohan to help save his marriage. As Manmohan asks Anita what can make a wife cheat on her husband, Jasveer calls.

videos.title: Who is Jasveer?
videos.overview: As Angoori tells Vibhuti about Manmohan's disturbed state, Manmohan comes rushing and takes Vibhuti out. Manmohan informs Vibhuti that Anita is having an affair because Vibhuti is jobless. Vibhuti apologises to Anita and tells her that he will work hard. Anita is delighted to hear this. At midnight, Anita suddenly disappears, and Vibhuti fears that she has run away. Vibhuti and Manmohan come to the former's house. Anita returns with Jasveer, who turns out to be a female friend.

videos.title: Vibhuti Plans to Act As Amitabh Bachchan's Friend
videos.overview: Angoori opens her cupboard, which is full of actor Amitabh Bachchan's posters, and dances to his songs. Vibhuti sees her dance, and she informs Vibhuti that she is a big fan of the actor. Vibhuti considers this a chance to come close to Angoori. Amitabh's movie is being played in a local cinema, but Manmohan refuses to take Angoori there. Chhedilal, the new washerman in the area, looks like Amitabh. Vibhuti decides to pretend to be Amitabh's pal with Chhedilal's help to get Angoori's attention.

videos.title: Vibhuti Arranges a Meeting With Amitabh
videos.overview: As Chhedilal accidentally takes Anita's laundry to Angoori's home, Vibhuti pulls him aside and tells him not to be seen in the area. Angoori is angry with Vibhuti for not informing that he knew Amitabh. Vibhuti informs Angoori that Amitabh is his uncle and that he will arrange a meeting. Angoori informs about this to Anita, who gets annoyed. Vibhuti makes arrangements for all to meet Amitabh, who is actually Chhedilal. As all talk to the fake Amitabh, Saxena informs that Amitabh has arrived.

videos.title: Angoori Plans to Make an Okra Dish For Vibhuti
videos.overview: As everyone talks to the fake Amitabh, the real one arrives, and Vibhuti's secret is out. Vibhuti wakes up when he hears a vegetable vendor selling okra. Vibhuti loves okra but hasn't eaten it since seven years as Anita hates it. Anita sees the vendor and slaps him for selling okra. She later feels guilty and sends Vibhuti to apologise. Vibhuti tells the vendor to secretly supply okra to him without Anita knowing about it. Angoori vows to make an okra dish for Vibhuti without Anita's knowledge.

videos.title: Manmohan Decides to Stop Vibhuti From Eating Okra
videos.overview: Angoori makes okra for Vibhuti and keeps it in the window. As Vibhuti goes to get it, Anita stops him. Saxena ends up eating the okra. Vibhuti gets annoyed with Anita and, in her anger, she gives away Vibhuti's dinner to Saxena as well. Angoori agrees to cook okra again for Vibhuti. Angoori informs Manmohan about Vibhuti's okra issue, and Manmohan decides to use it against Vibhuti. Manmohan decides to stop Vibhuti from having okra as he finds out that Anita will exit her home if Vibhuti eats it.

videos.title: Vibhuti Gives Angoori a Transmitter For Safety
videos.overview: Manmohan tells Angoori not to cook okra for Vibhuti. A sad Vibhuti is elated when he finds out that Anita has cooked okra for him after Angoori inspired her. Vibhuti reads in the newspaper about kidnappers in the area. He feels worried for Angoori and gives Angoori a transmitter to stay connected. Manmohan walks in as Anita is practising karate and gives her a pepper spray for her safety. Angoori sends a false transmitter signal to Vibhuti. Manmohan dreams about saving Anita from goons.

videos.title: Manmohan And Vibhuti Assume Angoori is Kidnapped
videos.overview: Manmohan gives the pepper spray to Angoori, which she sprays on his face thinking that it is a perfume. An upset Angoori calls Amma Ji to complain about Manmohan's conduct. Amma Ji calls Angoori over to stay with her. Manmohan and Vibhuti assume that Angoori has been kidnapped. They call Happu Singh, a local police inspector, to lodge a complaint. Manmohan informs Amma Ji that Angoori has been kidnapped. Angoori wants to go back, but Amma Ji stops her. Vibhuti mistakes another woman for Angoori.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Tall Promise to Angoori
videos.overview: As Manmohan and Vibhuti miss Angoori and daydream about her, Happu calls Manmohan and informs that he is bringing Angoori home. The woman Happu Singh brings home turns out to be Pandit Ji's wife. Angoori returns from Amma Ji's house. Anita is upset about the lack of water supply and calls Manmohan to request him to lend a bucket of water. There is only one bucket of water left at Manmohan's house, which he is unable to take to Anita. Vibhuti promises to bring a water tanker for Angoori.

videos.title: The Tiwaris And The Mishras Fail to Get Water
videos.overview: Manmohan tries to take the bucket of water to Anita. Angoori informs Manmohan that Vibhuti has ordered a water tanker. Anita calls Manmohan and informs that she does not need water. Manmohan tells Laddoo to inform all in the locality that Vibhuti has arranged for water. Everyone takes the water. The Tiwaris and the Mishras don't get any water for themselves. Anita calls Manmohan for a bucket of water. When Manmohan finds out that the water was for Vibhuti, he spills the whole bucket on himself.

videos.title: Vibhuti Assumes Angoori to be Drunk
videos.overview: As Angoori takes a herbal medicine made by Amma Ji for cough in an alcohol bottle, Vibhuti sees her and assumes that she has started drinking. The medicine makes Angoori dizzy and high, which confirms Vibhuti's doubt. Vibhuti tells Angoori that alcohol is harmful, pretending to shout at an alcoholic Saxena. Vibhuti sees Angoori having the medicine multiple times. Vibhuti seeks Anita's advice for a friend's alcoholic wife. She says that only a woman can make her understand.

videos.title: Vibhuti And Manmohan Get Drunk
videos.overview: Anita calls Angoori and coughs during the call. Angoori suggests her herbal medicine to Anita. Vibhuti dresses up like an old woman and tries to make Angoori understand the consequences of drinking alcohol. Vibhuti informs Manmohan about Angoori's alcoholism and later finds out that Anita is also drinking. Manmohan and Vibhuti decide to teach the women a lesson and come home drunk one night. Both the women confirm that it was just a herbal medicine that they were drinking and walk out.

videos.title: Anita's Fear Of Darkness
videos.overview: As the power supply gets disrupted, Anita shouts as she fears darkness, which compels her to hug whoever is near her. All the neighbours gather to find why the power cut happened. Manmohan has night blindness, which he wants to hide from everyone. All the men decide to ask Pandit Ji the reason as he works for the electricity department. Vibhuti informs Manmohan about Anita's fear. The power supply is restored, but only for a minute. Manmohan decides to use this chance to come close to Anita.

videos.title: Manmohan Hugs Pathak's Wife
videos.overview: Manmohan wants to use Anita's fear of darkness to get close to her. When there is a power cut, Anita hugs Angoori. Pandit Ji tells Manmohan that the load-shedding will stop, but Manmohan warns him not to stop it. Manmohan calls Vibhuti as a policy buyer to send Vibhuti away. A power cut again leads to Manmohan going to Pathak's doorstep and hugging his wife. Pathak beats Manmohan. Manmohan tells Angoori and the Mishras that a thief beat him. Pandit Ji blames Manmohan for the load-shedding.

videos.title: Angoori Beats Vibhuti
videos.overview: Everyone tells Pandit Ji to stop the load-shedding. Manmohan tells Saxena to cut Vibhuti's power cable at night. Manmohan calls Vibhuti as a policy buyer and asks him to come over at night. Manmohan then goes to Anita's house. Vibhuti comes back looking for his wallet and hears Anita shout. He rushes to his house and beats up Manmohan thinking that he is a thief. Angoori beats up Vibhuti to save Manmohan. Anita ends up hugging Malkhan, Kishorilal's son, who had come to rob the Mishras.

videos.title: Manmohan Receives Love From Vibhuti
videos.overview: Angoori tells Vibhuti that she likes people who are good to Manmohan. Vibhuti decides to be nice to Manmohan. Manmohan visits a holy man and obtains powder to lure Anita. He mixes the powder in coconut water and takes it to Anita, but Vibhuti ends up drinking it. Vibhuti starts behaving lovingly with Manmohan, and Manmohan feels it is due to the powder. Angoori is happy to see Vibhuti behaving nicely with Manmohan. Manmohan dreams that he is married to Vibhuti. Manmohan decides to annoy Vibhuti.

videos.title: Manmohan And Vibhuti Hide From Anita
videos.overview: Vibhuti controls his anger as Angoori is watching. Manmohan pretends to be romantically inclined towards Tillu, but Vibhuti still behaves nicely with him. Manmohan finally goes to the holy man and seeks an antidote. Manmohan tries to give the antidote to Vibhuti, but Anita consumes it. Manmohan decides to avoid the Mishras till the effect of the antidote wears off. Manmohan hides behind the sofa when Vibhuti comes over. Vibhuti hides behind the sofa too when Anita comes over.

videos.title: Angoori And Anita Receive Marriage Advice
videos.overview: Anita is shocked to find Manmohan and Vibhuti at Manmohan's house. Happu arrives with the holy man and informs Manmohan that he is a cheat. Vibhuti sees an ad about superglue and decides to use it to attach his hand to Angoori's hand. Vibhuti applies the glue on his hand and, as he tries to shake hands with Angoori, Manmohan ends up shaking hands with him. Pandit Ji informs Angoori and Anita about the eclipse and how they should talk in Sanskrit in bed with their husbands for a happy marriage.

videos.title: Manmohan Gets Bitten By a Dog
videos.overview: Vibhuti and Manmohan continue to irritate each other while they are stuck together. The Tiwaris and the Mishras have dinner together and decide to sleep in Manmohan's bedroom to complete the eclipse-related task for a happy marriage. Vibhuti gets a policy-related client call and needs to visit the client. Manmohan agrees to go with Vibhuti only if Vibhuti agrees to sit in his shop with him later. On their way, a dog bites Manmohan. Dr Gupta arrives and accidentally gives an injection to Vibhuti.

videos.title: Vibhuti Dons The Guise Of a Servant
videos.overview: Vibhuti slaps Happu and instigates him to jail him and Manmohan. When Happu arrests Vibhuti, Vibhuti and Manmohan are unglued, which saves the latter. Anita reminds Vibhuti of their role-play days and asks him to role-play. Angoori is hurt while alighting the stairs, and Manmohan decides to hire a servant to help her at Amma Ji's insistence. When Vibhuti dresses up as a servant and seduces Anita, Manmohan comes over. Anita introduces Vibhuti as her servant to Manmohan.

videos.title: Happu Asks For a Bribe From Deepu Mastana
videos.overview: Manmohan informs Anita that Angoori is hurt and asks her to lend Vibhuti, who is role-playing as servant Deepu Mastana, for housework. Manmohan takes Deepu to his place and assigns him tasks. While brooming, Deepu witnesses Angoori. Happu visits Manmohan's house and seeks Deepu's background. For a lack of background check, Happu warns that he will arrest him and seeks a bribe to avert it. Vibhuti returns home and tells Anita to stop the role play. As he removes his moustache, Manmohan walks in.

videos.title: Manmohan Catches Deepu Flirting With Anita
videos.overview: Manmohan badmouths Vibhuti for leaving Anita alone with a servant. He takes Deepu along to complete the housework and tells Anita that he is going to keep Deepu forever. Deepu takes good care of Angoori. As Deepu dries clothes on the terrace, Anita signals her love to him. Manmohan sees them and warns Deepu. Deepu threatens Manmohan that he will inform Happu about the background check and makes him do the chores. Anita tells Manmohan that Deepu has to go back due to an emergency.

videos.title: Manmohan Burns Anita's Mother's Sari
videos.overview: Angoori finds Manmohan sweeping the floor and gets angry with Deepu. Angoori starts beating Deepu up, which makes Deepu run to Vibhuti's house. Deepu changes his get-up and becomes Vibhuti and informs all that Deepu has run away. As Anita cries over a stain in her mother's sari, Manmohan promises to remove it. Anita promises a surprise for him if he succeeds. Manmohan calls Angoori as a lady to find out how to remove the stains and successfully removes it. But he burns the sari while ironing it.

videos.title: Manmohan Pretends Suffering From Memory Loss
videos.overview: Anita informs Vibhuti about Manmohan trying to remove the stain from her sari. Manmohan tells Tillu to find the same sari and get it for him. Anita and Vibhuti come over asking for her sari, but Manmohan is unable to give an answer. Manmohan runs away and falls down. He pretends to lose his memory due to the fall. The doctor checks Manmohan and tells all to keep reminding him events to normalise him again. Anita feels bad and asks Vibhuti to spend time with Manmohan to remind him about his life.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Angoori Pretend to be Married
videos.overview: Manmohan calls Anita his wife when Vibhuti tries to remind him about his life. Vibhuti and Angoori pretend to be married to revive Manmohan's memory but fail. Angoori tries to behave romantically with Manmohan and talks about their wedding night but fails to revive his memory. Tillu returns with the burnt sari and informs that he couldn't find the same sari. Vibhuti finds it and takes it home. As Vibhuti takes the credit for removing the stain while ironing the sari, Anita finds the burn mark.

videos.title: Manmohan Disturbs Vibhuti's Role Playing
videos.overview: When Manmohan visits Anita's house, he finds the door ajar and Anita sleeping. He hides and stares at her as she stretches. As Vibhuti and Angoori talk, Vibhuti finds female hair on Manmohan's shirt. Vibhuti decides to find out whose it is. Manmohan claims it is Saxena's, who has returned from a mental asylum. But it is actually Anita's hair. Manmohan sees Vibhuti role-playing as Deepu Mastana in Anita's bedroom at night and goes to save her. Anita rebukes Manmohan about the hair Vibhuti found.

videos.title: Vibhuti Suspects Manmohan Of Cheating On Angoori
videos.overview: Saxena is back from the mental asylum and has trimmed hair. Manmohan tells him not to leave home as it is unsafe and promises to arrange for his food to keep him away from Vibhuti. Vibhuti notices Manmohan talking to someone near Saxena's home. Angoori tells everything to Amma Ji who tells her to be careful. Vibhuti tries again and again to warn Angoori about Manmohan cheating on her. Manmohan dreams about Anita. Anita and Vibhuti notice Manmohan sneaking out from his home with a bag.

videos.title: Anita Finds Angoori's Hair On Vibhuti
videos.overview: At Saxena's home, Manmohan gives him a wig. Vibhuti, Angoori and Anita follow Manmohan and see him hugging Saxena and assume that he is having an affair. They later find out that the person is actually Saxena. A DNA test on the hair conducted by Vibhuti reveals that it is Angoori's. Anita and Vibhuti argue, and he calls her antisocial. Vibhuti overhears Teeka and Malkhan discuss the formula of ignoring a woman to lure her. Vibhuti tries this on Angoori. Anita invites the Tiwaris for dinner.

videos.title: Angoori Stops Talking to Vibhuti
videos.overview: Vibhuti continues to ignore Angoori, which upsets her. Angoori calls Amma Ji and informs her about Vibhuti's conduct. Amma Ji tells Angoori to ignore Vibhuti. Angoori starts ignoring Vibhuti, and he repents his action. Anita is confused on seeing Vibhuti upset. A flower girl meets Vibhuti, but Anita shoos her away. Anita asks Vibhuti to cook dinner as the Tiwaris are about to come over. Vibhuti calls Angoori to persuade her, but she hands the phone to Manmohan. The Tiwaris visit them for dinner.

videos.title: Angoori Seeks Amma Ji's Permission to Talk to Vibhuti
videos.overview: Angoori continues to ignore Vibhuti even after his several attempts to persuade her. The Tiwaris and the Mishras have dinner and decide to have a singing session. Angoori recites a poem to laud Manmohan. Anita sings and dances with Vibhuti. Manmohan recites a poem to compliment Anita. When Vibhuti tries to say a poem for Angoori, they leave. The Mishras go to the Tiwari house for lunch. Angoori ignores Vibhuti due to Amma Ji. Angoori calls Amma Ji and gets permission to talk to Vibhuti.

videos.title: The Mishras' and Tiwaris' Plan to Save Money
videos.overview: Vibhuti is elated as Angoori starts talking to him. Angoori asks for some money from Manmohan. As Manmohan blames her for wasting money, Vibhuti intervenes and gives INR 10000 to Manmohan and Angoori for a month and challenges them to manage it. Vibhuti tells about the challenge to Anita, and she decides to opt for it too. Angoori starts reducing her expenses to save money. Vibhuti feels bad and decides to help Angoori. Manmohan buys a cycle from Saxena for INR 900 to save travel money.

videos.title: Vibhuti Secretly Helps Angoori With Groceries
videos.overview: Angoori finds groceries in her fridge and assumes that Manmohan is keeping it to help her. Vibhuti sneaks into Tiwari's lawn twice and robs his cycle's parts. Angoori brings a heavy breakfast for Manmohan as she is happy that he is helping her. Vibhuti continues to smuggle groceries for Angoori. Anita is angry about her groceries getting stolen. Vibhuti instructs Pelu to keep a bag of groceries with Vibhuti's ring in Angoori's window. Pelu accidentally keeps a bag of alcohol in Angoori's window.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan Decide to Teach Maths
videos.overview: Manmohan sneaks groceries into Anita's house, and she assumes that he is the grocery thief. When he sneaks back into his house, Angoori assumes that he is helping her with the groceries. Laddoo tells Angoori about his difficulty in maths. Vibhuti promises to coach Laddoo to please Angoori. Manmohan also agrees to teach maths to Laddoo. Manmohan asks Anita to teach him maths so that he can teach Laddoo. Vibhuti prepares to teach chapter five to Laddoo, but he has already studied it.

videos.title: Anita Decides to Teach Math to Laddoo
videos.overview: Anita asks Laddoo if Manmohan taught him maths. When Laddoo asks Manmohan about it, he pretends to be sick. Vibhuti learns that Laddoo has already studied chapter six. Vibhuti decides to bribe Laddoo's teacher but gets hit instead. When Manmohan goes to Anita to learn maths, she reprimands him for not teaching Laddoo anything. Manmohan runs away. Vibhuti and Manmohan decide to avoid everyone the whole day. Anita overhears Angoori shouting at Laddoo over studies and decides to teach him maths.

videos.title: Amma Ji Believes Angoori is Pregnant
videos.overview: Laddoo passes his exams with good marks. Vibhuti and Manmohan try to take credit, but Angoori credits Anita. Amma Ji comes over to stay. As Amma Ji and Angoori talk about Amma Ji wanting a grandchild, Angoori vomits. Amma Ji assumes that Angoori is pregnant. Angoori knows that her stomach is upset, but doesn't tell Amma Ji about it as she seems elated. Amma Ji informs Manmohan about Angoori's pregnancy, which elates him as well. Manmohan and Amma Ji visit the Mishra house happily to inform them.

videos.title: Amma Ji Plans Angoori's Baby Shower
videos.overview: Amma Ji is awed by Anita's beauty. Amma Ji and Manmohan invite the Mishras for dinner, during which Amma Ji informs the Mishras that Angoori is pregnant. Anita is elated, but Vibhuti isn't. The Tiwaris and Anita dance. The next morning, Vibhuti and Anita are shocked to see two babies in the arms of the Tiwaris. The Tiwaris practise being parents with dolls. Vibhuti finds out that Happu is also a realty agent and asks Happu to find a home for him. Amma Ji invites the Mishras for the baby shower.

videos.title: Amma Ji Learns That Angoori is Not Pregnant
videos.overview: At the baby shower, as all sing songs and celebrate Angoori's pregnancy, Vibhuti gets up and leaves. As Vibhuti talks to his friend over the phone to find him a home outside his current area, Manmohan overhears him and asks Vibhuti not to leave. Angoori dreams about informing Amma Ji that she is not pregnant and Amma Ji dying. A shocked Angoori informs Manmohan that she is not pregnant. Amma Ji overhears it and consoles Angoori. Manmohan informs the Mishras that Angoori is not pregnant.

videos.title: Vibhuti Steals Mangoes For Angoori
videos.overview: Vibhuti is happy that Angoori is not pregnant. Angoori dreams about and desires to have a specific type of mango. Angoori asks Manmohan to get a box of it. Manmohan calls Tillu and asks him to get the mango from Pratapgarh. During a conversation, Angoori mentions her liking for mango to Vibhuti, and he promises to get it for her. As Vibhuti is unable to find the mango anywhere, he steals it from Tillu when he returns. Tillu remembers the perfume the mango thief wore, and Vibhuti overhears this.

videos.title: Manmohan Suspects Vibhuti Of Stealing Mangoes
videos.overview: Anita assumes that Vibhuti bought the mangoes for her. Vibhuti takes a few mangoes and gives them to Angoori and warns her not to tell Manmohan. Manmohan is shocked to see Angoori walk in with mangoes in her hand. Angoori says that she found them in the kitchen. Manmohan takes Happu to Vibhuti's house to seek his status during the theft. Anita brings a new perfume for Vibhuti. Vibhuti throws the old one, which Happu finds and uses. Happu catches Vibhuti entering Angoori's kitchen with mangoes.

videos.title: Anita Provides Therapy to Manmohan
videos.overview: Anita asks Vibhuti to role-play electrician Rajaram romantically. The Mishras overhear Manmohan shouting. Vibhuti goes to check on Angoori and finds out that, off late, Manmohan has been losing his temper. Anita repreminds Manmohan for shouting at Angoori. Anita addresses his temper issues and offers to provide a therapy, in which he has to remember her face whenever he gets angry, which works for Manmohan. Vibhuti informs Angoori about the therapy and asks her to pretend to be in love with him.

videos.title: Anita Helps Manmohan Calm His Temper
videos.overview: When Manmohan calls Anita and complains about Vibhuti irritating him, she calms him. Vibhuti and Angoori pretend to be in love in front of Manmohan. Manmohan gets very angry when Anita calms him. As Angoori and Manmohan romance at night, Vibhuti pops into the window and irritates Manmohan. Manmohan imagines Anita, which ends his anger. Manmohan pops into Vibhuti's bedroom window and irritates him. Manmohan tries to be around Anita always. Vibhuti informs about Manmohan's behaviour to Angoori.

videos.title: Anita's Manali Trip Lures Manmohan
videos.overview: Vibhuti calls Dr Gupta to treat Manmohan, but the doctor refuses to treat him as Manmohan insults him. As Vibhuti dreams of going to Switzerland with Angoori, Anita tells him that she is visiting Manali for work. Vibhuti refuses to go due to vertigo. Laddoo and Angoori insist that Manmohan vacation with them in Shimla. Manmohan finds out that Anita is going to Manali and decides to go there too. Vibhuti finds out that Angoori is going to Manali. Manmohan informs Anita about his Manali trip.

videos.title: Anita's Trip to Manali Gets Cancelled
videos.overview: Vibhuti refuses to mind Manmohan's shop and decides to go to Manali. While talking to Angoori, Vibhuti pretends to suffer an epileptic attack. The doctor says that Vibhuti's overheated brain needs to go to a cold place like Manali for healing. Anita decides to take Vibhuti. As Anita and the Tiwaris talk about the trip, Anita gets a call to inform that her session in Manali has been shifted to Kanpur and that she has to stay back. Manmohan pretends to hurt his leg, and Angoori cancels their trip.

videos.title: Vibhuti Becomes Bhoja For Angoori
videos.overview: Vibhuti tells Anita that he is fine now. As the Tiwaris and the Mishras talk, Anita gets a call and is told that she has to go to Manali. Suddenly, Manmohan's leg is healed, and Vibhuti feels sick again. As Angoori bathes, Vibhuti comes looking for her. His sneezing shocks Angoori, and she asks him to leave but after giving her the towel. While taking the towel, Vibhuti finds Angoori's diary, which has odd behavioural details about Angoori's childhood love Bhoja. Vibhuti decides to become Bhoja.

videos.title: Bhoja's Shenanigans
videos.overview: As Anita practises for a skit, Manmohan feels that she is shouting at him and starts crying. Vibhuti eats raw garlic like Bhoja, and hence, is ridiculed by Angoori, Manmohan and Anita. Vibhuti gets a snake tattoo inked on his neck like Bhoja and tries to talk to Angoori, but fails. Vibhuti wears a torn vest like Bhoja, and Angoori makes Manmohan give Vibhuti vests for free. Vibhuti sings like Bhoja and mentions Angoori's pet name Laccho as he mumbles to himself, which grabs Angoori's attention.

videos.title: Angoori Brings 'rakhis' For Bhoja
videos.overview: Angoori and Vibhuti are elated to find each other. Angoori informs Manmohan that Vibhuti is Bhoja. Anita and Manmohan are sceptical. Angoori invites the Mishras for dinner, during which Vibhuti and Angoori behave like kids, and Manmohan shouts at Vibhuti. Angoori stops Manmohan from shouting at Vibhuti and calls him her brother and brings 25 'rakhis' for him for all the 25 years of separation. On being called a brother, Vibhuti comes clean that he only pretended to be Bhoja to please Angoori.

videos.title: Vibhuti Decides to Get Angoori's Poetry Book Published
videos.overview: Manmohan does not like Angoori's poem and makes her cry. As Anita reads poems, Manmohan walks in and recites one for her, which she hates. Vibhuti finds an upset Angoori and decides to make her happy by publishing a book of her poems. Vibhuti approaches a publisher to print Angoori's book. The publisher reads Angoori's poems and feels insulted and walks off. He drops a famous poet's book, which Vibhuti finds. When Vibhuti shows it to Anita, she asks him to role-play as a poet.

videos.title: Manmohan Throws a Party For Vibhuti
videos.overview: Manmohan sees Anita hugging a role-playing Vibhuti and comes to her rescue, only to find Vibhuti dressed up as a poet. Anita informs Manmohan that Vibhuti is the famous poet Zalil Kaminpuri. Manmohan informs Angoori about Vibhuti being the famous poet she adores. Angoori waits for Vibhuti the next morning and tells him that she knows who he is. Manmohan decides to make Vibhuti popular as a poet and organises a poetry night at his house for Vibhuti and invites the neighbourhood.

videos.title: Zalil Kaminpuri Exposes Vibhuti's Pretense
videos.overview: Vibhuti compliments Anita and Angoori. Anita does not like one compliment, and she leaves. Vibhuti comforts her and brings her back. All recite their poems. Angoori recites a poem about Manmohan, which offends him. Angoori comforts Manmohan. When Anita recites her poem, no one understands it. When Vibhuti starts reciting Zalil Kaminpuri's poems, Zalil himself turns up, and Vibhuti's truth is revealed. Manmohan warns Anita about a gorilla on the loose and gives her a personal alarm for security.

videos.title: The Attack Of The Gorilla
videos.overview: As Vibhuti irritates Manmohan, he takes the alarm back. Angoori bangs Vibhuti's head, assuming that he is the gorilla. Vibhuti boasts how he is from a hunter's family to Angoori. Manmohan videos the conversation. Pandit Ji asks Manmohan how he plans to protect the neighbourhood. Manmohan suggests that Vibhuti should patrol at night. Manmohan tries to scare a patrolling Vibhuti with gorilla sounds. As Angoori brings tea for Vibhuti, Saxena comes dressed up as a gorilla. Vibhuti faints.

videos.title: Anita Mistakenly Hugs The Gorilla
videos.overview: Vibhuti falls sick. When Manmohan and Happu go to meet him, Anita gets angry with Happu for roaming with a rifle for an innocent animal. Amma Ji asks the Tiwaris to stay with her for a while. Vibhuti decides to get a glimpse of Angoori when he sees the Tiwaris leaving. Vibhuti runs down to them and requests them not to leave. Anita hugs the gorilla under a blanket assuming that it is Vibhuti. The gorilla runs out and scares the Tiwaris. Manmohan tells Anita that he now has a gun for protection.

videos.title: Anita has a Good Time With The Gorilla
videos.overview: As Manmohan gives flowers to Anita, the gorilla beats him up. As the doctor monitors Manmohan, the gorilla attacks Manmohan and gives flowers to Anita. Anita realises that the gorilla has a crush on her. Manmohan decides to kill the gorilla, which upsets Anita. Happu announces in the area that the gorilla has been caught. A sad Anita does not have dinner and goes out. Vibhuti and Manmohan later find her hugging the gorilla. Anita asks Vibhuti to donate blood to her friend's husband.

videos.title: Vibhuti Turns Feminine
videos.overview: During blood donation, Vibhuti is accidentally injected female hormones. As Angoori tries new bangles, Vibhuti boasts about blood donation. When Angoori is busy on a call, Vibhuti wears her bangles. As Anita talks about Vibhuti's manliness to Manmohan, Vibhuti walks in like a woman and shouts femininely at Manmohan. The doctor injects Vibhuti with an antidote but doesn't assure how long it will take to show its effect. Vibhuti wears make-up and earrings. The Tiwaris and Anita are shocked.

videos.title: Vibhuti Gets Harrassed By Men
videos.overview: Vibhuti bargains with the greengrocer and gives Angoori tips on managing her husband. Anita is upset when Manmohan pretends to be Deepu Mastana and identifies him. Vibhuti and Angoori become friends and have feminine conversations. As Teeka, Malkhan and Yaadram Ka Launda harass Vibhuti, Anitas shoos them away. Anita calls the doctor, who informs her about what is happening. Anita decides to accept Vibhuti just the way he is. As Anita and Angoori shop for Vibhuti, he appears in a cowboy outfit.

videos.title: Anita Records an Intimate Video On Her Laptop
videos.overview: Anita asks Vibhuti to role-play as electrician Rajaram and romance her. Anita records their romance on her laptop. Angoori wants to watch a movie on the laptop, but Manmohan is not able to operationalise it. Vibhuti offers to fix the laptop. While daydreaming, Vibhuti ends up spoiling Angoori's laptop and decides to give her his laptop. Anita informs Vibhuti about the video, and he rushes to get the laptop back. Angoori informs him that she has given the laptop to Saxena.

videos.title: Anita and Vibhuti Try to Retrieve Their Laptop
videos.overview: Vibhuti finds Saxena and snatches the laptop from him. Manmohan snatches the laptop from Vibhuti, saying that it is his. Vibhuti tells Anita about the fiasco. Anita engages Manmohan while Vibhuti scouts for the laptop. Laddoo arrives, and Vibhuti jumps from the window without the laptop. Anita directly asks Manmohan to lend his laptop, but he refuses to do so as he has saved her photos in it. Anita sends Vibhuti as a salesman to the Tiwari house to get the old laptop. Vibhuti steals the laptop.

videos.title: Vibhuti Finally Gets The Laptop
videos.overview: Pelu beats Vibhuti and returns the laptop to Manmohan. Laddoo sits to study with the laptop in the balcony when Vibhuti starts playing loud music. When Manmohan confronts him, Anita says that it was her idea. Anita dances, and Manmohan is engaged. Laddoo runs off to play. When Vibhuti is able to grab the laptop, Angoori stops him. Vibhuti gives the excuse of video-calling his old mom and takes the laptop. The Mishras do not find the video in the laptop, and Saxena informs that he had deleted it.

videos.title: Vibhuti Brings a 'cow' For Angoori
videos.overview: Vibhuti dreams that Angoori has moved away. Angoori informs that she plans to stay at Amma Ji's house for a month as she has to pray to a specific type of cow. Vibhuti vows to arrange for the cow in their locality. Anita refers to Manmohan's bad posture and asks him to drink pure cow milk. Vibhuti and Saxena wear a cow's costume and fool Angoori. Manmohan informs Anita about the cow, and she is angry that Vibhuti didn't inform her. Anita rebukes Vibhuti, but he denies buying a cow.

videos.title: Anita Exposes Vibhuti's Plan
videos.overview: Manmohan decides to prove to Anita that Vibhuti has a cow. As Angoori prays, Manmohan decides to milk the cow. Manmohan is unable to find its teats and pulls Saxena's finger. Manmohan gets Saxena's ring and assumes that the cow is magical. When Manmohan shows the gold ring to Vibhuti, Saxena snatches it back. Manmohan milks the cow and finds a watch this time. The Tiwaris set Vibhuti up to show the cow to Anita. When the cow arrives, Anita finds Vibhuti underneath the costume.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan Get Fake Moustaches
videos.overview: During a conversation, Angoori informs Vibhuti that she likes men with dense moustaches. Anita informs Manmohan that she hates men with moustaches. Manmohan asks Angoori if he can shave his moustache, and Angoori warns him not to. Vibhuti asks Anita if he can keep a moustache, and Anita shouts at him. Vibhuti and Manmohan see Saxena putting on a fake moustache. Vibhuti decides to borrow from him, and Manmohan also decides to shave his and borrow a fake one to wear in front of Angoori.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan's Moustache Troubles
videos.overview: Vibhuti sticks the fake moustache to his face while Manmohan shaves his off. Vibhuti tries to remove the fake mustache but fails as Saxena had given him furniture glue. Vibhuti covers his face and tells Anita that he has an oral infection. Manmohan accidentally drops the fake moustache in the toilet and covers his face. Anita and Angoori decide to respect their spouses' wish regarding moustaches. Vibhuti shows his moustache to an indifferent Angoori. Manmohan decides to come clean to Angoori.

videos.title: Manmohan Gets 'chickenpox'
videos.overview: Angoori decides to shave Manmohan's moustache, but is shocked to see it already shaved. Anita gets a fake moustache but is shocked to see Vibhuti already with one. Vibhuti sneaks into Manmohan's bedroom and makes chickenpox marks on his face. The next day, Vibhuti and Angoori wake Manmohan up and find that he has chickenpox. Vibhuti tells Angoori to stay away from Manmohan and vows to take care of Manmohan by locking him up in his room. Vibhuti informs Anita about Manmohan's health.

videos.title: Vibhuti Plans to Go For a Movie With Angoori
videos.overview: Anita is scared to contract chickenpox and avoids seeing Manmohan. Angoori asks Vibhuti to help her feed Manmohan. Vibhuti feeds Manmohan and informs Angoori that Manmohan wants them to go for a movie. As Vibhuti and Angoori leave for the cinema, Manju, Vibhuti's mom, arrives. Anita and Vibhuti are shocked to see Manju. Vibhuti tells Manju to go back until Manmohan's chickenpox is cured. After sending Manju away, as Vibhuti and Angoori are about to leave for the movie, Amma Ji arrives.

videos.title: Vibhuti Plans to Become Jholewale Baba
videos.overview: Happu tells Anita about a robbery in the area and Vibhuti sneaking out that night. Amma Ji goes for the movie alone. When Anita asks Vibhuti about sneaking out at night, Vibhuti takes Anita to the Tiwari house to come clean. Vibhuti tells that he did it to save Manmohan from the goons who were going to beat him. Vibhuti finds Anita's ring while doing laundry and hides it. Vibhuti sees Angoori pray to Jholewale Baba and overhears her awaiting his reincarnation and decides to be the reincarnation.

videos.title: Vibhuti Convinces Everyone With His Act
videos.overview: Anita tells Manmohan that she hates men who don't help their wives understand love. Vibhuti pretends to talk to Angoori's plants like Jholewale Baba, and Angoori deems that he is the one. Anita doesn't believe it though. Manmohan buys a book on pleasing one's wife from Teeka to prove Anita wrong. Vibhuti tells Angoori to stay away from Manmohan for 37 days. Vibhuti hides Anita's ring under the carpet and pretends to find it through mind power. Anita agrees that he is Jholewale Baba.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Quirky Solutions
videos.overview: Manmohan tries to come close to Angoori, but she avoids him as per Vibhuti's instructions. Angoori locks him up overnight in the bathroom. Since Jholewale Baba is known to make trees grow just by talking to them, Vibhuti exchanges Angoori's small plant with a huge one to make her belief in him stronger. Angoori tells the neighbourhood about Vibhuti's miracle. Vibhuti holds a session for everyone where he gives quirky solutions to everyone's problems. Manmohan also joins later to find the truth.

videos.title: Vibhuti Gets Caught Red-handed
videos.overview: Manmohan checks Vibhuti's knowledge, but Vibhuti manages it somehow. Anita cooks chicken, but Angoori brings fruits for Vibhuti as Jholewale Baba is a vegetarian. Vibhuti gives some fruits to Anita and asks her to keep the chicken in the fridge. As Vibhuti sneaks into the kitchen at night to eat chicken, he is caught red-handed. Vibhuti dreams about skating with Angoori. Anita tells Manmohan a story about a woman killing a man who eyes her. Saxena instigates Angoori into hitting him.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan Hide Saxena's Body
videos.overview: Angoori hits Saxena on the head, and he faints. Vibhuti confirms that Saxena is dead. The Tiwaris and the Mishras wonder what to do with the dead Saxena, who is actually fast asleep. Vibhuti suggests that Manmohan take the blame. Vibhuti and Manmohan sneak out of the house at night to get rid of the body but are videoed by Teeka and Malkhan. They return home and decide to do something the next day. As Manmohan hides Saxena under the bed, Angoori calls Happu and informs her about the crime.

videos.title: Anita and Angoori Confess About The Murder
videos.overview: Happu arresting Angoori turns out to be Vibhuti's dream. Angoori calls Amma Ji and tries to inform her about the murder, but Amma Ji can't hear. Happu arrives looking for Saxena, who is a witness in his corruption case, as Saxena was last seen with Manmohan. Manmohan denies knowing Saxena's location, and Happu leaves. Vibhuti and Manmohan make Saxena wear a burqa to take him out. They lose and find him. Anita and Angoori inform Happu about the murder. Happu cries as he has lost his only witness.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Angoori Start a Catering Business
videos.overview: Happu decides to arrest the Tiwaris and the Mishras when Saxena wakes up. Pelu comes to Vibhuti's home and seeks his pending cash. Anita feels embarrassed and rebukes Vibhuti for being jobless. As Manmohan is stressed about his business, Angoori suggests that he advertise. Manmohan rejects her idea and refers to her as stupid. An upset Vibhuti and Angoori decide to start a catering business. Vibhuti tells Angoori to seek INR 10000 from Manmohan. Angoori is able to get the money from Manmohan.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Angoori's Business Takes Off
videos.overview: Vibhuti and Angoori advertise their business and hire Saxena as a delivery boy. Manmohan asks Angoori for food, but she is busy with Vibhuti in her business. As Vibhuti talks on the phone, Anita reminds him of the house chores, but he refuses to do them. Angoori is busy talking to Vibhuti and asks Manmohan to take the food himself. Manmohan wants to romance Angoori, but she keeps getting calls from Vibhuti. An annoyed Manmohan tells him to call in the morning. Vibhuti gets a gold ring for Anita.

videos.title: Manmohan's Plan Backfires
videos.overview: As Anita thinks about Vibhuti, Manmohan arrives, and they discuss how busy their partners are. Manmohan adds loose-motion medicine to the tiffin meant for Happu to disrupt the catering business. Angoori replaces Happu's tiffin with Manmohan's by mistake, and he ends up eating Happu's food. Manmohan falls sick. Manmohan feels bad and decides to be supportive. Even Anita decides to be so and informs it to Manmohan. Angoori feels bad about not spending time with Manmohan and stops her business.

videos.title: Angoori Suspects Manmohan Of Having an Affair
videos.overview: Angoori assumes that Manmohan sings for her in his sleep, but later finds out that it is for someone else. Angoori tells Vibhuti about Manmohan singing for someone else, and they plan to record it and query him. Manmohan receives a call from a man, Sweety, who is a fan of his business and adores him. Angoori overhears the conversation and assumes that Sweety is Manmohan's lover. Angoori calls Vibhuti and tells him about Sweety. Anita overhears and assumes that Vibhuti has an affair with Sweety.

videos.title: Vibhuti Plans to Find Out About Manmohan's Girlfriend
videos.overview: Manmohan wants to romance Angoori, but she refuses to do so. Anita tries to be romantic with Vibhuti, but he is uninterested. Manmohan starts singing. Angoori calls Vibhuti and Anita assumes that it is Sweety. Vibhuti and Angoori try to record and find out who Manmohan is singing for. Angoori informs Amma Ji about Manmohan's affair, and she decides to come home. Vibhuti tells Manmohan that he has a girlfriend to find out about Manmohan's girlfriend, but Manmohan denies having one.

videos.title: Sweety Visits Manmohan and Angoori
videos.overview: Manmohan informs Anita about Vibhuti's lover. Vibhuti suggests to Angoori that she pretend to have an affair on the phone. Angoori calls Vibhuti and pretends to have an affair with some Raj. Anita overhears Vibhuti pretending to be Raj and removes him from the house. Manmohan is sad about Angoori's affair. Amma Ji beats Manmohan and removes him from the house. Vibhuti and Manmohan discuss why they were removed. Sweety comes to meet Manmohan and Angoori. Anita and Angoori realise the confusion.

videos.title: Manmohan's Dramatic Performance
videos.overview: Anita and Angoori apologise to their spouses. As Anita watches Vibhuti's old drama videos, Manmohan asks what she likes about it. Anita tells him that Vibhuti is an artist, and Manmohan lacks drama-based knowledge. Manmohan decides to prove her wrong. As Saxena discusses a TV show revolving around a bad husband with Malkhan, Manmohan asks Saxena to lend him the script. Manmohan asks Angoori to enact the script with him at night. The Mishras overhear and assume that Manmohan is torturing Angoori.

videos.title: The Mishras Call Happu to Help Angoori
videos.overview: When Vibhuti asks Angoori what happened the previous night, she tells him that she was studying. Manmohan tells Anita that he and Angoori played chess then. Manmohan asks Vibhuti to teach him angry expressions, which angers Vibhuti. Manmohan assumes that Vibhuti is teaching him. As the Tiwaris enact the script, Angoori shrieks on seeing a mouse. Manmohan picks a stick to hit the mouse. Assuming that Manmohan is hitting Angoori, the Mishras call Happu, who finds the Tiwari house's state alright.

videos.title: Manmohan's Act is Exposed
videos.overview: Angoori buys costly okra for Manmohan. Vibhuti tells Angoori not to love an abusive husband so much, but she says that Manmohan is good. Manmohan asks Anita to lend Vibhuti's leather belt, but she refuses to do so. The Mishras feel that Manmohan will use the belt to hit Angoori and decide to save her. As Manmohan ties up Angoori and starts enacting, Amma Ji, the Mishras and Happu barge in. Amma Ji beats up Manmohan. The Tiwaris clarify that they were just acting. Anita lauds Manmohan's acting.

videos.title: Manmohan Incites Anita to Divorce Vibhuti
videos.overview: Anita trips over Vibhuti's slippers and shouts at him for being careless. They shout at each other. Anita removes Vibhuti from the home. As Manmohan and Angoori behave playfully with each other, Vibhuti seeks shelter. Manmohan decides to mediate, but instead instigates Anita by saying that Vibhuti wants a divorce. Anita decides to divorce him first and asks Manmohan to get a lawyer. Manmohan finds out that Saxena is a lawyer. Manmohan informs Vibhuti that Anita wants a divorce.

videos.title: Anita Gives Divorce Notice to Vibhuti
videos.overview: Saxena discusses the divorce with Anita and gives its notice to Vibhuti. Vibhuti gets nightmares, because of which Laddoo asks him to leave his room. Vibhuti goes to Angoori, and they exchange places. Manmohan tries to hug Vibhuti, assuming that he is Angoori. Manju calls Anita to talk to Vibhuti, but Anita does not inform her about the divorce. Manmohan wants to use the loo, but Vibhuti is occupying it. Anita is on call with her friend when she mentions her birthday. Manmohan overhears it.

videos.title: Manmohan Tries to Break Anita and Vibhuti's Marriage
videos.overview: Vibhuti buys roses for Anita, but is scared to give them to her. Manmohan offers to give them on Vibhuti's behalf. Manmohan takes the roses, but wishes Anita himself and says that Vibhuti has forgotten her birthday. He tells her to have a party to make Vibhuti feel bad. Manmohan tells Vibhuti that Anita tore his card and asks him to attend the party to make her feel bad. Manmohan throws a party where Vibhuti sings a betrayal song. Anita runs out, and Manmohan consoles her. Anita returns dancing.

videos.title: The Mishras' and Tiwaris' Plan For Monsoon
videos.overview: Angoori cries because of the separation involving the Mishras. Manmohan decides to patch them up and calls Anita and informs that Vibhuti has consumed poison and vice versa. The Mishras end up getting back together. It is thundering, and Vibhuti wants to get wet in the rain with Angoori. Angoori refuses at first as Manmohan hates rains, but then agrees. Anita shares her desire to have home-made onion fritters with Manmohan as Vibhuti does not cook it well. Manmohan promises to cook for her.

videos.title: Manmohan Makes Fritters For Anita
videos.overview: Anita agrees to eat fritters only when it rains. Manmohan sends Angoori to rest and makes fritter batter under the pretext of helping her. Vibhuti tells Anita that he is practising to dance with her. When it starts raining, Vibhuti runs towards Angoori while Manmohan runs towards Anita with fritter batter. Angoori prays and tells Vibhuti to wait. By the time that Angoori is done, and Manmohan starts frying fritters, the rain stops. Vibhuti and Manmohan catch each other leaving the other's house.

videos.title: The Rain Spoils Manmohan and Vibhuti's Plan
videos.overview: Angoori sends Manmohan to bathe. Anita books movie tickets to go with Vibhuti, but he refuses to go with her, and runs out when it starts raining. Vibhuti takes Angoori out to dance and locks Manmohan up in the room. Just when Angoori steps out, it stops raining. Manmohan hears the rain and wants to rush to Anita in a soapy state, but is locked up. Angoori calls Amma Ji and informs about Manmohan's sudden love for rains. Anita and Angoori are not at home when it rains unexpectedly.

videos.title: Vibhuti Becomes a Millionaire
videos.overview: Angoori dances in the rain but Vibhuti is unable to see or join her as he is suffering from high fever. Manmohan gets some fritters for Anita but she declines due to her diet. Angoori informs Vibhuti and Saxena that Manmohan is buying a car. Saxena goes on a vacation to England. Anita receives calls from Vibhuti's creditors and she rebuked him. A lawyer arrives and informs that Vibhuti's late uncle has left him property worth INR 25 crores. The Tiwaris find out that Vibhuti is a millionaire.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Anita Show-off Their Wealth
videos.overview: Anita makes calls to buy cars and homes. Vibhuti plans to buy a kabaddi team but Anita tells him to wait till the money is received. He gifts Anita a diamond ring. Manju informs Anita about her dream where Vibhuti had become rich. Anita decides not to tell Manju that her dream has come true. The Mishras distribute clothes to the poor when Happu arrives and offers security to them. Manmohan calls his rich relatives to find out if anyone is dead. Vibhuti interviews the neighbours to hire servants.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Servants Mistreat Manmohan
videos.overview: Vibhuti brings an expensive saree for Angoori which she decides to gift to Ammaji. Tillu asks for his pending salary from Manmohan, while Vibhuti pays him more than his salary and hires him as his secretary. Vibhuti continues to purchase things on credit, making Anita scared. A money lender lends Vibhuti INR 10 Lac and Anita is stressed. Vibhuti invites the Tiwaris for dinner. When the Tiwaris go to the Mishras house for dinner, all the servants along with Vibhuti mistreat Manmohan.

videos.title: Manmohan Offers to Pay Off Vibhuti's Debts
videos.overview: Manmohan has a dying rich step-uncle and he waits for him to die. According to Vibhuti's uncle's will, Vibhuti is left with a debt of INR 2.5 lakhs and no property. Vibhuti falls in a huge debt and Manmohan offers to pay his debt as he is going to be rich. Angoori cures Manmohan's uncle and Manmohan gets nothing. Anita's friend brings her dog, Ravi, for her to keep for five days. Vibhuti hates dogs. Vibhuti tells Angoori to stop Manmohan's food for him to develop his muscles.

videos.title: Anita Gets a Dog
videos.overview: Angoori is allergic to dogs. Anita is feeding Ravi when Vibhuti arrives so she hides Ravi. The Mishras are fast asleep when Ravi enters their bed and Vibhuti finds out that Ravi is at home. Vibhuti sleeps in the veranda and Angoori asks him the reason. When Vibhuti informs her about Ravi, she tells him to stay away. Manmohan comes to meet Anita and Ravi smells his feet. Ravi ends up biting Manmohan. Happu comes to warn Anita about the chain snatchers when Ravi scares him.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan Plan to Get Rid Of Ravi
videos.overview: Ravi bites Happu and Manmohan. Doctor Gupta informs Manmohan that he has to behave like a dog to befriend a dog. When Manmohan practices to behave like a dog Angoori assumes he is becoming one and decides to cure him. Manmohan tries to befriend Ravi but gets bitten. On Ammaji's recommendation, Angoori gives Manmohan an iron rod burn to cure him. Angoori throws Manmohan out of the house because of the dog smell. Vibhuti and Manmohan kidnap Ravi and give him to Saxena. Anita looks for Ravi.

videos.title: Vibhuti Creates a Chatbook Account
videos.overview: Anita threatens to leave if Ravi is not found. Vibhuti and Manmohan ask Saxena to return Ravi but he is lost. They confess about their deed to Anita. Saxena arrives with Ravi and informs that he was hiding in his home. Anita asks Vibhuti to start a chatbook account. Vibhuti creates Angoori's account on chatbook to chat with her. Anita wants to create an advertisement for her classes. Vibhuti refuses to act in the advertisement but Manmohan agrees to do it. Angoori takes Ladoo's help to chat.

videos.title: Vibhuti Misleads Angoori
videos.overview: Ladoo sends rude replies to Vibhuti's messages and Vibhuti is confused why Angoori is being rude. Saxena explains to Teeka and Malkhan about copywriting and Manmohan asks Saxena to teach him modelling. Angoori asks Vibhuti to come online at night. Ladoo continues to post rude replies to Vibhuti and compliments Manmohan. Vibhuti pretends to be Angelina and chats with Angoori. He informs Angoori that he is Manmohan's girlfriend. Manmohan dresses differently and Angoori assumes it is for Angelina.

videos.title: Vibhuti Incites Angoori Against Manmohan
videos.overview: Vibhuti asks Manmohan to add a cap to complete his look. Angoori stops going online and Vibhuti tells her not to be scared of Angelina. While chatting as Angelina, Vibhuti informs Angoori that she has gifted Manmohan a cap. Manmohan walks in wearing the cap. Angoori questions Manmohan about the cap and he lies to her. Vibhuti keeps flowers in Tiwari's lawn with a card with Angelina's name to make Angoori angry. Angelina is invited by Anita to play the lead in the advertisement.

videos.title: Manmohan's Health Report
videos.overview: Manmohan and Angelina sit on a bike as a part of their shoot. Angoori stops them but Anita explains the situation. They wonder who has falsely defamed Manmohan. Manmohan approaches Anita with a backache and she makes Vibhuti kick him as a therapy. The doctor comes with Manmohan's bad health reports while Vibhuti's reports are perfect. Manmohan bribes the doctor to inform the Mishras that Vibhuti has diabetes. As a religious ritual, Angoori plans to laugh the entire day at anything said to her.

videos.title: Anita Stops Vibhuti From Eating Sweets
videos.overview: Teeka and Malkhan bring sweets for Vibhuti. Manmohan eats all the sweets. Vibhuti tries to steal the pastries from the fridge but Anita gives away the pastries to Manmohan who eats them in front of Vibhuti. Vibhuti goes to Angoori and requests her for some sweets when Manmohan arrives and eats the piece that Angoori was offering Vibhuti. Vibhuti and Manmohan fight and Happu decides to arrest Vibhuti. Anita stops Happu. Anita locks Vibhuti to stop him from eating sweets. Manju arrives.

videos.title: Manmohan Gets Diabetes
videos.overview: Anita lies to Manju that Vibhuti is not at home. Manmohan informs Manju that Vibhuti is upstairs and she is angry with Anita for lying. Anita informs Manju about Vibhuti's diabetes. Vibhuti tricks Anita into opening the door and runs away with the sweets. Saxena stops Vibhuti from eating the sweets and they fight while Manmohan polishes off the sweets. Manmohan faints and the doctor informs that he has diabetes. Anita finds Vibhuti's original reports that state that Vibhuti is healthy.

videos.title: Vibhuti Invests Money In Prem's Buisness
videos.overview: Vibhuti's friend Prem, a rich investor, decides to meet him. As the Tiwaris and Manmohan talk about his income, Prem arrives. Prem makes fun of Vibhuti. Vibhuti decides to invest and become rich and asks Angoori to choose a company to invest in as he feels that she is lucky for him. Vibhuti earns a good profit. Manmohan assumes that Anita is lucky for Vibhuti and decides to invest in a company Anita selects. Vibhuti informs Anita about the profit and his further plans. Anita is sceptical.

videos.title: Vibhuti Sells Anita's Necklace
videos.overview: Vibhuti steals Anita's necklace and uses it as a collateral to buy more shares. Vibhuti warns Manmohan that the company he is investing in is not profitable. Manmohan has second thoughts, but his inner voice tells him to go ahead. Vibhuti suffers a loss and decides to kill himself, but stops for Angoori. Manmohan profits and takes sweets for Anita and informs her about Vibhuti's loss. Vibhuti denies investing any money. Vibhuti is shocked to see that Manmohan has gifted Angoori Anita's necklace.

videos.title: Vibhuti Tries to Steal Anita's Necklace
videos.overview: Anita loves Angoori's necklace and asks Vibhuti to show Angoori the same one she has. Vibhuti diverts them. Vibhuti decides to borrow money from Saxena. As Vibhuti tells Saxena everything, Manmohan overhears them. Manmohan tells Vibhuti to steal the necklace. Angoori sees Vibhuti stealing and shouts. Pelu catches Vibhuti. Vibhuti comes clean to Anita, who tells that the necklace was a cheap fake. Angoori and Vibhuti read news about a vigilante, who bests men who torture their wives.

videos.title: Manmohan Gets Vibhuti Thrashed By The Vigilante
videos.overview: Anita wants to meet the vigilante. Manmohan tells her to write a letter to the vigilante about Vibhuti and use it to meet him. Anita agrees. Manmohan imagines being the vigilante and winning Anita's heart. Manmohan brings holy seeds for Anita and Angoori and asks Angoori to call Anita over alone. The Tiwaris gift the seeds to Anita. Manmohan leaves the women alone and locks them in. Manmohan calls Vibhuti outside. Vibhuti gets beaten by the vigilante. Anita loses a chance to meet the vigilante.

videos.title: Vibhuti Writes a Letter to Get Back At Manmohan
videos.overview: Manju is shocked to see Vibhuti wounded. Anita accepts that she wrote the letter on Manmohan's suggestion. As Teeka and Malkhan talk about girls, the vigilante arrives and beats them. The vigilante is Saxena. Manmohan asks Angoori to not write a letter about him if Vibhuti insists. Vibhuti tries to instigate Angoori vainly. Saxena sees Vibhuti writing a letter against Manmohan. Vibhuti brings a gift for Angoori and asks Anita to call her over alone. Vibhuti leaves the women alone.

videos.title: Anita Meets The Vigilante
videos.overview: As Vibhuti and Manmohan talk, the vigilante comes and batters Vibhuti. All are confused as to why Vibhuti was beaten up again. When Anita and Angoori talk about the vigilante, Manmohan overhears that Anita wants to hug the vigilante. When Manmohan calls up Vibhuti as the vigilante, Anita snatches the phone from him. Manmohan vows to meet Anita at night. Saxena overhears Manmohan's conversation. Manmohan comes as the vigilante. Anita asks for selfies with the vigilante, and he offers to hug her.

videos.title: Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hain - Episode 121 - August 17, 2015 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hain! will take you to the lively lanes of Kanpur and introduce two distinctly different neighbouring couples. Produced by Edit II,the sitcom promises rib-tickling comedy while bringing forth human tendencies.

videos.title: Happu Arrests Manmohan For Making Fun Of Him
videos.overview: Anita feels that her sense of humour is bad. Manmohan cracks a joke about spouses to prove her wrong but ends up enraging her. Manmohan runs away. As Saxena prepares for a lecture on sense of humour, Manmohan approaches and asks for help. He makes fun of Manmohan and upsets him. Anita tells a joke to Vibhuti and gets a lukewarm response, which makes her upset. Manmohan approaches Saxena and thinks that sense of humour is in making fun of others. He starts making fun of Happu and gets arrested.

videos.title: Anita and Angoori's Bad Jokes
videos.overview: Anita and Angoori decide to exchange their jokes to make their husbands laugh. Anita shares Angoori's joke with Vibhuti but he doesn't laugh. Angoori informs Ammaji about Manmohan not liking her jokes. Ammaji asks Angoori to put her on hold and share a joke with Manmohan. When Manmohan doesn't laugh, Ammji reprimands him. Vibhuti and Manmohan make a deal. They go to their respective wives and insist on hearing their jokes. The wives are happy to hear them laugh on their jokes.

videos.title: Vibhuti Gets X-ray Sunglasses
videos.overview: Angoori cooks wearing sunglasses and informs Vibhuti that Manmohan has got conjunctivitis. Prem gifts Vibhuti x-ray sunglasses which can make you see through the clothes. Vibhuti decides to see Angoori through the sunglasses but his inner voice stops him. Ammaji gives the home remedy of applying cow dung on Manmohan's eye to Angoori. Anita visits the Tiwaris and Manmohan hides his conjunctivitis. Vibhuti is about to throw away the x-ray sunglasses when he bangs into Saxena and loses them.

videos.title: Vibhuti Tells Anita About The X-ray Sunglasses
videos.overview: Vibhuti stops Anita from going to the market as he is scared that someone will look at her using the x-ray sunglasses. Presuming that they are the x-ray sunglasses, Vibhuti drops his basket when he sees the vegetable vendor wearing sunglasses and talking to Angoori. Vibhuti snatches Happu's sunglasses and runs away. Vibhuti sees Teeka and Malkhan wearing sunglasses and staring at Anita from the balcony and beats them. Vibhuti reveals the truth to an angry Anita. Manmohan overhears them.

videos.title: Prem Reveals The Truth About The X-ray Sunglasses
videos.overview: Manmohan tells Angoori about Vibhuti's x-ray sunglasses which makes her avoid Vibhuti. Vibhuti dreams that men wearing x-ray sunglasses are chasing him. Manmohan finds the x-ray sunglasses and using them, decides to see Anita but his inner voice stops him. Angoori overhears Manmohan talking to himself about possessing the x-ray sunglasses and informs the Tiwaris. Both the women rebuke their husbands. Prem arrives and informs them that the x-ray sunglasses were fake.

videos.title: Manmohan Uses The Lie-detector
videos.overview: Happu keeps a lie-detector at Manmohan's house until the police station gets painted and teaches Manmohan how to use it. Pelu drops Anita and asks a high fare for the ride. Anita tells him that he is lying when Manmohan intervenes and offers to test with his lie-detector. Pelu proves to be truthful. Vibhuti dreams about the lie-detector and Angoori. Anita refuses to give the clothes to the laundryman as he uses a sub-standard detergent but he denies the allegation.

videos.title: Anita Tests Vibhuti With The Lie-detector
videos.overview: The Mishras and the Tiwaris test the laundryman's honesty with the lie-detector and find out that he is using a sub-standard detergent. Next, the wives decide to test the lie-detector on their husbands and Manmohan goes in first. Angoori asks him simple questions so he passes the test. Anita asks Vibhuti twisted questions but he also passes. When she finally asks if she is the only woman Vibhuti loves, he pretends to get an epileptic attack making Anita decide to test him once he is well.

videos.title: Angoori and Anita Kick Their Husbands Out
videos.overview: Manmohan finds the way to tweak the lie detector's result from Happu. Vibhuti bribes Happu to take the machine away but Happu gets called by his boss so he is unable to help Vibhuti. Anita asks Vibhuti if he only loves her and his answer is detected as a lie. Anita throws Vibhuti from the house which makes Manmohan happy. Angoori also decides to test Manmohan with the same question and Manmohan fails the test and Angoori too throws him out of the house.

videos.title: Anita and Angoori Buy Rakhis
videos.overview: Manmohan and Vibhuti decide to take Happu's help to win their wives back. They bribe Happu to tell their wives that the machine is faulty. Happu informs Anita and Angoori that the machine is faulty and even provides a demonstration. Anita and Angoori repent. Vibhuti dedicates a love song for Angoori on the radio but accidentally a brotherly song is played. Saxena sells 'rakhis' and Anita and Angoori decide to tie 'rakhis' to the men in the area who look like their brothers.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan's Attempts to Avoid Rakhi
videos.overview: To avoid 'Raksha Bandhan' celebrations with Anita, Manmohan plans to leave for Aligarh. To ensure his escape, Manmohan rushes towards the door but falls and sprains his right leg. Vibhuti jumps off his balcony in the middle of the night and runs away in Pelu's rickshaw. But Pelu drops him back home. Meanwhile, Manmohan convinces Saxena to crash his bicycle into him, but Angoori saves him. Manmohan and Vibhuti carry out all kinds of shenanigans to avoid being tied a 'rakhi' by Anita and Angoori.

videos.title: The Mishras Visit Tiwaris For Raksha Bandhan
videos.overview: Manmohan dreams that Anita forcibly ties a rakhi around his wrist. So, Manmohan fakes an epileptic attack, and a doctor is called. Manmohan gives up his act when the doctor pulls out an injection. Vibhuti hides in his house, and Happu tries to help Anita find him. Happu finds him hiding in his fridge, but Vibhuti bribes him to shut him up. Yet, Happu tells Anita where he is hiding. Anita and Vibhuti visit Angoori's house for 'Raksha Bandhan'. What happens next surprises both of them.

videos.title: Manmohan Arranges a Job For Vibhuti
videos.overview: Angoori tells Vibhuti that she is fasting for 'Karva Chauth'. Anita wants Vibhuti to work as a peon, but Vibhuti disagrees. Manmohan finds a job for Vibhuti in Dubai as a sheikh's accountant-cum-personal assistant for INR one lakh a month. Angoori can't break her fast as she is unable to see the moon in the sky. Vibhuti climbs up a tree to show Angoori a lunar image and break her fast. Saxena sees Vibhuti in the tree and stones his ear. Vibhuti's hearing ability is affected.

videos.title: Vibhuti Loses His Hearing Ability
videos.overview: Manmohan brings the sheikh to Vibhuti's house. The sheikh interviews Vibhuti, but Vibhuti mishears all the queries due to his poor hearing. Anita and Manmohan discover Vibhuti's poor hearing, and she calls a doctor. The doctor gives eardrops to Vibhuti that deafen him. Happu seeks Vibhuti's advice, but he misunderstands and shoots Happu's gun in the air. When Vibhuti visits Angoori's house, she tries to talk to him using sign language. But Vibhuti misunderstands her actions as flirty gestures.

videos.title: Vibhuti Pretends to be Deaf
videos.overview: Angoori applies medicine on Vibhuti's ears, which leads to the recovery of his hearing. Vibhuti pretends to be deaf to find out what people talk behind his back. The sheikh offers to take Vibhuti to Dubai. Vibhuti plans revenge with his pal Leone, an actress. Leone falsely accuses Manmohan of eve teasing. Happu, Anita, and Angoori find out about the incident and ask Vibhuti about it, but he pretends to be deaf. But Vibhuti reveals his plan when Angoori threatens to leave the neighbourhood.

videos.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti Cheat to Get Krishna's Part
videos.overview: Angoori wants Manmohan to play the role of Krishna in Janmashtami celebrations, but he disagrees. Anita wants Vibhuti to portray Krishna, and he disagrees too. Manmohan and Vibhuti find out that Anita and Angoori will portray Rukmini and Radha. Vibhuti and Manmohan want to portray Krishna. But the role of Krishna is assigned to Saxena. Later, Happu, Teeka Ram, Malkhan and Pelu also want to play Krishna. Anita decides to pick chits to select their Krishna. Manmohan and Vibhuti cheat in the game.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Lips Get Burnt
videos.overview: Anita and Angoori find out that Vibhuti and Manmohan cheated in the game. Vibhuti pretends to play a flute with Saxena's help to impress Angoori. Manmohan sabotages his act and gives him an electric shock that burns Vibhuti's lips. Happu injures his left leg while breaking the pot. Manmohan bribes Happu to play the role of Kansa. While Angoori makes butter, a lizard enters her vessel, and Manmohan eats that butter. Anita notices Vibhuti's burnt lips, but he lies about the reason behind it.

videos.title: Angoori Dreams About Vibhuti's Death
videos.overview: Vibhuti spills oil in front of Manmohan's home to stop him from being Krishna. Manmohan and Vibhuti slip due to the oil and hurt themselves. Laddoo plays Krishna in the 'Janmashtami' procession. Later, Angoori has a nightmare that Vibhuti is dead. Angoori is worried about Vibhuti's life. Anita is excited as her uncle will be visiting and wants to surprise Vibhuti. Vibhuti finds out about Angoori's nightmare when she is praying. Vibhuti lies to Angoori that he will die soon to get closer to her.

videos.title: Manmohan Learns About Vibhuti's 'disease'
videos.overview: Angoori tells Manmohan about Vibhuti's disease. Manmohan feels sympathy for Vibhuti. Vibhuti requests Manmohan to hide the news from Anita. Manmohan overhears Anita's phone conversation with a DJ and thinks that she is planning to celebrate Vibhuti's death. Vibhuti tries to flirt with Angoori by taking advantage of his 'health excuse', but fails miserably. Manmohan tells Happu, Teeka Ram and Malkhan that Vibhuti will die soon. Teeka Ram, Malkhan and Happu visit Anita's house.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Lie Gets Exposed
videos.overview: Teeka Ram, Malkhan, Saxena, and Anita prepare for a party. 'Yaadram Ka Launda' plays music, and Anita and Saxena dance to his tunes. Manmohan and Angoori stop them and tell Anita about Vibhuti's health. Vibhuti's drama gets exposed. Anita tells everyone about her uncle's visit. However, Anita's uncle cancels his plan to visit her. Manmohan brings 'jalebis' for Anita, but Vibhuti throws them away. Manmohan gets angry and plans his revenge on Vibhuti after watching a Bollywood movie.

videos.title: Jagmohan's Revenge On Vibhuti
videos.overview: Manmohan robs Vibhuti and forces him to slap himself at knifepoint. When Vibhuti complains about the incident to Angoori, Manmohan lies that he has an evil identical twin, Jagmohan, who did it. Jagmohan enters Vibhuti's house and forces him to slap himself at knifepoint. Anita and Vibhuti visit Angoori's house and threaten to file an FIR.
