But Manmohan convinces Vibhuti that he doesn't need to file a report. Jagmohan strikes again, and he forces Teeka and Malkhan to beat up Vibhuti.

videos.title: Amma Ji Thrashes Manmohan For Lying
videos.overview: Jagmohan enters Vibhuti's house to abuse him, but Anita catches him and batters him. Manmohan goes home, but Angoori thinks that he is Jagmohan and hits him with a pole. Vibhuti calls Amma Ji to complain about Jagmohan. However, Amma Ji denies the existence of Jagmohan. Jagmohan attacks Vibhuti again, but Amma Ji catches him and beats him up with a leather belt. Manmohan reveals that he was lying all along about Jagmohan. Manmohan tries to justify his actions. Amma Ji hits Manmohan again.

videos.title: Vibhuti Gets Kidnapped
videos.overview: Vibhuti finds out that there are kidnappers in his neighbourhood and contemplates disappearing for a few days. Vibhuti pays Teeka and Malkhan to kidnap him. While sitting in his verandah with Anita and Angoori, Vibhuti patiently waits to be kidnapped. Vibhuti gets kidnapped in front of Anita and Angoori. Anita files a kidnapping complaint with Happu's help. Manmohan, Angoori, and Anita decide to wait for the kidnapper's phone call. Vibhuti finds out that he has been actually kidnapped.

videos.title: Angoori Pays Ransom to Vibhuti's Kidnappers
videos.overview: Anita is worried about Vibhuti and waits for the kidnapper's phone call. Teeka and Malkhan reach Anita's house to kidnap Vibhuti, but they find out that he has already been kidnapped. Teeka and Malkhan try to find Vibhuti. The kidnappers call Anita and seek a ransom of INR 50,000. Angoori is asked to carry the money to a specific location. Vibhuti finds out that Saxena has also been kidnapped with him. Angoori pays ransom to the kidnappers. Vibhuti escapes from the kidnappers with Saxena's help.

videos.title: Manmohan's Sudden Affinity For 'chinese'
videos.overview: Manmohan overhears Anita's phone conversation, where she finds out that her great-grandmother was Chinese, and that she likes Chinese men. Manmohan plans to start a Chinese food business with Angoori to impress Anita. Angoori calls Amma Ji and tells her that she finds it difficult to cook Chinese food. Vibhuti suggests to Angoori that he will buy Chinese food from a restaurant and she can serve it to Manmohan. Manmohan lies to Anita that he has a deep relationship with China and knows Chinese.

videos.title: Manmohan Sells Chinese Food
videos.overview: Manmohan dresses up in Chinese attire to sell Chinese food outside his home. Manmohan saves the last two plates for Anita. Anita likes his Chinese food. Manmohan pretends to do kung fu to impress Anita. Manmohan lauds Angoori's cooking and asks her to cook more Chinese food. Vibhuti brings Chinese food for Angoori since she can't cook. Happu objects to Manmohan's business as he doesn't have the license to sell food, but Manmohan bribes him. Anita asks Manmohan about his connection with China.

videos.title: Anita and Manmohan Plan to Watch a Chinese Film
videos.overview: Manmohan practises fake kung fu again. Vibhuti sabotages his practice, which hurts Manmohan. Anita asks Manmohan to break a tube light using kung fu, and they plan to watch a Chinese film together. Vibhuti brings only a few packs of Chinese food as he runs out of money. Manmohan and Anita discuss their movie plan, and Anita's mother calls to tell her that she is not Chinese. Anita rejects Manmohan's offer to watch the Chinese movie. Angoori cooks Chinese food, and Vibhuti praises her cooking.

videos.title: Manmohan Insults Vibhuti For Being Unemployed
videos.overview: Manmohan gifts a vase to Anita, but Vibhuti breaks it accidentally. Manmohan gets angry and insults Vibhuti based on his unemployment. Anita and Angoori are unhappy with Manmohan. Vibhuti tries to borrow money from Prem, Saxena and Happu. However, he fails to persuade them. Angoori calls Amma Ji to complain about Manmohan's behaviour. Amma Ji tells her how to hurt Manmohan. Angoori fakes mood swings to hurt Manmohan. Vibhuti pretends to be a poor labourer to gain Anita's and Angoori's sympathy.

videos.title: Vibhuti Pretends to be a Labourer
videos.overview: Manmohan is concerned as Anita is angry with him. Angoori seduces Manmohan and kicks him out of the bedroom to torment him. Vibhuti continues his drama of being a labourer. Anita is worried about Vibhuti. Manmohan tries to apologise to Anita. Anita and Angoori see Vibhuti sleeping on his bassinet outside his home. Vibhuti pretends to eat lunch like a labourer, and Anita and Angoori offer him well-cooked food, which Vibhuti doesn't eat. Manmohan vows to Anita that he will bring Vibhuti back home.

videos.title: Angoori Suspects That Manmohan Likes Pammi
videos.overview: Manmohan apologises to Vibhuti. Vibhuti's drama gets revealed. Manmohan buys perfume for Anita and places it on her doorstep, but Vibhuti takes credit for buying the perfume. Manmohan feels cheated. A new lady, Pammi, moves into the locality. Teeka, Malkhan and Pelu are attracted to her. Angoori grows suspicious of Manmohan as she thinks that Manmohan is attracted to Pammi. Pammi visits Manmohan's house, and he tries to set her up with Vibhuti. Angoori is jealous of Pammi.

videos.title: Pammi Confesses Her Feelings For Manmohan
videos.overview: Angoori tells Anita and Vibhuti that she is suspicious about Manmohan and Pammi. Vibhuti tries to manipulate Angoori into thinking that she is right about Manmohan. Vibhuti meets Pammi and tries to set her up with Manmohan. Pammi calls Anita's house, which infuriates her. Vibhuti talks to Pammi, and she calls him over. Teeka, Malkhan and Happu vainly try to approach Pammi. Manmohan tells Anita that Vibhuti is at Pammi's house. Pammi tells Vibhuti that she is in love with Manmohan.

videos.title: Pammi Traps Vibhuti and Manmohan
videos.overview: Anita tells Manmohan that she fully trusts Vibhuti. Pammi calls Manmohan and asks him to come over to her place. Pammi reveals that she is in love with Vibhuti. Vibhuti rushes to Angoori's house to tell her that Manmohan is at Pammi's house. Manmohan tries to deny the allegation. Pammi texts Vibhuti and Manmohan and calls them over urgently. Pammi blackmails Vibhuti and Manmohan using the video footage of their interaction. She demands a ransom of INR 10 lakhs within eight hours from both.

videos.title: Anita and Angoori Come to Their Husbands' Rescue
videos.overview: Vibhuti and Manmohan try to convince Anita and Angoori to vacation with them for a few days, but they disagree. Vibhuti tells Anita about the video and the blackmailing attempt. Anita and Angoori are angry with Vibhuti and Manmohan. Anita and Angoori visit Pammi's house and manipulate her into retrieving the videos. They successfully retrieve the videos from Pammi. Happu enters Pammi's house and arrests her. Vibhuti and Manmohan try to leave their house, but Anita and Angoori stop them.

videos.title: Vibhuti Gives Electric Shocks
videos.overview: Anita reads some article in a magazine. Vibhuti criticises the article. Manmohan sees Vibhuti and Anita kissing and interrupts them. Saxena tells Manmohan about a chip that gives electric shocks. Manmohan installs the chip in Vibhuti's watch when he is sleeping. Vibhuti accidentally gives electric shocks to Laddoo, Manmohan and Angoori. Vibhuti realises that his body transmits electric currents. Anita reads another article. Vibhuti gives an electric shock to Anita purposely.

videos.title: Vibhuti Installs a Chip In Manmohan's Glasses
videos.overview: Vibhuti gives an electric shock to Saxena. Saxena realises that Vibhuti has his chip. The electricity supply to Angoori's house gets disrupted. Vibhuti uses his powers to start Angoori's mixer grinder. Anita constantly pushes Vibhuti away due to his electric shocks. Vibhuti realises that his watch is culpable for the electricity. Vibhuti finds the chip in his watch. Vibhuti climbs into Manmohan's bedroom and installs the chip in his glasses. Manmohan gives an electric shock to Angoori and Tillu.

videos.title: Anita and Angoori Punish Their Husbands
videos.overview: Manmohan tries to find the chip but fails. Angoori kicks Manmohan out of the bedroom due to the electric shocks. Manmohan tells Anita and Vibhuti about his problem, and Anita asks him to leave as she thinks that his condition is contagious. Angoori hits Manmohan with a stick to get rid of his problem. Manmohan begs Vibhuti to tell him where he hid the chip. Anita and Angoori give electric shocks to Vibhuti and Manmohan. Anita and Angoori reveal that they used the chips to teach them a lesson.

videos.title: Manmohan Lures Vibhuti Into Gambling
videos.overview: Anita expresses disgust after watching the Mahabharata scene, where Yudhishthira gambles away Draupadi. She tells Manmohan that she doesn't allow Vibhuti to gamble. Manmohan sees Malkhan and Saxena playing cards and intervenes. Saxena invites Manmohan over for a game that night. Anita and Vibhuti have an argument about his unemployment. Manmohan manipulates Vibhuti into gambling and calls him over to play with Saxena. Vibhuti goes to Saxena's game, and Manmohan offers him money for gambling.

videos.title: Vibhuti Loses His Independence In Gambling
videos.overview: Vibhuti buys onions for Angoori and gives the greengrocer extra cash in case Anita and Angoori want to buy vegetables in the future. Vibhuti returns to gamble with Saxena, Manmohan, Teeka Ram and Malkhan. Manmohan fixes the game. Vibhuti starts with a big bet. Manmohan increases the bet to INR 1,80,000. As Vibhuti falls short of cash, Manmohan convinces him to bet himself. Vibhuti loses, and Manmohan makes him his servant. Manmohan renames Vibhuti to Hetram and makes him clean his house.

videos.title: Manmohan Mistreats His New Servant
videos.overview: Angoori insults Vibhuti and forces him to work. Vibhuti tells Happu about his loss. Manmohan kicks Vibhuti and makes him work all day. Anita sees Vibhuti carrying a heavy sack to Angoori's home. Manmohan calls Vibhuti at night and orders him to feed stale flatbread to dogs. Anita sees Vibhuti trying to call dogs by barking. Saxena attacks Vibhuti and offers to eat stale flatbread. Angoori finds Vibhuti lying on the road while watering her plants and calls Anita. Vibhuti tells them the full tale.

videos.title: Chhuttan Seeks Shelter At Manmohan's House
videos.overview: Laddoo goes on a school trip. Angoori and Manmohan invite Vibhuti and Anita for dinner as Angoori plans to cook a special dish from Bihar. While watching the news, Anita finds out that a criminal has escaped from Happu's custody with his gun. As Manmohan waits for the arrival of Anita, suddenly, the criminal Chhuttan enters his house. Chhuttan threatens Manmohan and Angoori with a gun and hides at their house. Happu searches for Chhuttan and fears that he might lose his job.

videos.title: Chhuttan Holds The Mishras and Tiwaris Hostage
videos.overview: Vibhuti tries to convince Anita that they should go to Manmohan's house. Happu visits Anita's house to warn her and Vibhuti about the escaped criminal, but Anita insults him for his incompetence. Anita and Vibhuti visit Manmohan's house again for dinner. Manmohan stops them from entering his house. Vibhuti insists on visiting Manmohan's house for dinner. Vibhuti and Anita forcibly enter Manmohan's house and find out that Chuttan is hiding there. They are held hostage by Chhuttan at gunpoint.

videos.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti Look For a Burqa For Chhuttan
videos.overview: Anita plans to help Chhuttan flee by making him wear a burka. Manmohan and Vibhuti try to find a burka, and they spot Saxena in it. They request Saxena to give them his burka, but he disagrees. Anita and Angoori call them back to discuss a new idea for Chhuttan's escape. Anita gives Chhuttan a makeover to make him look like a woman, but their plan fails. They dress up Chhuttan in a burka and sneak him out of the house. Vibhuti and Angoori request Saxena to drop Chhuttan at the Kanpur bus stop.

videos.title: Anita Organises a Blood Donation Camp
videos.overview: Vibhuti has a nightmare, in which Anita turns into a dracula. Anita organises a blood donation camp, and she wishes that Vibhuti participates in it. Happu and the others announce a blood donation camp in their neighbourhood and they laud Anita for her noble deed. Vibhuti lies to Angoori about his past blood donation experience and becomes almost unconscious after getting a small cut. Vibhuti hides at Manmohan's house to escape the camp. Manmohan is excited to donate blood.

videos.title: Vibhuti Hides From The Blood Donation Camp
videos.overview: Happu tells Manmohan that he donated blood. Saxena wishes to donate blood, but the doctor and Anita don't let him do so. Anita is concerned as only a few people showed up for blood donation. Vibhuti hides under Angoori's bed. Vibhuti dreams about romancing Angoori. Manmohan comes home after donating blood and asks Angoori to bring him sweet lemon juice. Vibhuti distracts Angoori and dilutes the juice with water. Manmohan changes his look and calls himself Romeo D'souza to donate blood again.

videos.title: Manmohan Loses Consciousness
videos.overview: Manmohan faints on the street after donating blood. Angoori wakes him up and gets a glass of milk for him. Vibhuti hides at Manmohan's house. Anita calls Vibhuti to ask him where he is, but he lies that his mother is sick and that he is taking care of her. When Vibhuti's mother visits his house, his lie gets exposed. Manmohan dresses up as a woman to donate blood again, but he faints at Anita's house. The doctor says that Manmohan has lost a lot of blood. Vibhuti volunteers to save Manmohan.

videos.title: Anita Prepares For a Night-long Prayer Ceremony
videos.overview: Angoori prepares for a night vigil prayer. Manmohan visits Anita's house to invite them for the prayer and tells them that he can't find a singer for the ceremony. Vibhuti tells Angoori that he sings so well for prayers that a tiger blesses the ceremony. Vibhuti teams up with Saxena and the others for a fake performance. Pandit Ji tells Anita and Manmohan that couples, who attend the prayer jointly, stay together for seven reincarnations. Manmohan plots to keep Vibhuti away from the prayer.

videos.title: A Tiger Appears At The Prayer Ceremony
videos.overview: Vibhuti hosts the night vigil prayer and starts a fake performance with the help of Saxena. Manmohan puts a drug in Anita's sherbet to induce sleep. Everyone starts praying and dancing in the ceremony. Angoori asks Vibhuti about the tiger's appearance at the prayer. Teeka Ram dresses up as a tiger, but some stray dogs chase him. A real tiger comes for the prayer, which shocks all. Happu gets a call saying that a tiger has escaped from a zoo. Angoori and Anita pray to the tiger, and it goes away.

videos.title: Angoori and Anita Compare Their Husbands to Demons
videos.overview: Anita invites Angoori for tea. They go to Anita's home and see that Vibhuti has messed up the living room. Anita and Angoori compare their husbands to Kumbhakarna and Ravana. Manmohan and Vibhuti plan to alter their opinions. Manmohan tries to address Angoori like Lord Ram and tells her that he wants to feed poor people. Manmohan looks for beggars to feed. He offers food to Teeka Ram, Malkhan and Pelu, but they refuse it. Vibhuti hires Teeka Ram and Malkhan to misbehave with florist Sreedevi.

videos.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti Decide to Donate Their Organs
videos.overview: Vibhuti hits the florist's husband, and the florist beats him up. Vibhuti pretends to meditate and ignores Anita. Manmohan ignores Angoori and focuses on his work. Anita and Angoori try to seduce their husbands, but they fail. Vibhuti offers sweets to Laddoo and Angoori and ignores her. Saxena dresses up as an old man and appreciates Manmohan as Manmohan promises to donate his kidneys to the old man. Vibhuti calls the doctor over and tells that he wishes to donate his organs after his death.

videos.title: Anita and Angoori Pretend to be Saints
videos.overview: Manmohan pretends to care about the world and its sorrows. Vibhuti dreams of romancing Angoori. Angoori complains to Amma Ji about Manmohan's behaviour, and she gives her an idea. Anita and Angoori discuss their husbands' weird behaviour. Anita and Angoori pretend to be saints and tell their husbands that they will adopt asceticism. Manmohan and Vibhuti reveal the truth and apologise. Vibhuti and Angoori meet two new people, Rahul and Malti, on the street. Rahul tells them that he is a rockstar.

videos.title: Anita and Angoori Demand a Car From Their Husbands
videos.overview: Angoori wishes to drive a car, and Vibhuti tells her to demand a car from Manmohan. Vibhuti says that he will teach Angoori how to drive. Vibhuti dreams to go on a long drive with Angoori. Angoori tells Manmohan that she wants a car, but he refuses to buy one. Manmohan sees Anita wait for a rickshaw and decides to buy a car to drop her at her grooming class. Manmohan enquires about a second-hand car. Manmohan tells Angoori that he has bought a car. Anita demands a car from Vibhuti.

videos.title: Angoori Hits Happu While Driving a Car
videos.overview: Manmohan drops Anita to her grooming class in his new car. Vibhuti plans to teach Angoori how to drive. Angoori and Vibhuti sneak out of their houses at night. Vibhuti teaches Angoori to drive. Happu hides in a trash can to catch a criminal. Anita sees Manmohan's car speeding on the road. Angoori drives for the first time and crashes into the trash can that Happu is using for hiding. Angoori and Vibhuti return home silently. Happu has multiple injuries and starts looking for the driver.

videos.title: The Mishras and Tiwaris Observe 'karva Chauth' Fast
videos.overview: Happu accuses Manmohan of drunk-driving and crashing into him. Happu tells Angoori about the whole incident, and she reveals that it was her fault. Happu tries to arrest Angoori, but a man interrupts them with a complaint about his stolen car. They all find out that Happu had sold Manmohan a stolen car, and Angoori is not arrested. Vibhuti buys an ice-cream cone for Angoori, but she tells him that she can't eat as she is fasting for 'Karva Chauth'. Vibhuti and Manmohan also fast for their wives.

videos.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti Struggle With Their Fast
videos.overview: Manmohan applies 'mehendi' on Anita's hand and makes a brinjal design. Vibhuti cleans Manmohan's house to help Angoori during her fast. Angoori tells a hungry Manmohan a story to make him forget about hunger. Vibhuti also experiences hunger, and Saxena eats a 'samosa' in front of him. An angry Vibhuti slaps Saxena. Vibhuti gives a prank call to Manmohan and tells him that his shop is on fire. Anita calls Vibhuti to tell him that she sprained her leg. Manmohan returns home as Laddoo is lunching.

videos.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti Wait to Break Their Fast
videos.overview: As Vibhuti tries to eat food from his fridge, Anita catches him. Vibhuti buys sarees for Angoori and Anita. When Manmohan and Angoori leave their house, Vibhuti climbs into their bedroom with her saree using a ladder. Saxena takes his ladder. As Vibhuti tries to escape from another door, Manmohan and Angoori come back home. Vibhuti veils himself using the saree and pretends to be a woman to escape. Manmohan and Vibhuti wait for the moon to rise. Vibhuti plans with Saxena to show a lunar image.

videos.title: Vibhuti Loses His Memory
videos.overview: Teeka Ram and Malkhan sell a lottery ticket to Vibhuti. Angoori attaches a nail to a wall with a hammer. The head of the hammer falls on Vibhuti's head, making him unconscious. Dr Gupta helps restore his consciousness, but Vibhuti loses his memory and can't recognise anyone. Anita meets Vibhuti, and he fails to recognise her. Manmohan tells Anita about the incident, but Vibhuti interrupts and tells them that he is fine. Angoori tells Anita about the incident. Vibhuti loses his memory again.

videos.title: Vibhuti Regains His Memory
videos.overview: To take advantage of Vibhuti's memory loss, Manmohan tells him that he stays in Shikarpur. Anita tries to find Vibhuti and asks Happu to search for him. After Pelu drops a banana peel on the street, Vibhuti slips and bangs his head against a pillar. Happu finds Vibhuti and vainly tries to send him to Shikarpur as Vibhuti regains his memory. Angoori calls Amma Ji, and Vibhuti overhears their conversation about his memory. Vibhuti pretends to have memory loss to gain sympathy from Angoori.

videos.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti Oppose The Flyover's Construction
videos.overview: Anita and Angoori are concerned for Vibhuti. Teeka Ram and Malkhan tell Vibhuti that he has won INR 1 crore in a lottery. Vibhuti's excitement exposes his drama. The lottery inspector informs Teeka Ram that Vibhuti hasn't won the lottery. Vibhuti and Manmohan check out Angoori and Anita from their balconies. Manmohan and Vibhuti find out that a flyover will be constructed in front of their houses. They are angry as the flyover will not let them see Angoori and Anita from their balconies.

videos.title: Manmohan Goes On a Hunger Strike
videos.overview: Vibhuti wishes to stop the flyover construction, and Manmohan tries to manipulate him into protesting. Manmohan and Vibhuti bribe civil engineer Gupta, but he disagrees with their terms. Vibhuti has a nightmare about the constructed flyover. Manmohan and Vibhuti motivate each other to stop the project. They hold a meeting in their locality to manipulate everyone, but they fail miserably. Vibhuti flips a coin to decide who will protest against the construction. Manmohan starts a hunger strike.

videos.title: Manmohan Secretly Eats Biryani
videos.overview: Angoori calls Amma Ji to complain about Manmohan's hunger strike. Angoori brings food for Manmohan, but he doesn't eat it. Saxena invites everyone except Manmohan for a party to celebrate the day he was declared insane. Everyone celebrates and eats 'biryani' at Saxena's party. Manmohan bribes Happu for the 'biryani'. Manmohan eats 'biryani' in the middle of the night. Amma Ji arrives and forcibly feeds Manmohan with Angoori's help. Dr Gupta is called, and he diagnoses Manmohan with overeating.

videos.title: Manmohan Takes Credit For Saxena's Work
videos.overview: Manmohan finds out via the media that a writer is returning his award as a protest. Saxena goes to Manmohan's house and asks Manmohan to keep his literature award with him for two days. Manmohan lies to Anita that he had won an award and takes credit for Saxena's work to impress her. Vibhuti lies to Angoori that he has got hired as a secret agent, who reports writers that return their awards. Manmohan tells that he will return his award to back other writers to impress Anita and her pal Jassi.

videos.title: Anita Organises a Press Conference For Manmohan
videos.overview: Angoori tries to hide Manmohan's award when he is sleeping. Happu visits Manmohan's house in the middle of the night and asks him to recite stories for his kids. Angoori complains to Amma Ji about the whole incident. Happu comes back and tells Manmohan and Angoori that Manmohan's stories sickened his kids. Anita interviews Manmohan about his literary career choices and prepares for a press conference. Vibhuti tries to force Angoori to go for a candlelight dinner with him to save Manmohan.

videos.title: Manmonhan and Vibhuti's Lies Get Revealed
videos.overview: Vibhuti convinces Angoori for a candlelight dinner with him. Manmohan tells Anita that he was lying. A secret agent interrupts Vibhuti and Angoori. He asks for Vibhuti's ID, which exposes Vibhuti's act. Saxena returns to Manmohan's home for his award, and his lie gets revealed to Angoori. Vibhuti overhears Manmohan's conversation about Angoori visiting her native place for Diwali as she is scared of fireworks. Vibhuti breaks Manmohan's phone. Angoori dreams about interacting with Goddess Laxmi.

videos.title: Angoori Turns Into a Kid
videos.overview: Manmohan complains to Anita that Vibhuti broke his phone. Anita tells Manmohan that she loves fireworks. Vibhuti tries to convince everyone in the locality against using fireworks. Manmohan accidentally burns Tillu's face while lighting fireworks. As Vibhuti tries to convince Angoori to stay, suddenly, Teeka Ram and Malkhan burst firecrackers to scare him. Angoori faints due to the sound of fireworks. Angoori mentally turns into a six-year-old kid and fails to recognise Vibhuti and Manmohan.

videos.title: The Tiwaris and Mishras Celebrate Diwali
videos.overview: Angoori constantly cries and annoys Manmohan. Angoori's condition saddens Vibhuti and Manmohan. Teeka Ram and Malkhan try to ask for money from Vibhuti and Manmohan, but they beat up Teeka Ram and Malkhan. Angoori, Saxena and Pelu team up to prank Teeka Ram, Malkhan, Happu, and Anita. Amma Ji visits Manmohan's house as she is worried about Angoori. Manmohan is concerned about Angoori. Vibhuti, Anita, Amma Ji and Laddoo celebrate Diwali. Amma Ji helps Angoori recover using a medicine.

videos.title: Bhoory Lal Comes to Visit Angoori
videos.overview: Manmohan repairs his radio. Manmohan and Angoori play the radio and dance. Angoori's father Bhoorey Lal comes to meet her but refuses to enter Manmohan's house and expresses hatred for him due to his commercial choices. Angoori takes Bhoorey Lal to Vibhuti's house. Vibhuti wishes to take advantage of his hatred for Manmohan. Vibhuti offers to let Bhoorey Lal stay at his place. Angoori tells Manmohan about her father's visit, which intimidates him. Vibhuti tries to bond with Bhoorey Lal.

videos.title: Bhoorey Lal Bonds With Vibhuti
videos.overview: Vibhuti bonds with Bhoorey Lal with alcohol. Manmohan is jealous of the bonding between Vibhuti and Bhoorey Lal. Angoori and Manmohan meet and try to communicate with Bhoorey Lal, but he insults and dismisses Manmohan and Angoori. Bhoorey Lal interrupts Anita and Vibhuti when they are sleeping and wishes to sleep between them on their bed. Vibhuti guides him to the living room and makes him sleep on the couch. Vibhuti breaks a mirror of Bhoorey Lal's scooter and puts the blame on Manmohan.

videos.title: Bhoorey Lal Files an Fir Against Manmohan
videos.overview: Vibhuti lies to Bhoorey Lal that Manmohan tortures his daughter and manipulates him into filing an FIR against him. Happu goes to Manmohan to tell him about the arrest warrant and gives a deadline to Angoori of two hours to convince Bhoorey Lal to scrap his FIR. Angoori and Manmohan request Bhoorey Lal to cancel his FIR, but he disagrees and dismisses Manmohan. Angoori requests Happu to extend the deadline by 30 minutes. Anita tries to convince Bhoorey Lal, and he reveals what Vibhuti had said.

videos.title: Manmohan Invents Sundari to Frame Vibhuti
videos.overview: Bhoorey Lal cancels his FIR and saves Manmohan. Anita wishes to go on a trip to Simla with Vibhuti. Manmohan overhears that during Vibhuti and Anita's fourth honeymoon, he had fallen into a river, disappeared for ten days, and couldn't remember what happened. Manmohan keeps a letter, faking it to be from Sundari, outside Vibhuti's home, and Anita reads it. The letter states that Vibhuti was with Sundari during his disappearance. Anita gets mad at Vibhuti and kicks him out of the house.

videos.title: Two Sundaris Show Up
videos.overview: Anita receives another letter from Sundari and she threatens to leave the house. Manmohan offers Anita his place to stay. Manmohan asks Tillu to find a girl and a child to impersonate Sundari and her child. Vibhuti asks Saxena to pretend that he is Sundari. Saxena shows up as Sundari at Manmohan's home and Tillu also pretends to be Sundari confirming that they had been together. Phulwa, the lady who had saved Vibhuti shows up and proves that he is innocent.

videos.title: Vibhuti Gets a Job As Angoori's Tutor
videos.overview: Angoori receives Manmohan's client, Gupta's, call. Due to Angoori's poor English, she miscommunicates to him that Manmohan has had an accident. Angoori's faux pas could have led to Manmohan losing money in his business. Manmohan gets mad at Angoori and tells her to learn English before speaking the language. Anita finds out that Minal's husband has got a promotion and wishes Vibhuti had a job too. An angry Anta asks Vibhuti to find a job. Vibhuti gets a job as Angoori's English tutor.

videos.title: Angoori and Vibhuti Ignore Their Spouses
videos.overview: Vibhuti dresses as a professor to teach Angoori English but, Manmohan criticises him. Vibhuti faces multiple difficulties due to Angoori's poor command over the English language. Vibhuti goes home and Anita asks him to cook special food to celebrate. However, Vibhuti refuses as he wants to work. Angoori and Vibhuti ignore Manmohan and Anita because of the English lessons. Angoori calls Vibhuti to recite a poem. Anita and Manmohan discuss the issues they are facing due to these English lessons.

videos.title: Vibhuti does Not Wish to Help Angoori
videos.overview: Manmohan challenges Angoori that if she recites a poem well, then he will become her servant. Angoori seeks Vibhuti's help. Vibhuti tries to teach her the correct pronunciation but fails. Angoori comes to Vibhuti's house for her English lesson. Vibhuti requests Anita to lie to Angoori that he's not at home. Angoori tells Anita about Manmohan's challenge. Anita decides to help her and tells her that Vibhuti is in his room. Vibhuti escapes from his balcony. Anita and Angoori look for Vibhuti.

videos.title: Anita and Angoori Go For a Ritual
videos.overview: Vibhuti admits that he is unable to teach English to Angoori but Happu forces him to teach her at gunpoint. Angoori tries to narrate an essay but messes up several words. Everyone appreciates her English anyway. Saxena reads Manmohan's palm and tells him and Angoori that he might be interested in other women. Anita gets a call from the editor of her favourite magazine inviting her for a ritual that helps women control their husbands. Anita and Angoori go for the ritual together.

videos.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti Hide Gulfam Kali
videos.overview: Manmohan and Vibhuti spend time at Vibhuti's home. Gulfam Kali, a local dancer, visits Vibhuti's home. Anita and Angoori return as the ritual gets cancelled. Manmohan hides Gulfam Kali in the bathroom. Anita tries to go to the bathroom but she hears a woman's scream. Manmohan comes out and lies that it was his scream. Vibhuti asks Gulfam Kali to leave. Angoori comes to Vibhuti's house looking for Manmohan and they hear a woman's scream again. Anita and Angoori get suspicious.

videos.title: December 15th's Importance For Anita
videos.overview: Manmohan brings flowers for Anita and dreams about romancing with her. Anita asks Manmohan about the reason behind getting flowers and Manmohan lies that he remembers a special day in his relationship with Angoori. Anita asks Vibhuti about the importance of December 15th but he fails to answer. Anita gets mad and kicks him out of the house until he finds the reason. Vibhuti requests Angoori to ask Anita about the reason. Anita tells her the reason but asks her not to disclose it.

videos.title: Manmohan Assumes That Anita is Pregnant
videos.overview: Anita prepares for her uncle's birthday on December 15, but Vibhuti thinks that it is her grandfather's death anniversary and plans to surprise her. When Dr Gupta tells Anita that he will have his fifth child soon, she lectures him about overpopulation. Manmohan sees Dr Gupta leaving Anita's house. Dr Gupta gives him the news, but Manmohan misunderstands that Anita is pregnant and becomes sad. Vibhuti invites Saxena, Malkhan and others to mourn on December 15, which angers Anita.

videos.title: Anita and Angoori Test Their Husband's Fidelity
videos.overview: Manmohan gets a call from the woman, who had rejected his engagement offer, and they decide to meet. Angoori overhears Manmohan's conversation and becomes suspicious. Angoori tells Anita about the whole incident. Anita also develops suspicion about Vibhuti. Anita asks many queries to Vibhuti, but he realises that she is suspicious. Angoori asks Manmohan about the woman after he returns, but he assures her that he is loyal. Anita and Angoori take their spouses' phones and message female contacts.

videos.title: Saxena Flirts With Manmohan
videos.overview: Anita checks Vibhuti's phone and continues to message his female friend. Anita invites his female friend over, but she refuses to come as her husband is home. Angoori tells Vibhuti that Manmohan is cheating on her. Angoori gets Manmohan's phone again and tells Laddoo to message Manmohan's female friend, who is actually Saxena. Laddoo sends a flirty text, and Saxena flirts back. Angoori tells Laddoo to invite Saxena to her home the next morning. Manmohan opens his door to find Saxena bathing.

videos.title: Shiela and Prem Prank Anita
videos.overview: Anita forcibly invites Vibhuti's friend Shiela to her house. Angoori behaves rudely with Manmohan and messages Saxena, thinking that it is Manmohan's girlfriend, to come over within an hour. Saxena comes over, and Angoori beats him up with a wooden pole. Manmohan witnesses the whole incident, and Angoori's plot gets revealed. Shiela comes to Vibhuti's home and pretends to be his girlfriend. Shiela reveals that she knew Anita had messaged her all along, and she and Prem decided to prank her.

videos.title: Vibhuti Tries to Invoke His Grandfather's Spirit
videos.overview: Vibhuti dreams about his grandfather asking him to find his grandmother's box of jewellery. Saxena visits Angoori's home and tells her that he has read a book about spirits. Vibhuti tells Saxena to summon his grandfather's spirit as he wants to ask about the location of his grandmother's jewellery box. Saxena, Manmohan, Vibhuti, Anita, and Angoori sit for the ritual, but Saxena fails to deliver. Vibhuti gets up in the middle of the night and follows a witch, who is singing on the street.

videos.title: Jhumma Possesses Manmohan's Body
videos.overview: Anita and Manmohan catch Vibhuti as he follows the witch. Vibhuti tells Saxena and everyone else about his experience. Vibhuti follows the witch again and everyone witnesses the incident. The witch, Jhumma, tells them that she was a local dancer, and Vibhuti's grandfather was attracted to her. Saxena scares Jhumma away. Bhoorey Lal visits Angoori's home, and she convinces him to forgive Manmohan. Jhumma possesses Manmohan's body. Manmohan behaves rudely with Bhoorey Lal, and they argue.

videos.title: Jhumma Plays With Mishras' and Tiwaris' Psyche
videos.overview: Jhumma changes herself into Angoori and flirts with Vibhuti. Jhumma regains her natural form and scares Vibhuti. Jhumma transforms into Anita to flirt with Manmohan. Anita and Vibhuti see the witch flirting with Manmohan and tell him about it. Jhumma scares Manmohan. Angoori calls Bhoorey Lal and tells him to give Manmohan another chance. Jhumma possesses Manmohan's body again, and he behaves rudely with Bhoorey Lal. Angoori is angry with Manmohan. Saxena performs a ritual to summon the witch.

videos.title: Jhumma Possesses Saxena's Body
videos.overview: Saxena tries to stop Jhumma, and she attacks Happu. Saxena tells everyone that Jhumma wants to marry and then kill Vibhuti. Anita is concerned after receiving this information. Jhumma possesses Angoori and Anita to haunt Manmohan and Vibhuti, and they all run to each other's houses. Saxena comes to the rescue and performs a ritual to scare Jhumma away. Vibhuti, Anita, Manmohan and Angoori ask Saxena to stay with them for security. Jhumma possesses Saxena's body and haunts everyone.

videos.title: Saxena Banishes Jhumma
videos.overview: Jhumma possesses Amma Ji, who dances to music playing through Pelu's radio and faints subsequently. Vibhuti gets possessed by Jhumma and tied to a bed. Saxena manipulates a possessed Vibhuti into drinking holy water, and Jhumma's spirit leaves his body. Bhoorey Lal visits Angoori's home and insults Manmohan. Angoori and Anita plan to go to a religious place. Vibhuti, Manmohan and Prem plan to spend time together. Prem sends Gulfam Kali over to Vibhuti's house. Anita returns to see them together.

videos.title: Vibhuti Gets a Diamond Ring For Angoori
videos.overview: Angoori tells Vibhuti that she loves diamond rings. Vibhuti plans to get a diamond ring for Angoori. Saxena shows his diamond rings to Vibhuti, and he asks Saxena to lend him one. Vibhuti manipulates Saxena by saying that the ring is for Anita and tells Saxena that he will pay for it later. Saxena visits Anita's home and tells her about the whole incident. Angoori loses her ring. Saxena tells Vibhuti that Anita knows about the ring. Angoori calls Vibhuti to tell that she has lost the ring.

videos.title: Manmohan Buys a Diamond Ring For Angoori
videos.overview: Vibhuti calls Angoori to tell her how he got the ring and ask her to find it. Angoori tells Vibhuti that might have dropped the ring in the sink. A happy Anita seduces Vibhuti. Angoori tries to steal money to pay Vibhuti while Manmohan is sleeping, but he wakes up. Vibhuti vainly tries to find the ring. Manmohan buys a diamond ring from Saxena and places it on the dressing table to surprise Angoori. Angoori thinks that she has found Vibhuti's ring and returns it. Vibhuti gives the ring to Anita.

videos.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti Dress As Thieves
videos.overview: Manmohan thinks that Vibhuti has stolen the ring he had got for Angoori and has gifted it to Anita. Angoori soon realises that she has given Manmohan's ring to Vibhuti. Angoori wishes to get her ring back from Vibhuti. Manmohan and Vibhuti dress up as thieves to steal the ring from Anita, and Angoori finds the ring. Anita and Angoori beat up the thieves. Vibhuti buys multiple soaps that have gift coupons in them. The Mishras open the soap packets to win a bungalow. Manmohan and Vibhuti are sad.

videos.title: Ranveer Singh Dances With Angoori and Vibhuti
videos.overview: Saxena pretends to be Vibhuti's client from London, who wants to purchase insurance worth INR 5 crore. Vibhuti plans to go to London for the client, but stubs his toe on the staircase. Manmohan prays to God that Anita doesn't move into their new bungalow. Vibhuti dreams that Anita forcibly takes him to the bungalow and Angoori doesn't want him to leave. Actor Ranveer Singh visits Angoori's home and interacts with her and Vibhuti. Ranveer dances with Angoori and Vibhuti and promotes his film.

videos.title: Anita Falls Prey to a Scam
videos.overview: Vibhuti and Manmohan pretend to be best friends to manipulate Anita and Angoori. Manmohan pretends to have fever and tells Angoori that he is sick because Vibhuti will leave soon. Vibhuti fakes a suicide attempt and leaves a note that says that he has taken sleeping pills as he is sad about leaving Manmohan. Anita, who has already paid INR 5 lacs to the soap company Rampat, is unable to contact them. Happu reaches Anita's home with Rampat's representative and tells everyone that he is a scammer.

videos.title: Manmohan Buys a Perfume to Attract Anita
videos.overview: A salesman sells Manmohan perfume, which will make him attractive to women. Manmohan sprays the perfume on his body. Angoori smells the perfume, and she instantly feels attracted to him. Manmohan dreams about romancing Anita but attracts Gulfam Kali instead. Vibhuti talks to Angoori as she cooks, but she dismisses Vibhuti after smelling Manmohan's perfume. Manmohan sprays the perfume again and runs to Anita's house, only to find out that Anita has a blocked nose due to cold.

videos.title: Vibhuti Replaces Manmohan's Perfume
videos.overview: Vibhuti buys a perfume that repels women from the salesman. Vibhuti replaces the perfume in Manmohan's pocket with the one that repels women. Vibhuti applies the perfume and goes to Angoori's house. Vibhuti dreams about romancing Angoori but romances Gulfam Kali instead. Anita sees Vibhuti and Gulfam Kali together. Manmohan repels Anita due to the perfume's smell. Vibhuti tells Anita about the perfume, and she throws it away. Manmohan finds it and realises that someone had replaced his perfume.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan Dress Up As Santa Claus
videos.overview: Anita and Vibhuti decorate a Christmas tree. Anita invites Angoori and Manmohan for Christmas celebration. Angoori and Anita tell their husbands to dress up as Santa Claus and give gifts to them and in exchange, they will kiss them. Vibhuti decides to give gifts to Angoori and Manmohan plans to give presents to Anita. Happu overhears their conversation and plans to give gifts to Anita. Vibhuti dresses up as Santa Claus and climbs into Anita's bedroom. Vibhuti dreams of romancing Angoori.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan Get a Kiss From Their Respective Wives
videos.overview: Anita talks to Angoori, while Vibhuti waits for her to leave. Anita takes Angoori with her and Vibhuti gets disappointed. Manmohan waits for Anita at her house. Anita returns to Angoori's home and sees Vibhuti dressed up as Santa Claus. Angoori goes to Anita's home to find Manmohan dressed as Santa Claus. Vibhuti and Manmohan give gifts to Anita and Angoori and they kiss their husbands. Angoori plans to go for a ten-day trip to Shimla and Vibhuti tries to manipulate a Shimla trip for Anita too.

videos.title: Vibhuti Arranges Snowfall In Kanpur
videos.overview: Vibhuti wears warm clothes and tells Angoori that there is going to be a snowfall in Kanpur. Vibhuti organises a fake snowfall with the help of Saxena. Angoori wears warm clothes. Vibhuti throws fake snow outside Angoori's window. Vibhuti convinces Manmohan about the cold weather in Kanpur with the help of Teeka Ram, Malkhan, and Saxena. Manmohan wears warm clothes and dreams about romancing Anita. Anita sees Vibhuti and Saxena throwing fake snow at Angoori and Manmohan and their act is exposed.

videos.title: Vibhuti Spies On The Tiwaris
videos.overview: Vibhuti tries to eat pastries but Anita sees him on a CCTV camera and stops him. To keep a watch on her all day, Vibhuti hides a camera in a bouquet and gives it to Angoori. Vibhuti sees Manmohan sneakily get his phone and kiss someone's picture, which makes him suspicious. Vibhuti sees Angoori hurt her foot and rushes to help her. Vibhuti accuses Manmohan of being interested in other women and demands to check his phone. While snatching his phone, Vibhuti tears Manmohan's shirt pocket.

videos.title: Vibhuti Sees Angoori 'killing' a Woman
videos.overview: Amma Ji calls Angoori to tell her that there are some issues in her horoscope and suggests a solution for them. Vibhuti watches Angoori stab a woman and Manmohan support her actions on his camera. Vibhuti gets scared of Angoori. Happu shows a picture of a missing woman to Vibhuti and Angoori and asks whether they have seen her. Manmohan invites Anita and Vibhuti over for dinner. Vibhuti sees Teeka Ram and Malkhan carry a mannequin to Angoori's home and thinks it's a dead body.

videos.title: Vibhuti Shows Bhoorey Lal Footage Of Angoori's Crime
videos.overview: Vibhuti watches Angoori stab another woman on his camera and gets scared. Vibhuti sees Manmohan and Angoori carry the dead body for disposal. Vibhuti notices that Anita is sick. Angoori calls Amma Ji to appreciate her solution and Amma Ji suggests stabbing another mannequin. Bhoorey Lal visits Angoori's home to meet her but Vibhuti stops him. Vibhuti tells Bhoorey Lal about the whole incident and shows him the video evidence. Bhoorey Lal tries to tell Angoori to leave Manmohan.

videos.title: Amma Ji Comes to Angoori's Rescue
videos.overview: Vibhuti and Bhoorey Lal think that Manmohan and Angoori are going to kill Anita. Vibhuti and Happu rush to Angoori's home and beat Manmohan. Amma Ji arrives and explains to everyone that Angoori had stabbed some mannequins to resolve the issues in her horoscope. Angoori plans to visit Amma Ji's home for a religious ritual. Vibhuti invites Angoori and Manmohan for the New Year Eve celebrations and finds out that Angoori cannot come. Anita wants Vibhuti to roleplay a thug for the celebrations.

videos.title: Angoori Beats Vibhuti For Holding Manmohan Hostage
videos.overview: Manmohan sees Vibhuti dressed as a thug, Kallu, enter Anita's home. Manmohan sees Anita and Kallu dancing and romancing. Manmohan intervenes but Anita and Vibhuti bully him. Angoori and Amma Ji return as Angoori is worried about Manmohan but they find their home locked. They go to Anita's home and Vibhuti hides Manmohan in the kitchen at knifepoint. Angoori enters the kitchen and sees Manmohan held hostage. Angoori and others beat Vibhuti but he escapes.

videos.title: Vibhuti Decides to Become a Tailor
videos.overview: Vibhuti decides to become a ladies tailor. Manmohan gifts Angoori a dress but she hates it. Vibhuti finds out that Saxena has started a ladies tailoring business and asks him for a job. Vibhuti takes Saxena's phone for business reasons. Angoori complains to Vibhuti about Manmohan's gift and he suggests to her a tailor, Gulkand. Vibhuti pretends to be Gulkand and tells Angoori that he will stitch her clothes. Vibhuti, disguised as Gulkand, visits Angoori's home to get her measurements.

videos.title: Gulkand Takes Anita's Measurements
videos.overview: Manmohan overhears Anita having some troubles with her tailor and suggests going to Gulkand. Anita asks Vibhuti whether he knows Gulkand. Pretending to be Gulkand, Vibhuti insults Anita. Vibhuti, disguised as Gulkand, gives Anita her dress. Angoori introduces Anita to Gulkand and Anita takes him home for her measurements. Manmohan sees Gulkand taking Anita's measurements and gets jealous. Manmohan interrupts and accuses Gulkand of touching Anita inappropriately but Anita dismisses him.

videos.title: Vibhuti Hypnotises Angoori
videos.overview: Saxena tells Anita that he has stitched Angoori's dress and accuses Gulkand of fraud. Manmohan exposes Vibhuti's act but he gives a false explanation. Manmohan notices that Anita orders Vibhuti to do household chores and tells him that he is his wife's servant. Vibhuti sees Saxena hypnotising Teeka Ram and Malkhan and making them slap each other. Vibhuti learns hypnotism from Saxena. Manmohan shows his authority over Angoori by making her do unnecessary tasks. Vibhuti hypnotises Angoori.

videos.title: A Hypnotised Angoori Beats Manmohan Black and Blue
videos.overview: A hypnotised Angoori kicks Manmohan out of the house. Anita sees Manmohan sleeping outside his house. Manmohan tells Anita about the incident but Angoori says that she had been worried about Manmohan as he hadn't returned home. Vibhuti hypnotises Angoori again and tells her to hit Manmohan. A hypnotised Angoori beats up Manmohan with a belt. Manmohan visits Anita's home, cries, and tells her about the entire incident. Anita and Manmohan go to his house and on seeing him, Angoori cries.

videos.title: Anita Hypnotises Vibhuti to Learn The Truth
videos.overview: Vibhuti dreams that Angoori flirts with him and Anita catching him in the act, stabs him. Anita finds out that Vibhuti has learnt hypnotism from Saxena. Anita asks Saxena to teach her hypnotism techniques. Anita hypnotises Vibhuti and asks him the reason behind learning hypnotism from Saxena. Vibhuti's entire plan gets exposed in front of Anita and she punishes him by locking him in the bathroom. Manmohan finds out that Vibhuti had learnt hypnotism to manipulate Angoori against him.

videos.title: Vibhuti Works Tirelessly All Day
videos.overview: Vibhuti and Anita argue and he complains about his poor health. Vibhuti tells the priest about his poor health and he checks Vibhuti's horoscope. He tells Vibhuti that he might go insane unless he keeps working all day and tells him to work continuously for five days. Vibhuti cleans the tea seller's utensils. Vibhuti goes home and starts cleaning the house and washes Angoori's utensils. Anita's friend offers Vibhuti a good job in the US. Vibhuti tells Anita that he has been working all day.

videos.title: The Priest Teaches Vibhuti and Manmohan a Lesson
videos.overview: Vibhuti cleans Teeka Ram and Malkhan's bathroom and offers to wash the tea seller's utensils. The priest tells Manmohan the same problem and the solution that he had given Vibhuti. Manmohan washes Anita's utensils and she kicks him out of the house. Vibhuti washes Angoori's utensils but Manmohan kicks him out and starts cleaning them himself. Angoori and Anita wish to romance their husbands but they continue working. The priest reveals that he had lied to teach Manmohan and Vibhuti a lesson.

videos.title: Puttan Visits Angoori
videos.overview: Puttan, Angoori's brother, enters Manmohan's home while everyone is asleep and pulls him out of the bed. Anita sees Manmohan sleeping on the street and accuses him of being drunk. Angoori tells Manmohan about Puttan's arrival and Puttan snatches his chain. Manmohan goes to Anita's home and tells her and Vibhuti about Puttan. Puttan gambles with Teeka Ram and Malkhan. Angoori introduces Vibhuti to Puttan and Puttan insults him. Angoori laughs at Vibhuti and later, she visits Anita's home.

videos.title: Puttan Steals Anita's Bangles
videos.overview: Anita and Vibhuti visit Angoori's home for dinner. Anita forgets her phone at home and Puttan offers to fetch it. Puttan steals Anita's bangles and gifts them to Angoori. Anita realises that Puttan has stolen her bangles and given them to Angoori but she stays quiet about it. Anita tells Manmohan to return her bangles. Manmohan tries to steal the bangles while Angoori is sleeping but Vibhuti attacks him. Puttan and Angoori wake up and Puttan beats Vibhuti and Manmohan.

videos.title: Puttan Gets Arrested Again
videos.overview: Puttan calls Happu to arrest Manmohan for stealing Angoori's bangles but Angoori stops them. Vibhuti and Manmohan cover Happu's face with a blanket and beat him pretending that the culprit is Puttan. Happu visits Manmohan's home and accuses Puttan of hitting him. Puttan shows a video as evidence of Manmohan and Vibhuti beating up Happu and their act gets exposed. Some cops arrive and arrest Puttan for escaping from the prison. Angoori is mad at Manmohan as Puttan leaves.

videos.title: Angoori Faints On Seeing Grapes
videos.overview: Dr Gupta grants Anita a diploma for past life regression therapy. Bhoorey Lal tells Angoori that he had a nightmare where she faints. Saxena starts a tattoo business. Vibhuti gets a tattoo of grapes on his chest from Saxena. Vibhuti shows the tattoo to Angoori and she faints. Angoori and Amma Ji discuss her health issues. Manmohan buys some grapes for her and she faints again. Dr Gupta is unable to find the cause of Angoori's fainting. Manmohan tells Bhoorey Lal about Angoori's poor health.

videos.title: Anita Takes Angoori to Her Past Life
videos.overview: Bhoorey Lal tells everyone that Angoori's condition is related to her past life. Anita takes Angoori back to her past life, which is set in the British era. In her past life, Manmohan is a king and Angoori is his fifth wife and Anita and Vibhuti their servants. In the past life, Manmohan is attracted to Anita and he tries to feed her grapes. Angoori takes a bath in a waterfall and Vibhuti watches her. Anita brings Angoori back to her present life. Vibhuti makes a drink for Bhoorey Lal.

videos.title: Angoori Revisits Her Past Life
videos.overview: After the past life session, Angoori wakes up and sees Saxena eating the grapes and faints again. Anita realizes that her condition is related to Vibhuti from her past life and the grapes. Anita starts another session where Angoori says that it's her birthday and Vibhuti forces her to drink. Happu, who is a Britisher tells Manmohan that the Indians and the British bet, where they play a cricket match. If the Indians win they are exempted from paying taxes or else they have to pay double tax.

videos.title: Manmohan Tries to Woo Anita In Angoori's Past Life
videos.overview: In her past life, Anita dances and Manmohan and Happu try to touch her inappropriately. Anita leaves but Manmohan, Vibhuti, and Happu follow her. Manmohan follows Anita to her bed. Angoori drinks and tries to find Anita. Angoori opens the bedroom door and faints. In the next session, Angoori is in her bedroom and Vibhuti knocks on her door. Vibhuti tries to instigate Angoori against Manmohan but Angoori dismisses him. Manmohan and Vibhuti discuss their past lives.

videos.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti's Past-life Romance
videos.overview: Anita is unable to sleep as she has multiple questions about her past life. In the final session, Angoori goes to take a bath in a waterfall and Vibhuti follows her. Vibhuti hides behind some rocks and watches Saxena taking a bath. Angoori goes back to when Manmohan and Vibhuti follow Anita to the bedroom. Manmohan asks Anita to leave and Angoori opens the door to see Manmohan feeding grapes to Vibhuti. The final session ends and Angoori cries. Vibhuti is disgusted with Manmohan's presence.

videos.title: Vibhuti Introduces Angoori As His Wife to David
videos.overview: David Mishra, Vibhuti's uncle, calls him and asks him about his wife. Vibhuti tells him that he is married to Anita but David gets angry as he remembers that Anita had thrown ink on his face. To get his share of David's property, Vibhuti says that he is married to Sunita. David tells him that he will visit his house and meet his wife. Anita convinces Angoori to pretend to be Vibhuti's wife until David leaves. David arrives and Vibhuti introduces Angoori as his wife Sunita.

videos.title: David is Shocked to Find Anita In Vibhuti's House
videos.overview: David sees Anita in Manmohan's house and gets mad at Vibhuti while Manmohan pretends to be her husband. David grants a part of the inheritance to Angoori and leaves. David returns as his flight is delayed and Anita opens the door. Anita informs Vibhuti about David's return. Vibhuti stalls David in the living room until Anita convinces Angoori to return. David runs to the bedroom to check whether Anita lives there but finds Angoori instead. David suspects that Anita is hiding in Vibhuti's house.

videos.title: David Sees Manmohan and Angoori Together
videos.overview: David finds Anita in Manmohan's house. Ammaji visits Manmohan's house and Manmohan stalls her at the door until Angoori returns. Ammaji gets suspicious and runs to the bedroom but finds Angoori sleeping there. David leaves as his flight is ready for departure. Ammaji, Manmohan and Angoori perform a religious morning ritual. David returns as his flight gets delayed again and he sees Manmohan and Angoori together. A suspicious David asks Vibhuti about them being together.

videos.title: David Wishes to Take Revenge On Anita
videos.overview: Vibhuti informs Anita that David has returned and requests Manmohan and Angoori to help him. Happu visits Vibhuti's house and meets David. David and Happu argue about Vibhuti's wife's identity. Vibhuti lies that Happu has Alzheimer's disease and forces Happu to leave. Ammaji returns to Manmohan's house and sees Anita in his living room. David wishes to take revenge from Anita and Vibhuti tells David to throw ink at Manmohan. Manmohan wants Ammaji to leave but she insists on meeting Angoori.

videos.title: Amma Ji Avenges Her Insult
videos.overview: David throws ink on Ammaji's face and hides in Vibhuti's house. He gets a call that his flight is ready for departure. Vibhuti tells Teeka to get a burkha for David. David wears a burkha and tries to escape but Ammaji spots him. David runs back to Vibhuti's house. Saxena gives a bottle of hair dye to Ammaji. David wears a saree to escape but Ammaji catches him. She throws hair dye on his face. Vibhuti receives the inheritance papers and learns that David has transferred his assets to Angoori.

videos.title: Anita and Angoori Get Nasty Messages
videos.overview: Anita tells Vibhuti to write some romantic messages for her. The next morning, she finds something ill written about her. Anita blames Vibhuti for this. Manmohan is about to start a new business, which can be done at night. Angoori thinks that her husband is involved in the wrong business. Reading an ad written on a wall, people call Manmohan, thinking that he is the agent who will arrange prostitute Gulfam Kali's night show for them. Later, Angoori reads a nasty message about her on the wall.

videos.title: Anita Holds Vibhuti Responsible For The Foul Message
videos.overview: Angoori blames Vibhuti for writing nasty messages about her. Anita stays alert at night to confirm who the culprit is. Vibhuti reaches the concerned place to write a good message for Angoori, but Anita misunderstands that Vibhuti is the culprit. Vibhuti denies that he is the culprit, but Anita does not pay heed to him and orders him to leave the house. Gulfam Kali reaches Manmohan's house as she thinks that he is her manager, and the inspector also blackmails Manmohan.

videos.title: Happu Blackmails Manmohan
videos.overview: Vibhuti returns home as he experiences itchiness after being out for the entire night. But Anita does not allow him to stay or take anything from the house. Happu reaches Manmohan's house with his officer to enjoy Gulfam's programme. Happu blackmails Manmohan and tells him that he will file a complaint about his involvement in an escort racket. Amma Ji slaps Gulfam Kali and beats up Manmohan black and blue. Anita leaves the house and sees a stranger writing on the wall.

videos.title: Vibhuti Pretends to have Injured His Hands
videos.overview: Vibhuti is tired of working at home like a servant. He learns from Angoori that she feels pity for handicapped people. To get rid of the chores and to gain Angoori's sympathy, Vibhuti lies that two buffaloes have attacked him, so he is unable to use his hands. Vibhuti tries to get Angoori’s help, but Manmohan intervenes. Saxena discusses with Happu about a B-grade movie in which a woman serves her handicapped husband. Manmohan sees Vibhuti eating sweets and decides to reveal the truth.

videos.title: Manmohan Tries to Expose Vibhuti's Act
videos.overview: Anita vainly tries to seduce Vibhuti to cure him. Manmohan informs Anita that Vibhuti is lying and tells her to try some tricks to find out the truth. Manmohan disguises himself as a hooligan and harasses Anita so that Vibhuti would come to save her, but Saxena arrives and saves Anita. The plan fails, and Saxena decides to become Vibhuti's hands. Saxena stays with Vibhuti as his shadow. Then, Manmohan tries another trick and hits Vibhuti's hands with a scale, but fails.

videos.title: Angoori Uses Sign Language to Communicate
videos.overview: Vibhuti and Manmohan discuss the pros and cons of each others' wives. Amma Ji tells Angoori to maintain silence. Vibhuti speaks with Angoori, but she maintains silence. Manmohan lies to Vibhuti that Angoori is angry with him. Angoori tries to talk to Vibhuti using sign language. Saxena interprets Angoori's sign-language message wrongly and hits Vibhuti. Anita tells Vibhuti about a financier wanting to invest in her grooming class, but Vibhuti is distracted, which annoys Anita.

videos.title: Vibhuti Decides to Commit Suicide
videos.overview: Vibhuti vainly tries to talk to Angoori. Saxena tries to translate Angoori's sign language to make Vibhuti understand, but misinterprets the message. Saxena finds pleasure in beating Vibhuti ruthlessly. Vibhuti is restless as he hasn't heard from Angoori at all. Mr Agarwal, the financier, informs Anita that he is willing to fund her project. Anita realises that Vibhuti isn't happy with her professional progress. A sad Vibhuti attempts to commit suicide. Vibhuti writes a suicide letter to Anita.

videos.title: Manmohan is Shocked By Anita's Attire
videos.overview: Anita informs Vibhuti that it is difficult to manage the house financially for her. Vibhuti ignores her request that he work, saying that he is too good for any job. Anita asks Angoori and Manmohan to discuss her problem with Vibhuti and says that she might have to alter her professional path to earn extra cash. Manmohan sees a flashily dressed up Anita walking to a car at night. The next day, Tillu informs Manmohan that he saw Anita dancing crazily with a man and that the man gave her money.

videos.title: Vibhuti Sees Anita Leaving With a Stranger At Night
videos.overview: Manmohan is worried about Anita even as Angoori feels like behaving flirtatiously with him. Anita again leaves at night with a man on a bike. The next day, Tillu informs Manmohan that he saw Anita dance with the same man in River Ganga. Manmohan informs Vibhuti that Anita goes out at night to earn more money due to Vibhuti's inability to earn. Vibhuti learns from Manmohan that Anita bathed in River Ganga and fell sick. The same night, Vibhuti also sees Anita go with a stranger in a car.

videos.title: Anita Rebukes Vibhuti For Suspecting Her
videos.overview: Vibhuti secures INR 50,000 from Manmohan as help and tells Anita that he has got a job. When Anita again goes out at night, Vibhuti catches hold of the stranger and beats him. Anita informs everyone that she was shooting for a film with her friend Abhay Ashiana. Abhay wants Vibhuti to act in his next film as Angoori's brother. Vibhuti refuses the offer. Vibhuti brings a cake for Anita, but she quarrels with Vibhuti for suspecting her intentions. Manmohan decorates the house for Valentine's Day.

videos.title: Vibhuti Tells Angoori About Manmohan's Affair
videos.overview: When Manmohan quarrels with a lady on the phone, Angoori suspects that he is having an affair. Manmohan vainly tries to make Anita feel envious of him. Vibhuti informs Angoori that Manmohan had received a call from a woman, who is madly in love with him. Though Anita reprimands Manmohan, he feels that Anita loves him. Angoori feels sad about Manmohan's affair. Vibhuti receives a call from Saxena at Manmohan's home, and he fakes the conversation to indicate that Manmohan wants to wed his lover.

videos.title: Vibhuti Pretends to be Manmohan's Secret Lover
videos.overview: Vibhuti calls as Manmohan's girlfriend and talks to Angoori, which angers her. Vibhuti leaves no stone unturned to create problems for Manmohan. Anita sees a love letter written for Manmohan. Teeka Ram, Malkhan and Happu also harass Manmohan. Vibhuti writes a message on Angoori's mirror that Manmohan's lover will take him away. Manmohan realises that Vibhuti is plotting against him. Vibhuti tries to brainwash Angoori. Manmohan tells everyone that the female has made him her brother.

videos.title: Vibhuti Steals Angoori's Lipstick
videos.overview: Vibhuti tells everyone that he lied. Vibhuti thinks that Teeka Ram and Malkhan stole his purse and informs Happu. Later, a boy hands over Vibhuti’s purse to him, which he had forgotten at home. Vibhuti seeks forgiveness from Teeka Ram and Malkhan. Vibhuti sees Angoori apply make-up and admires her beauty. Vibhuti enters her home at night to steal her lipstick. Saxena sees Vibhuti exit Manmohan’s home. Happu reaches Manmohan’s home to probe. Manmohan says that some undergarments have been stolen.

videos.title: Anita Compels Manmohan and Happu to Take The Case Back
videos.overview: Manmohan, Happu and Saxena reach Vibhuti's home and accuse him of having stolen undergarments from Manmohan's home and prove it as well. Anita tries to convince them that Vibhuti has better undergarments and that there is no need for him to rob Manmohan's undergarments. Anita seeks four hours to prove Vibhuti's innocence. Anita asks Manmohan to take the case back. Manmohan refuses initially, but after much ado, he does. Happu refuses to shut the case but does so finally due to Anita's pressure.

videos.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti Plan to Watch a B-grade Movie
videos.overview: Teeka Ram arrives at Vibhuti's house to keep Manmohan's undergarments there. Teeka wants to take revenge on Vibhuti as he had blamed Teeka for robbery. In the morning, Vibhuti and Manmohan meet for a tea break. Prem, Vibhuti's friend, meets them and offers them a B-grade film's DVD. Vibhuti and Manmohan convince their wives to go out. Prem gives them the DVD, and Vibhuti tries to play it. Angoori and Anita return, and Anita insists that the DVD be played. The DVD contains an old religious movie.

videos.title: Anita Opens Karate Classes For Women
videos.overview: Anita learns about the lack of women's safety in her area and decides to teach women karate. Vibhuti wants Angoori to join the class, but Angoori is certain that Manmohan will protect her. Manmohan helps Anita as her assistant. Manmohan plays the role of a hooligan, who tries to tease women, and Anita hits him in self-defence. To make the steps clear to her student Billo, Anita repeats the action of beating Manmohan. A ruffian teases Angoori when she is in the vegetable market to buy tomatoes.

videos.title: Angoori Beats a Ruffian For Harassing Her
videos.overview: Anita teaches self-defence to Billo, due to which Manmohan gets badly hurt. He seeks help from Saxena as he thinks that Saxena may like being beaten up. Later, he learns that Saxena was already beaten up by 500 people when he played a trick to get a shock and that Saxena needs time to recover to tolerate the next round of beatings. The next day, when Anita again beats Manmohan to teach self-defence to her students, he resigns. In the market, Angoori beats the ruffian Vibhuti in an Indian style.

videos.title: Anita and Angoori Adopt Saxena
videos.overview: Anokhelal Saxena misses his mom and decides to commit suicide as the world thinks that he is crazy. Angoori and Anita tell him that they will adopt him as their son and never let him miss his mother. Saxena stays with the Tiwaris in the morning and the Mishras at night. Vibhuti and Manmohan try to convince their wives to ignore Saxena. Saxena, Anita and Angoori go to watch a movie together. A realty agent asks Vibhuti and Manmohan informs Saxena that his properties worth crores have been sold.

videos.title: Vibhuti, Manmohan, and Happu Want to Adopt Saxena
videos.overview: Vibhuti and Manmohan compete to adopt Saxena. They shower love on Saxena as if he was their own child. Angoori and Anita are in disbelief seeing the changes in their husbands. It seems that Saxena is not sure about his new fathers' love for him. Manmohan does not want Vibhuti to adopt Saxena. Vibhuti does not want Manmohan to adopt Saxena. Finally, Vibhuti calls a lawyer to start the adoption procedure. But, soon, Happu enters and says that he wants to adopt Saxena.

videos.title: The Trip to Shimla
videos.overview: Saxena knows that Happu, Vibhuti and Manmohan want to adopt him for his money. Anita reads in a newspaper that there is an offer of a tour to Shimla with free stay and food. Vibhuti initially refuses, but he knows that Angoori and Manmohan are also going. Vibhuti convinces Anita to pack bags. Manmohan and Angoori fight and decide to cancel their trip. Hence, even Vibhuti fights with Anita and cancels the trip. Manmohan and Angoori make up, and Anita decides to go with them leaving Vibhuti alone.

videos.title: Manmohan Sees Angoori Leaving The House At Night
videos.overview: Vibhuti fights with Anita at night and exits the house. Vibhuti sees Angoori walking out of her home. When Pelu plays a Bollywood number, she starts dancing to its tunes. Vibhuti feels that she is dancing for him. The next morning, he sees Angoori praying to God and gets confused. The same set of events happens the next night too. Manmohan hears from Teeka Ram and Happu that women are running away with strangers. This makes Manmohan doubt Angoori when he sees her leaving the house at night.

videos.title: Anita and Manmohan Catch Angoori Dancing In The Night
videos.overview: Manmohan and Anita confirm that Angoori and Vibhuti have left the house at night. Vibhuti leaves the house at night to see Angoori's dance. Angoori again dances crazily on road. Vibhuti tries to ask Angoori indirectly whether she likes him, but Angoori tells him that she only loves God. Anita and Manmohan stay awake at night and they see Angoori leave the house and dance in front of Vibhuti. A shocked Anita seeks an explanation from Vibhuti and he tells her that he wanted Angoori to be safe.

videos.title: Vibhuti Dresses Like Bahubali
videos.overview: Manmohan summons a doctor to treat Angoori. Now, instead of dancing, Angoori slaps Vibhuti while sleepwalking. Angoori watches news in which the reporter talks about Bahubali, who steals from the rich and distributes to the poor. Angoori calls Manmohan a thief as opposed to Bahubali as he loots people via his business. Anita and Vibhuti also talk about Bahubali's might, and Anita wants Vibhuti to act like Bahubali. Vibhuti dresses up like Bahubali to impress Anita, but cannot perform like him.

videos.title: Vibhuti Gets Famous As Bahubali
videos.overview: Vibhuti tries to impress Anita by acting like Bahubali. Angoori and Manmohan see Anita dance with someone dressed up like Bahubali. To save herself, she lies that Vibhuti is Bahubali, and Angoori believes it. The next day, Vibhuti takes advantage of being called Bahubali. Angoori asks for a selfie with Vibhuti. Manmohan gets angry with Vibhuti getting the attention. Anita's demands keep increasing, which annoy Vibhuti. Teeka Ram insults Manmohan, and Vibhuti gets all the love.

videos.title: Manmohan Defames The Bahubali
videos.overview: Vibhuti reaches Angoori's home disguised as Bahubali. Vibhuti lifts all light objects and shows that he is quite strong. Vibhuti gets scared of Angoori's weightlifting demands and leaves. Teeka and Happu seek blessings from Bahubali. Manmohan disguises himself as Bahubali and beats Happu and Teeka black and blue. Manmohan does all the wrong acts to defame Vibhuti. They all blame Vibhuti, but soon learn that Bahubali has surrendered. Anita reminds Vibhuti how he spoiled her singing career.

videos.title: Angoori Wants to Become a Fashion Designer
videos.overview: Vibhuti clicks Angoori's picture and tells her that he likes her saree. She tells Vibhuti that she designed the saree, and Vibhuti encourages her to become a fashion designer. Manmohan reaches Anita's house and starts complaining about Vibhuti. Angoori seeks permission from Manmohan to become a fashion designer, but he discourages her. Anita tells Manmohan to encourage Angoori to do fashion designing. Vibhuti supports Angoori in her new venture but gets insulted by Teeka, Saxena and Manmohan.

videos.title: Angoori Designs a Shirt For Vibhuti
videos.overview: Angoori tells Vibhuti to try her new shirt. The shirt looks funny as she makes the shirt in the form of a blouse. Teeka curses Malkhan. Malkhan says that a rich man has adopted him. All make fun of Vibhuti looking at the design of the shirt. But Vibhuti defends the backless shirt. Vibhuti confidently carries the shirt. Happu files a report against Vibhuti for wearing bold clothes in the market, but Anita reprimands him. Angoori makes one more shirt for Vibhuti, which looks funny from the front.

videos.title: Anita Sugercoates Her Criticism For Angoori
videos.overview: Happu tries to arrest Vibhuti for wearing risque clothes. Vibhuti wants Saxena to become a model, but Saxena refuses. Anita finally tells Angoori that she is a bad designer. But Bablani, a businessman from France, calls Manmohan and gives a big order for designer clothes to Angoori as he thinks that her designs are for the future. Anita gets emotional after watching a movie wherein a husband cares for his sick wife a lot, and she asks Vibhuti whether he will care for her. Anita sprains her leg.

videos.title: Vibhuti Maintains Distance From Anita
videos.overview: Manmohan plans to keep Vibhuti away from Anita. He bribes a priest to tell Vibhuti that if he goes near Anita when she is in pain, her pain will increase. For Anita's safety, Vibhuti keeps himself away from Anita and she misunderstands him. The priest also tells Vibhuti that if someone whose name starts with the letter 'M' stays with Anita, then she will recover soon. Vibhuti innocently seeks Manmohan's help pleading to nurse Anita. Anita makes Manmohan perform all the daily chores.

videos.title: Manmohan Gets Tired Of Serving Anita
videos.overview: Saxena, Malkhan and Teeka Ram gather together to harass Manmohan for being Anita's servant. Anita curses him for not helping her. Tillu sleeps next to Manmohan and realises that Manmohan is in love with Anita. Manmohan is frustrated with working like a servant. Anita wants Manmohan to distribute 1000 invitations of her grooming classes in the society personally. Manmohan wants the priest to tell Vibhuti that his presence will not hurt Anita anymore. Manmohan sees Anita and Vibhuti dance.

videos.title: Manmohan is Shocked to Learn About Anita's Pregnancy
videos.overview: Vibhuti reveals that Anita was acting unwell as she wanted to test him. Vibhuti and Anita are very happy with each other. Anita's friend arrives and they discuss Vibhuti's unemployment. She tells Anita to pretend that she is pregnant and see the changes in Vibhuti. Anita wants Vibhuti to stand on his feet as she wants him to become a respectable father. Vibhuti informs Manmohan, Teeka Ram and Malkhan that he is going to become a father. Manmohan is shocked to hear this news.

videos.title: Vibhuti Lies to Anita About His 'hard-earned' Money
videos.overview: Vibhuti unsuccessfully tries to sell the life insurance policy to Teeka Ram and Manmohan. Anita knows that Vibhuti will be hurt after he gets to know the truth. Vibhuti tries to sell the policies but fails. Vibhuti steals Teeka Ram's, Malkhan's and a vegetable seller's purses and robs Manmohan's house. Vibhuti gives the money to Anita and tells her that it is his hard-earned money. Manmohan blames Tillu for stealing INR 50,000 from his bedroom, but Anita is convinced that Tillu is not the thief.

videos.title: Happu Mistakes David For a Hooligan
videos.overview: Vibhuti leaves at night to rob Saxena's house and Anita follows him. Saxena beats Vibhuti for stealing. Anita reveals that she is not pregnant. David Mishra, Vibhuti's uncle calls him and says that he will be visiting him for a day. Vibhuti asks Manmohan for help as his uncle will be arriving. Vibhuti wants Anita to stay at Manmohan's house. Happu catches David as he mistakes him to be a hooligan and takes him to Vibhuti. David tells Vibhuti that he some property for him.

videos.title: David Catches Anita With Vibhuti
videos.overview: Anita stays at Manmohan’s house. David tells Vibhuti that he hates Anita. Vibhuti enquires about the property, but David ignores the topic. Tillu keeps a watch on Manmohan. Vibhuti reaches Manmohan’s house, where Anita is sleeping and spends some romantic time with her. David and Manmohan are angry to see Vibhuti with Anita. David blames Vibhuti for cheating on Angoori and decides not to give the property to Vibhuti. David speaks to Manmohan about Vibhuti and Anita’s illegitimate relationship.

videos.title: Anita Pretends to Make Vibhuti Her Brother
videos.overview: David wants Manmohan to know about Anita cheating on him. Manmohan gets confused. David speaks with Happu about Vibhuti’s extramarital affair and he thinks that Vibhuti has an affair with Angoori. Vibhuti states that he will make David give them the property. Manmohan is hurt seeing Vibhuti and Anita’s closeness. Manmohan suggests to David that he should give him some money to make Anita his sister. Anita pretends to make Vibhuti her brother, but ultimately they do not get the property.

videos.title: Vibhuti Befirends Bhushan Babuta
videos.overview: Anita does not like Vibhuti chilling with Teeka and suggests that he keeps the company of reputed people to become something in life. Vibhuti promises to do so and meets the owner of Babuta builders, Bhushan Babuta. Tillu uses a fake gun to force Manmohan to give his salary, and later, realises that it is a real gun. A drunk Vibhuti returns home and tells Anita about his new friend. Vibhuti invites Bhushan home, and Anita invites Manmohan to tell him about Vibhuti and Bhushan's friendship.

videos.title: Bhushan Gets Smitten With Anita
videos.overview: Bhushan arrives home for dinner. He is smitten by Anita's looks. Anita feels uncomfortable with Bhushan's constant staring. Bhushan leaves and Anita reprimands Vibhuti for having befriended such an ill-mannered man. Anita wants Vibhuti to break his friendship with Bhushan. Ammaji and Laddoo arrive to check on Manmohan, as Tillu had complained about him. Bhushan arrives in the morning and admires Anita. He insists that Anita accept a car as a gift, but she refuses. Vibhuti misses Angoori.

videos.title: Anita Flirts With Bhushan
videos.overview: Vibhuti gets impatient to see Angoori and he enquires about her. Bhushan writes a letter to Anita and proposes to her. To make Vibhuti envious, she fakes calling Bhushan and acknowledging the gift. Vibhuti overhears this conversation and gets hurt. He shares his sadness with Manmohan. Bhushan arrives home and flirts with Anita. Anita also fakes love for Bhushan. Later, she scolds Bhushan and beats him black and blue. Anita wants Vibhuti to buy a bike and Manmohan decides to buy a vehicle.

videos.title: Vibhuti Teaches Manmohan How to Ride a Motorbike
videos.overview: Manmohan tells Happu that he needs a motorbike. Vibhuti promises Manmohan that he will teach him to ride the motorbike. Vibhuti starts Manmohan's bike training from the basics wasting Manmohan's time to earn more money. Anita tells Vibhuti to get a bike anyhow. Tillu complains to Ammaji that Manmohan harasses him at night. On the second day of training, Manmohan tries to ride the bike and meets with an accident with Happu. Happu obtains money from Manmohan for riding without a licence.

videos.title: Vibhuti Arranges a Second-hand Bike
videos.overview: Vibhuti continues Manmohan's bike lessons. Manmohan bangs into Happu again and Happu's second leg also gets injured. He again curses Manmohan and asks him for money as compensation. Anita decides to shut her grooming classes as she does not want to travel in a rickshaw. Vibhuti arranges a bike for Anita. Manmohan finally learns to ride the bike. He sees Vibhuti on a second-hand bike which is purchased by Manmohan's bike coaching money. Vibhuti's bike breaks down and this angers Anita.

videos.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti Drink Saxena's Potion
videos.overview: Anita wants Vibhuti to be romantic. Vibhuti has strength issues, which is why he ignores her request and reads a book. Anita feels that he is making excuses. Manmohan sees someone eve-teasing Anita. He tries to save her but instead gets beaten up by the goon. Anita beats the goon to protect herself. Saxena drinks a chemical and becomes exceptionally strong defeating anyone who competes with him. Manmohan and Vibhuti steal and drink the chemical and feel the changes happening within.

videos.title: Vibhuti Transforms Into a Wolf
videos.overview: The chemical seems to have a strong effect on both Manmohan and Vibhuti. Saxena informs Happu that a werewolf has attacked Malkhan. Vibhuti and Manmohan urge Happu to investigate. Malkhan describes that the animal looked like a half man and a half wolf. Vibhuti and Manmohan display signs of the werewolf. Ammaji is also injured by the wolf. Ammaji scolds Manmohan for mocking her. At night, Anita sees Vibhuti transforming into a wolf. Gulfam Kali complains that the wolf had attacked her too.

videos.title: Amma Ji and Anita Want to Cure Manmohan and Vibhuti
videos.overview: Anita is scared of spending her entire life with a wolf. Ammaji and Tillu suspect that Manmohan might be a wolf. The wolf attacks another person at night.
