videos.overview: The police commissioner of Kanpur gives Anita the duty of night patrolling. Vibhuti shudders because of the cold weather. Manmohan gets medicine from a 'Babaji' to brace the cold weather and feels energetic and youthful after having the medicine. Manmohan mocks Vibhuti and tries to impress Anita. Happu Singh gets worried about his night patrolling in the cold weather. Angoori seduces Manmohan but he avoids her because of the cold. At night, Anita gets ready for night patrolling with Saxena.

videos.title: Anita Decides to Take Manmohan's Interview
videos.overview: Anita reports about the poor people sleeping on the streets of Kanpur and exposes Happu Singh's sleeping on duty. Vibhuti flirts with Angoori and discusses on how to dry the wet clothes in the winter season. Manmohan takes the medicine and impresses Anita with his strength to brace the cold. Anita decides to take Manmohan's interview during her night patrolling. Teeka and Malkhan tease Happu Singh for sleeping on duty. Happu Singh bribes Teeka and Malkhan to patrol for him at night.

videos.title: Manmohan Slips Into The Bed With Vibhuti
videos.overview: Failing to get the medicine from 'Babaji', Manmohan tries to postpone his interview but in vain. Vibhuti guides Angoori on how to dry the wet clothes. In spite of not taking the medicine, a trembling Manmohan gives the interview wearing minimal clothes and dances. Masterji complains about his blanket being robbed. Manmohan rushes to Anita's house and slips into the bed with Vibhuti as Angoori doesn't open the door. Anita is shocked seeing Manmohan sharing the bed with Vibhuti.

videos.title: Manmohan Takes a Bath In Chilled Water
videos.overview: Anita confronts Manmohan for sharing the bed with Vibhuti. Vibhuti gives Angoori ideas to keep herself warm. Manmohan takes the medicine from the 'Babaji' again and mocks Vibhuti for shivering. Manmohan takes up the brave challenge of bathing in chilled water at night. Angoori tries to stop Manmohan from doing the stunt. The 'Babaji' gives incorrect medicine to Manmohan but he bathes in chilled water to impress Anita. Later, when Manmohan asks for a blanket, Angoori gets him an ice-cream.

videos.title: Vibhuti Agrees to Sleep On Ice
videos.overview: Vibhuti gets the same medicine from the 'Babaji' that Manmohan had got to keep himself warm. Manmohan gets upset on learning that Vibhuti has taken the medicine. Vibhuti announces that he will sleep on ice to prove himself but Anita laughs it off. Manmohan exchanges Vibhuti's medicine and Vibhuti fails to perform the challenge. Manmohan too fails to perform the challenge as he mistakenly takes an incorrect medicine. Manmohan and Vibhuti catch pneumonia and land in the hospital.

videos.title: Vibhuti Becomes Masakali
videos.overview: Due to Prem, Gulfam Kali injures her leg and is unable to perform for Prem's client. Vibhuti gets mesmerised with Angoori's dance and asks her to divorce Manmohan. Anita pressurises Vibhuti to earn money by lying to him that her grooming classes are not doing well. Vibhuti decides to earn money and performs as a lady called Masakali. Prem's client gets happy on seeing Masakali's dance and seals the business deal. Gulfam Kali learns that Vibhuti is Masakali and they both become business partners.

videos.title: Masakali Performs a Dance For Her Clients
videos.overview: Vibhuti hands over a bundle of cash to Anita and she suspects that Vibhuti is into gambling. Malkhan and Teeka overhear Happu Singh praise Masakali's dance and wish to see her dance. Vibhuti and Manmohan criticise Happu Singh for being a womaniser. Vibhuti asks Angoori to teach him how to dance and lies to Anita about his work. Manmohan sees Vibhuti leave with a lady at midnight. Masakali performs for Happu, Malkhan, Teeka and Prem. A drunk Happu Singh asks Masakali to dance on strewn beads.

videos.title: Manmohan Spies On Vibhuti
videos.overview: Anita wonders about Vibhuti's source of income and Manmohan instigates Anita against him. Vibhuti avoids Anita's questions after she sees him limping. Gulfam Kali threatens Vibhuti to continue performing as Masakali when he wishes to retire. Angoori teaches Vibhuti how to enhance his expressions while dancing. Anita asks Manmohan to spy on Vibhuti. Vibhuti unwillingly performs as Masakali. A drunk Happu Singh demands Masakali for a night. Manmohan learns that Vibhuti is Masakali.

videos.title: Anita Tells Vibhuti to Quit Dancing
videos.overview: Manmohan invites Anita to his house where he vows to expose Vibhuti's truth. Vibhuti fears of getting exposed when Gulfam Kali asks him to perform at Manmohan's house. Unwillingly, Vibhuti agrees to perform. Happu Singh is sad as Masakali is upset with him. Later, Anita and Angoori see Masakali perform at Manmohan's house and learn that Vibhuti is Masakali. An enraged Anita asks Vibhuti to stop performing as Masakali but he reveals that he is trapped. David wishes to see Masakali's dance.

videos.title: Anita Rescues Masakali From Gulfam's Clutches
videos.overview: Anita gets furious upon hearing David's wish to see Masakali's dance. Angoori is upset with Vibhuti for not doing the correct dance steps. Vibhuti pleads with Anita to allow him to perform as Masakali for one last time. Anita berates Happu Singh for going crazy over Masakali in spite of being married. Happu Singh and David go crazy about Masakali and Happu Singh takes Masakali with him. Happu Singh is shocked to learn Masakali's truth. A courageous Anita rescues Vibhuti from Gulfam Kali.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan's Courteous Behaviour
videos.overview: Anita and Angoori worry as Vibhuti and Manmohan bicker and abuse each other. Anita and Angoori get angry seeing the men of Modern colony abusing others and complain to the commissioner. Vibhuti and Manmohan don't pay heed to their wives when they ask them to behave decently. A TV anchor announces a reward of INR 5 lakhs to the 'Most well-behaved man' in the Modern colony. The next day, Happu Singh, Vibhuti and Manmohan start talking respectfully with everyone around.

videos.title: Most Well-behaved Man' In Modern Colony
videos.overview: Manmohan and Vibhuti display etiquettes to win the INR 5 lakhs reward for being the 'Most well-behaved man'. Malkhan and Teeka take Masterji's help in learning etiquettes. Anita berates Vibhuti as he refuses to enter the kitchen saying that his etiquettes do not allow him to do so. Tillu insults Manmohan and the latter accepts it with respect. Anita chides her washerman, Cheddi for spoiling her clothes but Vibhuti rewards him for being honest. Saxena taunts Happu Singh for faking etiquettes.

videos.title: Teeka and Malkhan Harass Masterji to Learn Manners
videos.overview: Anita and Vibhuti visit Manmohan's house for dinner and the men compete in displaying courtesy. Vibhuti and Manmohan fight about who would open the dish's lid and a furious Anita leaves without eating. Teeka and Malkhan harass Masterji to teach them etiquettes. Angoori chides Manmohan for his stubbornness. Vibhuti rewards Cheddi for being honest enough to accept that he has ruined Anita's clothes. Ammaji apprises Angoori about the auspiciousness of the night for conceiving a child.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan Bicker With Each Other
videos.overview: Angoori gets in a romantic mood but Manmohan avoids her in the name of etiquettes. Vibhuti invites Angoori and Manmohan for lunch where Vibhuti and Manmohan start competing again. Teeka and Malkhan kidnap Masterji to learn etiquettes from him. Saxena claims that Vibhuti and Manmohan are faking etiquettes. A lady smashes cake on Happu Singh's face for harassing her. Vibhuti and Manmohan begin abusing again when they learn that the competition of 'the Most well-behaved man' stands cancelled.

videos.title: Baba Premanand's Advice to Angoori
videos.overview: Prem complains to Vibhuti about his wife, hearing which Vibhuti starts deriding Anita. Anita overhears her insult and whacks Vibhuti in front of Modern colony residents. To teach Manmohan a lesson, Vibhuti disguises as Baba Premanand and asks Angoori to smash Manmohan 50 times for his long life. An innocent Angoori smashes Manmohan. Later, Angoori apologises and reveals the truth to Manmohan. Anita overhears Vibhuti telling Manmohan that it was his trick to take revenge.

videos.title: Vibhuti Ploughs His Garden to Impress Angoori
videos.overview: Anita's uncle gets a job for Vibhuti in Meerut but he refuses. This enrages Anita. Vibhuti learns that Angoori has high regards for farmers and makes up a story that he is also from a farmer's family. To impress Angoori, Vibhuti starts ploughing his garden. Vibhuti gives an offer to Teeka and Malkhan to join him as farmers. Angoori gets impressed seeing Vibhuti work hard as a farmer. But Anita gets furious on seeing her garden ploughed and confronts Vibhuti about his desire to become a farmer.

videos.title: Anita and Manmohan Suspect Vibhuti's Act
videos.overview: Manmohan insults Vibhuti for pretending to be a farmer and asks him to work in the real fields instead. Angoori supports Vibhuti. Teeka and Malkhan decide to join Vibhuti. Manmohan and Anita believe that Vibhuti is playing a drama just to avoid going to Meerut. Manmohan asks Anita to leave Vibhuti hungry to bring him back on track. But Angoori gets food for Vibhuti. Teeka and Malkhan work hard in the garden to sow the seeds. Teeka gives a massage to Malkhan and Saxena.

videos.title: Vibhuti Grows 10kgs Of Tomatoes Overnight
videos.overview: Anita claims that Vibhuti is a fraud farmer and is avoiding going Meerut. At night, Vibhuti buys ten kgs of tomatoes and places them in the garden. Angoori gets astonished seeing the grown tomatoes and wonders how the seeds bore the fruits in just a day. Vibhuti reveals that he has a secret formula for growing the tomatoes overnight. Manmohan and Anita ask Happu Singh to report against Vibhuti for farming in a residential area. Tillu insults Manmohan. Angoori vows to make Manmohan a farmer.

videos.title: Vibhuti Refuses to Reveal His Secret Formula
videos.overview: Anita throws Vibhuti out of the house for fooling everyone. Happu Singh accuses Vibhuti of troubling the residents because of his farming activity but the commissioner supports him. Manmohan gets furious with Vibhuti for ploughing inside his house but the commissioner supports Vibhuti. The media questions Vibhuti about his secret formula which he refuses to reveal. Anita is angry with Vibhuti for ploughing inside their house. A Chinese national spies on Vibhuti to learn about his secret formula.

videos.title: Vibhuti Gets Kidnapped By Chinese Men
videos.overview: Anita gets excited seeing Vibhuti's interview and calls him a scientist. Manmohan calls Vibhuti a fraud and accuses him of fooling everyone. Vibhuti gets kidnapped and thrashed by the Chinese for his secret formula. A worried Anita reports about Vibhuti's kidnapping to Happu Singh. A vegetable vendor exposes Vibhuti by revealing that Vibhuti has been buying tomatoes on credit from him. Meanwhile, Saxena rescues Vibhuti from the Chinese. Vibhuti reveals the truth to Malkhan and Teeka.

videos.title: Manmohan Gets Constipated
videos.overview: Manmohan is stressed because he is constipated and tries hard to get some relief. He lies to Anita about his constipation but Angoori blurts out the truth. A cunning Vibhuti gives a defective suggestion to Angoori to cure Manmohan's constipation. Vibhuti mocks Manmohan's state. Anita gets upset with Manmohan as he constantly blabbers about constipation. Ammaji suggests to Angoori to seduce Manmohan as a cure for his constipation. Angoori seduces Manmohan, which baffles him.

videos.title: Dr. Gupta's Medicines Fail to Cure Manmohan
videos.overview: Angoori seduces Manmohan but he gets irritated and avoids her. Angoori cries about Manmohan's actions which worries Anita and Vibhuti. Teeka and Malkhan mock Manmohan about his constipation. Manmohan overhears everyone making fun of him and lies that his constipation is cured. Dr Gupta gives medicine to Manmohan which bears no results. Anita gets annoyed as Vibhuti keeps talking about constipation. Manmohan slaps Saxena as the latter asks him to enjoy his current state.

videos.title: Manmohan Blocks His Colony's Water Supply
videos.overview: Manmohan whacks Teeka as he along with Malkhan constantly tease him about his constipation. Vibhuti instigates Teeka and he files an FIR against Manmohan with Happu Singh. Meanwhile, Angoori tries varied home remedies to cure Manmohan's constipation but fails. Manmohan hits Happu Singh as he irritates him by constantly repeating the word constipation. Anita uses meditation therapy on Manmohan, but that too fails. A frustrated Manmohan blocks the colony's water line to teach everyone a lesson.

videos.title: Manmohan is Finally Relieved Of Constipation
videos.overview: Manmohan refuses to unblock the water line for everyone to suffer what he is going through. Saxena reveals another working water line which disappoints Manmohan. Vibhuti and Angoori speak to a specialist but learn that he is a victim of constipation. Vibhuti hits on a new idea. Vibhuti, Angoori, Teeka, Malkhan and Happu Singh scare Manmohan by disguising scarily. The idea works and Manmohan is finally relieved of constipation. Angoori throws a party.

videos.title: Vibhuti Pretends to Commit Suicide
videos.overview: After a quarrel with Vibhuti, Manmohan lies to him that Prem has met with an accident, and asks him to take Happu Singh's new car. Vibhuti gets upset as Happu Singh's car gets stolen because of him which Manmohan and Happu Singh take discreetly. Manmohan makes Vibhuti his servant until he pays back for the car. Vibhuti learns about Manmohan's plan and pretends to have committed suicide which makes Happu and Manmohan confess their misdeeds in front of the commissioner.

videos.title: Angoori and Anita Prank Their Husbands
videos.overview: Manmohan and Vibhuti thank Prem for showing them a film and laud the actress in that film. Anita and Angoori get irritated as their husbands compare them with the vivacious film actress. A worried Anita and Angoori pick a solution from a magazine and play pranks on Manmohan and Vibhuti which infuriates them. Teeka and Malkhan mock Vibhuti and Manmohan as the latter discuss the pranks of their wives. An excited Anita decides to play a prank on Happu Singh.

videos.title: Angoori Lands Vibhuti In Trouble
videos.overview: Anita makes Happu Singh sit on a chair where she has spread adhesive because of which Happu Singh gets stuck to the chair. The Commissioner gets angry on seeing an irresponsible Happu Singh. To harass Vibhuti, Angoori lies to him that Masterji has teased her. A furious Vibhuti confronts Masterji for teasing Angoori and drags him to her. Meanwhile, Anita plays a prank on Manmohan. Angoori cunningly flips in front of Masterji and states that she has not said anything to Vibhuti.

videos.title: Happu Singh's Sudden 'death'
videos.overview: Vibhuti insults Dr Gupta as he advises him to start working. Angoori and Anita make their husbands do sit-ups and play pranks on them. Vibhuti and Manmohan decide to take revenge from Anita and Angoori with the help of Happu Singh. But instead of pretending, Happu Singh faints when Anita plays a prank on him. To take revenge from Vibhuti, Dr Gupta lies that Happu Singh is dead. Vibhuti and Manmohan get frightened and blame each other for the situation.

videos.title: Manmohan-vibhuti Try to Hide Happu's 'dead' Body
videos.overview: Vibhuti and Manmohan try to handle Happu Singh's dead body. They meet the commissioner on their way. Vibhuti and Manmohan deceive the commissioner and get Happu's dead body home. Anita and Angoori learn that it was Manmohan and Vibhuti's plan to harass them. Happu Singh shows some movements but nobody notices him as they are busy arguing. Cheddi, who mistakenly takes Happu Singh's dead body brings him back to Vibhuti. Vibhuti dresses Happu Singh as a lady in a veil and David asks him about her.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Head Gets Stuck In a Vessel
videos.overview: David flirts with the lady in the veil and is later, informed that the lady is Happu Singh. Vibhuti, Manmohan and David place Happu Singh's dead body in a rickshaw. The commissioner identifies the lady in the veil as Happu Singh by his shoes. As Anita and Angoori are confessing, Happu Singh regains consciousness and all are saved. Later, as Vibhuti flirts with Angoori his head gets stuck in a vessel. With great difficulty, Vibhuti is freed but Manmohan's head gets stuck in that vessel.

videos.title: Anita and Angoori Become Enemies
videos.overview: While consuming alcohol Vibhuti and Manmohan start quarrelling. Anita and Angoori ask their husbands to behave civilly with their neighbours but in vain. Anita and Angoori decide to teach their husbands a lesson. Vibhuti and Manmohan vow not to fight anymore. Anita and Angoori pretend to be enemies, and hurl insults on each other, witnessing which Manmohan and Vibhuti get stressed. Moreover, Vibhuti and Manmohan are asked by their wives not to cross the line drawn between their houses.

videos.title: Boredom Gang' Beats Vibhuti
videos.overview: Vibhuti and Manmohan mock the line drawn by Anita and Angoori. Anita and Angoori are glad to see Vibhuti and Manmohan being civil with each other but continue with their plan. Manmohan and Vibhuti get worried as Anita and Angoori insult each other. Dragging the drama, Anita and Angoori call each other their enemies and ask their husbands to stay away from each other. Vibhuti gets beaten by Saxena and Malkhan, who are a part of the 'Boredom gang', representing Angoori.

videos.title: Boredom Gang' and 'gori Gang's Enmity
videos.overview: Witnessing Anita and Angoori's enmity, Tillu and Teeka form a 'Gori gang' and Saxena, Prem and Malkhan form a 'Boredom gang' representing Anita and Angoori respectively. Anita and Angoori meet secretly to discuss the issue as the situation gets out of control. Vibhuti and Manmohan beg their wives to sort out their differences. Anita and Angoori are glad that their plan has worked and end their drama. But the 'Boredom gang' and 'Gori gang' continue their enmity and keep thrashing each other.

videos.title: Akshay Kumar Arrives In Modern Colony
videos.overview: Vibhuti and Manmohan learn about Anita and Angoori's plan to bring them together. Anita calls Jagdishwar Mishra to solve the matter. Actor Akshay Kumar who plays Jagdishwar Mishra in his new film arrives in Modern colony. Akshay Kumar sorts out the differences in the colony, and the residents unite. Akshay Kumar promotes his film 'Jolly LLB 2'. Later, Manmohan and Vibhuti thank their wives for teaching them a lesson. Soon, Vibhuti and Manmohan start bickering again.

videos.title: Angoori and Manmohan Follow Ammaji's Advice
videos.overview: Ammaji tells Manmohan and Angoori that as per Pandit Ramphal, her life is in danger. Ammaji asks Manmohan and Angoori to keep laughing at every given point of time, as a solution given by Pandit Ramphal to save her life. As per Ammaji's orders, Angoori and Manmohan keep laughing at the grave situations and the neighbourhood get annoyed with them. Later, following Ammaji's orders, Angoori and Manmohan start crying when Anita gives them a piece of good news, which leaves Anita and Vibhuti enraged.

videos.title: Modern Colony's Play On 'mughal Era'
videos.overview: Saxena informs everyone that his friend, Duckworth Lewis from London is making a show on the 'Mughal era' and that he would be writing the story. Saxena further says that he will cast the people of Modern colony for the drama. Manmohan and Vibhuti fight over the role of Salim and want the other's wife to play Anarkali. Vibhuti tries to teach Urdu to Angoori but fails. Saxena allots the roles, wherein Anita, Angoori, Vibhuti and Manmohan play Jodha Bai, Anarkali, Salim and Akbar respectively.

videos.title: Anita, Vibhuti, Manmohan, and Angoori’s Rehearsals
videos.overview: Teeka is unhappy with his role but gets convinced after Saxena mocks him. Happu Singh asks Saxena for Salim's role and threatens to stop the show when Saxena refuses. Saxena reveals that he has a written permission from the commissioner. Anita, Vibhuti, Manmohan and Angoori start rehearsing. Angoori gets stressed as she is unable to memorise the dialogues. During the live performance, Teeka and Malkhan falter, which upsets Saxena. Manmohan and Prem enact a scene beautifully.

videos.title: Ghara Pehelwan Gets Furious With Saxena's Play
videos.overview: Manmohan and Anita enact a historic scene from the 'Mughal era' in a comic way which makes the audience laugh. Angoori entertains as a 'Bhojpuri Anarkali'. The leader of a political party, Gharra Pehelwan gets furious as Saxena taints the great historic drama by converting it into a comedy. Vibhuti gets personal with Manmohan during the play. Gharra Pehelwan and his men, the 'Khunkhar Sena' reach the venue to stop the play while the audience loves the play.

videos.title: Khoonkhar Sena Stops The Play
videos.overview: The 'Khoonkhar Sena' stops the play and beats everyone. A furious Anita decides to complain to Commissioner Resham Pal. Ghara Pehelwan threatens Anita that he will make them regret destroying the historic play. The 'Khoonkhar Sena' paints Manmohan's face black. Anita, Vibhuti, Angoori and Manmohan discuss on how to handle the 'Khoonkhar Sena'. The 'Khoonkhar Sena' thrash Teeka and Malkhan. Later, everyone accuses Saxena of twisting the historic play.

videos.title: Ghara Pehelwan Settles The Matter For Inr 5000
videos.overview: Anita complains to Commissioner Resham Pal about the tyranny of the 'Khoonkhar Sena' but the commissioner is scared of them. Tillu temporarily settles the matter. Commissioner Resham Pal organises a meeting wherein Ghara Pehelwan points out the major defects in Saxena's play which is defaming history. Ghara Pehelwan fails to answer questions on Indian history and decides to settle the matter for INR 5 lakhs. Finally, Ghara Pehelwan settles for INR 5000 leaving everyone shocked.

videos.title: Anita Decides to Hold a Hockey Match
videos.overview: Anita reveals to the Modern colony that she was hit by a ball by the people of the neighbouring area and has, therefore, taken up a challenge of defeating them in a hockey match. Vibhuti concocts a story claiming to be a hockey champion. Vibhuti teaches romantic codes to Angoori saying that they are important for sports. Anita declares to Modern colony that Vibhuti shall be their hockey coach which makes them laugh. Anita berates the men for mocking Vibhuti and asks them to show him respect.

videos.title: Vibhuti Trains The Hockey Team
videos.overview: Manmohan tells Anita that he doesn't trust Vibhuti and introduces a new coach, Gyanchand. Gyanchand flirts with Anita and Manmohan throws him out. Anita excitedly watches old hockey matches to learn about various strategies. The next morning, Vibhuti starts the training session and gets everyone except Angoori exhausted. Vibhuti changes Manmohan's diet. Anita confronts Vibhuti for not making Angoori practice and gets happy on learning about Vibhuti's made-up strategy.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Training Strategy Tires Out His Team
videos.overview: Anita clears her doubts from Vibhuti about his training strategies. Teeka gets drained out with the training and complains to Happu about Vibhuti's strictness. Vibhuti sneaks into Manmohan's room at midnight and asks him to practice the game while he flirts with Angoori. Manmohan complains to Anita about Vibhuti's strictness and she admonishes him for being insincere. Everyone gets exhausted with Vibhuti's training. Vibhuti makes a special diet for Manmohan to make him fit.

videos.title: Vibhuti Organises a Lemon-and-spoon Match
videos.overview: Manmohan complains to Anita about Vibhuti's strictness. Manmohan introduces a new coach, Mahila who turns out to be a cricket coach. Manmohan tries to expose Vibhuti by getting him identified by his school principal but fails. Malkhan and Teeka cry as they are forced to turn bald. While everyone expects Vibhuti to teach them hockey he organises a lemon and spoon race for them. Meanwhile, Vibhuti flirts with Angoori in the secret code that he has taught her.

videos.title: David Exposes Vibhuti's Truth
videos.overview: Vibhuti interrupts Manmohan and Angoori's romance and orders Manmohan to take ten rounds of the colony. Vibhuti flirts with Angoori in the secret code. Manmohan sends goons from the enemy team to beat Vibhuti. The goons beat Prem instead as he is using Vibhuti's whistle. Anita removes Manmohan from the team for sending goons after Vibhuti. Manmohan apologises and begs Vibhuti to reinstate him in the team. David arrives and reveals to the team that Vibhuti is no great hockey player.

videos.title: Anita Decides to Make a Documentary Film
videos.overview: Anita decides to make a documentary film on Angoori and Ammajii's relationship to resolve the issue of arguments between daughters-in-law and mothers-in-law. Manmohan and Vibhuti argue with each other. Angoori asks Ammaji to visit them for a week. Manmohan vainly tries to convince Angoori to not shoot the film and stop Ammaji from visiting them. Vibhuti convinces Anita to postpone the film but she refuses when Happu tells her about his mother and wife's arguments.

videos.title: Anita Films Angoori and Ammaji's Relationship
videos.overview: Ammaji arrives and threatens Vibhuti who annoys Angoori. Saxena and Anita film Ammaji beating Manmohan in front of Angoori. Vibhuti tries to convince Angoori to ask Ammaji to leave but Ammaji chases him away. Anita and Saxena film Ammaji and Angoori in the kitchen. Angoori and Ammaji praise each other in front of the camera. Vibhuti mistakes Manmohan for Anita and kisses him. Manmohan and Vibhuti go to sleep. Malkhan and Teeka need money to pay their rent.

videos.title: Manmohan Tries to Hide From Ammaji
videos.overview: Malkhan and Teeka beg Happu for money but he refuses. Manmohan hires Teeka and Malkhan to chase Ammaji away from his house. Ammaji is a firm believer of fortune-telling and astrology. Teeka disguises himself as a fortune-teller to scare Ammaji away. Teeka fools Angoori but Ammaji sees through his disguise when he sneezes. Manmohan hides from Ammaji in Vibhuti's house. Ammaji finds Manmohan when she comes with Angoori to Vibhuti's house to shoot for the documentary film.

videos.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti's Plan to Scare Ramkali
videos.overview: Happu asks Malkhan and Teeka to shelter him in their house but they refuse. Vibhuti flirts with Angoori by singing poetry dedicated to her. When Ramkali confronts Vibhuti regarding the poetry, he insults her. Anita convinces a drunk Vibhuti and Manmohan to apologise to Ramkali for their misbehaviour. When Vibhuti and Manmohan apologise to Ramkali, they learn that she is scared of gorillas. Manmohan and Vibhuti hire Teeka and Malkhan to disguise as gorillas to scare Ramkali.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan Write a Fake Letter For Ammaji
videos.overview: Manmohan and Vibhuti learn that Ammaji is not afraid of gorillas and that she has trapped Teeka and Malkhan and made them her pet gorillas. Teeka and Malkhan seek Vibhuti and Manmohan's aid. Manmohan and Vibhuti decide to write a fake letter addressed to Ammaji from Pandit Ramphal. Ammaji reads the letter and thinks that Pandit Ramphal is sick. She decides to meet him. Ammaji is about to leave with Teeka and Malkhan when they reveal themselves and put Vibhuti and Manmohan in trouble.

videos.title: Pre-holi Festivities At Modern Colony
videos.overview: Vibhuti challenges an excited Angoori that he will apply colour on her during Holi. Manmohan helps Anita choose a costume for Holi and challenges her that he will apply colour on her while playing Holi. A priest tells Teeka and Malkhan their fortune in exchange for 'bhang'. Happu Singh, Saxena, Manmohan, Vibhuti, Anita and Angoori celebrate before the day of Holi. Prem arrives with Gulfam Kali who dances at the party. Teeka and Malkhan apply colour to a woman's face.

videos.title: Tirri and His Goons Spoil The Holi Celebrations
videos.overview: Commissioner Resham Pal reveals that Tirri, a local wrestler and gangster has banned the celebration of Holi in Modern colony using his political influence. Teeka and Malkhan visit Tirri to apologise for their mistake along with Manmohan and Vibhuti. Manmohan and Vibhuti insult Tirri's girlfriend and get beaten by Tirri's goons. Vibhuti tries to play Holi with Angoori but Tirri's goons catch him and beat him. Manmohan and Anita decide to play Holi secretly. Tirri's goons arrive at Anita's house.

videos.title: Tirri's Goons Strip Happu Naked For Playing Holi
videos.overview: Manmohan accidentally throws water from a bucket on Tirri's goon instead of Anita. Tirri's goons beat Manmohan. Tillu arrives and threatens Manmohan that he will smear his face with colour unless Manmohan pays him his wages. When Tillu extorts his wages and colours Manmohan's face, Tirri's goons beat Manmohan again. When Saxena applies colour to Teeka and Malkhan they receive a beating from the goons. Happu Singh decides to play Holi with Anita but the goons catch him and strip him naked.

videos.title: Alia Bhatt and Varun Dhawan Teach Tirri a Lesson
videos.overview: Vibhuti suggests that they should play imaginary Holi. The Mishras and Tiwaris play imaginary Holi but are stopped by Tirri's goons. Vibhuti mixes sleeping pills in a goon's drink but Happu drinks it instead and falls asleep. Saxena tricks Teeka and Malkhan into playing Holi. The Tiwaris and the Mishras decide to play Holi at a friend's place. Alia Bhatt and Varun Dhawan arrive to promote their film 'Badrinath ki Dulhania'. Varun and Alia teach Tirri a lesson. Modern Colony celebrates Holi.

videos.title: Modern Colony Celebrates Holi
videos.overview: Modern Colony plays Holi. Teeka, Malkhan, Prem and Happu chase Gulfam and smear colour on her face. Gulfam plays Holi with Vibhuti. The residents of Modern colony sing and dance together. Angoori and Anita are intoxicated after drinking 'bhang'. Angoori annoys Manmohan by applying colour on his face. Anita beats Vibhuti with a stick. Teeka and Malkhan sort their differences with the goons and play Holi with them. Happu and Tillu trick Teeka and Malkhan and smear colour on their face.

videos.title: Manmohan Gets a Big Order
videos.overview: Taylor, Manmohan's American client, gives him an INR 20 lakhs worth of order but plans to confirm the order only after seeing Manmohan's showroom. Manmohan looks for a place for his undergarment showroom. Vibhuti offers his house for the showroom in exchange for money. Vibhuti says that he will act like a salesman and convince Anita to be the brand ambassador of the showroom for INR 60000. Vibhuti visits Angoori and flirts with her while giving her a salesgirl training for the showroom.

videos.title: Anita Shoots For an Undergarments' Ad
videos.overview: Vibhuti convinces Anita to shoot the advertisement for Manmohan's undergarments by explaining to her the monetary benefits. Manmohan hires Teeka and Saxena to be fake customers in his showroom in front of the client. Manmohan and Happu watch Saxena shoot the advertisement with Anita. Anita poses with the undergarments. As the showroom gets ready, Manmohan asks Vibhuti to conduct a rehearsal. Manmohan tells Angoori to forget the flirty salesgirl training received from Vibhuti.

videos.title: Tillu Tricks Manmohan and Extorts His Wages
videos.overview: Vibhuti argues with Manmohan while trying to trick him into paying extra money. Happu asks Manmohan for money. Tillu arrives in the showroom in the disguise of a Chinese. Tillu tricks Manmohan and extorts his wages from him. Anita feels pity for Manmohan but Vibhuti says that Manmohan is greedy and he deserves to be tricked by Tillu. Angoori tries to console an angry Manmohan. The client calls Manmohan and says that he wishes to watch a dance performance in Manmohan's showroom.

videos.title: Ross Turns Out to be a Terrorist
videos.overview: Saxena disguises as a woman and gives a dance performance for Ross who enjoys it. Ross happily gives Manmohan a cheque of INR 20 lakhs. Ross gives Manmohan a suitcase and says that his friend will pick it up later. Commissioner Resham Pal gives Happu Singh orders to catch a terrorist in possession of RDX. Ross turns out to be the terrorist with a suitcase full of RDX. Happu Singh argues with Saxena and Teeka. The Mishras and the Tiwaris try to dispose of the suitcase filled with the explosives.

videos.title: Anita and Angoori Get Rewarded
videos.overview: Vibhuti runs away, as the commissioner arrives with a sniffer dog and Happu for the suitcase. Vibhuti hides the suitcase, but Anokhelal spots him and brings the suitcase back. The commissioner, along with Happu and the dog, desperately hunt for the suitcase. Vibhuti asks Prem to lure the dog away from their home. Manmohan dumps the suitcase in the jungle, but Teeka and Malkhan bring it back. Anita and Angoori get a reward when they give the suitcase to the commissioner and tell him the truth.

videos.title: Vibhuti Becomes an Underworld Don
videos.overview: When Vibhuti insults Manmohan, they start arguing. Anita arrives and scolds Vibhuti for staying unemployed. Vibhuti's uncle who disappeared in his childhood arrives. Vibhuti's uncle reveals that he is an underworld don and wants Vibhuti to inherit his criminal business. Vibhuti agrees and inherits the criminal business and becomes an underworld don. Vibhuti makes Anokhelal his subordinate and calls him Narang. Vibhuti threatens Manmohan as he always insults him. Vibhuti bribes Happu.

videos.title: Episode 538
Manmohan Becomes a Police Inspector
videos.overview: Manmohan shows the commissioner pictures of Happu accepting bribes from Vibhuti. The commissioner removes Happu from his post and makes Manmohan a police inspector. Manmohan requests the commissioner to make Teeka and Malkhan his subordinates. Manmohan confronts Vibhuti and vows to stop his smuggling and arrest him. Angoori tries to stop Manmohan from going against Vibhuti. Anita tries to stop Vibhuti from smuggling. Vibhuti steals more cow dung, and Manmohan conducts an investigation.

videos.title: Anushka Sharma Gives Tips to Angoori and Anita
videos.overview: Actress Anushka Sharma arrives to promote her film 'Phillauri'. Anushka dances on a song from her film with Teeka and Malkhan. Anushka gives Anita and Angoori a suggestion to help them make a plan and teach their husbands a lesson. Manmohan refuses to pay Tillu his wages. Anita and Angoori recruit Tillu to help them punish Manmohan and Vibhuti. Manmohan and Vibhuti argue. Anita and Angoori act like they are killing Tillu to scare Manmohan and Vibhuti. Anita lies to Vibhuti about her gang.

videos.title: Episode 541
Vibhuti Disguises As Katori, a Masseuse
videos.overview: Manmohan looks for a masseuse for Angoori, who sprains her ankle. Disguised as one, Vibhuti arrives at the Tiwari house as Katori and finds that Angoori is cured. He is forced to massage Manmohan and Happu, leaving him disappointed as he wished to massage Angoori's foot. To his discomfort, Anita expresses her desire to get a massage from Katori. Later, Manmohan looks for Katori to massage Angoori's head. Vibhuti, disguised as Katori, reaches the Tiwari house and finds Angoori playing a game.

videos.title: Manmohan Clicks Compromising Pictures Of Vibhuti
videos.overview: Vibhuti, as Katori, gets disappointed on seeing a well Angoori. Manmohan gets a massage from Katori, and Happu takes him to massage Anita. Anita finds Katori's hands familiar. Happu, Teeka and Malkhan get their massage done by Katori. Manmohan chances upon Vibhuti changing out of Katori's attire in the bushes. While getting a massage from Katori, Manmohan fakes paralysis and clicks Vibhuti's incriminating photos, which he sends to Anita. He makes a threatening call to Vibhuti.

videos.title: Anita Defends Katori
videos.overview: An angry Anita throws Vibhuti out of the home. Vibhuti hides his face and pretends to be a beggar. The police looks for Vibhuti, and Manmohan declares a reward of INR 15000 on him. Manmohan's pretence of paralysis is exposed, and Anita and Angoori admonish him. Happu, Teeka and Malkhan thrash Vibhuti. Anita defends him and points out each one's ulterior motives behind getting massaged by Katori. Manmohan apologises to Vibhuti and shares his alcohol. Vibhuti introduces Angoori to online shopping.

videos.title: Manmohan Claims to be a Painter
videos.overview: Vibhuti angers Anita when he sketches her cartoon. To impress Anita, Manmohan claims to be a painter and gets cornered by her to paint her portrait. Vibhuti informs Angoori, who insists that Manmohan make her portrait. Manmohan sketches her cartoon and calls it Modern Art. Seeing Saxena's awesome paintings, Manmohan takes his help in painting Anita via a proxy. Manmohan starts his work on Anita's portrait and ensures that Vibhuti leaves the house. Manmohan looks for Saxena outside the window.

videos.title: Vibhuti Uncovers Manmohan's Lie
videos.overview: Saxena paints Anita's portrait outside her window while Manmohan pretends to paint with Anita posing. Manmohan sends Anita out of the room and exchanges his portrait with Saxena's. Vibhuti shows the badly made Angoori's sketch to Anita. Anita is pleased with hers. Vibhuti devises a plan to expose Manmohan. Disguised as a nawab, he lures Manmohan with cash to paint his wife's portrait. Manmohan gets it done by Saxena. Vibhuti threatens to chop Manmohan's hands, compelling him to reveal the truth.

videos.title: Chatanki's Spirit Possesses Vibhuti
videos.overview: Vibhuti overhears Angoori sobbing while remembering her childhood friend Chatanki, who had drowned to death 15 years ago. While consoling Angoori, Ammaji thrashes Manmohan. Seeing Angoori's feelings for Chatanki, Vibhuti gets an idea. He fakes being possessed by Chatanki's spirit, which makes Angoori ecstatic but distresses Manmohan. Vibhuti insults and slaps Manmohan, and Anita stops Manmohan from retaliating. Manmohan gets Chatanki's story verified by Happu. The doctor monitors Vibhuti.

videos.title: Manmohan Pretends to be Chatanki
videos.overview: Vibhuti, as Chatanki, flirts with Angoori, and Angoori narrates their childhood tales. Teeka, Malkhan and Happu are petrified on seeing Anokhee's witchy behaviour. Anita calls Dr Manharan Sharma, who treats madness, to Kanpur to cure Vibhuti. Vibhuti calls Prem to ensure that the doctor does not reach Modern Colony. Manmohan overhears Vibhuti's truth. Manmohan shocks all when he starts speaking like Chatanki and slaps Vibhuti. Manmohan gets irritated as Angoori refuses to share the bed with him.

videos.title: The Real Chatanki Arrives to Meet Angoori
videos.overview: Pretending to be possessed, Manmohan lands in the bedroom of the Tiwaris and thrashes Vibhuti. To trouble Angoori, Manmohan alternates from being himself to Chantaki's spirit. Anita calls Dr Manharan Sharma for Manmohan's treatment. Vibhuti overhears Manmohan's truth when he calls Tillu to stop the doctor. Both Vibhuti and Manmohan pretend to be possessed by Chatanki's spirit and are exposed with Chatanki's arrival. Saxena tells Teeka, Malkhan and Happu that Anokhee is a gymnast and not a witch.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Photo Gets Published As a Criminal
videos.overview: Manmohan is shocked to read the news with Vibhuti's photo about a crazy lover, who has murdered his first two wives and now lives in Kanpur with the third one. Manmohan takes Anita to his house. The newspaper's editor pulls up his employee for putting Vibhuti's photo with the criminal's record. Vibhuti is ostracised and wonders why everyone's avoiding him. Anita goes with Manmohan to collect her clothes, and Happu renders Vibhuti unconscious. A distraught Vibhuti hits Saxena insanely.

videos.title: Manmohan Labels Vibhuti As a Criminal
videos.overview: Manmohan instigates Anita against Vibhuti saying that the latter wants to murder her. Vibhuti gets disturbed as Anita stops speaking to him. Manmohan, Anita and Angoori get scared on seeing Vibhuti holding a knife. Anita confronts Vibhuti. Vibhuti sees a fly sitting on Anita and tries to kill it with a knife. Everyone jumps to the conclusion that he wants to kill Anita. Vibhuti clears the air by stating that the advertisement was for a commercial which has wrongly mentioned him as a criminal.

videos.title: Vibhuti Pretends to be a Ceo
videos.overview: Anita lies to her uncle, Vishambhar that Vibhuti is a CEO of an MNC. Vishambhar decides to meet Vibhuti and Anita asks Vibhuti to pretend to be a CEO and dress like one. The neighbours mock Vibhuti on seeing him in a suit. An irate Vibhuti insults Vishambhar not knowing that he is Anita's uncle. Manmohan leaves no opportunity to impress Vishambhar. To escape embarrassment, Anita introduces Vibhuti to Vishambhar as her brother-in-law, Chandu. Anita berates Vibhuti for insulting Vishambhar.

videos.title: Episode 553
Angoori Lies That She is Pregnant
videos.overview: As Vishambhar finalises his daughter's engagement with Chandu, Angoori lies that she is pregnant with Vibhuti's child. Saxena thrashes Vibhuti for ruining Anita and Angoori's lives. But Vishambhar remains adamant. Vibhuti offers Teeka and Malkhan to marry Vishambhar's daughter. An overjoyed Teeka and Malkhan compete in impressing Vishambhar. Later, Anita spills the beans that Chandu is Vibhuti. Vishambhar reveals that he was joking all the while and was already aware of the truth.

videos.title: Manmohan Becomes a Tenant At Anita's House
videos.overview: Against Vibhuti's will,Anita puts the living room of her house on rent. Manmohan decides to grab the opportunity to live with Anita and purposely picks up a fight with Angoori. Angoori complains to Ammaji who throws Manmohan out. Manmohan happily goes to Anita's house and asks her to make him her tenant since he has fought with Angoori. Vibhuti agrees to take Manmohan as his tenant on certain conditions. Happu asks Vibhuti to make him his tenant. Vibhuti insults Happu and refuses.

videos.title: Angoori Calls Manmohan Back Home
videos.overview: Angoori gets worried about Manmohan's whereabouts. Ammaji admonishes Vibhuti for instigating Angoori against Manmohan. Anita snaps at Manmohan as she slips on the floor because of him. Vibhuti and Anita unwillingly let Manmohan sleep on their bedroom floor as the fan in the hall doesn't work. Malkhan and Teeka throw Manmohan out of Vibhuti's house and Manmohan returns to his house. Ammaji throws him out too but an innocent Angoori calls Manmohan back home.

videos.title: Anita Conducts Vibhuti's Funeral Prayer
videos.overview: Anita's uncle asks her to urgently arrange for INR 5 lakhs. Anita asks Vibhuti to sell their house for money but he refuses. Anita unwillingly supports Vibhuti as he decides to cheat the Insurance agency for money. Vibhuti pretends to fall off a cliff and is declared dead. Anita arranges a prayer ceremony for Vibhuti. Vibhuti also attends his prayer ceremony disguised as an old man. Modern colony's residents insult the late Vibhuti while addressing him in the prayer ceremony.

videos.title: Manmohan Chides Anita
videos.overview: Anita feels disgusted with the insults being hurled at Vibhuti in his prayer ceremony. Vibhuti, disguised as an old man praises Vibhuti and chides everyone for speaking ill about him. Manmohan gets emotional and reveals that he will miss Vibhuti. An insurance agent attends the prayer ceremony to validate Vibhuti's death. At night, Vibhuti flirts with Angoori pretending to be a ghost. Manmohan is shocked to see Anita dance joyfully and confronts her for being indifferent about Vibhuti's death.

videos.title: Manmohan Misses Vibhuti
videos.overview: Manmohan confronts Anita for being indifferent towards Vibhuti's death. Anita claims to be courageous to move on. Later, Manmohan watches Anita romance with Vibhuti. When he confronts Anita she brushes it off. The Insurance agent gives his approval to pass Vibhuti's Insurance claim. Happu tries to comfort Anita and she shoos him away. At night, Manmohan misses Vibhuti and prepares a drink in Vibhuti's remembrance. Acting like a ghost Vibhuti arrives in front of Manmohan.

videos.title: David Transfers His Property In Vibhuti's Name
videos.overview: Vibhuti shares a drink with Manmohan and later, scares Malkhan and Teeka acting as a ghost. David reveals that he has transferred INR 20 crore property in Vibhuti's name, hearing which Vibhuti reveals that he is alive. But the will gets cancelled as David's bank accounts are sealed. The chaos ends as Anita's uncle reveals that he does not need the INR 5 lakhs anymore. Later, while having dinner, Anita stomps out angrily as Vibhuti sings praises of the food cooked by Angoori.

videos.title: Anita Decides to Prove Her Culinary Skills
videos.overview: Anita feels jealous as Vibhuti lauds Angoori's culinary skills and disregards her feelings. Anita decides to show everyone that she is also a good cook and invites her neighbours for lunch. Anita's dishes turn out to be very spicy but everyone sings false praises of her. Anita overhears Manmohan and Vibhuti complaining about the food but feels glad that everyone else loves the food. Anita accepts that she is an excellent entrepreneur but not a good cook. Anita hands the kitchen back to Vibhuti.

videos.title: Manmohan and Angoori Decide to Remarry
videos.overview: Pandit Hazari Prasad reveals that Manmohan and Angoori are technically unmarried yet as he had recited incorrect prayers during their marriage. A shocked Manmohan and Angoori decide to remarry. Malkhan and Teeka become news channel reporters and catch Happu taking a bribe. Vibhuti instigates Angoori not to marry Manmohan and indirectly asks her to have an affair with him. A cunning Vibhuti organises a bachelors party for Manmohan and asks Malkhan and Teeka to organise a live telecast.

videos.title: Vibhuti Defames Manmohan
videos.overview: Happu Singh and Manmohan reach Gulfam Kali's place for the bachelors' party organised by Vibhuti who does not turn up. Vibhuti purposely watches the television in Anita and Angoori's presence. Teeka and Malkhan organise a live telecast of Happu Singh and Manmohan's dance with Gulfam Kali. Anita and Angoori are furious and reprimand Manmohan who blames Vibhuti. Later, an emotional Angoori forgives Manmohan. Vibhuti offers one more assignment to Teeka and Malkhan to defame Manmohan.

videos.title: Angoori and Manmohan Remarry
videos.overview: Vibhuti traps Manmohan yet again by forcing him to bet in a game of cards. Angoori gets infuriated on seeing Manmohan gamble. Manmohan gets upset as Angoori refuses to marry him. Manmohan exposes Vibhuti for trapping him in illegal activities. Later, Angoori and Manmohan remarry. The next day, Vibhuti suddenly meets his old friend, Sulochana and converses with her. Sulochana's husband, Ram Sevak gets angry seeing them together. Manmohan faces trouble as his shop is sealed by the municipality.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Ram Sevak Act Friendly
videos.overview: Happu Singh is worked up as he is caught taking a bribe. The minister, Ram Sevak whacks Vibhuti assuming that he has an affair with his wife, Sulochana and warns him to stay away from her. To save their embarrassment, Vibhuti and Ram Sevak act friendly with each other publicly. Anita rebukes Manmohan and Vibhuti for washing utensils at each other's house instead of their own house. The entire neighbourhood flatter Vibhuti to get their problems solved by Ram Sevak.

videos.title: Ram Sevak Apologises to Vibhuti
videos.overview: While Vibhuti feeds 'pani puri' to Sulochana, Ram Sevak and Anita secretly watch them. Manmohan agrees to become Vibhuti's servant hoping to stop his shop from shutting down. The neighbourhood thrash Vibhuti on learning that he is not friends with Ram Sevak. As Manmohan and Angoori are about to leave for their village, Ram Sevak apologises to Vibhuti for whacking him. Sulochana reveals that she had enacted a drama to make Ram Sevak jealous. Ram Sevak saves Manmohan's shop from closing down.

videos.title: Vibhuti Gets Threatened By a Blackmailer
videos.overview: Manmohan and Vibhuti narrate stories to insult each other. Happu Singh informs Manmohan and Vibhuti about the death of their electrician, Girdharilal by an electric shock. Anita warns Vibhuti against having an affair with another woman. Vibhuti gets a task from a blackmailer who threatens him and asks him to thrust a cucumber in Manmohan's mouth. Vibhuti obliges the blackmailer and Manmohan complains to Happu who refuses to file Manmohan's complaint.

videos.title: Vibhuti Tells Anita About His Blackmailer
videos.overview: Vibhuti apologises to Angoori for his actions saying that he is a victim of a disease which has made him lose control over himself. Vibhuti throws away a gift sent by the blackmailer to Anita. The blackmailer threatens Vibhuti and asks him to whip Manmohan with a sandal. Vibhuti informs Anita about the blackmailer. Manmohan is baffled as Vibhuti mercilessly whips him. Late at night, Manmohan complains to Anita about Vibhuti's actions but Anita berates Manmohan for disturbing her sleep.

videos.title: Manmohan is Flustered With Vibhuti's Behaviour
videos.overview: Vibhuti fools Angoori and flirts with her again blaming it on the disease. A frustrated Manmohan asks Happu to file a report against Vibhuti but Happu shrugs it off as a minor case. Happu and the Commissioner tap the blackmailer's call and he reveals that he is Girdharilal's spirit. Following the blackmailer's order, the Commissioner asks Vibhuti to throw milk on Manmohan's face and Vibhuti obliges. Manmohan gets frustrated after Vibhuti misbehaves with him time and again.

videos.title: Manmohan Gets Blackmailed
videos.overview: Vibhuti reveals to Anita and the Commissioner that he had fun whacking Manmohan but at the same time is feeling guilty too. Manmohan creates chaos and sends Vibhuti to a mental asylum. The blackmailer then asks Manmohan to ill-treat Anita and Manmohan obliges. Anita gets furious with Manmohan and admonishes him for his actions. Meanwhile, Saxena convinces Vibhuti to take some electric shocks at the asylum. Manmohan performs his next task by smudging the cake on Malkhan, Happu and Teeka's face.

videos.title: Anita, Angoori and Commissioner Nab Girdharilal
videos.overview: Manmohan is also sent to the asylum for harassing people. Anita and Angoori decide to nab the blackmailer, Girdharilal. Anita and Angoori along with the Commissioner nab the blackmailer, Girdharilal. Girdharilal finally confesses that he was taking revenge from Vibhuti and Manmohan and settling a previous score. Vibhuti and Manmohan are set free from the asylum and Girdharilal is sent to the asylum. David tears the will on learning that Vibhuti has been sent to the mental asylum.

videos.title: Vibhuti Gives Anita a Bicycle Ride
videos.overview: Anita becomes unconscious after getting a sunstroke. Manmohan accuses Vibhuti of disregarding Anita. Anita gets upset as Vibhuti is unable to provide her adequate means of commuting. Vibhuti takes Anita on a bicycle ride which makes Manmohan jealous. Manmohan tries to give Anita relief from the scorching heat. Manmohan is tempted to buy a scooter to give Anita a ride to and fro from her grooming classes. Vibhuti convinces Angoori for a bicycle ride but Saxena deflates his bicycle's tyre.

videos.title: Vibhuti Decides to Write a Book
videos.overview: Vibhuti beats Saxena for puncturing his bicycle's tyre. Manmohan buys a two-wheeler and takes Angoori on a ride which makes Vibhuti jealous. Anita suffers from sunstroke yet again and berates Vibhuti for not picking her up on time. An excited Manmohan day-dreams of taking Anita on a ride on his scooter. Anita orders Vibhuti to pick her up and drop her from her grooming classes. Since Anita dominates Vibhuti, he tells her that he will write a book on her which will be titled 'Hitler lady'.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan End Up Injured
videos.overview: Manmohan punctures Vibhuti's bicycle's tyre and offers a ride to Anita but Anita leaves with her friend. Happu mistakenly hits Manmohan with his scooter which causes Manmohan to fracture his leg. Vibhuti dreams about taking Angoori on a bicycle ride but Saxena punctures Vibhuti's bicycle once again. Teeka and Malkhan borrow Manmohan's scooter for one day and meet with an accident with Vibhuti. Later, as an injured Manmohan and Vibhuti watch Angoori takes Anita on a scooter ride.

videos.title: Happu Becomes In-charge Of a 'romeo Squad'
videos.overview: Happu is made an in-charge of a 'Romeo Squad' to protect the women from the eve-teasers. Happu catches Malkhan and Teeka teasing women. Later, Happu catches Vibhuti flirting with Angoori and spares him after accepting a bribe from him. Happu observes Manmohan watching Anita dance and spares him after he is paid some money. Happu pounces on Prem as he dances with Gulfam Kali on obscene songs and arrests Vibhuti once again as he feeds 'pani puri' to Anita publicly.

videos.title: Happu Gets Suspended
videos.overview: Happu refuses to arrest Saxena who wants to get beaten for fun. Happu mistakenly lays his hands on the Commissioner romancing with his wife and gets a stern warning. Tired of being purposely harassed by Happu; Anita, Angoori, Vibhuti and Manmohan romance openly as per their plan. Malkhan and Teeka nab Happu taking a bribe and expose him in front of the Commissioner. The Commissioner confronts Happu for taking law in his hands for personal benefit and is suspended for a week from his post.

videos.title: Vibhuti Decides to Earn Money
videos.overview: Masterji whips Manmohan for disturbing him while teaching Ladoo. Manmohan plans to get a damaged wall repaired. Anita chides Vibhuti for being a spendthrift and asks him to earn money. Vibhuti decides to repair Manmohan's damaged wall to earn money with an ulterior motive of spending time with Angoori. Vibhuti claims to be a civil engineer and forces Manmohan to give the repair job. He hires Teeka and Malkhan for the work. Vibhuti interrupts Manmohan and Angoori while they are romancing.

videos.title: Vibhuti Works On Manmohan's Damaged Wall
videos.overview: Vibhuti disturbs Angoori and Manmohan at night asking for money to purchase the material. On Angoori's insistence, Manmohan gives Vibhuti some money. Manmohan snaps at Angoori for providing food to Vibhuti, Malkhan and Teeka for free. Manmohan complains to Anita that Vibhuti is not working properly. Anita gets splashed with paint and scolds Manmohan after seeing that Vibhuti and his team are working hard. Vibhuti flirts with Angoori while pretending to repair the damaged wall.

videos.title: Vibhuti Deliberately Delays Repair Work
videos.overview: Vibhuti disturbs Manmohan and Angoori again. David observes a stranger entering Anita's house and tears the will assuming that Anita is having an affair. Manmohan complains to Anita about Vibhuti as he breaks the water pipe and creates a ruckus in the name of repairing the wall. With the help of Teeka and Malkhan, Vibhuti extends the work so that he can stay at Angoori's house for longer. Anita gets hit by a brick as she visits Manmohan's house to check on Vibhuti.

videos.title: Happu Arrests Vibhuti, Teeka and Malkhan
videos.overview: Manmohan asks Anita to punish Vibhuti as the latter is creating chaos at his house in the name of repairing the wall. Manmohan accuses Vibhuti for his head injury. Happu asks Vibhuti for his Civil Engineering degree certificate which Vibhuti fails to provide. Happu arrests Malkhan, Teeka and Vibhuti. Vibhuti apologises and begs Happu to release him. Happu orders the trio to refurbish the jail before they are set free. Vibhuti learns that it was Manmohan and Anita's plan to set him straight.

videos.title: Tillu Accuses Manmohan Of Fraud
videos.overview: Manmohan gets excited upon getting an advance payment for an order. Tillu asks for his salary but Manmohan refuses. Vibhuti offers to help Tillu in exchange for money. Tillu threatens to drink poison to get his salary. Manmohan gives Tillu his salary from the money given to him by Gupta. Tillu refuses to give commission to Vibhuti. Manmohan learns about the fraudulent Gupta in the news. Happu arrives with Tillu with the fake notes given by Manmohan and accuses Manmohan of the fraud.

videos.title: Gulfam Kali Wants to Get Married to Zorawar
videos.overview: Vibhuti and Manmohan dream about romancing each otherâ€™s wife. The next morning, Gulfam Kali informs Anita, Vibhuti, Manmohan and Angoori that she has fallen in love with Zorawar who belongs to a dacoit family. Gulfam Kali asks Vibhuti and Manmohan to pretend that they are her dacoit brothers. Prem grieves after learning that Gulfam Kali has decided to marry Zorawar while Happu him. Anita and Angoori convince their husbands to help Gulfam Kali. Gulfam Kali asks Anita if they have any horses.

videos.title: Gulfam Kali Introduces Her 'family'
videos.overview: Gulfam Kali informs Anita that they will have to arrange for a few horses. Vibhuti and Manmohan go in search of horses. Unable to find horses, they borrow a donkey from Chedi. Zorawar arrives with his father, Dilawar and mother, Putlibai. Zorawar's family tells their dacoit history which scares Manmohan and Vibhuti. Vibhuti and Manmohan introduce themselves as Daku Jagga and Daku Ranga. Saxena pretends to be Gulfam Kali's mother, Jhulan Devi. Gulfam Kali is introduced to Zorawar's family.

videos.title: Happu Informs Commissioner About Gulfam
videos.overview: Anita and Angoori pretend to be kidnapped, rich women. Dilawar falls for Jhulan Devi. Anita and Angoori dance on Dilawar's request. Happu informs the Commissioner about Gulfam Kali's marriage being arranged with a dacoit. Anita and Angoori confront their husbands for making them dance in front of everyone. Gulfam Kali tells Vibhuti and Manmohan that Dilawar finds them less dangerous and asks them to shed blood to impress Dilawar. Manmohan and Vibhuti approach Prem for help.

videos.title: Zorawar's Family's Truth
videos.overview: Dilawar aims at Teeka to shoot him but Jhulan Devi stops him. Pretending to be Gulfam Kali's lover Prem arrives but is beaten by Jagga and Ranga. Gulfam Kali informs that Zorawar's family has agreed for her marriage with him. The Commissioner is confused about arresting Zorawar's family. Zorawar's family reveal that they are Special Intelligence Agents and are going to arrest everyone. Anita and Manmohan reveal the truth of their pretence to the Agents.

videos.title: David Tears His Property Papers Again
videos.overview: Anita asks Vibhuti to romance with her dressed as Daku Jagga. David sees Vibhuti climbing up to his balcony and mistakes him for a dacoit. David is shocked to see Anita with a dacoit and confronts her for having an affair. Anita reveals the truth after David informs that he has willed his property to her. David tears the property papers and leaves. Malkhan and Teeka trick Angoori into giving them money to buy an expensive gift for Teeka's girlfriend, Sunita.

videos.title: The 'sahi Pakde Hain' Band
videos.overview: Manmohan suffers from an earache and scolds Angoori for singing which makes her angry. Anita is frustrated with Vibhuti's unemployment and taunts him. Saxena tells Vibhuti that he is a one-man-band. Vibhuti decides to start a band called "Sahi Pakde Hain Band". Anita disapproves of Vibhuti's plan. Dr Gupta informs Manmohan that his ear is infected and asks him to stay away from any loud sound. Vibhuti and Saxena include Malkhan, Teeka, and Tillu in their band.

videos.title: Anita Tries to Stop Bandmaster Vibhuti
videos.overview: Suffering from an ear infection Manmohan irks Anita when he hears the opposite of what is being said. Rajwati, Anitaâ€™s NRI cousin informs Anita that she will be visiting with her boyfriend, John. Anita asks Vibhuti to stop working as a bandmaster as it will embarrass her in front of Rajwati. Vibhuti and his band practice on the street which disturbs Anita and Manmohan. Manmohan asks Angoori to stop singing in Vibhuti's band but allows her to sing after getting scolded by Ammaji.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Band's First Performance
videos.overview: Happu teases Vibhuti for starting a band but gets insulted in return. Masterji books Vibhutiâ€™s band. Angoori tells Anita that Manmohan insults her for singing and that it is a waste of time. Vibhuti informs Angoori that they have got work and need to practice. Vibhutiâ€™s band is thrown out for playing inappropriate songs at a funeral. Anita asks Happu to shut Vibhutiâ€™s band. Gulfam Kali offers to work as a dancer with Vibhutiâ€™s band.

videos.title: Anita Flirts With John
videos.overview: Happu locks Vibhuti and his band members in jail but the Commissioner asks him to set Vibhuti and his members free. Rajwati arrives with her boyfriend, John to meet Anita. Anita asks Rajwati to lend her John to teach Vibhuti a lesson. Vibhuti is shocked to see Anita flirting with John. David arrives at Mishra's house. On seeing Vibhuti watching them Anita refuses to recognise David. Anita tells David that she is not anyone's daughter-in-law anymore.

videos.title: Anita Tells Vibhuti That She's Marrying John
videos.overview: Anita tells David that she has left Vibhuti and is marrying John. Vibhuti overhears Anita and is devastated. Vibhuti tells David that Anita is angry with him for working as a bandmaster. Anita asks Vibhuti to perform at her house. Vibhuti arrives with his band at the party. Rajwati announces that Anita is marrying John. A heartbroken Vibhuti pleads Anita to not leave him. Anita feels sorry for Vibhuti and tells him that she is not leaving him and that the drama was created to teach him a lesson.

videos.title: Angoori Drowns In The River Ganga
videos.overview: Angoori tells Ammaji on the phone that she will ask Manmohan to take her on a holiday. Angoori asks Manmohan to take her to Shimla with him but he refuses. A fight erupts between Angoori and Manmohan. Angoori shares her pain with Anita. Anita and Angoori go to bathe in the river Ganga. Anita returns crying and informs Vibhuti and the others that Angoori has drowned in the river Ganga. Vibhuti and Saxena are devastated upon hearing the news. A grieving Vibhuti gives the bad news to Manmohan.

videos.title: Manmohan Misses Angoori
videos.overview: Angoori, who is hiding at Chediâ€™s 'tabela', tells Anita that she worries about Manmohan. Happu tells Manmohan that he is unable to trace Angoori. A drunk Vibhuti blames Manmohan for Angoori's death and beats him. Happu is dragged between their fight. Ammaji suggests that Manmohan remarries but he refuses. Ammaji tells Angoori that Manmohan misses her a lot. A grieving Manmohan and Vibhuti are shocked to see a woman who looks like Angoori at Anita's house.

videos.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti Meet Phaguniya
videos.overview: Vibhuti requests the washerwoman, Phaguniya to unveil herself and show her face. Manmohan and Vibhuti faint when they see that her face is Angoori's replica. Anita brings Vibhuti and Manmohan back to consciousness. Vibhuti and Manmohan confront Chedi for marrying Angoori and ask him to leave her. Chedi tells them that she is his Phaguniya. Anita suggests that Manmohan bribes Chedi and marries Phaguniya. Vibhuti and Manmohan bribe Chedi to leave Phaguniya but she refuses to leave him.

videos.title: Manmohan Marries Phaguniya
videos.overview: Phaguniya marries Manmohan as she is disgusted with Chedi for taking the bribe. Vibhuti blames Anita for giving Manmohan the idea of marrying Phaguniya. Vibhuti enters Manmohan's bedroom through the window and interferes in his 'suhag raat'. The next morning, Manmohan and Vibhuti try to recall Phaguniya's memories but fail. Anita asks Vibhuti to disguise as a washerman and romance with her. David sees the disguised Vibhuti entering the house and believes that Anita is having an affair.

videos.title: Episode 596
Gulfam Kali Gets Cheated By The Men
videos.overview: Anita and Angoori ask their husbands to return home but they continue with their game of chess. Happu, Malkhan, Teeka and Prem refuse to pay Gulfam Kali after enjoying her dance. Anita and Angoori confront their husbands for playing chess all night but in vain. Gulfam Kali asks for money but Happu, Teeka, Malkhan and Prem laugh it off. A worried Gulfam Kali reaches out to Vibhuti and Manmohan for help but they ignore her and continue with their game of chess. Gulfam Kali is heartbroken.

videos.title: Gulfam Kali's Funeral
videos.overview: Tillu informs Angoori that Manmohan plays chess at the shop all the time. Gulfam Kali tells Anita and Angoori about her problem. Anita makes a plan and asks Gulfam Kali to pretend to commit suicide. At Gulfam Kali's funeral, everyone mourns for her and pays tribute to her by saying a few words about her. Anita and Angoori tell everyone that her soul will haunt the men responsible for her death. At night, while playing chess, Manmohan and Vibhuti see Anita coming towards them holding a candle.

videos.title: Gulfam's Spirit Possesses Anita and Angoori
videos.overview: Manmohan and Vibhuti are scared to see a possessed Anita walking by. Happu, Malkhan, Prem and Teeka believe that Anita is possessed by Gulfam Kali's spirit. Happu falls in fear. Possessed with Gulfam Kali's spirit, Angoori scares Manmohan who sweats in fear. Vibhuti and Manmohan blame Happu, Malkhan, Teeka and Prem for Gulfam Kali's death. Manmohan sees Anita dancing and praises her. Anita informs Manmohan that she is Gulfam Kali which terrifies Manmohan.

videos.title: Gulbadan Entertains The Men
videos.overview: A possessed Angoori threatens to cut Vibhutiâ€™s fingers if he plays chess. Manmohan and Vibhuti are about to play chess but run after hearing Gulfam Kali's voice. Manmohan and Vibhuti are scared to sleep with their wives alone. They ask Saxena and Tillu to sleep with them. Happu, Teeka, Malkhan and Prem enjoy Gulbadan's dance. Everyone is frightened after Gulbadan is revealed to be the dead Gulfam Kali. Anita and Angoori scare their husbands at night with the help of Saxena and Tillu.

videos.title: Vibhuti Gets Shocked to See Gulfam Kali Alive
videos.overview: Manmohan gets scared when Tillu speaks as Gulfam Kali. Vibhuti overhears Anita and Gulfamâ€™s conversation. He realises that Gulfam Kali is alive and that she is playing a prank on him and Manmohan with Anita and Angoori as accomplices. Vibhuti tells Manmohan the truth about their wives' plan. Anita tries to scare them to stop them from playing chess but she is unsuccessful. Vibhuti and Manmohan vow to stop playing chess and spend time with their wives instead. David arrives from London.

videos.title: Vibhuti Sees a Terrifying Dream
videos.overview: Vibhuti, Angoori, Manmohan and Anita have a conversation when builder Ramesh Gupta, the owner of Ashanti Construction arrives with his secretary, Shaila and an engineer. He plans to build a shopping complex by razing Modern colony but the four disagree. He threatens them and leaves. Vibhuti dreams that Manmohanâ€™s home is razed by the builder and Angoori leaves the colony. Angoori, Anita, Manmohan and Vibhuti seek the Commissioner's help to stop the construction of the mall.

videos.title: Vibhuti Vows to Stop The Demolition Of The Colony
videos.overview: Manmohan is sad when Anita tells him that she will miss everyone in the colony but forgets to take his name. Vibhuti promises Angoori that he will stop her house from being razed. Vibhuti and Manmohan have a drink and discuss their circumstances of having to live apart. Builder Gupta arrives and informs the colony residents that he has seven bulldozers lined up outside the colony. He faces resistance from the residents. Gupta informs everyone that Vibhuti is his long-lost son, Vijay.

videos.title: Manmohan Gets Jealous Of Vibhuti
videos.overview: Manmohan is sad about knowing that Vibhuti is rich. Vibhuti informs Angoori that the construction of the mall will not take place. VIbhuti starts flaunting his newfound status in front of the colonyâ€™s residents. Gupta announces to the press that Vibhuti is his son, Vijay. Vibhuti plans on expanding Guptaâ€™s business. Anita is unhappy with Vibhuti pretending to be Guptaâ€™s son. Vibhuti and Anita plan on going to Nainital the next day and ask Angoori and Manmohan to accompany them.

videos.title: Vibhuti Tears David's will
videos.overview: David arrives from London but finds the door to his house locked. Vibhuti, Manmohan, Anita, and Angoori return from their picnic. David makes his will in Vibhutiâ€™s name. Vibhuti, however, tears the papers as he doesnâ€™t need his uncleâ€™s property anymore. An infuriated David leaves. Vibhuti plans on hiring Manmohan as his assistant. He offers Manmohan INR 1 lakh per month salary. Guptaâ€™s employees and clients ask Vibhuti for their dues. The creditors throng Vibhutiâ€™s home for money.

videos.title: Vibhuti Seeks Refuge In Manmohan's House
videos.overview: Vibhuti hides from the creditors who have stationed themselves outside his home. He escapes and sneaks into Manmohanâ€™s house. Manmohan and Angoori find Vibhuti hiding beneath their bed. He tells the couple the truth about Gupta. Manmohan is scared about his job as he has sold his shop to Tillu. Anita finds the creditors outside her house in the morning. She goes to search for Vibhuti and asks Tillu and Malkhan to find him. Angoori and others ask Vibhuti to abscond to which he reluctantly agrees.

videos.title: Ammaji Tells Angoori About Nani and Dadi's Rivalry
videos.overview: A robber enters Manmohanâ€™s house. Angoori tries to wake him up but he asks Angoori to check. The robber is caught by Angoori. The robber is concerned as this time Manmohan is not the one who has come to check. The robber tells Angoori that Manmohan is suffering from laziness and asks her to try the tips given in â€˜Dadi ke nuskheâ€™ book kept in her cupboard. Ammaji, too, advises Angoori the same. In addition, she cautions her not to touch â€˜Nani ke nuskheâ€™ book as Dadi and Nani were enemies.

videos.title: Angoori's Secret Concoction Makes Manmohan Energetic
videos.overview: Anita plans on installing a 5-ton air conditioner. Manmohan is full of energy after drinking a special drink made by Angoori. Manmohan takes Anita for jogging. Upon returning, he is still full of energy. Angoori complains to Ammaji that Manmohan is not utilising his energy properly and that he uses it to play kabaddi with her instead of romancing with her. Ammaji asks Angoori to get household chores done by Manmohan. Manmohan happily cleans the utensils. Manmohan finds Anitaâ€™s ring.

videos.title: Vibhuti Plans to Steal The Secret Recipe Book
videos.overview: Angoori wakes up to find Manmohan doing pushups with Laddoo on his back. Manmohan challenges Vibhuti for an arm-wrestling match and easily defeats Vibhuti making Angoori and Laddoo happy. Vibhuti plans on learning about the recipe of the energy drink from Manmohan by forcing him to drink alcohol. Manmohan blurts the secret about â€˜Dadi ke nuskheâ€™ book to Vibhuti. Vibhuti tries to steal the book but is caught and beaten by Manmohan. Vibhuti mistakenly steals â€˜Nani ke Nuskheâ€™ book.

videos.title: Anita Gets Frustrated By Vibhuti's Sluggish Behaviour
videos.overview: Vibhuti feels weak after having the energy drink. Vibhuti realises his mistake of stealing the wrong book after overhearing Manmohan and Angooriâ€™s conversation. Anita is angry with Vibhuti as he goes to sleep instead of romancing with her. Vibhuti feels tired and sleepy throughout the day. Ammaji visits Angoori and asks her to attend a 'jagrata' with Manmohan. Vibhuti sleeps all day. Vibhuti gives Manmohan a bottle of alcohol with his energy drink mixed in it.

videos.title: David Suspects Anita's Behaviour
videos.overview: Vibhuti is hell-bent on staying awake the whole night for a ritual that will grant him a lot of wealth. Teeka and Malkhan try to steal a lot of shoes, but Happu catches them. Later, a priest reveals that sleeping, not staying awake the whole night, will grant the devotees wealth. Teeka and Malkhan offer Happu his own money as a bribe. David overhears Vibhuti and Anitaâ€™s conversation while they are role-playing and thinks that Anita is cheating on Vibhuti. An angry David tears his will papers.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan Secretly Gamble
videos.overview: Vibhuti plays poker with Teeka and Malkhan and wins a lot of money with his cards. Manmohan agrees to play poker with Vibhuti. Anita is mad as Vibhuti returns home late and lies to her. Angoori grows suspicious of Manmohanâ€™s behaviour and contacts Ramkali. Impressed by Vibhutiâ€™s gambling skills, a mysterious woman, Lilly, seeks to hire him and offers him a deal. Angoori says that she hates gamblers. Vibhuti decides to hide his gambling addiction from Angoori to avoid being hated by her.

videos.title: Happu Reveals Vibhuti's Secret to Anita
videos.overview: Teeka and Malkhan follow Vibhuti to an expensive club. Vibhuti wins a lot of games for Miss Lilly. Teeka and Malkhan trick the club's guard and enter. Vibhuti lies to Anita that heâ€™s been hired as a club manager. Vibhuti tells Manmohan to come to the club and gamble. Vibhuti offers an expensive sari to Angoori bought with his gambling money. Happu spots Vibhuti, Malkhan and Teeka at the club. Happu reveals to Angoori and Anita that Vibhuti has become a professional gambler for the club.

videos.title: Angoori Snubs Vibhuti
videos.overview: Anita confronts Vibhuti about his gambling activities and rebukes him for gambling at a club every night. Manmohan tells Angoori about his gambling when she keeps asking him to tell her the truth. Vibhuti and Manmohan comically insult Happu for being an incompetent cop. Ramkali decides to teach Manmohan a lesson. Angoori tells Vibhuti that she'll not talk to him for being a compulsive gambler. David learns about Vibhutiâ€™s gambling and assures Anita that he'll get him away from the nasty habit.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan Break Their Promise
videos.overview: Lilly seduces Vibhuti, who gets uncomfortable and leaves. Manmohan fears going home, thinking that his mother will beat him for his disloyalty to Angoori. David confronts Vibhuti about his gambling. Vibhuti and David have a comical conversation about gambling and the latterâ€™s will. Vibhuti tells David that he will quit gambling. Ramkali beats Manmohan, who decides to quit gambling as well. Vibhuti and Manmohan continue to gamble. Anita and Angoori decide to teach their husbands a lesson.

videos.title: Vibhuti Forbids Anita From Dancing At The Casino
videos.overview: Anita performs a dance at the casino where Vibhuti and Manmohan are gambling. A disappointed Vibhuti leaves the casino and tells Anita not to dance at the casino. But she says that she will stop only if he stops gambling. David comically tears another one of his wills. Ramkali wants to take Angoori to the formerâ€™s village. As Vibhuti doesn't want Angoori to leave, he lies that Anita is pregnant. Manmohan is sad upon hearing the news. Ramkali talks to Anita about being pregnant.

videos.title: David Invites Vibhuti and Anita to London
videos.overview: David arrives while Vibhuti and Anita are sharing an intimate moment and reveals that he is getting married in London. Manmohan and Angoori are invited to the wedding, but the latter refuses to go as she is scared of flights. Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu want to go to London, but don't have the money. Vibhuti talks Angoori into going to London with the rest. Tillu lies that he was robbed by some goons and steals Manmohanâ€™s money with Teeka and Malkhan. A couple of terrorists plan to hijack a plane.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan’s Visa Get Rejected
videos.overview: Angoori tells Manmohan that she too wants to go to London. Manmohan learns that Tillu has sponsored Teeka and Malkhanâ€™s air tickets for London. Happu has a comical conversation with a visa officer. Everyoneâ€™s London visas, barring Vibhuti and Manmohanâ€™s, are approved by the officer. However, David uses his diplomatic connections to get their visas approved. Everyone prepares for the London trip. The terrorists decide to hijack the plane, which the Mishras and Tiwaris plan to board.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan’s Sit Next to Each Other's Wives
videos.overview: Anita agrees to sit next to Manmohan in the airplane. The terrorists have placed a gun on the plane. The Mishras and the Tiwaris board the flight. Happu and the others too board the plane. The flight attendant is unable to read English, and Anokhelal assists her. Vibhuti sits next to Angoori and tells her to rely on him if she gets scared. Happu has a stomach problem. Anita fastens Manmohan's seatbelt. Happu needs to go to the bathroom urgently. Happu enters the bathroom with the gun.

videos.title: The Terrorists Hijack The Plane
videos.overview: The terrorist makes Anokhelal retrieve the gun from the planeâ€™s bathroom. Teeka and the gang call and trouble an air hostess, who slaps Malkhan. Happu forgets his pants in the bathroom. The terrorist draws his gun and hijacks the plane. The terrorist says that he'll throw Vibhuti out of the plane if he doesn't comply. The terrorists want to divert the plane to Afghanistan and tell the commissioner to release their aides or else everyone on the plane dies. The hostages in the plane get scared.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan Nab The Terrorist
videos.overview: The terrorist makes Manmohan and Vibhuti talk to the commissioner. He wants to see Angoori and Anita dance. The duo distracts the terrorist, and Anita snatches the gun from the terrorist and hands it to Vibhuti. The terrorists are locked in a bathroom. However, the pilot hits his head in the cockpit and loses his memory. Anita makes Vibhuti take control of the plane. An air control official, Shukla, fails to guide Vibhuti over the radio. Pelu pilots the plane and successfully lands it.

videos.title: Vibhuti Refuses to Go to Mussoorie With Anita
videos.overview: Manmohan dreams that he is romancing Anita, but Angoori wakes him up. Anita wants to go to Mussoorie with Vibhuti in her friendâ€™s car. However, a schizophrenic man warns her not to go to Mussoorie. Tillu and the gang are shelterless while its raining outside. Vibhuti does not want to go to Mussoorie, but Anita emotionally blackmails him. Vibhuti bribes a priest for Angoori. Malkhan and Teeka ask Vibhuti to let them stay with him, but he denies. It begins to rain heavily again.

videos.title: Anita Decides to Go to Mussoorie Alone
videos.overview: As per Vibhutiâ€™s plan, the priest tells Manmohan that he shouldn't go out in the rain with Angoori as his life is in danger. Manmohan asks Vibhuti to dance with Angoori in the rain to avoid disappointing her. Vibhuti wants Manmohan to go to Mussoorie with Anita. Vibhuti instigates Angoori against Manmohan. Manmohan feeds Anita lies against Vibhuti. Anita decides to go to Mussoorie alone and rejects Manmohanâ€™s offer to accompany her. Tillu and the gang ask Happu if they can move in with him.

videos.title: Anita and Angoori Leave For Mussoorie
videos.overview: Tillu, Malkhan and Teeka slap Happu in order to get arrested so that they can have some shelter. Angoori is upset as Manmohan refuses to enjoy the rains with her. Anita too is sad as Vibhuti does not want to go to Mussoorie with her. Angoori and Anita talk about their husbands and decide to teach them a lesson.
