Anita and Angoori leave for Mussoorie without telling anyone. The police commissioner orders Happu to let the trio go as they are treating the jail as a comfortable guest house.

videos.title: Anita and Angoori Arrive In Mussoorie
videos.overview: Anita and Angoori arrive in Mussoorie. Vibhuti and Manmohan grow restless, thinking about their missing wives. Malkhan, Tillu and Teeka decide to harass the commissionerâ€™s wife to get into jail. Angoori and Anita arrive at the haunted guest house, where Anitaâ€™s friend Meenal and her husband Anurag are staying. Anita is shocked to learn from the guest house's receptionist that Meenal and Anurag never checked into the guest house. A headless man limps along the guest house's corridors.

videos.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti Take Happu's Help
videos.overview: The commissioner orders Happu to take the trio back to their landlord. Manmohan and Vibhuti decide to leave for Mussoorie with Happu to help Angoori and Anita. Anita, Angoori, Meenal and Anurag are kidnapped. The headless monster stalks Happu and the rich businessman. Vibhuti and Manmohan see their wives in the guest house. The women say that theyâ€™re spirits. Ramlal, the guest house's receptionist, reveals that he had planned to scare the businessman, who wanted to buy his guest house.

videos.title: Manmohan Misbehaves With Angoori
videos.overview: A couple of goons harass a girl. Anita wants Vibhuti to fight the goons. Manmohan suffers losses in his business. The priest tells Manmohan to misbehave with Angoori in order to turn his luck around. Happu assures Anita that he will teach the goons a lesson but runs away after hearing the goonâ€™s name. Anita decides to teach the goons a lesson by herself. Manmohan yells at Angoori to cover his loss as directed by the priest. Anita dresses up as a vigilante to punish the goons.

videos.title: Anita Becomes Meow Girl
videos.overview: Anita, disguised as the â€˜meow girlâ€™, beats the goons up. Manmohanâ€™s client repays him money and renews his order. Manmohan thinks that his losses are being recovered because of the priestâ€™s advice. The priest advises Manmohan to be cruel with Angoori for better results. Anita overhears Manmohan abusing Angoori. A disguised Anita beats Manmohan. Vibhuti wonders where Anita goes at night. Vibhuti feels that Anita is cheating on him. Anitaâ€™s uncle meets Vibhuti, who learns that she is lying.

videos.title: Vibhuti Links Anita With Commissioner
videos.overview: Anitaâ€™s uncle tells Vibhuti that she hasn't met him in a long time and that heâ€™s fit and dandy. Manmohan thinks that it was Angoori who beat him. Angoori wonders why Manmohan treats her badly despite she not behaving faultily. Vibhuti tells Angoori that Anita is cheating on him, but she is drowned in her own sorrows. Anita arrives when some men are watching Gulfam Kali dance and batters the men. Anita gets a text from the commissioner, but Vibhuti reads it and thinks that the two are dating.

videos.title: Happu Instigates Vibhuti Against Anita
videos.overview: Vibhuti is sad, thinking that Anita doesnâ€™t love him and is cheating on him. Manmohan talks to Anita about his sadness and pain, but she laughs at him. Happu Singh and the others learn that Manmohan has been beaten by the Meow Girl. Anokhelal is on a quest to befriend the Meow Girl. Happu overhears the commissioner's conversation with Anita and thinks that she is cheating on Vibhuti. Happu fuels Vibhutiâ€™s misunderstanding towards Anita, and the two visit Gulfam Kali. David returns to India.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan Leave Their Houses
videos.overview: Amidst Gulfam's enthralling dance, the Meow Girl scratches Happu, Vibhuti and the other men to punish them. As Manmohan awaits Angoori to massage his pulled back, the Meow Girl lashes his back even as he thinks that Angoori is doing it to turn him on. David is shocked that Anita is dating Commissioner Singh and tauntingly states to Vibhuti that even the latter is better than Singh. Vibhuti and Manmohan leave their houses for their self-respect. Anita and Commissioner Singh reveal the truth.

videos.title: Achanaklal Predicts Vibhuti's Future
videos.overview: Vibhuti flirtatiously agrees to accompany Angoori at midnight to a chowk to help her complete her vow. Anita lets Vibhuti accompany Angoori after he reveals to Anita Manmohanâ€™s selfish refusal to accompany Angoori. Angoori leaves after making Vibhuti dig the site and place her pouch. Vibhuti finds a golden coin there. Anokhelalâ€™s clairvoyant grandfather Achanaklal predicts Teeka, Malkhan, Happu and Tilluâ€™s future and present. Achanaklal predicts treasure for Vibhuti beneath the Tiwari house.

videos.title: Anita and Vibhuti Dig Tiwari's House For Treasure
videos.overview: The Tiwaris, whose house is damaged, have relocated temporarily to the Mishra house where they are given spiked milk by Vibhuti. Anita looks forward to possessing the treasure. Manmohan, who wishes to ogle at a sleeping Anita, is caught red-handed by Anita and Vibhuti as they return from the Tiwari's house. Anita realises that the milk contained anti-headache pills. Anita and Vibhuti stop the Tiwaris from returning to their home. A hungry Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu excavate the Tiwari house.

videos.title: Happu Ask Vibhuti For a Share In The Treasure
videos.overview: Vibhuti informs Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan about Achanaklalâ€™s prediction and consents to a quadrilateral division of the treasure. Happu learns the truth too and starts digging a public road between the Tiwari and the Mishra houses as per Achanaklalâ€™s prediction. Vibhuti evicts the Tiwaris rudely from his house. The Tiwaris wonder who dug their house. Commissioner Singh also starts digging on learning the truth, which confuses the Tiwaris further. The Mishras reveal the truth to the Tiwaris.

videos.title: The Truth Behind Achanaklal's Predictions
videos.overview: The doctor joins the excavators after learning the truth. The excavators want cocky supervisor Vibhuti to dig with them. Manmohan tears Davidâ€™s will's papers, which are for the benefit of the Mishras as a massive treasure awaits them. David joins the excavators. As they excavate to find the treasure, two nurses from a hospital inform them that Achanaklal is unhinged and his prediction is false. Commissioner Singh allegedly appoints Anokhelal as Kanpurâ€™s commissioner for a day to restore law.

videos.title: Vibhuti Vows to Earn Inr 10000 Daily
videos.overview: Vibhuti asserts to a taunting Manmohan and Anita that he will earn INR 10000 daily. Vibhuti eventually decides to provide key supplies to Anokhelal's insane friends with Prem's car. Happu, who is taunted about his obscenely materialistic nature, assists Vibhuti unexpectedly. As Vibhuti drives Prem's car in hilly terrain, he visualises dancing romantically with Angoori. Anokhelal pays INR 10000 to Vibhuti for his service, which elates Anita, who lambasts a fearful Manmohan for watering the notes.

videos.title: Vibhuti is Forced to Work In Manmohan's House
videos.overview: Anita sends Vibhuti back to the Mishra house to wash the utensils. After realising that Chhedi's wife Gulabiya is forced to defecate in public despite having a toilet in her house, Anita boycotts Chhedi. Vibhuti is forced to wash the clothes of the Mishras. Manmohan suggests that Vibhuti stay with David in London. Vibhuti volunteers to launder Angoori's clothes, but she gives him Manmohan's dirty clothes. Malkhan and Teeka unintentionally defecate at Masterji's house.

videos.title: Happu Jails Vibhuti and Manmohan For Protesting
videos.overview: Manmohan lambasts Vibhuti for poorly laundering his clothes. Chhedi refuses to reform despite Vibhuti and Manmohan's advice. Anita vows to send Chhedi to jail for violating the law by defecating. Anita threatens to bar an apathetic Vibhuti from using the personal toilet of the Mishras. Despite Tillu, Malkhan and Teeka mocking Vibhuti's joblessness, he, Anokhelal, Manmohan and Masterji campaign for public hygiene. Anita secures their release from jail by threatening to expose Happu's defecation.

videos.title: The Plait Cutter Terrorises The Modern Colony
videos.overview: Anita and Angoori use Collector Jain to campaign against defecation. Jain catches Teeka, Malkhan and Happu red-handed as they prepare to defecate. Jain counsels Chhedi not to defecate and not to let Gulabiya defecate. Jain highlights public sanitation. Later, Manmohan assures a worried Angoori that her plait is safe amidst news of a plait cutter on the run. An enticed Vibhuti's assertion that he feels like cutting Anita's plait shocks her. The plait cutter victimises Gulfam and Happu's wife too.

videos.title: Gaaleeyanand Threatens Vibhuti and Manmohan
videos.overview: As per the abusive Gaaleeyanand's instruction, Vibhuti and Manmohan prepare at midnight to cut Angoori and Anita's hair respectively to win their hearts. Though the two women titillate their husbands, the latter escape somehow. Manmohan lies to Happu and Vibhuti that he is out to nab the plait cutter. Vibhuti lies to Manmohan and Happu that he is out to trim the plants. Malkhan and Teeka agree to protect two young sleazy women's hair. Angoori stops Vibhuti from styling her hair with a scissor.

videos.title: Anita and Angoori Decide to Catch The Plait Cutter
videos.overview: Vibhuti and Manmohan obtain fresh advice from Gaaleeyanand after failing in their mission. Meenal informs Anita and Angoori tearfully that her hair has been cut. The two sleazy young women dump Teeka and Malkhan. Anita and Angoori are out at night to trap the plait cutter with their plan. Manmohan and Vibhuti too wake up to execute their plan. As Anita, Angoori and Happu, who adores Anita's hair, await the plait cutter, Vibhuti and Manmohan don't find Angoori and Anita at their respective homes.

videos.title: Vibhuti Starts a Security Agency
videos.overview: Anita's constant praise of Anurag's professional successes hurts Vibhuti. Tillu, who is offered food by Angoori, curses Manmohan when the latter refuses to remunerate him. Vibhuti hates Anurag due to the latter's mediocre academic record. Anita's praise of Anurag's accomplishments irks Manmohan. Vibhuti opens a security agency after Tillu angrily states that he is ready to work as a guard. Angoori rejects Vibhuti's advice that she hire a bodyguard. Anokhelal seeks work with Vibhuti's agency.

videos.title: Vibhuti Trains Anokhelal, Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan
videos.overview: Eventually, Anita supports Vibhuti's security agency. Soon, she is forced to accommodate Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan at the Mishra house. Vibhuti's public training early in the morning with his recruits Anokhelal, Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan angers Manmohan. Vibhuti's impassioned promotion of his security agency makes no difference to Angoori. The four recruits fail to attract a client. As Anita brings Manmohan to her home for lunch, she realises that the four recruits have eaten up everything.

videos.title: Vibhuti Tricks Manmohan Into Hiring a Bodyguard
videos.overview: As per Vibhuti's plot, Tillu pretends to be a dangerous goon, Yaacoob, and threatens to abduct Angoori, after which Vibhuti convinces a stingy Manmohan to hire him as Angoori's bodyguard. Teeka pretends to be a thief and robs Masterji's cheque, after which Vibhuti convinces him to hire Teeka as his guard. The recruits munch everything at the Mishra house, which angers Anita. Vibhuti's plot lets him guard Angoori in her bedroom sans Manmohan. Vibhuti's plan to frighten Anita backfires badly.

videos.title: Anita Ousts Vibhuti From The House
videos.overview: Vibhuti's four recruits munch Angoori's halwa for Manmohan instead of tasting it to determine its health, which angers Manmohan. Vibhuti's sympathy for his recruits, who have been evicted from the Mishra house by Anita, leads to Anita evicting him too. Anita is happy to meet her pal Bitti, who is in search of the prince of her dreams. Vibhuti bars Manmohan from dropping Angoori at Ammaji's home due to security reasons. Anokhelal sleeps with a snake, which rattles the other recruits.

videos.title: Anita Gets Abducted
videos.overview: Anita asks Manmohan to abduct her so that Vibhuti closes his security agency. Happu overhears Vibhuti's agency's untruthful modus operandi. A professional masked kidnapper abducts Anita, who misunderstands that he is Manmohan. A masked Manmohan with a canine sound doesn't get a reply from Anita and, instead, a dog angrily rips apart his pant. Vibhuti realises that Anita has been abducted and cries and is arrested. Happu exposes Vibhuti's plan, which saddens Angoori.

videos.title: Ammaji Tells Tiwari About Raamphal's Prediction
videos.overview: Vibhuti accuses Manmohan of humiliating him in the garb of humour. Ammaji informs the Tiwaris and the Mishras at the Tiwari house that Pandit Raamphal has predicted astrological danger for Angoori. Circumstances lead Teeka and Malkhan to a mansion in Chandangad, the eeriness of which makes the two flee from there, but with a costly musical anklet. Manmohan buys the anklet for Anita but is forced to give it to Angoori. As Manmohan adorns Angoori with it, eerie developments take place nearby.

videos.title: Angoori Gets Possessed
videos.overview: Angoori's public dance at night, which leads to Thakur Saab mourning the loss of his wife Gulaab Jaan, surprises Vibhuti. Manmohan faints on seeing Angoori disappear and appear eerily. Angoori doesn't believe Vibhuti's claim that she had danced. After an interaction with Happu, Vibhuti apologises to Angoori for his claim. But Angoori, with Gulaab's voice, then eerily admits to him that she did dance. Anita gets angry with Manmohan over the anklet. Tillu plots to steal his salary from Manmohan.

videos.title: Gulaab Tells Vibhuti About Her Past
videos.overview: Angoori, who is possessed by Gulaab whenever she wears the anklet, talks in pure Urdu about being an attendant at Nawab Shaukat's durbar, which unsettles Vibhuti. Manmohan points out Angoori's pure Urdu and non-vegetarian cooked food to Anita, who thinks that an insecure Manmohan envies Angoori. A possessed Angoori drinks alcohol with Manmohan and Vibhuti. Happu nabs Tillu, Teeka and Malkhan as they try to rob at the Tiwari home. Ammaji blames Manmohan for Angoori's disappearance from the house.

videos.title: The Residents Of Modern Colony Arrive At Chandangad
videos.overview: The Mishras, Tillu, Malkhan, Teeka, Ammaji, Happu, Anokhelal and Manmohan are in Chandangad after the truth is known about the musical anklet, the mansion and Chandangad. In the mansion, all of them convince a reluctant Thakur Saab to accommodate them there for a night after he denies that Angoori is with him. Happu, Vibhuti and Manmohan encounter their blanket sliding away from them and turning into an invisible entity. The eeriness of the servant Lakhan frightens Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan.

videos.title: Gulab Jaan's Spirit Possesses Angoori
videos.overview: Anita and the others wonder about the person inside the locked room. Anita tries to lure Thakur to make way for others to enter the room. Lakhanpal sees them entering and informs Thakur. Everyone stares at Angoori who is possessed by Gulab Jaan's spirit. Gulab Jaan states that Thakur had choked her to death. Gulab Jaan's skeleton is discovered behind a wall which shocks everyone. Gulab Jaan's spirit enters Ammaji's and beats Thakur. Angoori wakes up with no memory of the events.

videos.title: Vibhuti Becomes a Taxi Driver
videos.overview: After the dinner, Meenal states that the dinner was not tasty. Anita blames Vibhuti for her bad kitchen skills. Prem informs Vibhuti that he wants to use his newly bought car as a taxi and is searching for a driver. Vibhuti agrees to be his driver which makes Anita angry. Teeka and Malkhan thank the Commissioner for sponsoring their garage. Vibhuti gives a ride to Angoori but refuses Anita. Manmohan gets mad at Angoori for returning late. An upset Anita asks Vibhuti to sleep in the taxi.

videos.title: Anita Tells Manmohan to Sabotage Vibhuti's Taxi
videos.overview: Vibhuti tells Angoori that he will drop her to the market but she refuses as she fears Manmohan. Left with no choice Angoori goes in Vibhuti's taxi. Malkhan and Teeka fail to repair Happu's scooter's horn. Anita advises Manmohan to ruin Vibhuti's taxi. Manmohan hires Malkhan and Teeka for the job. Manmohan gets angry with Vibhuti for bringing Angoori home late and charging a high fare. Anita misses Vibhuti who sleeps in his taxi and convinces him to return home.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Angoori Lose Their Memory
videos.overview: Malkhan and Teeka take Vibhuti's taxi's engine out. Vibhuti takes Angoori to the market in his taxi. Anita and Manmohan learn that Malkhan and Teeka have taken the taxi's brakes out instead of the engine. Vibhuti and Angoori are shocked after learning about the break fail. Manmohan and Anita are devastated after Happu informs them that Vibhuti and Angoori's car has fallen down the cliff. Vibhuti and Angoori are saved by a fisherman, Kallu Mama and his wife, Dulari but lose their memory.

videos.title: Happu Brings Angoori and Vibhuti Back
videos.overview: Kallu and Dulari assume that Vibhuti and Angoori are lovers and decide to get them married. Anita informs David about Vibhuti and Angoori's accident and that they cannot be traced. Malkhan and Teeka feel guilty about Vibhuti and Angoori's accident. Happu arrives with Angoori and Vibhuti which makes everyone happy. To Anita and Manmohan's disappointment, Angoori and Vibhuti don't recognise them as they have lost their memory. Manmohan and Anita take Vibhuti and Angoori inside the house.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Worst Nightmare
videos.overview: Anita and Manmohan fail to bring their respective spouse's memory back. Anita and Manmohan stop Vibhuti and Angoori from leaving. Anita comes up with a plan to bring Vibhuti and Angoori's memory back. Anita, Manmohan and David take Vibhuti and Angoori for a car ride. Vibhuti and Angoori's memory returns but David loses his memory during the ride. Everything that happened turns out to be Vibhuti's nightmare. On Anita's order, Vibhuti returns the car to Prem and gets back to his normal life.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Devastating Medical Test Reports
videos.overview: Vibhuti wakes up after dreaming about Anita marrying Happu when she learns about Vibhuti's illness. Anita assures Vibhuti that she will not leave him at any cost. Dr Gupta mistakenly gives Vibhuti the wrong medical test reports. A devastated Vibhuti asks Dr Gupta to keep the news about his ill-health a secret. Manmohan boasts about his clean health report in front of Vibhuti. Malkhan and Teeka talk about the film 'Anand' in front of Vibhuti making him emotional.

videos.title: Manmohan Invites Vibhuti to His Party
videos.overview: Vibhuti takes Manmohan's advice on whether to tell Anita about his ill-health. Bhuja realises about his blunder of mixing up the reports. Manmohan invites Anita and Vibhuti at his party to celebrate his good health which bothers Vibhuti. Everybody enjoys the party except Vibhuti. A drunk Vibhuti arrives at Gulfam Kali's place and argues with a man there. Gulfam Kali consents to Vibhuti's last wish to take a few selfies with her. The man with whom Vibhuti had argued is stabbed by an unknown man.

videos.title: Vibhuti Gets Arrested For Murdering Kantilal
videos.overview: Vibhuti sees a man dragging a dead body. The man tells Vibhuti the reason for committing the crime. Vibhuti decides to take the blame for the murder in exchange for money and asks the man to take his photo with the body. Happu informs everyone that Vibhuti has murdered Kantilal and arrests him. Manmohan takes Anita to a renowned lawyer, Booteshwar Muthreja. Anita requests Booteshwar to defend Vibhuti's case but he refuses. He insults Anita. Anita and Angoori slap Booteshwar and leave.

videos.title: Saxena Fights Vibhuti's Case
videos.overview: Vibhuti tells Anita about his illness and the reason for taking the blame for the murder which makes Anita happy. Dr Gupta arrives with the good news of Vibhuti's good health. Happu advises Anita to hire a good lawyer. Saxena tells Anita that he will fight Vibhuti's case. In the court, Muthreja arrives to fight against Saxena. Vikram tells the court that he has photos of Vibhuti killing Kantilal and sends them to Happu. Saxena accuses Vikram of clicking the photos instead of saving Kantilal.

videos.title: Vibhuti Professes His Love to Angoori In Court
videos.overview: Saxena and Muthreja argue during the trial. Tillu, Teeka, Malkhan, and Gulfam Kali are called for questioning in the court. Happu tells Anita that he has found a Jodhpuri suit's button near the dead body. The next morning, Anita and Manmohan visit a tailor, Adil Behaya, to inquire about the button. Adil Behaya informs Anita that it belongs to Vikram Chenoi and agrees to testify in the court. In the court, Vibhuti says 'I Love You' to Angoori in front of everyone.

videos.title: Anita and Angoori Gather Evidence Against Vikram
videos.overview: Vibhuti dreams about proposing to Angoori and dancing with her in the court. Adil Behaya testifies against Vibhuti. Gulfam Kali informs Anita and Angoori that she is going to perform at Vikram's farmhouse. Anita and Angoori perform at Vikram's farmhouse instead of Gulfam Kali. Tillu finds Vikram's suit with the buttons similar to the one that was discovered near the dead body. Manmohan dreams about Vibhuti getting a death penalty and romances with Anita before he is woken by the judge.

videos.title: Anita Saves Vibhuti From The Death Sentence
videos.overview: In the court, Saxena shows Vikram's coat found at his farmhouse. Muthreja alleges that the coat belongs to Vibhuti. The judge pronounces that Vibhuti is guilty. Manmohan and Angoori console Anita. Malkhan and Teeka tell Anita that they will kidnap the judge's daughter and ask Vibhuti's freedom as ransom. Everyone is shocked at seeing the judge's daughter's photo. The judge gives Vibhuti a death penalty. Anita brings evidence against Vikram. The judge sets Vibhuti free which makes everyone happy.

videos.title: Manmohan Throws a Party For Ladoo
videos.overview: Tillu informs everyone that Ladoo has passed in his exams which makes them jubilate. Manmohan decides to throw a party to celebrate Ladooâ€™s success. Masterji decides to tell Manmohan about Ladoo's poor performance but Tillu, Teeka and Malkhan stop Masterji. Everyone celebrates at the party. The commissioner orders Happu, who is on his way to the party, to hide in a dustbin to capture a goon. Happu finds a tied Masterji in a dustbin. Happu arrives at Manmohanâ€™s party with Masterji.

videos.title: Anita and Vibhuti Pretend to be Ladoo's Parents
videos.overview: At the party, Masterji informs everyone about Ladoo failing in his exams. Vibhuti gets angry with Anita for insulting him in front of Manmohan. Ammaji decides to take Ladoo with her but Anita tells Ammaji to give Ladoo another chance. On Anita's advice, Manmohan calls Martha Mathew English School but they want the parents to be well educated. Ammaji suggests to Anita that she and Vibhuti should pretend as Ladoo's parents. Miss Martha from the school arrives and questions Vibhuti and Anita.

videos.title: Anita Prepares Ladoo For His Exams
videos.overview: Anita and Vibhuti introduce the Tiwaris to Miss Martha. Miss Martha asks Vibhuti and Anita to come to the school for a meeting. After Martha leaves, Anita and Vibhuti fight with each other and just then, Martha enters the house. Ladoo informs Martha that Vibhuti tortures him. Martha brings Happu to arrest Anita and Vibhuti. Saxena arrives with Anita and Vibhuti's release papers. Anita helps Ladoo for his English exam. Ladoo passes in his exam which makes everyone happy.

videos.title: Anita Invites Pralay Jhangirabadi At Her House
videos.overview: Vibhuti and Anita are thrilled to see their classmate, Pralay Jhangirabadi, a renowned poet, on a talk show. Anita invites Pralay at her house and decides to host a poetic evening. Vibhuti invites Manmohan, Angoori and Saxena. Manmohan unintentionally upsets Anita while complimenting her. Vibhuti gets angry to see Malkhan, Teeka, Tillu and Happu at the event. Saxena talks to himself stating that Pralay will get raged upon seeing Manmohan's redshirt.

videos.title: Pralay Threatens to Kill Manmohan
videos.overview: Pralay Jhangirabadi arrives at Vibhuti's house and makes weird faces on seeing Manmohan's redshirt. Everyone introduces themselves poetically. Pralay makes a weird face on seeing Anita's red saree and asks everyone to speak poetically. Everyone showcases their poetry one by one. David Mishra and Manmohan insult each other with their poems. On Anita's request, Pralay reads his poem while Vibhuti proposes to her. Pralay threatens to kill Manmohan if anyone moves from their place.

videos.title: Pralay Wishes to Marry Anita
videos.overview: Saxena informs everyone that Pralay Jhangirabad becomes insane on seeing red colour. Pralay threatens everyone to speak poetically and takes Manmohan into the bedroom. Pralay confesses his love for Anita and wishes to marry her. Happu is unsuccessful in calming Pralay. Pralay threatens to drown himself along with Manmohan in River Ganga if Anita rejects his proposal. Pralay agrees to let Manmohan have a cup of tea on the condition that Anita will slap Vibhuti.

videos.title: Bhoorey Lal Agrees to Save Manmohan
videos.overview: David consoles Vibhuti who gets slapped by Anita. Ammaji arrives after learning that Pralay has held Manmohan hostage. Vibhuti asks Ammaji to speak only in rhymes. Pralay suspects that everyone is planning to catch him. David flirts with Ammaji which annoys Anita. Anita comes up with a plan to free Manmohan and capture Pralay. Pralay learns about Anita's plan to capture him and injures Vibhuti and Happu. Bhoorey Lal learns that Pralay has kept Manmohan hostage and reluctantly agrees to save him.

videos.title: Anita Makes Her Thesis On Angoori
videos.overview: Anita visits Angoori and sees her drinking blood, which is actually beetroot juice to cure her blood deficiency. Anita questions Angoori and makes notes for her thesis. Vibhuti and Manmohan arrange the sugarcane for Tony Braganza. Malkhan and Teeka are hospitalised for consuming spurious liquor. The commissioner informs Anita about Manmohan and Vibhuti being involved in the liquor racket. They clarify their stance with Anita. Anita shows the commissioner that Angoori left the house at night.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan Expose Tony and His Gang
videos.overview: Anita and Commissioner Singh follow Angoori and meet Daroga, who joins them in confronting Angoori for drinking blood. Angoori clarifies that she is not a Dracula by apprising them that she drinks a medicinal mixture prescribed by a priest. At the graveyard, Vibhuti and Manmohan give a consignment of sugarcanes to Tony Braganza's spirit to cure Angoori. When they learn the truth together with the police, they expose Tony Braganza and his co-gang member. Anita gives up her thesis on Draculas.

videos.title: Anita Prepares to Settle Down In The Us
videos.overview: Manmohan goes through a nightmare about Anita leaving Kanpur. Anita receives a phone call from her brother Mark Shuturmurg, who invites her to come to the US and settle with Vibhuti there. Teeka states his dream of going to the US to Malkhan and Tillu. Dressed in a western outfit, Anita states her excitement to Manmohan and Daroga, who are grief-stricken. Angoori tells Vibhuti that the only thing that she will miss about him is his Urdu. Manmohan and Vibhuti share their grief over alcohol.

videos.title: Mark Shuturmurg Arrives to Meet Anita
videos.overview: Following Ammaji's advice to improve Manmohan's business, Angoori gets duped by a beggar, whom she mistakes for a foreigner. Vibhuti throws the scrap dealer out after Anita calls him to sell the furniture. But Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu take away a table from her house. Desperate to make Anita not leave Kanpur, Vibhuti makes a tall commitment of earning INR one lakh a month. Wanting Anita close to him, Manmohan sponsors a motor garage for Vibhuti, but the arrival of Mark upsets the boat.

videos.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti Ask Gulfam to Enchant Mark
videos.overview: Vibhuti imagines frolicking with Angoori in his garage. A car owner requests him to repair his car. Vibhuti decides to not leave Kanpur. Manmohan states Vibhuti's success as the reason for his happiness. Anita introduces Manmohan to Mark, who insults him. Manmohan and Vibhuti ask Gulfam Kali to enchant Mark to stall the plan of leaving Kanpur. Gulfam Kali mistakes Angrez Kumar for Mark. Remembering Ammaji's advice, Angoori agrees to show Mark around and is spotted by Manmohan and Vibhuti.

videos.title: Mark Wants to Take Angoori to The Us
videos.overview: The irate car owner shouts at Vibhuti. Angoori's return home gets delayed, which makes Manmohan angry. Daroga wants Prem to apply for a job for him in the FBI. He readily agrees to Vibhuti and Manmohan's plan of instigating Anita to beat him and later register a case against her to stop her from going to the US. Instead, he gets thrashed by the public for eve-teasing, and the plan fails. Mark insists on taking Angoori to the US. David arrives, and Anita tears his will into pieces.

videos.title: Anita Throws a Farewell Party
videos.overview: Anita refuses to accept Vibhuti's inheritance. David and Mark spat about English versus American superiority. Vibhuti dresses up as a foreigner to make Anita relent. Manmohan and Vibhuti break their heads over the solution to this problem. Manmohan weeps, thinking about Anita's departure. Anita hosts a farewell party. Modern Colony and Ammaji attend the party where Vibhuti renders a patriotic song. Vibhuti and Anita's visa is rejected, and everyone, including Anita, rejoices.

videos.title: Vibhuti Disguises Himself As a Beggar
videos.overview: Anita and Vibhuti hear the news of a beggar, who dies as a millionaire. Ammaji gets an electric shock from the doorbell. She instructs Angoori to feed delicacies to beggars and donate INR 501 for the betterment of Manmohan's business. Vibhuti sees the special treatment that Angoori gives a beggar. He disguises himself as a beggar, and Manmohan gives him special Halwa and Poori and money. Vibhuti sends the delicacies to Anita. Vibhuti plans to recruit Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu to his gang.

videos.title: Vibhuti Seeks Alms From Angoori
videos.overview: Manmohan becomes suspicious of Vibhuti. Ammaji gets another electric shock. Ladoo puts a bomb under Manmohan's chair. Vibhuti gives his day's earnings to Anita and tells her that he is working for Prem. Vibhuti recruits Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu as beggars briefing them about BBIA, his organisation. The next day, Vibhuti, dressed up as a beggar, troubles Angoori. Manmohan gives him Jalebis and a saree as instructed by Ammaji and gets shocked seeing Anita wearing the same saree and eating Jalebis.

videos.title: Manmohan Exposes Vibhuti's New Profession
videos.overview: Recognising the saree and the Jalebi container, Manmohan questions Anita, who defends Vibhuti. When Pelu arrives with the 'kheer' that Manmohan had given Vibhuti, Anita decides to check on him. Vibhuti gifts a saree to Angoori, which angers Manmohan. Manmohan takes Anita to the temple where Vibhuti begs and exposes him. Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu beg for money from the Doctor and Masterji. Ladoo places a bomb on Tillu's hand, and Teeka bears the repercussion. The commissioner reprimands Daroga.

videos.title: Anita Encourages Vibhuti to Beg
videos.overview: Anita encourages Vibhuti to continue being a beggar and joins him to manage the collections. Manmohan is shocked to see Anita's support for Vibhuti. Vibhuti, dressed up as a beggar, impresses Angoori with his profound talk. Anita offers tips to increase the collections. David becomes bankrupt and joins Vibhuti's gang. The other beggars' gang beat Vibhuti's gang for usurping their areas. Modern Colony celebrates Diwali, and Ladoo pledges not to light crackers, which cause pollution.

videos.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti Flatter Their Wives
videos.overview: Saxena shares the news about women falling prey to false praise. Vibhuti showers unlimited praise on Angoori, which pleases her. On the other hand, Manmohan and Daroga praise Anita, which elate her. Later, Manmohan praises Angoori's poetry and promises to get a book published about her jokes. Vibhuti laughs at Anita and tells her that her sense of humour is awesome. While the two of them celebrate their success, Saxena brings Angoori and Anita, who forbid their husbands from entering the house.

videos.title: Angoori and Anita Visit Professor Mintoo Chhabbra
videos.overview: Professor Mintoo Chhabbra, a love guru, claims to revive romance in couples' married lives. Anita takes Vibhuti for a romantic film where he falls off to sleep. Angoori takes Manmohan to a farmland where he spends time talking to his client. Angoori and Anita state their woes to each other and plan to visit the professor. Win Kundra comes in search of his choreographer Siddhu and offers to take Angoori to a shooting site. Saxena helps Gulfam Kali finalise a groom from Tillu, Teeka and Malkhan.

videos.title: Anita and Vibhuti's Role Reversal
videos.overview: Manmohan and Vibhuti resist visiting the professor. Angoori complains to Ammaji about Manmohan. At the counselling session with Masterji and his wife Vidya, Tiwaris and the Mishras, the professor tells them that they suffer from 'MNBG' and advises them to switch their roles. Saxena is worried about the groom selection and reacts violently to Daroga. Attempting to reignite their romance, Anita dresses up and behaves like Vibhuti and Vibhuti like Anita. David arrives during their act.

videos.title: Saxena Plans to Shave Half Of Happu's Moustache
videos.overview: Assuming that Vibhuti and Anita have had a gender change, David tears the will. Bhoorey Lal and Ammaji see Manmohan and Angoori dressed up and behaving like each other. Saxena's task for the boys is to plaster Daroga's face with cake. The couples share their experiences of their first task with the professor. To rekindle the romance in their marriages, he tells them to romance each others' wives, which excites the men. Saxena's next task is to shave Daroga's half moustache.

videos.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti Romance Each Other's Spouses
videos.overview: Vibhuti and Angoori's candlelight dinner ends in a disaster when David interrupts and tears his will. Ammaji convinces Bhoorey Lal to forgive Manmohan. But on seeing him romancing Anita, Bhoorey Lal slaps him. Ammaji faints when Angoori tells her about her evening with Vibhuti. Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu execute Saxena's task of shaving Daroga's half moustache and get hammered by him. They expose Saxena. The professor asks Vibhuti and Manmohan to run away with each other's wife.

videos.title: The Commissioner Sees Happu Threatening Manmohan
videos.overview: Saxena tells Daroga about targeting him to avenge his insult. Anita and Angoori disapprove of their husbands running away with each other's wife. Although excited initially, realising their folly, Vibhuti and Manmohan romance their wives. Anita's fountain pen's ink smears David's face, and he tears his will. Daroga promises to get Tillu's salary from Manmohan. He is caught threatening Manmohan by the commissioner, who is at the Mishra residence to change his underwear.

videos.title: Manmohan Gets a Huge Business Order
videos.overview: Anita jumps at the proposition of opening her grooming institute in partnership with Meenal and Anurag. Manmohan gets an order of INR two crores and is promised the money the next day. When Anita asks for INR one crore as a loan, Manmohan readily agrees. Angoori dreams of a Swiss trip. The commissioner tells Daroga that if he nabs the kidnappers who are threatening him, he would be promoted. Manmohan's order gets cancelled, which crashes Angoori's dreams. Anita asks for the cash promised to her.

videos.title: Anita Agrees to Sell Vibhuti For Money
videos.overview: Manmohan can't give Anita the loan of INR one crore. Anita requests two days' time from Meenal to arrange the cash. Singhania approaches Prem with a proposal of getting Vibhuti married to his sister, who loves Vibhuti. Prem refuses, but Manmohan closes the deal in INR three crores. At first, Anita is appalled at the thought of selling her hubby, but on seeing the advance money, agrees. Daroga ropes in Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu to kidnap the commissioner, but Daroga gets trapped in his game.

videos.title: Teeka and Gang Plot to Abduct The Commissioner
videos.overview: Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu realise their mistake of kidnapping Daroga instead of the commissioner. Anita's heartless and greedy behaviour distresses Vibhuti. Manmohan gets Vibhuti's complete health check-up done. Vibhuti feels like a piece of furniture while everyone inspects him. Anita discusses the payment schedule with Singhania. Manmohan and Vibhuti visit Gulfam Kali where Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu wait for Daroga and the commissioner to execute their second plan to abduct the commissioner.

videos.title: Sweety and Vibhuti's Ring Ceremony
videos.overview: Vibhuti rubbishes Anita's concern for him. Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu miss the target once again and abduct Daroga instead of the commissioner. Singhania's sister Sweety and Vibhuti exchange rings. Prem and David join in the celebrations. Anita is unhappy with Vibhuti dancing with Sweety. Daroga tells the boys to abduct a burkha-clad commissioner on a secret mission but is told by the commissioner that he will wear the burkha instead. Angoori disagrees with Vibhuti being sold.

videos.title: Ammaji has a Wall Built On The Tiwaris' Terrace
videos.overview: Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu abduct the burkha-clad Daroga. Anita changes her mind, and Singhania cancels the wedding, saying that Sweety wants to marry Manmohan. Vibhuti watches Angoori. Manmohan feels happy watching Anita from his balcony. For Manmohan's business' betterment, Ammaji gets a wall built on the balcony of the Tiwaris. Vibhuti and Manmohan devise a plan portraying the wall's inauspiciousness. Ammaji agrees to get the wall demolished and falls through the wall on Manmohan and Vibhuti.

videos.title: Manmohan Invents 'judwa Mania'
videos.overview: While eating 'Dahi Bhalle', Vibhuti chucks one at a girl and puts the blame on Manmohan, who gets thrashed by Tillu, Teeka, Malkhan and others for eve-teasing. Vibhuti donates his blood to Manmohan. Manmohan gets an idea to take revenge while watching a film. He pretends that, every time Vibhuti gets hurt, he feels the pain. The doctor calls this condition 'Judwa Mania'. Vibhuti does not support Anita's new assignment of working for mad people. Angoori ignores Vibhuti, which bothers him.

videos.title: Vibhuti Urges Angoori to Punish Him
videos.overview: Anita shares with Meenal about the details of her new project with IHO and briefs Teeka, Malkhan, Tillu and her staff. Daroga congratulates Anita. On being ignored by Angoori, a heartbroken Vibhuti tells her to slap him as his retribution. Vibhuti thinks that Manmohan will feel the pain. Manmohan enjoys himself at Vibhuti's expense. Manmohan tries to gain Anita's sympathy. Next, Vibhuti gets himself beaten with a slipper from Angoori. Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu convince Prem to fake madness.

videos.title: Vibhuti Convinces Angoori to Beat Him Ruthlessly
videos.overview: Anita threatens to throw Tillu, Teeka and Malkhan out of their jobs when they bring Prem, who poses as a mad man. Vibhuti offers them money and asks them to hit him. Manmohan enjoys Vibhuti being beaten and later, at night, fakes pain in front of Vibhuti. Vibhuti convinces Angoori to beat him ruthlessly with a hunter, and Daroga witnesses this. Daroga informs Anita and promises to bring a video recording. Manmohan comforts Angoori and tells her not to feel guilty for hitting Vibhuti.

videos.title: Angoori Brands Vibhuti With a Hot Iron Rod
videos.overview: Daroga films a handcuffed Vibhuti being hit by Angoori with a belt while Manmohan watches gleefully. Anita is distressed on seeing the video and is convinced that all three are mad. Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan mistake that the commissioner is a mad man and pay a price by getting arrested. Manmohan dupes Angoori into using a hot iron rod on Vibhuti. David and Anita catch all three of them and put them in the mental asylum where Manmohan confesses that his plan is to take revenge on Vibhuti.

videos.title: Anita Gets Angry When Vibhuti Criticises Her
videos.overview: Anita shares with Angoori her favourite author's view on husbands lying to their wives, and they insist that Vibhuti and Manmohan speak the truth. Angoori gets hurt due to Manmohan and Vibhuti's low opinion about her singing and low IQ. Anita gets angry when Vibhuti criticises her looks and when Manmohan and Vibhuti call her haughty. Vibhuti and Manmohan state their true opinion about Teeka, Tillu, Malkhan and Daroga. Disliking the truth, Angoori and Anita ask their hubbies to revert to lies.

videos.title: Anita Becomes an Inspector
videos.overview: A goon holds the commissioner at gunpoint. While Daroga deserts him, Anita overpowers the goon. Vibhuti overhears Ammaji telling Angoori that she needs to dance in a dacoit's presence for Manmohan's business to flourish. At the annual police function, Daroga is demoted while Anita is appointed as an inspector. Tillu warns Teeka and Malkhan about their bleak future. Anita threatens to suspend Happu Singh if the pending cases are not solved. Vibhuti tells Angoori that he has a dacoity friend.

videos.title: Vibhuti Gets Kidnapped By a Dacoit
videos.overview: Anita's strictness unnerves Manmohan, who comes to the cop station to give her sweets. He informs her about dacoit Anjana Singh's whereabouts. Angoori dances in front of Vibhuti disguised as the dacoit. Anita and Happu Singh arrive, and Vibhuti is exposed. Before he can prove his innocence, the real dacoit abducts him. No one is ready to believe a helpless Vibhuti, who is forced to loot. Teeka and Malkhan become greengrocers. A disguised Manmohan gets himself caught for eve-teasing by Anita.

videos.title: Anjana Singh Refuses to Grant Freedom to Vibhuti
videos.overview: Vibhuti, as dacoit Anjana Singh, loots Manmohan and Tillu. He gives the money to Anjana Singh, who denies him his freedom. Manmohan reports the robbery to Inspector Anita. Anita states her dilemma to Angoori. Vibhuti wants to talk to Anita as her husband, but Anita holds him at gunpoint. Using Angoori as his crutch, Vibhuti escapes. Commissioner reprimands Anita for allowing Vibhuti to escape. Manmohan throws Angoori out for hampering Vibhuti's arrest. Anjana Singh takes Vibhuti to Gulfam Kali.

videos.title: Angoori Becomes a Dacoit
videos.overview: A homeless Angoori joins Vibhuti and dacoit Anjana's Singh's gang. Inspector Anita reprimands Happu Singh for sleeping in the police station and calls for Manmohan's arrest for pushing Angoori to become a criminal. Vibhuti imagines romancing Angoori. While Vibhuti and Angoori are looting vegetables from Teeka and Malkhan, Inspector Anita arrives. Manmohan causes Vibhuti and Angoori to escape. Vibhuti tears David's will of INR 20 crores and strips him off his personal belongings.

videos.title: Inspector Anita Traps The Dacoit
videos.overview: At Angoori's insistence, Vibhuti and Dacoit Anjana Singh come to Manmohan's house to clean his safe. Inspector Anita catches them and discloses her, Angoori and Manmohan's plan of Angoori joining the dacoit's gang to trap Vibhuti. Happu Singh catches the real dacoit, who escapes. Happu Singh gets reinstated, and Anita resigns. Manmohan mistakes Ammaji for her character Pappu in a play, who romances with Anita while rehearsing. Teeka and Malkhan get caught trying to dupe a CID officer.

videos.title: Angoori and Vibhuti Visit Baba Lakdanand
videos.overview: Tillu lifts Teeka and Malkhan's sagging spirits by bringing work. Manmohan overhears Anita coaxing Vibhuti to grow his hair like actor Salman Khan. Ammaji informs Angoori about Baba Lakdanand, a tantric who is visiting Kanpur. Angoori accompanies Vibhuti to the tantric to resolve his unemployment and agrees to shave Manmohan's hair once Vibhuti gets work. Anita sees Vibhuti in Manmohan, who grows his hair to suit Anita's taste. Vibhuti consents to replace the absconding acrobat.

videos.title: Vibhuti is Tasked With Performing a Perilous Act
videos.overview: Angoori informs Manmohan about Lakdanand's instruction, which requires offering Manmohan's hair to him after Vibhuti gets work. Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu prepare for the show. Seeing Vibhuti as an acrobat upsets Anita. Angoori is happy for Vibhuti and approaches Manmohan to cut his hair. Manmohan is put in a spot with Ammaji's arrival, but he defers losing his hair by a day. Anita throws a stinking Vibhuti out of her bedroom. Vibhuti is told about the perilous act that he has to perform.

videos.title: Angoori Prepares to Shave Off Manmohan's Head
videos.overview: Vibhuti refuses to perform the dangerous act and realises Manmohan's motive behind discouraging him from working. Manmohan bribes Daroga to stop Vibhuti's street performance. Realising Daroga's weakness, Vibhuti makes him dance like a monkey. Anita sees Vibhuti in Manmohan. Vibhuti gives a razor to Angoori to shave Manmohan's hair. Manmohan overhears Ammaji and Angoori's plan to sedate him and then shave his head. Although Manmohan throws away the spiked milk, Ammaji's blow knocks him out.

videos.title: Manmohan Wears a Wig
videos.overview: Manmohan hides his bald head under a monkey cap and, when questioned by Anita, attributes it to ill health. He buys a wig and meets Anita for lunch where his wig gets blown away by the strong breeze. A disappointed Anita asks him to leave. Manmohan asks Daroga to return the bribe for his failure to stop Vibhuti's work. Daroga's second attempt is also foiled. Manmohan puts a lizard in Vibhuti's shirt, causing him to fall during his act. Anita tells a bedridden Vibhuti that he isn't meant to work.

videos.title: Vibhuti, Manmohan, and Daroga Get Thrashed
videos.overview: Daroga informs the Tiwaris and the Mishras about a terrorist escaping from jail. Manmohan and Vibhuti make fun of Daroga. Vibhuti, Manmohan and Daroga decide to put each other down. Angoori and Anita decide to display their strength against the terrorist. Vibhuti gets beaten by Angoori, who mistakes him for the terrorist. Likewise, Manmohan gets thrashed by Anita. Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu mistake Daroga for the terrorist and beat him. All three hide the actual reason for their injuries.

videos.title: Anita and Angoori Join Political Parties
videos.overview: Anita joins politics and decides to contest the municipal elections as Tej Tewar Party's candidate with Manmohan as her secretary. Nand Kishore of the Bholi Bhali Party urges Angoori to be their candidate. Vibhuti coaxes Angoori to agree. Manmohan stops Angoori, but on Vibhuti's provocation and with Ammaji's support, Angoori agrees. In front of Ammaji, Manmohan has to support Angoori. Prem gives Tillu, Teeka and Malkhan the task of sticking posters for the elections.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan to Ruin Their Wives' Campaign
videos.overview: Anita and Angoori get their photo shoots done for their campaign posters. Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan wonder who would be more advantageous for them between Anita and Angoori. Anita gives a speech focusing on the youth, and Angoori on the mothers. Manmohan and Vibhuti run each other down. Vibhuti promises to get Prem's gambling dens reopened in exchange for his help in tarnishing Anita's image. Manmohan and Daroga vow to ruin Angoori's innocent image. Prem records Vibhuti pressing Anita's legs.

videos.title: A News Channel Airs Angoori and Anita's Videos
videos.overview: Daroga films Angoori not being able to answer Manmohan's general knowledge questions, thereby exposing her ignorance. Tipish Kumar's news channel airs Angoori and Anita's videos. Ammaji beats Manmohan. Masterji and Baba Parmanand are the panellists on the news show. Manmohan and Daroga watch Vibhuti bribing Tillu, Teeka and Malkhan by giving them one year's free access to Gulfam Kali's place in exchange for their votes for Angoori. Manmohan devises a plan to counteract Vibhuti.

videos.title: Manmohan Bails Out Tillu, Teeka, and Malkhan
videos.overview: Anita and Angoori express their comradeship and discuss their husbands' animosity towards each other. Vibhuti enjoys the breakfast prepared by Angoori and forbids Manmohan from eating as he is from the opposition. Anita tells Manmohan to prepare breakfast for her and himself as Vibhuti has refused to do so. Vibhuti is unable to polish Angoori's Urdu. He tells Gulfam Kali to take care of Tillu, Teeka and Malkhan, but Daroga arrests them. Manmohan secures their bail and wins their votes for Anita.

videos.title: Anita and Angoori Withdraw From The Elections
videos.overview: Angoori and Anita with their respective husbands, Manmohan and Vibhuti, appear on a news debate. The news host, Tapish Kumar, asks them about their plan to bring about a change in the city. Manmohan and Vibhuti insult each other and indulge in a physical fight. Anita and Angoori decide not to take part in the elections. Teeka informs Malkhan about a trick that can make any girl fall in love. Ladoo, who overhears their conversation, tells Malkhan and Teeka to impress girls with their talent.

videos.title: Angoori Steals Jewellery
videos.overview: Angoori steals jewellery from Ghanshyam Das's house. Meenal asks her to keep his jewellery until she returns from Dubai. Angoori asks Vibhuti to throw a bag in the forest leaving Vibhuti puzzled. Vibhuti learns that Malkhan, Teeka and Tillu have found the bag. The trio is filled with joy when they find the jewellery inside the bag. On Anita's insistence, Manmohan agrees to keep Meenal's jewellery at his house. Manmohan is shocked to learn that the jewellery is missing from the safe.

videos.title: Adhoore Lal Tells Angoori's Story to Vibhuti
videos.overview: Manmohan tells Anita that he cannot find the keys to his safe. Angoori asks Vibhuti to drop another package in the forest. Vibhuti gets suspicious after seeing jewellery inside the packet found by Malkhan, Teeka and Tillu. Vibhuti sees Angoori sneaking out of her house in the middle of the night and decides to follow her. Vibhuti is heartbroken to learn that Angoori is a thief. He meets Angoori's uncle, Adhoore Lal who narrates a story to him that turned Angoori into a thief.

videos.title: Vibhuti Finds Meenal's Missing Jewellery
videos.overview: Anita is relieved on finding Meenal's jewellery and informs Manmohan. Angoori arrives at Vibhuti's house to steal but Vibhuti stops her. When Meenal asks for her jewellery Anita is shocked to see that it is missing from her safe. Vibhuti asks Angoori to return the stolen jewellery but learns that she has thrown the jewellery in the forest. Vibhuti finds the jewellery with Happu and gives it back to Anita. Angoori informs Anita that she has stolen the jewellery.

videos.title: Angoori Steals Queen Kamlavati's Diamond
videos.overview: Anita tells Vibhuti and Manmohan to keep an eye on Angoori. The commissioner gives Happu the responsibility of keeping Queen Kamlavati's diamond safe in the museum. Manmohan informs Anita and Vibhuti that Angoori has stolen Queen Kamlavati's diamond. Happu and the commissioner find Vibhuti and Manmohan, who arrive to bring back the diamond, sneaking into the museum. Anita informs Vibhuti and Manmohan that they will have to recreate the event that has impacted Angoori.

videos.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti Want to Adopt Teeka
videos.overview: Angoori washes Adhoore Lal's face and decides that she will never steal. The priest informs Teeka that whoever will foster him will become rich. Manmohan and Vibhuti convince their wives to adopt Teeka. Vibhuti and Manmohan shower love on Teeka and invite him for dinner leaving Tillu and Malkhan confused. Happu informs Manmohan that Teeka is having a feast at Vibhuti's home. Tillu and Malkhan reveal Teeka's truth in front of Vibhuti and Manmohan. Manmohan and Vibhuti beat Teeka.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Angoori Meet With an Accident
videos.overview: Angoori tells Vibhuti that Manmohan is taking her for shopping. Manmohan makes an excuse and refuses to go with Angoori as he wants to spend time with Anita. Vibhuti takes Angoori for shopping on Prem's scooter. While returning, Vibhuti and Angoori meet with an accident and Angoori loses consciousness. Manmohan blames Vibhuti for the accident. Angoori addresses Vibhuti as Bhushan and slaps him multiple times which shocks everyone.

videos.title: Vibhuti Slapped!
videos.overview: Vibhuti tries to enter Angoori's bedroom in the middle of the night. Angoori wakes up and slaps Vibhuti while addressing him as Bhushan. Manmohan invites Anita and Vibhuti for Ammaji's birthday party. At the party, Vibhuti dances with Angoori while donning a mask. Angoori recognises Vibhuti and slaps him for coming to the party. Ammaji tells Manmohan that she has to leave to take care of Pandit Ramphal and asks Manmohan to keep a nurse for Angoori. Vibhuti borrows nurse's clothes from Saxena.

videos.title: Vibhuti Dons The Guise Of Julie Chattopadhyay
videos.overview: Vibhuti disguises himself as a nurse and introduces himself as Julie Chattopadhyay. Manmohan is not convinced by her nursing abilities, and Anita interrogates him. Saxena vouches for her and, later, takes his compensation with a thrashing. Masterji is scandalised by the sounds from the bushes. Happu Singh faces a problem of not being able to urinate and seeks Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan's aid. Vibhuti confesses to Anita about his disguise, and Manmohan sees Anita romancing Julie Chattopadhyay.

videos.title: Manmohan Ousts Julie
videos.overview: Manmohan is scandalised and anguished on witnessing Anita romance Julie. Later, Masterji informs him about Julie and Saxena, and Manmohan sees David embracing Julie. Manmohan overhears Julie telling Angoori to divorce him. An agonised Happu is desperate for help. Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan suggest a way. What nobody could do, Prem's malfunctioned scooter does. Happu finally urinates. Manmohan throws Julie out, and in the tussle that ensues, Vibhuti's wig comes out.

videos.title: Manmohan Kisses Vibhuti
videos.overview: Vibhuti visits a Baba to win Angoori's love. Manmohan to get rid of his irritation. Baba gives 'Kajal' to Vibhuti to apply and look at only the person he wants to attract. He tells Manmohan to kiss the person, who irritates him the most. Vibhuti opens his 'Kajal'-applied eyes in front of Manmohan, who kisses him. Happu shows Anita a video of Manmohan kissing Vibhuti, and Anita informs Angoori about it. Angoori prepares to leave the house. Ammaji thrashes Manmohan. Manmohan explains his action.

videos.title: Vibhuti Donates His Sperm At Dr Micky's Clinic
videos.overview: Happu cries and shares his grief about not knowing his father's name with Vibhuti. Vibhuti tells him about his royal lineage, which Dr Micky Donor overhears. He invites Vibhuti to his clinic to donate his sperm. Ammaji tells Angoori and Manmohan that she wants a grandchild. Anita tells Vibhuti to arrange INR two lakhs to give the landlord. Vibhuti donates his sperm at Dr Micky's clinic and sees Ammaji and Angoori there. Meenal advises Anita to have a baby to make Vibhuti a responsible man.

videos.title: Happu Learns That He is Vibhuti's Brother
videos.overview: Dr Micky Donor advises Angoori to fake her pregnancy to get Manmohan interested in fatherhood. Anita tries to convince a reluctant Vibhuti about becoming parents. She questions Vibhuti about the INR 2 lakhs that he gives her. Dr Micky Donor discloses to Happu that the latter and Vibhuti are brothers. An emotional Happu informs Vibhuti and Anita about this. Angoori's fake pregnancy elates Manmohan. To pay the landlord of the premises of Anita's grooming class, Vibhuti donates his sperm again.

videos.title: Angoori Pretends to be Pregnant
videos.overview: Vibhuti can't believe his ears and wrongly assumes that his sperm has caused Angoori's pregnancy. He takes a raw mango for Angoori. Happu shares with Anita the entire story about how he is Vibhuti's brother. Vibhuti tries to calm a distraught Anita. Manmohan stops Angoori from doing the household chores. Ammaji advises Angoori to carry on the pretence for a while longer. An emotional Happu interrupts Vibhuti and Anita's romance and tells Tillu, Teeka and Malkhan about his sob story.

videos.title: Anita Wants to Become a Mother
videos.overview: Anita overhears Angoori, who informs Bhoorey Lal about her pregnancy at Manmohan's insistence. An excited Anita emphatically expresses her desire of parenthood to Vibhuti. Happu's emotional outburst irritates the Mishras. Unable to contain his happiness, Bhoorey Lal wants to organise a 'Godh Bharai' ceremony for Angoori. Manmohan is unhappy with Anita's wish to become a mother. Dr Micky Donor rejects Teeka's offer to donate his sperm. Tillu and Malkhan try their luck, but they too are rejected.

videos.title: Gulfam Kali Forcibly Hides In The Tiwaris' Bathroom
videos.overview: An inebriated Vibhuti informs Bhoorey Lal that he has impregnated Angoori. An embarrassed Ammaji reveals her plot to instil paternal feelings in Manmohan. Vibhuti reveals to Anita that he misunderstood that Angoori's pregnancy was linked to his sperm donation. Dr Micky requests an exasperated Happu to hunt for his own father. As Gulfam forcibly hides in the bathroom of the Tiwaris, Anita and Vibhuti seek to bathe at the Tiwari house due to a water supply cut at their house.

videos.title: Vibhuti Becomes Kanpur's Cleanliness Ambassador
videos.overview: Anita wants Vibhuti to retrieve her diamond ring from the dustbin as she suspects that he placed it there irresponsibly. Angoori thinks that she should throw garbage on Vibhuti to ensure prosperity for her house after Ammaji warns of astrological trouble for Manmohan. Vibhuti fines Minister Singh for littering in public after the latter appoints him Kanpur's cleanliness ambassador. Vibhuti's fame and plans as ambassador elate Anita and Angoori but irk Manmohan.

videos.title: Vibhuti Fines Anita For Littering Her Home
videos.overview: Vibhuti fines Manmohan, assuming that the latter will throw banana peels, and for misbehaving with his cleanliness officers. Vibhuti bars Teeka from fining Angoori despite her littering Vibhuti after the latter flirts with her over her tasty carrot halwa. Anokhelal litters publicly and Happu and wants to be punished brutally, but the cleanliness officers and Happu escape from him. Vibhuti fines Anita for littering her home. Manmohan angrily deems that the cleanliness campaign is fleecing people.

videos.title: Anita Pretends to be Manmohan's Wife
videos.overview: Vibhuti fines Agarwal, assuming that the latter will spit out chewing gum publicly. To seal her grooming class' deal with Agarwal's marital counselling bureau, Anita pretends to be Manmohan's wife. Angoori, who notices Manmohan's delight, is told by Ammaji that she will have to make her hitherto target throw garbage publicly as the astrological state is improving. Vibhuti refuses to punish Anokhelal. Angoori makes Vibhuti litter publicly, which leads to him being fined. Vibhuti fines Malkhan.

videos.title: Kanpur's Residents Begin to Fear Vibhuti
videos.overview: Vibhuti fines Master Bhoop for the litter at a venue after a conversation with Minister Bhojraj. Angoori makes Vibhuti litter the venue, which shocks Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu. Manmohan seeks to boost his chemistry with Anita to retain Agarwal's trust. Ammaji visits the Tiwaris for a puja. Anita-Manmohan's pretence is exposed, which leads to Agarwal scrapping the deal. Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu find Anokhelal in a gutter after the pipe gets blocked. Kanpur's residents fear Vibhuti and his team.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Nainital Trip With Gulfam Kali
videos.overview: Manmohan romances a miffed Angoori. Bhojraj sacks Vibhuti from his position as cleanliness ambassador. Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu plot to scuttle Vibhuti's supposed sleazy plan in Nainital with Gulfam. Anita gets angry when she receives a message on the phone that Vibhuti has booked a room with Babita in Nainital in a hotel. Angoori suspects that Manmohan has lied to her about the reason behind his scheduled visit to Nainital. Angoori, Anita, Manmohan and Happu follow Vibhuti and Gulfam.

videos.title: Anita Goes Missing In Chimpugad
videos.overview: Close to an eerie Chimpugad, as Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan bike, a saree-clad person lurks. Manmohan recommends that the new year be welcomed in Chimpugad, to which Angoori and Anita consent happily and Vibhuti reluctantly. Vibhuti flirts with Angoori over the romantic reputation of Chimpugad. The Mishras and the Tiwaris play spoken parlour in Chimpugad. Anita hears someone screaming outside her tent and subsequently goes missing. Vibhuti and the Tiwaris report to Happu about a missing Anita.

videos.title: Anita's Odd Behaviour
videos.overview: Anita's disappearance anguishes Manmohan and Happu. A tearful Anokhelal bashes Manmohan and orders Happu to find Anita as soon as possible. A shattered Anokhelal batters a crestfallen Vibhuti, who weeps in front of Angoori. Vibhuti disagrees emphatically with Manmohan when the latter suggests that Vibhuti should unite with Gulfam. Anita returns and rather weirdly cooks food and feeds it to Vibhuti. A seemingly possessed Anita's arrival at the police station elates Happu, whom Anita flirts with.

videos.title: Anita Kisses Manmohan
videos.overview: Vibhuti resumes flirting with Angoori. An arguably possessed Anita flirts with Manmohan at her home and kisses him, which sends 'electric signals' throughout his body. At Zorawar's hideout, as the real tied Anita watches, Mona, who has disguised herself as Anita with 'plastic surgery', plots evilly with him. Mona sends Vibhuti out of the Mishra house, which makes him suspect that Anita wants to flirt with Happu. Mona wants justice for her murdered sister. Manmohan wonders why Anita kissed him.

videos.title: Mona Runs Away With Jk
videos.overview: Manmohan, who thinks that Anita kissed him and wants to know why, gets kissed by Mona again. Happu affectionately blackmails Commissioner Singh into letting Anita meet the imprisoned criminal JK without knowing that it is Mona who wants to meet him. Mona reveals with giggles to Angoori that Vibhuti loves Angoori and that she kissed Manmohan, which shocks Angoori and the two men, who assume that she is Anita. Mona fools Singh and Happu and runs away with JK. A trapped Anita is in a dilemma.

videos.title: Angoori Identifies The Real Anita
videos.overview: At Mona's hideout, Vibhuti's personal questions are answered rightly by Mona and Anita, which heightens the confusion as to who is Anita. Manmohan, who gets slapped by both women, is also unable to identify Anita. Angoori helps the cops arrest Mona. Later, Anita happily lets a feminine Saxena do domestic work in her house. Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan wish to wed the maid not knowing that he is Saxena. Anita doesn't know it too and agrees to help the maid choose one of the men as her hubby.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan Get Flashbacks Of Their Past Lives
videos.overview: Tillu asks Manmohan for his salary. Manmohan refuses and slaps him. Tillu gangs up with Teeka and Malkhan and beats Manmohan. Vibhuti sees Manmohan getting beaten and has flashbacks of his previous life where he was 'Karan' and Manmohan was 'Arjun'. He saves Manmohan. That night, Manmohan has the same flashbacks. Saxena confirms that it is indeed a case of flashbacks of their previous birth. Happu asks Teeka, Malkhan, and Tillu to threaten Lakkad Singh, the son of a minister, Kankar Singh.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan Meet Their Mother
videos.overview: Saxena hypnotises Manmohan and Vibhuti and takes them back to their previous birth. They realise they are 'Karan' and 'Arjun', residents of Pissu Nagar, who were killed by Thakur Durbal Singh. Their mother is waiting for them for the last 35 years. Lakkad Singh beats Tillu and Malkhan. He forcefully enters Gulfam Kaliâ€™s place and harasses her. Manmohan and Vibhuti are interviewed by a local news channel along with Saxena in connection with the story of their reincarnation.

videos.title: Phulwa Devi Gets Her Sons Back
videos.overview: Phulwa Devi asks her lawyer, Chaddha, to search for Vibhuti and Manmohan as they are reincarnations of her sons, Karan and Arjun. Chaddha finds Manmohan and Vibhuti. Phulwa Devi, however, has no recollection of her past. To get her memory back, Manmohan and Vibhuti marry Zorawar and Bakhtawar. Phulwa Devi gets her memory back. Chaddha informs Vibhuti and Manmohan that he will get the property papers ready in their name. Happu requests Lakkad Singh not to harass Gulfam Kali.

videos.title: Chaddha Exposes Manmohan and Vibhuti's Marriage
videos.overview: Ammaji arrives and beats Manmohan. Vibhuti and Manmohan promise to give Tillu's salary, in addition to a job for him and Teeka and Malkhan after inheriting the Phulwa Devi's property. Chaddha shows a video of Manmohan and Vibhuti's marriage which reveals that the marriage was faked to get Phulwa Deviâ€™s over-aged daughters married to them. He asks Manmohan and Vibhuti to return to Pissu Nagar to stay with their newly-wedded wives. Anita and Angoori are worried about Vibhuti and Manmohan.

videos.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti's Plan to Earn Respect
videos.overview: Vibhuti and Manmohan engage in an argument as to who gets respected by society. Manmohan decides to teach Vibhuti a lesson. Tillu, Malkhan and Tika harass Gulfam Kali. Vibhuti arrives and slaps the trio. Manmohan makes a plan with Gulfam Kali. Gulfam Kali arrives at Vibhutiâ€™s home and starts flirting with him. Vibhuti mistakes Gulfam Kali for Anita. Anita gets angry on seeing Gulfam and Vibhuti flirting. Vibhuti realises the truth and comes up with a plan of his own.

videos.title: Back Ache!!
videos.overview: Minal and Anurag visit Anita who thinks that Minal is inviting her to become a member of the Jhumru Club of Kanpur. But Minal wants Anita and Vibhuti to participate in a dance competition. She asks Anita to send her a video of them dancing where their chemistry is evident. Following that, Angoori helps relieve her uncle of his back pain. Later, Vibhuti hurts his back when Anita asks him to practice the dance with her. So Vibhuti visits Angoori to cure him of his back pain.

videos.title: Accidents Happen!
videos.overview: Angoori relieves Vibhuti of his back pain. Later, he apologises to Anita and they start practising another dance routine. However, Vibhuti injures his back for the second time when he tries to lift Anita. So he goes to Angoori and begs her to kick him on his back but Manmohan tells Vibhuti to say mean things to Anita first. Meanwhile, Anita tells her friends that she will perform a dance when Vibhuti returns home. Just then, Vibhuti comes home and insults Anita.

videos.title: Thrown Out!
videos.overview: Vibhuti asks Angoori to kick him. While doing so, Angoori falls to the ground and injures her leg. When Manmohan calls the doctor, the latter blames Vibhuti for Angoori's injury. On the other hand, Anita apologises to Minal on Vibhuti's behalf but Minal calls them the worst couple. Following that, Anita decides to teach Vibhuti a lesson. Later at night, he tries to apologise to her but she kicks him out of the house. He goes to Saxena's house to spend the night.

videos.title: Captured!
videos.overview: Anita tells Manmohan that she kicked Vibhuti out of the house. On hearing this, Manmohan tells Anita that Vibhuti does not deserve a woman like her in his life. On the other hand, Mr Saxena ties Vibhuti's hands so he is unable to answer Anita's calls. Just then, Angoori tells Anita the reason behind her leg injury. Following that, Anita tries to call Vibhuti but he is unable to answer so she gets worried. Later, Anita gets annoyed when Happu Singh asks her silly questions about Vibhuti.

videos.title: Lost or Found?
videos.overview: Anita's brother-in-law walks in just as Happu Singh is consoling her. Anita tells him that Vibhuti is missing and he states that a person like Vibhuti can either be found in a bar or a brothel. When they go to the brothel, Gulfam Kali tells Anita that Vibhuti didn't visit. Meanwhile, Vibhuti dresses up on Saxena insistence, who wants to take him around the world after eloping with him. Vibhuti makes some excuse and somehow lands in Angoori's house. Will Anita save him?

videos.title: No More Alcohol!
videos.overview: Anita tries to call Vibhuti home but he continues to drink with Tiwari. At the same time, Angoori tells Tiwari to come home but he refuses to do so. The following day, Angoori and Anita request the police commissioner to ban alcohol because of their husbands' misbehaviour. Later, Anita tries to share a romantic moment with Vibhuti, but he tells her that he's not in the mood. Similarly, Angoori and Tiwari dance together at home. Both men are attracted to each other’s wives and leave no chance to impress them, which often lands them in funny situations.

videos.title: Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hain - Episode 933 - September 25, 2018 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Anita excitedly uploads Vibhuti’s selfie with the mummy. Bhoorey watches a news segment wherein Bodhi speaks of being attacked by the mummy. Frightened, Bhoorey meets Vibhuti. While Teeka, Malkhan, Tillu and Happu receive a visit from the mummy, Bhoorey narrates to Angoori, Vibhuti, and Manmohan how the mummy once swore revenge against his ancestors. Thereafter, the mummy visits them, but they drive it away. Anita and the doctor mistake the mummy for a heavily bandaged Gupta.

videos.title: Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hain - Episode 934 - September 26, 2018 - Full Episode
videos.overview: The mummy is on the loose, and it breaks into Angoori’s house. Thereafter, Bhoorey, Manmohan, Vibhuti and Angoori turn to Bodhi for help. He consults Migrant Mishra, who advises him to entice the mummy of King Jutankhamun with a look-alike of his queen, Lashkara. Later, Bhoorey explains to Manmohan and Angoori the plan to trap the mummy, while Vibhuti convinces Anita of the necessity of dressing up as Lashkara. Vibhuti reveals himself in his new avatar, and Angoori calls out to the mummy.

videos.title: Migrant Mishra Captures a Bandaged Figure
videos.overview: Vibhuti as Lashkara seduces the mummy, who takes him away. However, Vibhuti escapes, and the mummy runs amok again. Later, a bandaged figure visits Vibhuti. While Laskhara dances and keeps it distracted, Migrant Mishra captures it. Later, Saxena is impressed with two schoolboys speaking fluent Sanskrit. Everyone awaits Saxena’s decision regarding the reward, but he insults them, and they leave empty-handed. Migrant Mishra secures the mummy in its coffin, unaware that it is actually Gupta.

videos.title: Gulfam Tells Happu She is Pregnant With His Child
videos.overview: Happu extorts money from Vibhuti and Manmohan and spends it on Gulfam. Angoori, Vibhuti and Manmohan ask Gulfam’s help in getting the money back, and she agrees. Later, Gulfam tells Happu she is pregnant with his child and gets him to give her money by threatening him. At night, Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu are furious with Happu for impregnating Gulfam, and Teeka beats him up. While Happu learns the truth from Vibhuti and Manmohan, Gulfam assures Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu that she is not pregnant.

videos.title: Vibhuti Sells Snacks On Prem’s Cycle
videos.overview: In a bid to stop Angoori from donating huge amounts of money, Manmohan lies to her about his business suffering. Meanwhile, Anita, whose business is truly on the decline, tells Vibhuti to get a job. A worried Angoori wants to help Manmohan, and she approaches Prem as a rickshaw driver. Thereafter, Vibhuti agrees to ride Prem’s cycle and sell snacks. Meanwhile, Malkhan tries to release the genie from a lamp but in vain. Teeka suggests duping someone else. Later, Malkhan and Teeka con Happu.

videos.title: Vibhuti Meets Hrithik, a Rickshaw Driver
videos.overview: On his nightly round, Vibhuti, disguised as a snack seller, encounters Hrithik, who is, in fact, Angoori in disguise as a male rickshaw driver. Although Angoori does not recognise him, he realises who Hrithik really is. The next day, Vibhuti hands over his earnings to Anita, while Angoori leaves hers for Manmohan to find. Meanwhile, Happu calls upon the genie and wishes to become Commissioner. Later at night, a concerned, disguised Vibhuti meets Hrithik, while Happu visits Teeka and Malkhan.

videos.title: Manmohan Tells Vibhuti His Suspicions Regarding Angoori
videos.overview: After Manmohan reports Angoori’s disappearance to Happu, he catches her sneaking into the house. She fibs about her whereabouts, but Manmohan soon spots her lie. Later, a depressed Manmohan tells Vibhuti that he suspects Angoori is having an affair. For a hefty price, Vibhuti agrees to find out where Angoori disappears to at night. Meanwhile, Happu complains to his genie that none of his wishes have come true. However, the genie makes up excuses and continues making gastronomic demands.

videos.title: Angoori Reveals The Truth About Hrithik
videos.overview: After Bhoorey’s scooter is stolen, he rides in Hrithik’s rickshaw. Bhoorey reaches home and, upon finding Angoori missing, beats Manmohan. Unable to bear this, Angoori reveals the truth. Thereafter, Vibhuti realises Anita too was lying about her business. Meanwhile, Teeka and Malkhan suffer from diarrhoea, which they learn is Happu’s payback for duping them. While Bhoorey is reprimanding Prem, he gets his scooter back. At night, Manmohan feels guilty and apologises to Angoori for lying to her.

videos.title: Manmohan, Vibhuti, Teeka and Happu Get Depressed
videos.overview: Teeka is struck by depression when he reflects on his life and realises how devoid it is of accomplishments and marital stability. Manmohan sees a dull Teeka and, in trying to cheer him up, realises how dismal his own married life is. The depression is contagious, and Vibhuti is next in line to recognise how fruitless his life has been. While Vibhuti and Manmohan lament their existence, Happu has a go at trying to cheer up Teeka. Although he succeeds, he himself falls victim to depression.

videos.title: Bhoorey, Manmohan and Vibhuti's Mysterious Business
videos.overview: While Teeka starts a new business as a cobbler, Anita makes Vibhuti take her to dinner at Hotel Red Diamond. There, Vibhuti meets an old friend, Sanjana. While one the job, Teeka receives a huge business offer and is whisked by businessmen Nagar, Dagar and Sagar. Vibhuti lies about his employment and financial status to Sanjana. Impressed, she asks him to divorce Anita and marry her. A few days later, a mysterious bag changes hands between Bhoorey, Manmohan and Vibhuti.

videos.title: Sanjana Blackmails Vibhuti
videos.overview: Vibhuti secretly meets Sanjana. She requests him to blackmail her miserly husband, Brij Bhushan, for INR 5 lakhs, which she claims she desperately needs. Meanwhile, Angoori dances for Manmohan, but he remains indifferent. Sanjana calls Vibhuti and blackmails him with the photos they had clicked together. Meanwhile, Happu is being hounded for money he borrowed while under the influence. The next day, Vibhuti decides to blackmail Manmohan. Elsewhere, Teeka shows up touting his wealth and new name.

videos.title: Angoori and Anita Try to Help Their Spouses
videos.overview: Vibhuti devises a plan to extract INR 5 lakhs from Manmohan by blackmailing him. Vibhuti phones Manmohan under a false name and calls him to a brothel to pay a cheque of INR 3 lakhs. Upon Manmohan's arrival, a woman starts dancing with him that enables Vibhuti to take pictures for blackmail. Later, Angoori and Anita are suspicious of their husbands' late night outings, and try to resolve the case of blackmail their husbands have gotten into. But, their endeavours land them in more trouble

videos.title: A Dying Sanjana Gives Clues to Vibhuti
videos.overview: Angoori and Manmohan decide to get the money from Bhoorey Lal by creating a situation for blackmail. Manmohan threatens Bhoorey of revealing his obscene photos to his family if he doesn’t give INR five lakhs. Pillar’s numbers become the dropping point of the ransom. Elsewhere, Vibhuti gets hit and the bag is snatched from him. Just before dying, Sanjana gives Vibhuti some clues. After telling Anita of the murder, Vibhuti is on the run because he was seen at the murder spot.

videos.title: Resham and Happu Arrest Chinoy
videos.overview: With Prem’s help, Manmohan, Vibhuti and Angoori, disguised as dancers, get to Sanjana’s room in Chinatown Club. While they dance, Anita retrieves Sanjana’s diary. She later shares how Sanjana needed the money to save herself from Chinoy. Chinoy shows up wielding a gun, but Resham and Happu come to the rescue. The next day, Bhoorey’s money finds its way back to him through Happu, Vibhuti and Manmohan. Meanwhile, Teeka, having realised the rich life is not for him, returns to Malkhan and Tillu.

videos.title: Mr Foreigner Searches For Amateur Actors
videos.overview: Saxena introduces everyone to Mr Foreigner, his English friend and an award-winning film producer. Mr Foreigner is on the lookout for amateur actors for his next film, which is based on the story of Ravan and is to be shot in London. Everyone argues about whose role they will play, but Saxena settles the matter by picking chits and assigning everyone their roles. In order to get into character, Saxena requests everyone to go about their daily routine in their respective costumes.

videos.title: Manmohan, Angoori and Vibhuti Practise Their Roles
videos.overview: As instructed by Saxena, everybody tries to get into their respective character. Tiwari, dressed as Ravan, scolds Vibhuti in Vibhushan’s costume, when they get into recital mode over the beautiful Angoori, who is dressed as Mondadori. Mr Foreigner and Saxena are very impressed by what they observe. Optimistic about going to London, Angoori and Tiwari in costume start talking about everybody’s affairs and trying to be creative. On observing them, Mr Foreigner and Saxena are confident of success.

videos.title: Vibhuti Assures to Settle Manmohan's Claim
videos.overview: Vibhuti suffers from gastroenteritis. Despite the unbearable pain, the prospect of a trip to London entices him to continue playing his role. A life insurance officer visits Tiwari for the claim he made for his burnt-down shop. On investigation, the officer offers Tiwari a far smaller amount than expected. Vibhuti assures Tiwari he will get the claim fulfilled, and they make a deal on the commission. During their round-up, Mr Foreigner and Saxena are impressed with their actors.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Tiwari Catch Suresh Rawal
videos.overview: On seeing Mr Foreigner and Saxena, all the role playing characters go into acting mode in the police station. Vibhuti and Tiwari are put in prison for a fraud insurance claim. They bribe Happu Singh who lets them escape. Vibhuti and Tiwari spot Suresh Rawal discussing a deal with a suspicious man on how Tiwari’s shop was set ablaze. They film it and nab Suresh and hand him over to Happu Singh. The next day, they attend the grand rehearsal where they act, sing and dance.

videos.title: Vibhtuti Promises to Take Angoori to The Fair
