videos.overview: Saxena's revelation about Mr Foreigner makes everyone shower them with abuses. Manmohan refuses to take Angoori to the village fair. A broke Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu ask Happu to lend them money but receive a slap in return. Vibhuti plans to take Angoori to the fair by fibbing to her. Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu are elated to have Happu sponsoring them. Vibhuti and Manmohan arrive, and they all eat the sweets snatched from Saxena. Realising it is mixed with laxatives, everyone runs to the loo

videos.title: Anita Suspects That Vibhuti had Affairs In The Past
videos.overview: Vibhuti and Anita praise each other’s young looks and Anita suspects that Vibhuti may have had affairs. Manmohan is worried about having to pay INR five lakhs as income tax. He refuses to pay Tillu his wages. When Anita sings a song, Vibhuti starts to tremble and sweat. Tillu, Malkhan and Teeka are jealous on learning that Happu is posted on duty outside a girls’ hostel. Ammaji gets an amulet for Manmohan to get his marriage back on track and to protect him from evil spirits, but he discards it.

videos.title: Haunted Room In The Girls' Hostel
videos.overview: Dressed as women, Teeka, Tillu and Malkan are stopped at the girl’s hostel by Happu. The girls at the hostel tell the trio that room 13 is haunted. Later, the men hear singing from the locked room and run for their lives. Anita’s college friends decide to hold a reunion party. Manmohan is told to collect INR 8 lakh cash from the girl’s hostel from a prospective client. Vibhuti brings biscuits for Angoori and asks her to sing. She obliges, but her song makes Vibhuti tremble and sweat

videos.title: The Ghost On Manmohan's Back
videos.overview: Vibhuti and Anita get nostalgic during the reunion at their house. Vinod keeps eyeing Anita and reveals that he was the one who had put colour on her during the Holi festival and got beaten up, and not Vibhuti. In the meanwhile, Tiwari enters the haunted room number 13 at the girl’s hostel and returns home with the invisible ghost on his back who is only reflected in the mirror. On hearing a familiar song, Vibhuti goes out in the balcony to see a weird looking Tiwari singing it.

videos.title: The Ghost Goes Back-hopping
videos.overview: Teeka reveals how he had disguised as a client to send Tiwari to the haunted room number 13. Later, the ghost latches on to Malkhan’s back and he starts to sing the same song, surprising Happu and scaring Tillu and Teeka. Vibhuti’s uncle starts to sing the same song before he lands up at Vibhuti’s house with the ghost. After circling and singing around Vibhuti, his uncle starts kissing him. Subsequently, the ghost attaches herself to Vibhuti. Meanwhile, Saxena learns the art of exorcism.

videos.title: Vibha's Ghost Reveals Her Murderer's Name
videos.overview: The ghost latched on Vibhuti makes him do abnormal things. In the meanwhile, Saxena is trying to attract the ghosts with the help of a ritual. Tiwari and Angoori complain to Anita and Vibhuti while the ghost gets dragged away and lands up at Saxena’s ritual ceromony. Tiwari, Angoori and Anita, on seeing the ghost reflected in the mirror, get frightened. The ghost reveals that she is Vibha and was loved and murdered by Vibhuti, and the proof is in room number 13 of the girl’s hostel.

videos.title: Anita Catches Vibha's Real Murderer
videos.overview: Vibha's ghost tells everyone she has a video recording of the murder in room number 13. At the police station, everyone watches the video intently and sees Vibhuti murder Vibha. But, Vibhu consistently says the person is not him. Anita, aware of Vibhu’s mannerisms, notices a twitch in the person's shoulder and gets suspicious. Their friends drop by, and Anita sees Vinod with the same mannerism and accuses him. The impersonator removes his mask in the footage ahead and the murderer is revealed.

videos.title: Dr Gupta Brings Some Marriage Proposals
videos.overview: In the morning, Vibhuti visits Tiwari who, along with Happu Singh, makes fun of Vibhuti for being jobless. Prem offers Vibhuti a partnership at his new hair-cutting salon. Angoori convinces Tiwari to get a hairstyle resembling Amitabh Bachchan. The doctor brings marriage proposals for Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan and tells them they will have to become 'Ghar Jamais' in order to inherit a lot of wealth. In return, the doctor asks them for a bungalow as a gift.

videos.title: Vibhuti Gives Manmohan's Hair a Makeover
videos.overview: Angoori reminds Tiwari to go to a good salon for a haircut. Teeka and friends, too, want to go for facials. Vibhuti promotes his modernised salon. An impressed Tiwari lands up at the salon and consumes a spiked welcome drink which puts him to sleep. Later, Tiwari wakes up to curly blue hair and freaks out Vibhuti justifies his work by saying the style belongs to Amit Pachori as Tiwari had not specified which Amitji he wanted to emulate. Vibhuti then presents Tiwari with a bill of INR 8,500

videos.title: Vibhuti's Gives Unique Salon Treatment
videos.overview: A blue-haired Tiwari plans revenge after receiving a beating from Ammaji. Happu comes to Vibhuti’s salon and consumes the spiked welcome drink. On waking up, Happu is shocked to find himself with a toothbrush moustache, half eyebrows, and a bill of INR 2,500 Doctor tells Teeka and gang to get their facials done as the fathers of the brides will visit them the next day. To their horror, Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu wake up to faces that are golden, green and red after Vibhuti’s treatment

videos.title: Manmohan's Revenge On Vibhuti
videos.overview: Tiwari initiates his plan to take revenge on Vibhuti. Angoori sings with her face half covered. Vibhuti enquires her about it, and Tiwari replies that the cream he had given her spoilt her face. A devastated Vibhuti loses all interest in his new salon. Tiwari tells Vibhuti that Angoori wants him to leave the city. Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan, with their coloured faces, are visited by a stranger who calls them losers. The doctor tells the trio that he is the father of the brides.

videos.title: Puttan Comes to Live With Angoori
videos.overview: Angoori’s Daddoo tells Putan that her brother will come and stay with her and Tiwari once he is released from jail. Anita decides to become a writer. Putan arrives with a bang as he crashes his scooter into Happu. Fed up with Putan’s previous antics, Tiwari dreads his stay in their house. Vibhuti also knows Putan will only create trouble for all of them. Meanwhile, Putan decides to turn over a new leaf. Happu tells Vibhuti that Gullu is planning marriage and she wants to dump him.

videos.title: Angoori Looks For Prospective Brides For Puttan
videos.overview: Putan tells Angoori to get him INR 25 lakhs from Dadoo to do business. Knowing Putan’s criminal ways, she refuses. Putan plans to get rich by marrying a rich girl. Vibhuti’s attempts at wooing Anita fail as she begins writing for her novel and doesn't wish to be disturbed. Happu is unable to eat the food cooked by Gullu as it is too spicy. Angoori calls for prospective brides for Putan. Tiwari and Vibhuti are irked to see an insolent Putan getting pampered by Angoori. Teeka proposes to Gullu.

videos.title: Gullu and Puttan Fall In Love
videos.overview: Vibhuti and Tiwari, both unhappy with Puttan’s criminal ways, want him out of their lives. Puttan tells Tiwari and Vibhuti to get him married. They devise a plan and approach Gullu who they know is looking to get married. Vibhuti and Tiwari praise Puttan and tell her the proposal is from him and arrange a meeting between Gullu and Puttan. For the two, it's love at first sight. Puttan comes home and announces to Angoori and Bhoorey that he is in love. Tiwari upsets Anita with his filmy dialogues.

videos.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti's Disguise As Gullu’s Parents
videos.overview: Bhoorey and Angoori are shocked to learn that Puttan is in love with Gullu. Bhoorey wants to hit Puttan, but Tiwari and Vibhuti intervene and save him. Tiwari and Vibhuti tell Gullu that she should get her parents to meet Puttan’s family, but Gullu tells them that her parents are not available. Desperate to get Puttan out of their lives, Tiwari and Vibhuti decide to disguise as Gullu’s parents and meet Bhoorey and Angoori to talk about the marriage arrangements.

videos.title: Gullu and Puttan's Engagement Ceremony
videos.overview: Bhoorey is shocked to learn the story behind Gullu having two biological fathers. However, Saxena arrives and exposes them Bhoorey backs out, but on Puttan's warning, immediately agrees for the engagement. As Vibhuti and Tiwari celebrate their success, Happu, Prem, Teeka, Malkhan, and Tillu arrive and vent their frustration on them. Later, the heartbroken gang attend Gullu's engagement ceremony. Seeing Gullu and Puttan putting a ring on each other's fingers drowns her secret admirers in misery

videos.title: Puttan Breaks His Engagement
videos.overview: A worried Tiwari and Vibhuti want to put a stop to Puttan and Gullu’s marriage due to Puttan's plan of staying in the Tiwari house even after his marriage. The devise a plan to lure Gullu back to dancing. Later, on seeing Gullu dancing in front of wealthy clients, Puttan breaks his engagement. Elsewhere, Anu realises she has written the worst book ever and puts an end to her writing career. She appreciates Vibhuti’s encouragement and calls him the best husband.

videos.title: Vibhuti Gets Selected For The Moon Mission
videos.overview: Anita tells Vibhuti to get a real job so that she too can be proud of him. A TV show announces that they will send a common man along with the astronauts to the moon and that the common man may also win INR 10 lakhs. Anita makes Vibhuti apply for the same. Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu too apply for the same. Scientist NL Gupta interviews the candidates and selects Vibhuti as the winner. Vibhuti shares the good news with Angoori, who requests him to get some sweetmeats from the moon

videos.title: Angoori Packs Snacks For Vibhuti's Moon Mission
videos.overview: Tiwari congratulates Anita with sweetmeats for Vibhuti’s attempt to win INR ten lakhs and go to the moon. Tiwari criticizes Vibhuti, but gets surprised at Vibhuti’s selection. Tiwari requests Vibhuti to promote his business of undergarments on the moon, and promises to pay him INR 10,000 per month. As per her logic, Angoori packs long lasting snacks for Vibhuti, in case he feels hungry on the moon. Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu fall into a trap of an old man’s tale.

videos.title: Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu Plan to Rob Hidden Treasure
videos.overview: Anita is happy with Vibhuti for getting the chance of winning the prize money to go to the moon. Anita states her wish to romance Vibhuti in an astronaut's costume. Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu plan to rob the hidden treasure from the police station by beating Happu and going to prison. The next day, Vibhuti is given a farewell by the neighbours. Happu, as told by an astrologer, repents for his sins by forgiving and forgetting, thus dashing Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu’s plans of finding the treasure.

videos.title: Vibhuti Lands On The Moon
videos.overview: Tiwari and Angoori watch telecast of the rocket that is taking Vibhuti to the moon. From within the rocket, Vibhuti says in his interview that India looks the best from outer space. On landing on the moon, all the other scientists are allotted jobs except for Vibhuti who is asked to clean, vacuum and cook. Vibhuti makes romantic calls to Anita and Angoori. To get into jail for the hidden treasure, Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan decide to insult Commissioner Resham Pal Singh.

videos.title: Vibhuti Gets Stuck On The Moon
videos.overview: Tiwari gets jealous every time Vibhuti calls Angoori from the moon. Tiwari wants to know why Vibhuti is not promoting his 'Chameli Chhap' innerwear from the moon. The rocket takes off for earth, leaving Vibhuti behind who is busy hoisting the innerwear. Anita, Angoori and Tiwari are shocked when they hear Vibhuti was left behind on the moon. Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan go to jail and find the casket but are unable to open it. Vibhuti starts to hallucinate on the moon and begs Anita to save him.

videos.title: A Scientist From Bangladesh Rescues Vibhuti
videos.overview: Tiwari and Angoori discuss Vibhuti being stuck on the moon, Just then, an innerwear falls on Tiwari. Looking at the innerwear, Tiwari is assured that it has fallen from the moon, but Saxena tells him that the innerwear is his A feeble Vibhuti is visited by a professor who lands on the moon from Bangladesh and rescues Vibhuti. Vibhuti gets another offer from scientist Sawant who says he will pay INR 25 lakhs to Vibhuti if he goes to Mars. Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan search for the 'Rasvarti' herb.

videos.title: Puttan Plans to Extract Money From Tiwari
videos.overview: Angoori brings 'kheer' for Vibhuti, who boasts to her of being a macho man, but, on seeing a rat, he gets petrified. Angoori leaves Vibhuti feeling insulted. Saxena gives Malkhan reenergising herbs, which he shares with Teeka. Saxena tells them the herb does the opposite. Puttan wants to extract INR 20,000 from Tiwari and includes Tillu in his plan of playing tiger. Puttan growls and Tillu says it’s the tiger who scratched him in Tiwari’s shop. A fearful Tiwari runs away.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Plan to Impress Angoori Backfires
videos.overview: To prove his bravery, Vibhuti plans to get Angoori in trouble and then rescue her to become a hero in her eyes. However, the plan backfires when Prem sees Gullu and beats Vibhu. Tillu tells Tiwari that the tiger’s visit to the shop has severely hit the business. Puttan suggests he will catch the tiger, provided he is given INR 20,000 for it. Later, Tiwari tells Angoori of Puttan’s cheating and they decide to visit the jungle at night. Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan finally find the ‘Rasverti’ herb.

videos.title: Saxena Befriends The Tiger In The Forest
videos.overview: In the jungle, Happu threatens to put Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan behind bars for stealing from the jungle. Just then, they hear growls and hide in the machan. Vibhuti sees Saxena, who is dressed as a tiger, being photographed by Puttan. They too, hear the growls and hide in the machan. Tiwari and Angoori reach the deep forest and hear the growls. On seeing the real tiger, they too hide in the same machan. Saxena decides to lure the tiger away but soon comes back with the tiger as his friend.

videos.title: Manmohan Conducts His Grandmother's Prayer Ceremony
videos.overview: Vibhuti overhears Manmohan sharing anecdotes about his grandmother to Angoori, Pandit and Anita. Hearing Anita's story about her uncle, Vibhuti comes up with an idea to trouble Manmohan. Later, Manmohan receives an earful from Ramkali after informing her about celebrating his grandmother's birthday. Gulfam Kali hits Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu by her car, thereby landing Happu in trouble and the trio in the hospital During his grandmother's prayer ceremony, Manmohan shares a story from her life.

videos.title: Vibhuti Dons Tiwari's Grandmother's Garb
videos.overview: After seeking Tiwari's grandmother's blessings, Vibhuti falls unconscious. Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu enjoy their stay at the hospital. Vibhuti bribes Dr. Gupta and Pandit into supporting him. Later, Vibhuti arrives in Tiwari's grandmother's garb and gives an elaborate performance. Tiwari and Angoori fall prey to Vibhuti's plan. An excited Tiwari apprises Anita about the situation. At the hospital, Dr. Gupta hands several bills to Happu while Gulfan decides to stay the night for the injured trio.

videos.title: Helen Buys Clothes For Vibhuti
videos.overview: Saxena takes Tiwari's grandmother, Helen, out for shopping and later hands Tiwari a bill of INR 20,000 Helen buying clothes for Vibhuti irks Tiwari, but Helen silences him. Tiwari takes Helen to meet Anita. Helen discloses unpleasant stories of Tiwari's childhood to Anita and hands her the gift. Later, Helen lovingly eats from Angoori's hands. At the hospital, Happu catches Tillu, Malkhan, Teeka and Dr. Gupta dancing with Gulfam, but Dr. Gupta covers up for them and hands another bill to Happu

videos.title: Bhoorey and Ramkali Meet Helen
videos.overview: Under Helen Tiwari's garb, Vibhuti dreams of romancing Angoori. The next day, Anita has a good time watching Helen mistreating Tiwari and sharing interesting stories from her personal life with Angoori. Bhoorey visits Angoori, who introduces him to Helen. Ramkali arrives and greets Helen, who poses an extremely awkward question to her, making Ramkali flee on the spot. Happu overhears Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu's discussion about fooling him, and later, makes them pay a heavy price for it

videos.title: Manmohan Brings His Grandfather to Meet Helen
videos.overview: Anita overhears Prem and Vibhuti's conversation and tells it to Tiwari, who gets emotional. Anita and Tiwari come up with a plan to make Vibhuti spill the beans. As Tiwari's grandmother narrates stories to Angoori, Tiwari brings his grandfather home, shocking Vibhuti After Tiwari's grandfather tries to get intimate with him, Vibhuti runs downstairs and reveals the truth to everyone. Later, Vibhuti comes home to another surprise. Happu too tells the truth to Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu.

videos.title: Puttan's Gujarati Girlfriend
videos.overview: Vibhuti asks Angoori the reason for feeling sad. She tells him she wants Puttan married at the earliest. When Vibhuti criticises Puttan, she reprimands him, making Tiwari happy. Meanwhile, Puttan is romancing Hetal in the park. She tells him her mother wants her to marry only a Gujarati. On hearing Puttan will stay with his in-laws in Surat, Tiwari and Angoori agree to act like Gujaratis to get Puttan married off. Prem wants to start a dairy farm and offers Tillu, Teeka and Malkhan a job.

videos.title: Manmohan and Angoori Get Into The Gujarati Garb
videos.overview: Tiwari, Puttan, and Angoori get into the Gujarati garb to help Puttan. Puttan's girlfriend Hetal and her mother Alpa arrive and are greeted by the trio. Hearing Angoori's broken Gujarati language, Alpa questions her, but Puttan cleverly covers it up. Vibuti tries to interfere but is soon ousted. Alpa's priest arrives to take the matter further. Elsewhere, Teeka, Malkhan, and Tillu thank Prem for offering them jobs at his cattle shed. Gulfam inaugurates the shed while a peeved Happu looks on.

videos.title: Hetal’s Astrologer's Advice For Puttan
videos.overview: Hetal’s astrologer tells Tiwari and Angoori that Puttan’s parents are required for the blessing or the marriage can go wrong. He also demands for pure buffalo milk when they visit the next time. Meanwhile, in Prem's dairy farm, Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu remain unsuccessful in milking the buffalo that they had named Anarkali. Puttan tells the terrible trio to keep 2 litres milk ready for Hetal's mother. To make Angoori jealous, Vibhuti pretends to talk to another woman on the phone.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Saxena Become Puttan's Parents
videos.overview: Angoori requests Vibhuti to help them get Puttan married by playing his father’s character. Saxena plays the mother. Tiwari and Vibhuti want the marriage so that Puttan can settle permanently in Surat. Vibhuti starts to flirt with Hetal’s mother Alpa. Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan dance in front of Anarkali and still get no milk. The astrologer tells them Hetal would need Puttan's grandparents' blessings to make the marriage successful.

videos.title: Alpa Flirts With Vibhuti
videos.overview: Tiwari, Vibhuti, Puttan and Saxena are interrupted by Happu, who blackmails to expose them to Alpa for pretending to be a Gujarati family. To avert this, they decide to bribe Happu but also make him play Puttan’s grandfather. After arriving at Tiwari’s house, Alpa starts flirting with Vibhuti. Later, it is decided that Hetal and Puttan's marriage will take place after the ring ceremony. Meanwhile, at the cowshed, Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan are still unsuccessful at milking Anarkali.

videos.title: Alpa Breaks Puttan's Marriage
videos.overview: During the engagement function, everybody has a good time and dance to Bollywood songs. Bhoorey gets happy for Puttan when he hears about his big fat Gujarati wedding. Meanwhile, Prem informs Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan that Anarkali cannot give milk as she is actually Salim. The trio reflect upon their unsuccessful attempts to milk Salim. On seeing Bhoorey, Alpa tells everyone that it’s because of his unfaithfulness that she distrusts and hates Biharis. Later, an angry Alpa breaks the marriage

videos.title: Manmohan Becomes a Robber
videos.overview: Angoori gives Vibhuti a pan but before he can praise it, Tiwari interrupts them. An astrologer advises Ammaji to make Tiwari rob wearing black clothes in order to safeguard Angoori's life. The fear of being imprisoned makes Commissioner Resham Pal give his black money to Happu to hide. Happu gives the money, INR 5 lakhs, to Vibhuti for safe custody. Vibhuti demands INR 50 thousand as fees for keeping the money safe. Later, as advised by his mother, Tiwari gets into Vibhuti’s house to rob.

videos.title: Teeka, Tillu, and Malkhan Decide to Reform Their Ways
videos.overview: As ordered by his mother, Tiwari, dressed in black, goes to rob Vibhuti's house at night. A sleepy Vibhuti mistakes Tiwari for Anita and kisses him. The next morning, Angoori sings a religious song. Angoori is surprised to hear from Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan that they have decided to give up all of their bad habits. They request Angoori to take care of their meals till they get a job to which she agrees. After failing the previous night, Tiwari finally robs the briefcase from Vibhuti’s house.

videos.title: Angoori Takes The Blame For Manmohan's Robbery
videos.overview: At night, Angoori sees Tiwari with a black briefcase. The next day, Happu visits Vibhuti to collect the bag. Angoori overhears Vibhuti telling Happu that the briefcase is missing, and gives the bag back to save Tiwari. Angoori lies to Happu that she had stolen the bag. To save Angoori, Vibhuti takes the rap. Later, Tiwari confesses to stealing the bag. The self-blame game concludes when Ramkali tells Tiwari to return the bag. While Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan have a good spell, Angoori falls ill.

videos.title: Angoori Falls Sick
videos.overview: Tiwari wakes up at 5 am to do the household chores which he detests. Angoori’s deficiency of vitamin D becomes a cause of worry for Tiwari. Vibhuti is bribed by Tiwari into doing his housework. Vibhuti smartly offers the work to Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan. Meanwhile, INR 25,000 is stolen from Tiwari’s safe. Vibhuti pampers Angoori while Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan do the chores. When Teeka and Tillu confess to stealing the money, they are punished to work for the next six months along with Vibhuti.

videos.title: Manmohan Opens 'angoori Devi Asharam'
videos.overview: Ammaji tells Tiwari to convert his home into Angoori Devi Asharam to help the poor and needy to get rid of the bad luck. Every time Ammaji calls, he has to wash their feet and drink the water. Vibhuti and Prem decide to party while Anu is away. Angoori advertises Tiwari's phone number to the newspaper inviting the needy to their Ashram. On hearing music, Tiwari snoops and sees Gulu dancing in Vibhuti’s house along with Prem. Tiwari decides to get Vibhuti in trouble with Anu.

videos.title: Anita Sees Vibhuti With Gulfam In Their House
videos.overview: Tiwari calls Anita and tells her Vibhuti is enjoying himself with Gulfam. Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan approach Phulwati’s father having marriage in mind. Phulwati ties raakhi to all three of them and puts a stop to their regular teasing. All three are thrown out of the house. Anu comes back and finds Gulfam in their house and throws Vibhuti out of the house. Teeka ,Tillu and Malkhan go to live in Angoori Devi Asharam. Vibhuti pretends to become a sage thinking Anita will call him back.

videos.title: Resham Pal Vents His Anger On Happu's Statue
videos.overview: Angoori finds a dishevelled Vibhuti near a temple, and after learning his sob story, takes him to her 'Ashram'. Anita rebukes Tiwari for inciting her against Vibhuti. Tiwari washes Teeka, Malkhan, Happu and Tillu's feet and drinks the water on the orders of his mother. Later, Tiwari is stunned to hear Anita's decision to divorce Vibhuti. In the night, Teeka, Malkhan and Tillu lie about Happu being a statue to Resham Pal, who arrives looking for him, and vents out his anger on the statue

videos.title: Saxena's Challenge to Baba Vibhu
videos.overview: Vibhuti goes on a spiritual mode in Tiwari’s ashram. Anita watches him and is convinced he is faking it. Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan think Vibhu is a saint and call him as 'Baba Vibhu'. At night, Angoori serves them dinner and receives praises for her cooking skills. Ammaji tells Tiwari to wash the needy’s feet and drink the water. The next day, Baba Vibhu sings a religious song, amazing Anita. Saxena challenges Baba Vibhu to a religious recital competition. Baba Vibhu accepts the challenge.

videos.title: Baba Vibhu Takes Saxena Into Confidence
videos.overview: Tiwari, on Ammaji’s instructions, washes Baba Vibhuti’s feet and drinks the stinking water. The competition on religious topic is almost won by Saxena until Vibhuti takes Saxena in confidence and tells him he is acting only to gain Anita’s sympathy so that she takes him back home. Happu is thrown into trash by the commissioner. Tiwari, who is in a romantic mood, dances with Angoori. Baba Vibhu tells Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan to put an end to the romantic dance.

videos.title: Anita and Angoori Trick Vibhuti
videos.overview: Tiwari’s romantic mood is disrupted by Teeka, Tillu and Makhan when they prick him with a needle as instructed by Vibhuti Baba. Tiwari wants Vibhu to leave his Ashram and admits to Anita the truth. He urges her to take Vibhuti back. Anita and Angoori plan to trick Vibhuti into going back home and succeed. Ammaji tells Tiwari he has to beat Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan and throw them out of the house. Tiwari enjoys the task of throwing them out.

videos.title: Manmohan and Angoori Plan to have a Child
videos.overview: Angoori starts with her daily chores and Prem disturbs Vibhuti while espying her. Saxena enacts a child, while on doctor's explanation, Tiwari takes him home. Tiwaris plan for a child, but an agitated Vibhuti and childlike Saxena become a blockage for them. Malkhan and Teeka ask for money to go on a holiday and Happu agrees on a humorous condition. Vibhuti puts a powder in the dish while Angoori cooks, but stops Tiwari when he feeds it to her.

videos.title: Teeka Accepts The Offer to Get Sterilised
videos.overview: Vibhuti is unhappy with the lullaby that Angoori sings. He tells her that a woman’s figure gets spoilt after pregnancy. Tiwari tells Happu about his wish to become a father. Vibhuti eavesdrops on Tiwari’s conversation and decides to stop his wish from being fulfilled. Saxena, dressed as a baby, calls Tiwari 'papa' to help him practice being a father. Teeka accepts the offer to get sterilised in return for INR 1 lakh. However, the doctor tells Teeka that only married men can get sterilised.

videos.title: Manmohan's Dreams Of Becoming a Father Shatter
videos.overview: Vibhuti stops Angoori from eating the spiked food. Tiwari gets food poisoning after eating the spiked food. Teeka and Malkhan convince Tillu to act as Teeka’s wife so that he can claim INR 1 lakh on his sterilisation. Vibhuti, on the pretence of taking Tiwari to a nursing home, takes him to get sterilised. The next day, Tiwari hear of his condition and his hopes of becoming a father shatter. The doctor tells Teeka that his bride’s father has to sign a no objection form before they sterilise him.

videos.title: Angoori Learns About Tiwari's Sterilisation
videos.overview: Ammaji tells Tiwari and Angoori that the next four days is the right time to try for a baby. Hearing this, Tiwari remembers his sterilisation and cries. Tiwari tells Angoori, who is trying to seduce him, that he has turned celibate and runs away. Malkhan is brought as Teeka’s father-in-law but their deceit is discovered by the doctor. Before trying to hang himself, Tiwari tells Angoori of his condition. Seeing Angoori cry, an emotional Vibhuti tells them the truth.

videos.title: Tiwari Decides to Throw a Party For Anita
videos.overview: Angoori suggests a party for New Year when she is asked what she wants as a gift by Tiwari. Meanwhile, Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan are unable to find a place to settle down. Getting insulted by Vibhu for being a miser, Tiwari decides to throw a party for Anu to request her to come back to Kanpur. Happu invites Gulfam for the party, who decides to go with both Prem and him. Seeing Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan beaten up by girls, Saxena gives them an idea to enter Tiwari’s party.

videos.title: Tiwari Kisses Vibhuti At The Party
videos.overview: To fulfil Tiwari’s condition, Teeka, Malkhan and Happu arrive with their respective dates for the New Year Party. Though a steady stream of guests arrive, Tiwari waits to welcome Anu. Vibhuti lies to Tiwari about Anu’s inability to attend the party. Upon Vibhuti’s suggestion, all decide to play a dance game and land up with unexpected partners. Hilarity ensues when Tiwari ends up kissing Vibhuti during the New Year’s countdown. On coming to know the truth, Tiwari kicks Vibhuti out of the party.

videos.title: Anita's Predictions About Tiwari Come True
videos.overview: Tillu, Teeka and Malkhan discuss their New Year resolutions when Happu intervenes and calls them hopeless. When Tiwari joins them at the tea stall, they inform Happu and Tiwari that Anu is back in town. Tiwari goes to meet her and finds out that she has learnt Tarot reading. Anu predicts that Tiwari is going to get disrobed in public soon. Vibhuti overhears the prediction and makes it come true. Tillu decides to befriend Happu to gain the advantage of his connections.

videos.title: Vibhuti Makes Anita's Predictions Come True
videos.overview: Upset at Tiwari's nude video going viral on the internet, Angoori curses the trickster. Vibhuti gets hit by a brick, and a motorbike slams into him. Tiwari tells Anu that her tarot card reading came true. The same night, Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan praise Happu and read Urdu poems in his honour, much to his delight. Tiwari moves around with his face covered. To make Anu happy, Vibhuti makes her predictions come true. Later, Anu predicts bird droppings on Happu’s head which Vibhu makes come true.

videos.title: Vibhuti Confesses to His Wrongdoings
videos.overview: Tiwari complains to Vibhuti that his nude video on the internet got 20 lakh likes The next day, Vibhuti hides from Angoori knowing well that her curses will affect him. Angoori asks Vibhuti to look for a ladies tailor. Happu praises Anita for her tarot readings and says that the bird dropping tasted just like ice cream. Angoori’s tarot reading says she will slap her neighbour. Vibhuti confesses that the prank on Tiwari was played by him. Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan slyly extract money from Happu.

videos.title: Anita Learns About Vibhuti's Acts
videos.overview: Angoori tells Anu that she was not able to slap Vibhuti and hence, her tarot reading failed. Vibhuti confesses to his wife that all her readings came true because of his doings. Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan are beaten because they are friends with Happu. Wanting to impress Angoori, Vibhuti tells her he is very religious. Prem invites Vibhuti to his birthday party ignoring Happu, who decides to spoil it. While the matchmaking for Puttan continues, he is told his wife’s name will begin with 'G'.

videos.title: An Insulted Happu Takes Revenge
videos.overview: Prem’s birthday celebrations are held at Gulfam’s house which upsets Vibhu. When Happu is insulted and made to leave, he takes his revenge by cutting off the electricity. Vibhu makes his escape. The next morning, Teeka, Gulfam and Puttan come to Vibhu’s house with charred clothes due to the fire in her house. Gulfam blames Vibhu and stays at his house. Angoori is barred from entering Vibhu’s house. At night, Vibhu stops Tiwari from entering his house, making him curious to solve the mystery.

videos.title: Manmohan Secretly Watches Vibhuti Lying
videos.overview: At night, in spite of Vibhuti’s objection, Gulfam continues her daily singing and dancing ritual at his house. Tiwari secretly watches Vibhuti lying to Anita on the phone. Meanwhile, Angoori feels giddy due to the fasting and waiting for the religious prayer meeting to be held at Vibhu’s house, which he keeps postponing. Prem decides to get Gulfam’s house repaired and asks Happu, Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan to give INR 1 lakh each. Tiwari keeps an eye on Vibhuti at night and sees Gulfam on his bed.

videos.title: Vibhuti Foils Manmohan's Plans
videos.overview: As instructed by Tiwari, Angoori pretends to feel weak and giddy, making Vibhuti feel guilty. Tiwari tries to complain to Anita, who is setting up her grooming parlour in Lakhimpur Khiri. Her continuous talking does not give him an opportunity to speak, so he travels all the way to Lakhimpur and gets her back. Vibhuti hears about her return in advance and hides everyone in the house. Anita returns to a normal home and a loving husband, and accuses a shocked Tiwari of hallucinating.

videos.title: Vibhuti, Manmohan and Angoori Unite Against Gulfam
videos.overview: Anita tells Vibhuti that she had come to check on him after receiving Tiwari's complaint that Gulfam had moved to their house. On finding nothing unusual, Anita returns to Lakhimpur Khiri. When Vibhuti tells Tiwari and Angoori the truth, they agree to help him. Vibhuti pretends to have poisoned Tiwari, and Angoori blames Gulfam, who calls off their bluff. On hearing that Prem has gotten her house repaired, Gulfam vacates Vibhuti's house. Vibhu tells Anita the truth but she does not believe him.

videos.title: Vibhuti Hypnotises Manmohan
videos.overview: Vibhuti tells Angoori of the fair that is set up in the outskirts of Kanpur, for which, he wants to take her. She tells him that she dreams of all the fun she would like to have at the fair with Tiwari. Prem brings back a floating hypnotism locket from a vacation in Hong Kong. Vibhuti borrows it for a day. Teeka and Malkhan get jobs as reporters at A2Z local news channel. Vibhuti hypnotises Tiwari by getting him drunk. He asks Tiwari to tell Angoori to talk to Vibhuti for any concerns.

videos.title: A Hypnotised Manmohan does Vibhuti's Bidding
videos.overview: Tiwari reaches home hypnotised. He responds to Angoori’s romantic gestures in a trance. She wants him to talk romantically, but he tells her to talk to Vibhuti. Insulted by Happu and Gulfam, Vibhuti plans a revenge. He orders Tiwari to rob Gulfam, beat Happu, give Tillu INR 5000 and tell Angoori to talk to him. Happu's attempt to beat Tiwari for robbing Gulfam’s bracelet backfires when reporters Teeka and Malkhan put it on live coverage. Vibhuti hypnotises Angoori when she comes to complain.

videos.title: Manmohan's Behaviour Surprises Tillu and Angoori
videos.overview: Vibhuti daydreams of hypnotising Angoori and making her say 'I love you'. His bubble bursts when Prem, who comes to collect his hypnotising locket, kisses him. Vibhuti hypnotises Tiwari and nicknames him 'Tommy'. At night, Tillu comes to Tiwari's house and is shocked when Tiwari feeds him dinner and gives him INR 5000. Angoori is elated by Tiwari's changed behaviour. She agrees to go to the fair with Vibhuti. Seeing Happu, Tiwari beats him up again, while Teeka and Malkhan cover the event live.

videos.title: Happu and Manmohan Learn About Vibhuti's Locket
videos.overview: Whenever Prem asks for his hypnotising locket, Vibhu calls Tiwari and gets him beaten up. At night, Tillu makes an appearance and is given INR 5000 by Tiwari. Angoori is shocked when Tiwari gives her permission to go to the fair with Vibhuti. Teeka and Malkhan become top reporters by showing Happu's news. Angoori overhears Prem telling Vibhu that his misuse of the locket on Tiwari is the reason for his weird behaviour, and gets Tiwari dehypnotized. Happu and Tiwari plan to teach Vibhu a lesson.

videos.title: Chaos In Vibhuti's Life
videos.overview: Tiwari teaches Vibhuti a lesson with the help of Angoori and Happu. Tillu, Teeka and Malkan ponder over ways of procuring the money to take Jhulan to a five-star hotel. Spotting a scooter, they steal it and try to sell it to Vibhuti. Excited at the prospect of taking Angoori to the market on it, he borrows the money from her to buy it. It turns out that it was the commissioner's scooter and Happu catches Vibhuti riding it. Later, Vibhuti demands his money back from the trio.

videos.title: Angoori and Manmohan Go to Prem's Bungalow
videos.overview: Vibhuti is terrified due to a recurrent dream where he is bitten by a snake in a jungle. The next day, he is approached by Prem who tells him about his bungalow in Chondera village, situated near a jungle, that needs painting. Vibhuti offers his services for the job in exchange for a hefty sum. He lures Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan to do the job instead. Meanwhile, Angoori convinces Tiwari to take her to the bungalow for a vacation. She also invites Happu to join with his wife and kids.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Dreams Unsettle Him
videos.overview: When Vibhuti is leaving for Chondera village with Tillu, Teeka and Malkhan, Angoori tells him about joining them in the bungalow with Tiwari. On the way, Vibhuti once again sees the dream where he is following a woman, who later turns into a snake and bites him. Tillu, Teeka and Malkan have interesting insights as to why Vibhuti is seeing this dream repeatedly. Elsewhere, Badami agrees to accompany Prem and Happu to Chondera as well. Upon reaching the bungalow, Vibhuti gets a feeling of déjà vu.

videos.title: Has Vibhuti's Nightmare Come True?
videos.overview: After settling in his room in Prem’s bungalow, Vibhuti reminisces about Angoori and wishes for her to come to him. Suddenly, he sees Angoori by the door. Akin to his dream, when Vibhuti touches Angoori, she turns into a snake, thus terrifying him Meanwhile, Tiwari and Angoori set out early for Chondera. When Tiwari tells Vibhuti about their changed travel plans, Vibhuti is rendered confused as he is under the notion that Angoori has already arrived.

videos.title: Angoori Confesses Her Love to Vibhuti
videos.overview: To stand true to his words, Vibhuti turns Amar’s bungalow into a hotel before Angoori and Tiwari’s arrival. With Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan posing as waiters and bellboys, the situation becomes more hilarious. At night, Angoori, in a trance-like state, takes Vibhuti outside the bungalow and confesses being in love with him. Tiwari, who hears this, is devastated and leaves before seeing Angoori transforming into a snake. Later, chaos ensues when Angoori denies doing what she is accused of.

videos.title: A Shape-shifting Cobra Creates Havoc
videos.overview: All get to know that it is a shape-shifting cobra who took over Angoori’s consciousness and caused the troubles. They also learn that, in his childhood, Vibhuti was bitten by the cobra’s mate and died, and a tantric had killed the mate to save him. Now, that shape-shifting cobra wants to exact revenge against Vibhuti for her mate’s killing. Troubled upon knowing this, everyone goes to the same tantric who had saved Vibhuti, for a solution. His solution leaves them all baffled.

videos.title: The Shape-shifting Cobra Forgives Vibhuti
videos.overview: Following the tantric’s instructions, everyone assembles to see Saxena trying to call the shape-shifting cobra. Heeding to Saxena’s call, she takes over the gathered people’s consciousness one by one to communicate. The cobra’s lust for revenge is dampened upon listening to Angoori’s advice and she forgives Vibhuti. Back home after this adventure, Angoori and Tiwari indulge in some light-hearted moments. Meanwhile, Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan’s preparations to sing at a birthday party go to waste.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Tall Claims Backfire At Him
videos.overview: While cooking lunch, Angoori sings a romantic song. Vibhuti joins her and finds the weather romantic. On enquired by Vibhuti, a shy Angoori describes her first crush on a motorcyclist who had performed in the well of death 13 years ago. Blushing, Vibhuti confirms it was him. Angoori praises Vibhuti's daredevil stunts, making Tiwari jealous. Prem and Tiwari organize a fair and in the well of death, invite Vibhuti to perform. Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan get beaten up by Happu for insulting him.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Attempt to Escape Manmohan's Challenge
videos.overview: Stuck in a situation of his own making, Vibhuti convinces Prem not to organize the fair in which he has to be the daredevil motorbike rider. Vibhuti and Prem go to Tiwari's house to tell him the decision. When Tiwari tells them he has a sponsor who is willing to invest, a greedy Prem agrees. Elsewhere, Happu beats Tikka, Tillu, and Malkhan everytime he sees Commissioner Resham Pal trying to impress him. Vibhuti, with a plaster on his leg, tells Angoori that he fractured his leg during practice.

videos.title: Episode 1025
Vibhuti Asks Saxena to Perform The Stunt
videos.overview: Happu Singh’s trick of instigating Anu against Vibhuti fails. Vibhuti, who is scheduled to ride a motorcycle in the well of death is terrified of the prospect. When Saxena tells him of having ridden a motorcycle in the well of death in the past, Vibhuti gets an idea. He convinces Saxena to perform the stunt instead by wearing a helmet to be unrecognisable. Meanwhile, Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan’s schemes result in Happu Singh’s suspension. They also take revenge upon Happu Singh in the fair.

videos.title: Manmohan Exposes Vibhuti's Lies
videos.overview: At the fair, a large crowd gathers excitedly to watch Vibhuti perform in the well of death. Vibhuti gives Angoori the credit for being his inspiration. Saxena secretly substitutes for Vibhuti and puts up an excellent show. However, Tiwari realises the trick and exposes Vibhuti. The crowd, too, gets shocked to see Saxena emerge from the well of death. Vibhuti pleads with Angoori to not be upset with him just like Anita. Feeling sorry, Angoori and Tiwari go to Anita's house and resolve the issue.

videos.title: Vibhuti Becomes a Psychiatrist
videos.overview: Anurag and his wife drop in at Vibhuti's place, complaining about the fight that led to Anita spending the night at their house. Vibhuti gets his Degree of Psychology and tells Angoori to call him as Doctor Vibhuti, the Psychiatrist. Saxena opts to be his compounder. Angoori tells Happu and Tiwari about Vibhuti becoming a psychiatrist. Happu is insulted by Gulfam for not being manly enough. Teeka is advised to visit a psychiatrist for being rejected in love.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Plan Impresses Teeka
videos.overview: The inauguration of ‘Doctor Vibhuti Narayan Clinic’ is well attended. Tillu, Malkhan and Teeka are Vibhuti's first patients. He asks one of them to be disguised as a woman, while the other two hit on him. Tillu, in the guise of a woman, romances Teeka. Teeka's love interest is impressed and tells him that she loves him. Vibhuti's plan works and they promote Vibhuti as the psychiatrist with mouth-to-mouth advertisement. Happu is convinced when he sees Teeka romancing a beautiful girl.

videos.title: Vibhuti Advises Angoori to Beat Manmohan
videos.overview: At night, Angoori's plan to romance Tiwari fails as he is not in any mood. Seeing Angoori depressed, Vibhuti invites her to his clinic. Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan promote Vibhuti. At the clinic, Angoori tells Vibhuti that she thinks Tiwari does not love her anymore. He tells her that variety is the spice of life. He advises her to beat Tiwari as he is suffering from an overdose of love to bring a change in their monotonous lifestyle. Saxena manages the big queue of patients outside Vibhuti's well.

videos.title: Puttan and Gulfam Add to Happu's Troubles
videos.overview: Seeing the long queue outside Vibhuti's clinic, Angoori too promotes Vibhuti. To bring out Tiwari's internal pain, Angoori applies dough on his face on Vibhuti’s instructions and later, she whips him. Puttan and Gulfam hoodwink Happu again by making him try to break a wall with his head. Happu tries to Gatecrash the queue to Vibhuti's clinic. Saxena teaches him a lesson on discipline by making him stand last. He keeps standing even when Vibhuti announces that the clinic is shut.

videos.title: Vibhuti Enjoys Troubling Manmohan
videos.overview: Tiwari goes to Vibhuti for Angoori’s treatment and he suggests that Tiwari should pretend to like Angoori’s beatings. Later, Angoori is happy to see Tiwari enjoying it and feels that he is cured. Meanwhile, Happu pleads for another round, and Puttan and Gulfam trick him into eating red chili powder. When the Principal watches Vibhuti’s interview on TV, he and Natwar realise that they goofed up and the degree has gone to the wrong Vibhuti Narayan Mishra.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Lies Come to The Fore
videos.overview: Vibhuti becomes a celebrity after his television interview. The people in his colony felicitate him. Vibhuti is elated with the praises but discourages the people from speaking after being insulted. The principal arrives at the event and discloses that Vibhuti is no psychiatrist. Tiwari gets angry with Angoori for thrashing him. Malkhan, Tillu, and Tikka lose their girlfriends. Meanwhile, Tiwari plans to take Angoori to visit the Taj Mahal. Ammaji tells them not to celebrate Valentine's day.

videos.title: Vibhuti Tries to Spend Valentine's Day With Angoori
videos.overview: Hearing Angoori's plight about not being able to celebrate Valentine's day with Tiwari, Vibhuti tries to attract her to spend it with him. Vibhuti refuses to give Tiwari Anita's new phone number. Teeka, Tillu, and Malkhan want to spend Valentine's with Gulfam but escape on seeing her down with a viral infection. Saxena meets the trio in the disco disguised as Teena. Tiwari manages to get Anita's number by getting Vibhuti drunk. Teena asks Teeka to keep their Valentine date confidential.

videos.title: Manmohan's Return Foils Vibhuti's Plans
videos.overview: On Valentine's day, Tiwari goes to meet Anita with the intention of spending the day with her. Meanwhile, Vibhuti invites Angoori to his house to recite some verses from a well know Baba. Teena continues with her dating spree. Tiwari reaches Lakhimpur Khiri, only to find that Anu is away. Teeka, Tillu, and Malkhan reach the disco but are embarrassed when they find out Teena's truth. Tiwari returns amidst Vibhuti's love recitation and proposes his love to Angoori, bursting Vibhuti's bubble.

videos.title: Saxena Slaps Everyone Leaving Them Shocked
videos.overview: Saxena interrupts Vibhuti and Angoori and informs them about his migration to America. Having kept tabs on all the slaps he has received, Saxena decides to return them before he leaves and starts by slapping Vibhuti. He repeats the same with Tiwari. Thinking Saxena is going to return the money he owes them, Teeka, Tillu, and Malkhan are shocked when they get slapped too. Later, they emotionally blackmail Saxena from leaving Kanpur to make him unable to deliver the rest of the slaps.

videos.title: Manmohan Refuses to Let Angoori Act In Films
videos.overview: Tiwari finds Angoori watching c-grade movies. When she tells him about her desire to act in films, he mocks her pronunciation. Anu falls and sprains her ankle. She blames Vibhuti. Harry Chaddha, a Punjabi film director, who had seen Angoori act, comes to her house with Saxena. He wants to sign Angoori for a film. Tiwari refuses and an upset Angoori throws utensils in the kitchen to vent her anger. Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan help a constipated stranger pass motions at the back of a motorcycle.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Plan to Act Opposite Angoori Fails
videos.overview: Tiwari's rejection to let Angoori act in movies gives Vibhuti an opportunity to instigate her against Tiwari. Teeka's help to the stranger makes him a film producer as the man turns out to be a film financer. Vibhuti makes Angoori call Ammaji to complain about Tiwari. Ammaji assures Angoori that she will make Tiwari consent to her acting. Tiwari's decision is overruled by Ammaji. Harry Chaddha rejects Vibhuti's plea to make him the hero. Both, Vibhuti and Tiwari are left red-faced and insulted.

videos.title: Harry Chaddha Shoots In Manmohan's House
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti discuss Angoori's co-actor, Vikram Bhalla, who is considered to be a womaniser. Tiwari offers Vibhuti the job of Angoori's bodyguard. Teeka insults Tillu and Malkhan, and throws them out of his office. Happu meets Teeka to get a role in his film. He is made to dance for his audition. Vibhuti convinces Tiwari to let Harry Chaddha shoot in his house. Shoot begins at Tiwari's house the next day. When the scene is narrated and improvised by Harry, Vibhuti objects by screaming no.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Happu's Woes Continue
videos.overview: Bhalla and Chaddha force to hug Angoori on the name of film's script, but Vibhuti and Tiwari oppose it. Malkhan gets a gift for Teeka, but he crushes it, making him and Tillu leave in an insulting manner. Later, Happu visits Teeka for an actor's role, but he gets Happu injured. An anxious Anita calls Vibhuti for hot water. She gets even more irritated as he requests her to calm down. After he leaves to get water again, she realises she's getting cranky and there's a need for her to tone down.

videos.title: Manmohan Gets Harry Chaddha Arrested
videos.overview: Tiwari tries to romance Angoori while she is practising for her shoot. Vibhuti comes in between and she leaves the room. An injured Happu narrates his accident to Malkhan and Tillu over a drink. Prem informs Vibhuti about Bhalla being a womaniser. Tiwari and Vibhuti try lodging a police complaint but nothing works. Malkhan's father throws him out assuming him to be a jinx for the business. Tiwari gets Bhalla arrested for sexually exploiting his colleagues and Chaddha for being his helping hand.

videos.title: Manmohan and Angoori Romance In The Open
videos.overview: Teeka romances Badami, who is supposedly Gulfam's sister. Angoori, on seeing them together, makes a noise. Everybody gathers and Teeka gets caned by Masterjee. Ammaji tells Tiwari that if he romances Angoori in the open, they will be blessed with a baby. The same night, while sharing a couple of drinks, Vibhuti and Prem praise Angoori's dignified behaviour. Just then, they see Tiwari and Angoori romancing in the open. Meanwhile, others too watch them openly romancing and are perplexed

videos.title: Manmohan and Angoori's Romance Enrages Vibhuti
videos.overview: Owing to a superstition, Ammaji suggests Angoori to romance Tiwari at a police station in presence of a senior police officer. Happu and his senior witness this, but they let go of it. They keep romancing in public, which gets Vibhuti upset. He throws Prem out of his house and then slaps Tillu after seeing him with Badami. Tika and Malkhan suggest Tillu forgive Vibhuti. A sheepish Angoori decides to romance Tiwari in presence of Vibhuti. She calls him with the excuse of apologising in person.

videos.title: Anita Decides to Leave Vibhuti
videos.overview: Vibhuti visits Tiwari and Angoori but they irritate him again by romancing in his presence. While returning, he slaps Tillu, Teeka and Malkhan on being asked for the treat he had promised them. Anu decides to leave Vibhuti after a dispute, but Tiwari convinces her to stay back. Happu plays a prank on Vibhuti to show him Tiwari's romance again, following which Vibhuti tries running away. Prem accidentally hits Vibhuti with his bike. He then rushes him to a doctor and pays the medical bills.

videos.title: Vibhuti Falls Prey to Manmohan and Angoori's Prank
videos.overview: Saxena tends to Vibhuti’s sprain. Tiwari makes Angoori call Vibhuti again for dinner at their home, which he falls prey to. Tillu, Malkhan and Teeka decide to make Vibhuti apologise to them or they'll pay him the slaps back. An excited Vibhuti promises them a treat after returning from Tiwari's house. The couple again romances in Vibhuti’s presence and he comes back fuming. He hits Tillu, Malkhan and Teeka again who plan to give it back, but Tiwari couple stops them after Ammaji's phone call.

videos.title: Saxena Puts His Prank In Action
videos.overview: Seeing Tiwari, Vibhuti, Tillu, Teeka, and Malkhan boasting about their bravery, Saxena starts a prank. While roaming around the town, Tillu, Teeka, and Malkhan find a bag of money. Saxena calls them as a stranger and bluffs of planting a bomb in it. A scared Tillu hands it over to Tiwari. The bag then goes to Vibhuti and returns to the boy gang after going to Prem. The fun keeps growing as each of them fears for their life. Angoori and Tiwari announce about the show 'Happu Ki Ultan Paltan'.

videos.title: Angoori Dances to Vibhuti's Tunes
videos.overview: Vibhuti visits Angoori, while a Dafli-wala, tambourine seller, passes by playing the ‘dafli’. This makes her dance and she leaves due to being shy. Anu gets a medical advice to take rest, which Vibhuti doesn’t take well. Vibhuti hideously plays a ‘dafli’ at Tiwari's door, which makes Angoori throw a dish at Tiwari's face. Tillu, Teeka and Malkhan ask money for a job application, but Happu and Tiwari reject their proposal. They try stealing money from Master Ji's house and get a caning for it.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Negligence Injures Anita
videos.overview: Anu cries in pain as her leg sprains on the wet floor due to Vibuti's negligence. Tiwari gets thrown out by Vibhuti when he makes fun of him while empathizing with Anu. Tillu, Malkhan and Teeka steal money from Tiwari's locker. When Vibhuti plays the 'Dafli', it makes Angoori dance in her sleep. This gets Tiwari scared. Vibhuti repeats it the next morning, making Angoori drop all the eatables on Happu. Tillu, Malkhan, and Teeka bribe Happu with the stolen money for getting them jobs as cops.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Act Adds to Manmohan's Envy
videos.overview: Angoori dances to the tunes of Vibhuti's 'dafli', a musical instrument. Tiwari comes out of the house and yells at them. Angoori expresses her addiction to the sound of Dafli. Tiwari approaches Saxena for learning to play Dafli. A jealous Tiwari tries playing Dafli for Angoori, but in vain. Tillu, Malkhan, and Teeka do Happu's odd jobs for getting recruited as cops. Vibhuti takes Bhoorey Lal out with him for a drink. Badami visits Happu at the Police Station and makes fun of the trio.

videos.title: Manmohan is Beaten Up By Saxena
videos.overview: Vibhuti informs Dadoo about making Angoori dance to his tambourine's tunes. He narrates how Angoori has had an addiction for tambourine since her childhood to an extent that it could be harmful. Saxena Ji shows up there and grabs Tiwari by the collar and takes him. He hits Tiwari with his belt for not practising tambourine. Later, Angoori starts forcing him a number of times. In the evening, while Tillu, Malkhan and Teeka enjoy their drinks, Happu directs them for more odd jobs at his house.

videos.title: Angoori's Past Returns to Trouble Her
videos.overview: Angoori threatens Vibhuti with a knife and makes him play the Dafli. Scared, Vibhuti and Tiwari run inside a room to hide from her, but Saxena Ji sneaks in from the window and makes Tiwari play the Dafli. The next morning, Bhoorey explains how Angoori got mentally disturbed due to a childhood incident. Bhoorey, Vibhuti and Tiwari come up with an idea to get rid of the problem. Tiwari gets fruits for an injured Anita. Tillu, Malkhan and Teeka threaten Happu to get their bribe money back.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Spooky Encounter
videos.overview: Tiwari gives a parcel to Vibhuti for delivering it to Dumargarh. Saxena and Dr Gupta test their invention that was designed for tracking ghosts. Anita's friend Minal and her husband Anurag invite Anita to be the captain of a football team. On the way, Vibhuti meets a Travelling Ticket Examiner's ghost at Gunnour Railway Station. Angoori tells Tiwari about the TTE whom Bhoorey had earlier chosen to be her groom. At night, Ammaji visits Tiwari and informs him about the problem she is anticipating.

videos.title: Vibhuti Gets Possessed By Anoop's Spirit
videos.overview: Ammaji suggests a way out of the problem foreseen by Pundit Ramphal. She guides Angoori to prepare 'kheer', a sweet dish, and serve it to a corrupt man and a popular courtesan. Vibhuti gets possessed by the TTE's ghost. Unaware of this, Angoori feels puzzled after talking to the TTE's ghost in Vibhuti's body. Tiwari invites Happu and Gulfam to have 'kheer'. However, while talking to Ammaji on call, Angoori blurts out about Happu and Gulfam's character, which makes them leave in anger.

videos.title: A Possessed Vibhuti Troubles Everyone
videos.overview: Angoori informs Ammaji about a possessed Vibhuti attacking Tiwari. They deduce it as the difficulty Pundit Ramphal had foreseen. Ammaji suggests a similar resolution again. The TTE's ghost in Vibhuti's body refers to himself as Anoop Upadhyay. He punishes Tillu, Teeka, and Malkhan for their previous ticketless journeys. Tiwari and Saxena discuss Vibhuti's behaviour. Gulfam and Happu accept Tiwari's invite for a sweet dish. Angoori happily serves it but unknowingly offends them again.

videos.title: Vibhuti Threatens to Kill Manmohan and Marry Angoori
videos.overview: Possessed by Anoop's ghost, Vibhuti intervenes Tiwari and Angoori's romance. He then warns them of marrying Angoori after killing Tiwari. The next morning, Bhoorey confirms that Anoop was in love with Angoori and he committed suicide after Angoori got married to Tiwari. Bhoorey tries talking to Anoop, but in vain. Later, Saxena suggests a plan to rescue them. Anoop manages to get inside the police cell by ill-treating Resham Pal. He then thrashes Tillu, Teeka and Malkhan for their mistakes.

videos.title: Angoori Confronts Anoop's Spirit
videos.overview: As per their plan, Saxena and Dr. Gupta convince Anoop to meet Angoori at Gunnour Railway Station. As agreed, Saxena, Dr. Gupta, Tiwari, Angoori and Vibhuti visit the place. They invocate Anoop's ghost to enter Vibhuti's body. A possessed Vibhuti threatens to kill everyone and marry Angoori. However, her confrontation makes him realise his mistake. To avoid further thrashing, Tillu, Teeka and Malkhan submit the railway tickets to Vibhuti. Laddoo plays a prank on Master Ji to skip studies.

videos.title: Vibhuti Accepts an Embarrasing Job Offer
videos.overview: Vibhuti tends to a sprain in Prem's leg, which gives Prem an idea. Prem offers Vibhuti to work at his Chinese Massage Centre as a Chinese female masseur, Chuki. Later, Tiwari taunts Vibhuti about Anita going to Lakhimpur Kheri due to his unemployment. A shamefaced Vibhuti accepts Prem's job offer, and Saxena joins them as an Assistant Chinese female masseur, Luki. Prem and Saxena announce the opening of the massage centre. Out of eagerness, Tillu, Teeka and Malkhan go there as customers.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Saxena Plan to Thrash Manmohan
videos.overview: Dr. Gupta observes Tiwari's pain and suggests he visit a masseur. Later, Vibhuti suggests he visit Prem's Chinese Massage Centre. In the name of massage, Vibhuti as Suki, thrashes Teeka. Saxena as Luki does the same to Malkhan. Tillu, Teeka and Malkhan's greed for massage makes them rob Master Ji. Tiwari and Angoori visit the massage centre. While Angoori waits at the reception for Tiwari, she meets Tillu, Teeka and Malkhan there. Suki and Luki begin with their plan to trounce Tiwari.

videos.title: Angoori's Decision Leaves Vibhuti Restless
videos.overview: Suki pretends to be in a compromising position with Tiwari, while Luki clicks their pictures. Seeing Tiwari relieved of his pains, Angoori decides to go to Suki for a massage. This makes Vibhuti restless. The next day, Master Ji lodges a police complaint about a robbery. Initially reluctant, Happu finally lodges the complaint after receiving a threat from Master Ji. Tillu, Teeka and Malkhan take advantage of the situation and rob them, and use the money for paying off their massage bills.

videos.title: Saxena and Vibhuti Reveal The Truth to Angoori
videos.overview: Tiwari wants to get rid of Suki who always tries to hang out with him. Angoori gets angry with Tiwari for letting Suki kiss him. Vibhuti tells Angoori he heard rumors of Tiwari's affair with Suki. Devastated, Angoori wants to divorce Tiwari. Scared of getting arrested by Happu on Angoori's complaint, Vibhuti and Saxena reveal themselves as masseurs Suki and Luki. Inspired by the Chinese episode in her life, Angoori dresses like one and decides to give Tiwari a Chinese massage.

videos.title: Vibhuti Concocts a Plan
videos.overview: Vibhuti overhears Angoori telling Tiwari that she has ordered a special; but very expensive saree for herself, which Tiwari refuses to buy. Teeka, Tillu, and Malkhan ask Saxena to lend them INR 3000 to pay their house rent, whereas, Vibhuti comes up with a plan. When Teeka and Malkan disguise themselves as dacoits and pretend to plan to kill Tiwari; they end up knifing Tillu instead. It is then revealed that this was a plot to extort money from Tiwari. However, Tiwari overhears the plan.

videos.title: Ammaji's Advice to Manmohan
videos.overview: Tiwari scolds Tillu after calculating the losses he has been incurring in his business. Ammaji calls Angoori and suggests Tiwari visit Vastu Shastri Jugnu Kumar for a solution to his financial issues. Meanwhile, Vibhuti borrows Prem's scooter to visit Lakhimpur Kheri. On the way, an incident makes him meet Jugnu and his caretaker Jugni. When Vibhuti joins Jugnu as his enthusiast and partner, Tiwari senses an opportunity in it. Later, Tillu, Teeka, and Malkhan drool over Boondi, a street hawker.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Bizarre Suggestions to Manmohan
videos.overview: Vibhuti, along with a paralysed Jugnu and the caretaker Jugni, visits Tiwari. Vibhuti provides a solution for Tiwari's financial issues using Vastu Shastra, a traditional Hindu architecture system. He charges Tiwari five times the actual fee and suggests bizarre changes to his home. When Vibhuti does the same to Tillu, Teeka, and Malkhan, their situation deteriorates to the point where they are compelled to defecate in the open. Happu stops the trio while doing this and suggests a better place.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Suggestions Put Everyone In Trouble
videos.overview: Due to change in home's architecture, Tiwari conducts a meeting in his bathroom which leads to losing the client. Vibhuti's Vastu Shastra methods enforce Tiwari and many other people to defecate in the open. Happu takes them all to the police station and asks for a bribe to use the toilet there. Tillu, Teeka, and Malkhan propose Boondi for marriage, but the revelation of her spouse puts them in a fix. Adding to it, Resham Pal gets the trio arrested for defecating in the police station.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Tillu Con Manmohan
videos.overview: Resham Pal gets Tiwari and the other colony residents arrested for defecating in the police station. After a lot of to-and-fro over this crime, the accused, Happu, and Resham Pal conclude Vibhuti to be the core issue. They confront Vibhuti for fooling people in the name of 'Vastu Shastra.' In this hodgepodge, Jugnu's paralysis gets cured. In the evening, a fuming Tillu demands from Tiwari his delayed salary. Later, Vibhuti partners with Tillu and they fake Tillu's death to con Tiwari.

videos.title: Angoori Confesses Everything to Happu
videos.overview: Taking advantage of Tiwari's panicking, Vibhuti asks him to go home and then pays Tillu to stay hidden for a while. Later, Teeka and Malkhan interrogate Tiwari, but out of nervousness, he throws them out of the house. However, Angoori confesses to Happu about Tiwari's accident with Tillu and Vibhuti helping him. Meanwhile, Saxena reveals to Teeka and Malkhan about Tiwari and Vibhuti killing Tillu. The situation gets even amusing when all meet at the same place to locate Tillu's buried corpse.

videos.title: Vibhuti is Cursed By an Ascetic
videos.overview: Angoori receives a scratch card on purchasing a pack of soap. Calling himself lucky, Vibhuti scratches the card and wins the first prize which turns out to be a cheap glass replica of the Taj Mahal. When the gift breaks down as soon as Tiwari enters, Vibhuti calls him unlucky. Later, Vibhuti insults an ascetic for spitting on the road, who curses him into bringing bad luck everywhere he goes. Meanwhile, Resham Pal orders Happu to arrest Bittu, the thief who picks his pocket every morning.

videos.title: A Cursed Vibhuti Asks Angoori to Get Help From Pandit Ramphal
videos.overview: One after the other, a cursed Vibhuti's presence keeps harming everyone around him. He then asks Angoori to request Ammaji to get help for him from Pandit Ramphal.

videos.title: A Meeting is Held At Tiwari's to Resolve Vibhuti's Curse’s Issue
videos.overview: Depressed by the curse, Vibhuti plans to stay away from humanity and live in the jungle or kill himself. Meanwhile, a meeting is held to resolve the issue at Tiwari's house.

videos.title: Angoori Steals a Few Mangoes Which Land Vibhuti Into Trouble
videos.overview: As a remembrance of her childhood, Angoori steals mangoes while Teeka, Tillu, and Malkhan loot Tiwari. Seeing the mangoes and money in Vibhuti's hands, the locals beat him up.

videos.title: Tiwari Suggest Wearing Blindfolds to Avoid a Cursed Vibhuti
videos.overview: When a cursed Vibhuti becomes a trouble for the colony residents, Tiwari suggests them to wear blindfolds as a precaution. Finally, the ascetic brings peace by forgiving Vibhuti.

videos.title: Reading Laila Majnu's Love Story Makes Vibhuti Hallucinate Tiwari As Laila
videos.overview: Vibhuti takes a book on Laila Majnu's love story from Saxena. A long strenuous reading makes Vibhuti hallucinate himself as Majnu and Tiwari as his Laila, which scares the latter.

videos.title: Saxena Explains Why Vibhuti is Visualizing Tiwari As Laila
videos.overview: Saxena explains it to Teeka, Malkhan and Angoori why Vibhuti is hallucinating Tiwari as Laila. Vibhuti later ties anklets on Tiwari's legs which shocks him the next morning.

videos.title: The Colony Residents Protest Against Vibhuti For Kissing Tiwari
videos.overview: Vibhuti kisses Tiwari imagining him as Laila. Angoori and Tiwari's police complaint makes Happu try and change Vibhuti's mind. The colony residents later protest against Vibhuti.

videos.title: Angoori and Tiwari Follow Saxena's Plan to Break Vibhuti's Hallucination
videos.overview: Saxena suggests a plan to break Vibhuti's hallucination. Angoori and Tiwari follow it, leading Vibhuti to get normal. Upset with Teeka and Malkhan's negligence, Tiwari fires them.

videos.title: Saxena's New Prank Scares The Men Of The Colony
videos.overview: Saxena informs Tiwari and Vibhuti about a woman attacking people of the town. Their boasting makes him come up with a prank. One after another, he scares all the men of the colony.

videos.title: Tiwari Urges Vibhuti to Pretend As Angoori's Husband
videos.overview: Bhoorey apprises Angoori of lying to his brother-in-law, Bhimji, who'll soon visit her for a short stay. To help Bhoorey in this, Tiwari requests Vibhuti to pretend as her husband.

videos.title: Tillu Knows About Bhimji Taking Vibhuti For Tiwari and Tiwari For Gaddu
videos.overview: Bhimiji visits Angoori wherein Vibhuti pretends to be Tiwari and Tiwari pretends to be Gaddu, a house help. Tillu warns Tiwari of telling on him. Saxena comes up with a new prank.

videos.title: Bhimji Tries to Get Nazuk Married Off to Tiwari
videos.overview: Bhimji decides to get Gaddu married to his daughter, Nazuk. Tillu, Teeka and Malkhan try exposing Vibhuti's lie, but their bold statements on Resham Pal land them up in prison.

videos.title: Angoori Reveals The Truth
videos.overview: Nazuk agrees to get married to Tiwari. After hearing this, Angoori loses her patience and reveals the truth. Later, Angoori demands a nose ring, but Tiwari's rejection upsets her.

videos.title: Vibhuti Gifts a Nose Ring to Angoori
videos.overview: David gives a nose ring to Vibhuti, who gifts it to Angoori. David later wants it back which makes Vibhuti offend Angoori. Vibhuti takes it back, but David changes his mind again.

videos.title: Angoori Decides to Start Studying Again
videos.overview: Angoori decides to start studying again. Though Tiwari opposes it, Ammaji and Vibhuti support her. Malkhan and Prem plan to call a rich man's spirit as they yearn for his wealth.

videos.title: Angoori Gets Admitted to The School
videos.overview: Tiwari fails Masterji's test but Angoori fares well and gets admitted to the school. With Dr. Gupta's help, Saxena fools Teeka and Malkhan of conjuring up a wealthy man's spirit.

videos.title: Saxena Dupes Teeka and Malkhan
videos.overview: Masterji escorts Angoori and Vibuti to their classroom on the first day in school. Saxena pretends being possessed and dupes Teeka and Malkhan into looting Resham Pal.

videos.title: Saxena Makes Teeka and Malkhan Frame Happu
videos.overview: Tiwari feels worked up finishing Angoori and Vibhuti's homework. Elsewhere, a pretentious Saxena makes Teeka and Malkhan frame Happu of being the man behind looting Resham Pal.

videos.title: Vibhuti Convinces Angoori to Quit School
videos.overview: Masterji expels Vibhuti from school for bunking classes and making Angoori do the same. Vibhuti later convinces Angoori to quit her studies. Happu forgives Saxena as a punishment.

videos.title: Raziya Gulkandi Agrees to Train Angoori
videos.overview: Angoori expresses her desire to learn a folk dance. Vibhuti meets a dance trainer Raziya Gulkandi and requests him to train her. Gulkandi's criticism makes Gulfam restrain from performing until she betters her skills.

videos.title: Tiwari Complains About Gulkandi's Dance Classes
videos.overview: Gulkandi suggests Gulfam, Angoori, Vibhhuti, Tillu, Teeka, and Malkhan practice winking as their first lesson in learning folk dance. Irritated by this, Tiwari informs Happu about it. Happu tries stopping Gulkandi but Prem barges in.

videos.title: Resham Pal Arrests Gulkandi For Routine Enquiry
videos.overview: Tiwari feels irritated at Happu falling head over heels for Gulkandi's bribe. Tiwari then escalates his issues to Resham Pal who visits Gulkandi and takes him to the police station for routine enquiry.

videos.title: Gulkandi Introduces His Disciples to a Human Trafficker
videos.overview: Resham Pal releases Gulkandi and becomes his disciple. A furious Tiwari later sees a nightmare about Vibhuti. Gulkandi introduces all his disciples to Shaikh, a human trafficker who tricks all into flying to Dubai for a show.

videos.title: Tiwari Takes Happu's Help to Get Gulkandi Arrested
videos.overview: Tiwari records Gulkandi and Shaikh's conversations, following which he takes Happu along to arrest them. As Tiwari refuses to pay Tillu's wages, Tillu, Teeka, and Malkhan have to do odd jobs at Gulfam's house to pay off their debts.

videos.title: Vibhuti, Teeka, and Malkhan Join Saxena In His 'save Water' Movement
videos.overview: Angoori and Tiwari fight over a marcher Dadduji's motives. To impress her, Vibhuti joins Saxena in his 'save water' movement and even convinces Teeka and Malkhan to join them. Meanwhile, Tiwari visits Happu to lodge a fake complaint.

videos.title: Vibhuti Quits Using Water
videos.overview: Vibhuti and Saxena initiate their 'save water' movement. Happu and Tiwari attempt to stop them but Teeka and Malkhan try using their muscle power. Vibhuti's team decides to quit using water and Tiwari tries all his methods to trouble them.

videos.title: Prem and Master Ji Convince Daddu Ji to Support Vibhuti
videos.overview: Vibhuti, Teeka, and Malkhan struggle to live without water while Saxena enjoys filming them. Tiwari keeps tempting them with his numerous antics. Prem and Master Ji visit Daddu Ji to convince him to support Vibhuti's movement.

videos.title: Daddu Meets Vibhuti, Teeka, and Malkhan
videos.overview: Daddu, a local celebrity who has also given up water, visits Modern Colony to meet Vibhuti, Teeka, and Malkhan. He also reveals his real reason for giving up water to Vibhuti. Vibhuti then considers calling off the movement.

videos.title: Tiwari Succeeds In Ending Vibhuti's 'save Water Movement'
videos.overview: Tiwari succeeds in ending Vibhuti's 'save water movement'. Prem offers to send Vibhuti to Canada for a stewards' job. Vibhuti overhears Angoori appealing to Tiwari to get him a job in Kanpur and is elated that she wants him around.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Angoori Meet With an Accident
videos.overview: Amma Ji requests Angoori to visit Baba Hadbadanand to seek his blessings so as to soon be blessed with a child. As Tiwari is busy, Vibhuti volunteers to take Angoori to meet the sage. While on their way, the two meet with an accident.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Angoori's Souls Get Swapped
videos.overview: Baba Hadbadanand brings Vibhuti and Angoori back to life by summoning their souls. However, their souls get swapped with each other. Seeing Angoori's soul in Vibhuti's body puts Tiwari in an awkward situation.

videos.title: Tiwari Explains The Soul Swapping Incident to Amma Ji
videos.overview: Amma Ji is utterly confused seeing Angoori's soul in Vibhuti's body and vice-versa. Tiwari then goes on to explain what led to the soul swapping. He awkwardly avoids Angoori's advances.

videos.title: Baba Hadbadanand Suggests Tiwari to Revisit Him For a Resolution
videos.overview: Tiwari visits Baba Hadbadanand to find a resolution for the soul swapping but he asks him to revisit on the coming eclipse. On learning about this from Tiwari, Bhoorey feels unsettled. Resham Pal threatens Happu to help Master Ji get his remuneration.

videos.title: Baba Hadbadanand Swaps Vibhuti and Angoori's Souls
videos.overview: Tiwari plans to celebrate Angoori's birthday and invites the colony's residents to the party. After the party, Baba Hadbadanand swaps the souls, and everything gets normal. Later, Master Ji decides to forcefully demand the amount Vibhuti had borrowed.

videos.title: Episode 1102
Tiwari and Vibhuti Stand Against Each Other Due to Naganmohan and Dhoti
videos.overview: Naganmohan Tiwari and Dhoti Mishra face each other and their outburst leads to a tussle between Tiwari and Vibhuti. Meanwhile, Tillu and Teeka fall for the same girl and fight over winning her heart. Tiwari and Vibhuti decide to use them as pawns.

videos.title: Tiwari's Cousin Lalli and Vibhuti's Cousin Hariya Return From Australia
videos.overview: Tillu and Teeka fool Vibhuti and Tiwari into visiting Gulfam in the name of maintaining a top-notch lifestyle. The next morning, Tiwari's cousin Lalli and Vibhuti's cousin Hariya arrive at Kanpur after a long stay in Australia.

videos.title: Episode 1105
Episode 1106
Ammaji Advises Angoori to Go On a Cruise
videos.overview: Ammaji suggests Angoori to go on a cruise to celebrate her wedding anniversary. Elsewhere, a tantric warns Vibhuti about his death if Angoori gets pregnant during the cruise. Prem helps procure jobs for Tillu, Teeka, and Malkhan on the cruise.

videos.title: Angoori, Tiwari, Tillu, Teeka, and Malkhan Go On The Jalesh Cruise
videos.overview: Tillu, Teeka, and Malkhan go on the cruise as employees but Captain Kohli's explanation about their remuneration dispirits them. Vibhuti attempts to stop Angoori and Tiwari, but in vain. Later, Angoori and Tiwari finally board the cruise.

videos.title: The Residents Of Modern Colony Meet Two Lookalikes Of Pellu
videos.overview: All the residents of Modern Colony meet each other on the cruise and are surprised to see Pellu's lookalike. Meanwhile, Saxena meets another lookalike of Pellu at the casino when he starts playing with a popular gambler named Khanna.

videos.title: Vibhuti Uses Gulfam to Keep Tiwari Away From Angoori
videos.overview: To keep Tiwari away from Angoori, Vibhuti poses as a criminal named Luca Brasi and keeps harassing Gulfam. Vibhuti later meets Gulfam as himself and suggests her to pretend to be Tiwari's wife, and to stay close to Tiwari to be safe from Luca.

videos.title: Vibhuti Stops Angoori From Jumping Off The Cruise
videos.overview: Angoori tries to jump off the cruise, but Vibhuti stops her. He reveals to her and Tiwari about helping Gulfam. Meanwhile, Ammaji informs Angoori over a phone call to stay away from Tiwari. Later, all Modern Colony residents return home.

videos.title: Tiwari Makes a Fool Out Of Vibhuti In The Name Of Salman Khan
videos.overview: Minal visits Anita and offers a job to Vibhuti on a condition that he has to get Salman Khan's interview. Tiwari overhears this and fools Vibhuti into doing odd jobs for him. Vibhuti promises Teeku, Tillu, and Malkhan to get a selfie with Salman Khan.

videos.title: Vibhuti Takes Teeku, Tillu, and Malkhan to Meet Salman Khan
videos.overview: Vibhuti takes Teeku, Tillu, and Malkhan with him to the film studio for an interview with Salman Khan. On learning that Salman is not an acquaintance of Tiwari, Vibhuti doesn't lose hope and tries his best to meet Salman Khan and Katrina Kaif.

videos.title: Two Popular Couples Of Modern Colony Get Upset With Their Married Life
videos.overview: An excited Vibhuti meets Minal to hand over the interview footage. Later, Vibhuti-Anita and Tiwari-Angoori keep disputing over their boring married life. Elsewhere, Gulfam passes demeaning comments on Tillu, Teeka and Malkhan.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Keep Getting Into Arguments With Their Wives
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti share their despair with each other and decide to meet over a dinner, which turns into a skirmish over their married life. Tillu, Teeka and Malkhan approach a tantric to make Gulfam fall in love with them.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Tiwari Decide to Stay Away From Anita and Angoori
videos.overview: Minal suggests Angoori and Anita to see the marriage counsellor, Dr. Santusht Verma. As per the counselling, Vibhuti and Tiwari move out of their homes to stay away from their wives for a week. Gulfam insults Tillu, Teeka and Malkhan yet again.

videos.title: Angoori and Anita Enjoy Their Leisure Time At Home
videos.overview: Vibhuti moves to stay with Tillu, Teeka, and Malkhan while Tiwari moves to stay with Saxena. At home, Angoori and Anita enjoy music and beverages during their time together. Tantric's medicine and Saxena's madness give rise to some unpleasant events.

videos.title: Angoori and Anita Start Missing Their Husbands
videos.overview: Vibhuti visits Angoori and Tiwari visits Anita to check if they can return home. Later, Angoori and Anita start feeling bad due to their husbands' absence. The next morning, Happu tries to talk to Tiwari and Vibhuti but they avoid revealing anything.

videos.title: Angoori Discusses Her Personal Issues With Ammaji
videos.overview: Tiwari's tiredness affects his marital life and Angoori talks to Ammaji about this problem. Elsewhere, Prem ousts one of his business partners, Danny Pathak, which enrages Danny.

videos.title: Angoori Takes Vibhuti to a Hill For a Medicinal Herb
videos.overview: Danny Pathak plots against Prem, while Happu and Resham get misled due to Danny's phone call. As suggested by Ammaji, Angoori takes Vibhuti to a hill for a herb that is supposed to increase Tiwari's vigour and vitality.

videos.title: Vibhuthi and Angoori Cling On to a Rickety Branch
