videos.overview: Vibhuti and Angoori are on the verge of falling down from a cliff and hang on to a rickety branch. Tiwari, Tillu, Teeka, and Malkhan reach out to help. Just when Happu is dragged by the car, they realize that the brakes have gone off

videos.title: The Car's Brake Failure Bothers Tiwari, Tillu, Teeka and Malkhan
videos.overview: Ammaji and Pundit Ramphal reach out to help Angoori and Vibhuti. While Tiwari, Tillu, Teeka and Malkhan struggle to reach faster, their car's brake failure keeps them from it. On seeing Happu stuck behind the car, they remain dumbfounded.

videos.title: Vibhuti Discovers His Royal Lineage
videos.overview: Anita makes fun of Vibhuti while talking to her friend Prince Ranvijay Singh of Babraala. Later, a man reveals that Vibhuti is a royal heir and son of King Hagendra Singh and Queen Babita and his name is Prince Nalendra Pratap of Jhingurpur.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Anita's Changed Behaviour Becomes a Pain For Tiwari
videos.overview: Vibhuti starts behaving like a royal heir which looks appealing to all the Modern Colony residents. Elsewhere, Anita follows Vibhuti's footsteps and while doing so, she teases Tiwari to an extent that he feels insulted.

videos.title: Vibhuti Continues With His Show Off and It Begins to Offend People
videos.overview: Saxena arranges a press conference and Vibhuti uses it to flaunt his newly earned title of a prince. However, Vibhuti offends Tiwari and Prem, who still take him as Vibhuti. Later, Vibhuti visits Angoori to impress her by showing off his money.

videos.title: Maintaining a Lavish Lifestyle Gets Challenging For Vibhuti and Anita
videos.overview: Vibhuti's changed lifestyle exhausts Anita's savings and she fears the upcoming expenses. His demeaning comments on Tiwari and the mass supporting it, makes the latter furious. Later, Vibhuti steals Anita's jewellery to pay for his lavish lifestyle.

videos.title: An Announcement Changes Anita and Vibhuti's Future Plans
videos.overview: Anita gets upset with Vibhuti for stealing her jewellery but he convinces her to join him for his coronation. However, an announcement completely changes their future. Later, Saxena explains how no technicians are willing to help him.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Tiwari Get Hospitalised Due to a Bike Accident
videos.overview: Vibhuti and Tiwari meet with a bike accident and get hospitalised. Ammaji informs Angoori and Anita to stay in a veil for a month as their husbands are jinxed for that period. In the meantime, Prem offers a business plan to Tillu, Teeka, and Malkhan.

videos.title: Angoori and Anita Avoid Showing Their Faces to Tiwari and Vibhuti
videos.overview: As per Ammaji's suggestion, Angoori and Anita refrain from unveiling themselves to anyone except for their husbands. Vibhuti and Tiwari get restless and come up with various schemes. Prem tricks Happu into serving him refreshments from Prem's new shop.

videos.title: Episode 1130
Saxena Tries to Help Vibhuti and Tiwari With Their Restlessness
videos.overview: Vibhuti asks Angoori to show him her face as it's his last dying wish. Tillu, Teeka and Malkhan trick Happu into buying a refreshment drink at a high price. Saxena tries to help Vibhuti and Tiwari with their restlessness.

videos.title: Vibhuti, Tiwari and Happu Struggle With Their Addictions
videos.overview: Saxena administers a shock therapy on Vibhuti and Tiwari to help them get rid of their addictions. While returning home, they meet Ammaji, who offers a solution. Happu's addiction for Prem's refreshments forces him to sell off his wife's jewellery.

videos.title: A Chemical Solution Changes Tillu, Teeka, Malkhan and Angoori's Behaviour
videos.overview: Vibhuti steals a solution from Saxena's secret laboratory to improve Angoori's health and serves it to her. The next morning, Angoori's changed behaviour leaves Vibhuti and Tiwari shocked. Tillu, Teeka and Malkhan act as different people altogether.

videos.title: Saxena Explains Why Angoori is Behaving Like Him
videos.overview: Vibhuti and Tiwari learn from Saxena that Angoori has consumed the solution he had prepared to invent his clone. Malkhan and Teeka behave like husband and wife, while Tillu behaves like their son. Master Ji remains confused experiencing this mess.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Try to Get Angoori Back to Normal
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti go to Dr. Gupta for some medicine to make Angoori normal, but in vain. Tiwari tries to woo Angoori but the Saxena's traits in her make her run away. Tillu, Teeka and Malkhan's strange behaviour with each other puzzles Gulfam.

videos.title: Saxena Serves Angoori a Chemical Solution
videos.overview: Pellu informs Tiwari and Vibhuti about Saxena preparing to turn Angoori into his clone. By the time Vibhuti and Tiwari arrive to stop Saxena, she consumes the chemical solution. Elsewhere, Master Ji scratches his head seeing Tillu, Teeka, and Malkhan.

videos.title: Vibhuti Gets Hit By a Bull
videos.overview: Vibhuti gets hit by a bull and slaps the doctor when he sees a red apple. Ammaji asks Tiwari and Angoori to adopt a young man and get him married to rid Tiwari of the looming danger in his horoscope. Meanwhile, Saxena predicts Teeka’s future.

videos.title: Tiwari and Angoori Adopt Teeka
videos.overview: Angoori talks to Vibhuti to adopt him but he comes up with another option. Meanwhile, Tiwari adopts Teeka and then Happu is called to find a match for Teeka. He somehow manages to find a girl but she lays down a condition for Teeka.

videos.title: A Strange Incident Occurs With Teeka
videos.overview: Vibhuti repeatedly misbehaves with Teeka and repents for it. Master Ji calms Vibhuti but some negative energy makes Vibhuti misbehave with him too. Angoori bars Vibhuti from attending Teeka's wedding. Later, a strange incident happens with Teeka.

videos.title: Tillu and Malkhan Get Assaulted By The Police
videos.overview: Teeka files a police complaint against Tillu and Malkhan for abducting his wife. Vibhuti gets wild and keeps bashing people when he sees them with red-coloured objects. Ammaji suggests Tiwari and Angoori to remarry each other.

videos.title: Happu Joins Tiwari and Angoori In Their Plan
videos.overview: Angoori deduces that red-coloured objects provoke Vibhuti. Tiwari and Angoori take Happu's help in dealing with this situation. Later, Minal and Anurag offer Vibhuti a job that makes him feel heartbroken.

videos.title: Vibhuti Decides to Teach Music to Angoori
videos.overview: Vibhuti refuses to give music lessons to Anita. He later gets to know about Angoori's wish to learn music from a South Indian music teacher, following which he changes his attire and visits her. Saxena invites Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan for dinner.

videos.title: A Meal At Saxena's Place Lands The Trio In Trouble
videos.overview: Tillu, Teeka, and Malkhan rush for medical help due to the non-vegatarian food served by Saxena. Tiwari complains about the music teacher to Anita and she tells him to bring him to her. Resham Pal orders Happu to arrest a South Indian smuggler.

videos.title: Anita Requests The Music Teacher For Lessons
videos.overview: Vibhuti disguises as a South Indian music teacher and meets Tiwari, who takes him to Anita. She requests him for music lessons. Tillu, Teeka and Malkhan once again fall prey to Saxena's prank. Happu arrests Master Ji as he doubts him to be a smuggler.

videos.title: Anita’s Revelation Shocks Tiwari and Vibhuti
videos.overview: After the music teacher is done with teaching Angoori, Anita calls him at her home. Tiwari overhears Anita expressing her feelings to the music teacher. An anguished Tiwari reports about it to Vibhuti, who later gets into an argument with Anita.

videos.title: Tiwari Challenges The Music Teacher
videos.overview: Tiwari visits Saxena who gives him some music lessons. Later, Tiwari challenges the music teacher for a competition. Meanwhile, Anita lures the music teacher to elope with her. Saxena rewards Tillu, Teeka, and Malkhan with a bag full of cash.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Tiwari Get Thrown Out
videos.overview: Minal passes derogatory comments about Vibhuti's unemployment which provokes Anita to oust him from the house. Meanwhile, Ammaji kicks Tiwari out for insulting Angoori. Saxena suggests Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan look for a guide for enlightenment.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Struggle For a Job
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti approach Saxena and Prem for a job. Saxenda finds David assisting a 'pir baba' and requests to assist him. Angoori shares her concern about Tiwari with Anita. Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan get the job of a collection agent.

videos.title: Angoori and Anita Act Tough
videos.overview: Vibhuti and Tiwari beg for food, but Angoori and Anita dismiss their plea. At the police station, Master Ji bribes Happu and 'Pir Baba' sings a song opposing it. Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan start their job by threatening Tiwari and Vibhuti.

videos.title: Tiwari Fights Vibhuti For Pellu's Rickshaw
videos.overview: Vibhuti and Tiwari fight each other to drive Pellu's new rickshaw. The next morning, both of them start with their new jobs. Late at the night, Tillu, Teeka, and Malkhan meet Vibhuti and Tiwari with a plan to snatch their meagre earnings.

videos.title: Will Tiwari Starve to Death?
videos.overview: Vibhuti begs people to help a starving Tiwari. Saxena sees their condition and suggests both of them to meet 'Pir Baba'. Teeka, Malkhan, and Tillu fear for their lives on listening about their boss's human organ trafficking business.

videos.title: Vibhuti's New Relative
videos.overview: Chandrabhan Singh Lara makes a video call to Anita and introduces himself as Vibhuti's illegitimate grandfather. On hearing the news about another relative of Chandrabhan, Vibhuti insists to meet them. However, the revelation leaves him startled.

videos.title: Saxena Brings More Relatives
videos.overview: As per Uncle Lara's revelation, Tiwari becomes Anita's uncle and Vibhuti becomes Angoori's brother. Saxena introduces Tillu, Teeka, and Malkhan to Vibhuti and Anita as their new relatives. Happu gets upset at Resham Pal inheriting a plush property.

videos.title: Uncle Lara Conducts a Meeting
videos.overview: Saxena introduces Happu and Dr. Gupta as Vibhuti's new relatives. Saxena makes all the relatives of Uncle Lara compete. Uncle Lara eliminates one of the relatives and suggests gearing up for the upcoming tasks.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti In Trouble
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti compete with each other for a cooking task. Angoori and Anita are forced to give Vibhuti and Tiwari good scores. Saxena instructs all the relatives of Uncle Lara to sleep together. Vibhuti and Tiwari's dreams land them in trouble.

videos.title: Uncle Lara's Startling Truth
videos.overview: Uncle Lara eliminates Vibhuti and Tiwari for their misbehaviour. Saxena instructs Angoori and Anita to divorce their husbands. Both of the women sign the divorce papers, following which, Saxena unveils an unexpected truth about Uncle Lara.

videos.title: Kanpur's Best Married Couples
videos.overview: Kautuhal Sharma felicitates Kanpur's three best couples namely Minal-Anurag, Anita-Vibhuti and Angoori-Tiwari. Vibhuti and Tiwari give credit to themselves for the win. Prem promises Tillu, Teeka and Malkhan to help them go to Canada.

videos.title: Angoori and Anita Devise a Plan
videos.overview: Fed up of their husbands' taunts, Angoori and Anita decide to teach them a lesson. Meanwhile, Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan struggle to collect INR 25,000 for preparing the documents required for their trip to Canada.

videos.title: The Trio Steals
videos.overview: Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan steal money from Master Ji, Tiwari and Happu and give it to a travel agent for their strip to Canada. Anita and Angoori flirting with Anurag and Chhedi leaves Tiwari and Vibhuti tremendously shocked.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti are Astonished
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti get the shock of their life witnessing their wives dancing with Chhedi and Anurag. Resham Pal rebukes Happu for losing the money that he had given him. Malkhan shares some stolen costumes with Tillu and Teeka.

videos.title: The Trio's Dreams Shatter
videos.overview: Angoori and Anita reveal about their pretence to their husbands. Later, Vibhuti and Tiwari learn from their mistakes and praise their wives. Prem informs Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan about the travel agent duping all of them and fleeing away.

videos.title: Vibhuti Takes Bhoorey Home
videos.overview: Angoori narrates Bhoorey's struggle to Vibhuti and Anita. When Makhmal asks Bhoorey for his money, the latter makes an excuse of being out of the country. An unwell Bhoorey visits Angoori, and Vibhuti takes him to his home.

videos.title: Will Happu Arrest Bhoorey?
videos.overview: Angoori insists Tiwari to bring Bhoorey home. However, being influenced by Vibhuti, Bhoorey refuses to go with Tiwari. As per a piece of information, Makhmal discovers Bhoorey's location and sends Happu to arrest him.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Anita Save Bhoorey
videos.overview: Angoori tells Happu that Bhoorey is staying at Vibhuti's house. Bhoorey reveals the truth about his debt to Vibhuti and Anita, and requests them to hide him. They lie to Happy to save Bhoorey. Later, Bhoorey asks Vibhuti to pay the bill for his drinks.

videos.title: Anita Gets Annoyed With Bhoorey
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti argue over Bhoorey. Anita gets upset with Vibhuti for paying the bill of Bhoorey's drinks. She asks Tiwari to take Bhoorey home with him. Later, Bhoorey asks Anita to pay the bills for the massage services he received from Tillu.

videos.title: Happu Brings In Bhoorey
videos.overview: Tiwari tries to stop Gulfam from going to Vibhuti's house. Anita comes home and gets angry on seeing Gulfam there. At night, Bhoorey tries to sneak out of Modern Colony but Happu gets hold of him. Tiwari offers to pay off Makhmal's debt for Bhoorey.

videos.title: Saxena Meets Adbhut
videos.overview: Saxena's great grandfather Adbhut visits him and the residents of Modern Colony gather to hear stories from him. Adbhut narrates how they all are a reincarnation of the residents who used to live in the same colony during the year 1920.

videos.title: Adbhut Continues His Engrossing Story
videos.overview: Angoori and Anita get upset with their husbands for their actions in their past lives. Adbhut shares stories about his days as a freedom fighter. He narrates how Angoori aka Kasturi and Tiwari aka Pudinath invited Anita and Victor for a meal.

videos.title: Kranti Narayan's Truth Surfaces
videos.overview: Pudinanath and Kasturi visit Anita for a meal. Adbhut apprises his peers to protect a diamond from going in General Hip Donald's hands. However, Hip Donald manages to get the diamond. Adbhut tells Kasturi a truth about Kranti Narayan.

videos.title: Kranti Narayan and Pudinanath Get Shot
videos.overview: Anita decides to support Victor aka Kranti Narayan. Later, Kranti Narayan takes the diamond from Hip Donald on gunpoint and gives it to Anita and Kasturi to take it away. General Kaayar shoots at Kranti Narayan and Pudinanath.

videos.title: Episode 1171
A Truth About Vibhuti's Past
videos.overview: Tiwari visits Anita and informs her about Vibhuti getting selected for a job opening in Meerut. Angoori bumps into a man named Jhumru, who tells her about his son Jimmy. Vibhuti recognises Jhumru on seeing him and apprises him of being Jimmy.

videos.title: Vibhuti Agrees to Go to Meerut
videos.overview: Vibhuti shares details about his and Jhumru's past and tears his appointment letter. Mittal makes a phone call to Tiwari and asks him to convince Vibhuti for joining. Anita tries to convince Vibhuti and he agrees to go to Meerut for the job.

videos.title: Vibhuti Becomes a Street Performer
videos.overview: Jhumru convinces Vibhuti to become a street performer again. Anita, Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan decide to join Vibhuti as dance performers and Saxena is hired as Vibhuti's manager. Anita gets upset with Vibhuti and Tiwari worries about Mittal.

videos.title: Episode 1175
Master Ji Breaks Vibhuti's Leg
videos.overview: Master Ji breaks Vibhuti's leg and reveals to everyone that Tiwari paid him to do it. Anita and Angoori curse Tiwari for it. After three months, Vibhuti gets normal with people's motivation and then presents his last street performance.

videos.title: A Mysterious Anita
videos.overview: Anita sees a nightmare. DK visits Tiwari and leaves his car with him for two days. Late at night, Tiwari offers a lift to Anita, who had been waiting at a bus stop. Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan rush to the police station to prove their innocence.

videos.title: Anita Visits a Graveyard
videos.overview: Tiwari is startled to hear Anita's request of going to the graveyard. Later, she denies the claims made by Tiwari before Vibhuti and Angoori. Tiwari visits a tantric, who recommends him to keep Anita and Vibhuti away from each other for two days.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Visit a Graveyard
videos.overview: The 'tantric' asks Vibhuti to spend some quality time with Anita in the coming two days. Ammaji gives a book of 'mantras' to Angoori. Scared of a changed Anita, Vibhuti rushes to Angoori and Tiwari for help. Tiwari and Vibhuti leave for a graveyard.

videos.title: Roxy Reveals Her Identity
videos.overview: Angoori uses a book to call upon the ghost in Anita's body, who claims herself to be Roxy. Vibhuti requests Roxy to let him romance Anita as it will help him change his fortune. DK visits Tiwari to take his car back and Anita invites him for a party.

videos.title: Roxy's Horrifying Party
videos.overview: DK and Tiwari's family enjoy the dinner at Vibhuti's house. Meanwhile, Roxy shows up again leaving everybody scared. Happu concludes that Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan are responsible for the thefts. Angoori and Anita reveal tantric's truth to Vibhuti.

videos.title: A Chimpanzee Attacks Vibhuti
videos.overview: Angoori, Anita, Tiwari and Vibhuti discuss about the increasing terror of the monkeys in the city. Prem offers Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan a job in the forest department. Vibhuti takes Angoori to a zoo wherein he gets bitten by a chimpanzee.

videos.title: Vibhuti Starts Behaving Like a Monkey
videos.overview: Anita finds Vibhuti behaving like a monkey. Later, Vibhuti takes Tiwari's clothes away. Ammaji recommends Angoori to feed some monkeys. Vibhuti explains the changes in his body to Angoori. Master ji gets stuck in yet another problem.

videos.title: Vibhuti Attacks Happu and Tiwari
videos.overview: The increase in Vibhuti's monkey-like behaviour forces him to bite Tiwari. A determined Anita decides to make Vibhuti normal. Tiwari requests Happu to help him make Vibhuti normal but Happu falls prey to Vibhuti's attacks.

videos.title: The Trio Captures Vibhuti
videos.overview: Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan capture Vibhuti for Tiwari but Saxena sets him free. On seeing him out again, Tiwari demands that the trio return his money. Meanwhile, David tells Anita about his decision to give his wealth to Vibhuti over a phone call.

videos.title: David Learns Vibhuti's Truth
videos.overview: Vibhuti tries hard to control himself when he meets David. However, Tiwari tells David about Vibhuti's medical condition. On seeing Vibhuti behave like a monkey, David tears the property papers. Later, Dr. Gupta provides a cure to Vibhuti.

videos.title: Budget Separates Vibhuti and Anita
videos.overview: Anita gets angry at Vibhuti for not paying the vegetable seller on time. They get into an argument and then decide to stay distant. Tiwari scolds Angoori for being a spendthrift. Saxena informs Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan about the government's new scheme.

videos.title: Anita Struggles Without Vibhuti
videos.overview: Ammaji gives a tip on how to manage household expenses in INR 5000. Anita struggles with the daily chores of the kitchen. Vibhuti permits Teeka and Malkhan to stay with him in his lawn. Master Ji accuses Happu of stealing food from his house.

videos.title: Happu Gets Accused Of Stealing Food
videos.overview: Tiwari gets in trouble due to the budget decided by him. Master Ji accuses Happu of stealing a kettle from his house. He later meets Makhmal and complaints against Happu. Anita asks Tiwari to help her with kitchen work.

videos.title: Anita Organises a Party
videos.overview: Anita tells Tiwari to complete the chores of her house. Vibhuti visits Angoori and brings some food for her. Later, Anita organises a party keeping her budget in mind. Everyone from Modern Colony arrives at the party except for Vibhuti.

videos.title: Vibhuti Enters The House Again
videos.overview: Tiwari sings a song in Anita's party. Angoori gives Vibhuti some food stolen from the party. At the police station, Teeka and Malkhan reveal that they were stealing the food. Anita pretends of getting hurt and Vibhuti comes back inside the house.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti to Land In Trouble
videos.overview: Vibhuti expresses his feelings for Angoori to Prem. Tiwari also reveals his feelings for Anita and someone video shoots it. Vibhuti receives a video on phone wherein he is expressing his love. Saxena talks about making a documentary on Happu.

videos.title: The Blackmailer Calls Tiwari and Vibhuti
videos.overview: Vibhuti gets a call from the blackmailer who sent him his video. Tiwari feels shocked on receiving his video. Angoori and Anita are advised to control their anger. The blackmailer tells Angoori and Anita to leave their husbands over a phone call.

videos.title: The Blackmailer's Tricky Plan
videos.overview: Vibhuti fails at his attempt to tease Angoori. The blackmailer tells Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan to humiliate Happu. Meanwhile, even Tiwari tries to tease Anita. Later, the blackmailer forces Vibhuti and Tiwari to annoy Angoori and Anita.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Tiwari Reveal Their Predicament
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti discuss about their blackmailers. The again try to tease Anita and Angoori. The next morning, when Anita and Angoori get angry Tiwari and Vibhuti reveal the truth. Happu promises to trace the location of their blackmailer.

videos.title: The Blackmailer Gets Caught
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti locate the blackmailer and discover that it is David. Later, Tiwari brings coffee for Anita and Vibhuti brings tea for Angoori. Tillu and Malkhan doubt that Saxena has abducted Teeka, which angers them enough to assault him.

videos.title: The Director Antenio From Italy
videos.overview: Angoori tells Tiwari about her interest in the profession of acting. Prem tells Vibhuti about his Italian director friend Antenio over a phone call. Anita calls Tiwari and Angoori home to meet Antenio. Later, everybody goes to meet Antenio.

videos.title: Modern Colony Residents Earn Their Roles
videos.overview: Antenio explains their roles to everyone. Later, people bag their roles after clearing the auditions. Vibhuti and Tiwari get upset with Malkhan and Teeka for getting important roles, while Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan celebrate their achievement.

videos.title: The Film's Shooting Begins
videos.overview: Vibhuti and Tiwari bribe Bagawat Mirza to edit some scenes in the movie. Later, shooting of the film begins and Vibhuti acts for a role with Angoori. During the shooting, Teeka gets upset at the last-minute changes done in the scene.

videos.title: Happu Gets Upset Due to a Movie Scene
videos.overview: Angoori talks to Tiwari about the sudden changes in the movie's plot. Happu expresses his disappointment about his role in the movie to Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan. Later, Vibhuti, Malkhan and Anita win praises for their acting from Antenio.

videos.title: The Film's Shooting Stops
videos.overview: Anita and Angoori complain about another unnecessary change in the script. Antenio's father gets arrested and the film's shooting stops at once. Later, Teeka and Malkhan reveal that Tiwari and Vibhuti had made the changes in the scenes.

videos.title: Vibhuti Raids Tiwari's House
videos.overview: Tiwari discusses his bank balance with Anita and Vibhuti. A person known as Satyaprakash appoints Vibhuti, Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan as income tax officers. Later, Vibhuti takes a team of officers to Tiwari's home for an income tax raid.

videos.title: Tiwari is Upset Due to The Raid
videos.overview: Tiwari tells Angoori to ask Vibhuti for his help. Anita gets worried about Vibhuti becoming an income tax officer. Vibhuti explains Anita the benefits of income tax raid and then raids his own house. Later, Tiwari arrives at Anita's house.

videos.title: Ammaji Thrashes Vibhuti
videos.overview: Anita tells Tiwari that Vibhuti has raided his own house. Ammaji thrashes Teeka, Tillu, Malkhan and Vibhuti so as to keep them away from the money she got by selling off some land. Later, Vibhuti insults David on his arrival.

videos.title: Happu Assaults Vibhuti and His Team
videos.overview: Vibhuti seizes all the black money in David's possession. CID officer Nathu apprises Happu of Satyaprakash being a thug. Happu assaults Vibhuti and his team to get Satyaprakash's whereabouts. Satyaprakash returns Tiwari's money after getting arrested.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti's Plans Fail Miserably
videos.overview: Anita and Angoori convince Vibhuti and Tiwari to watch the film. Tiwari and Vibhuti buy tickets to watch the movie with each other's wives. Later, both of them refuse the movie's offer and then Vibhuti and Tiwari watch the movie alone.

videos.title: Tillu In Love With a Royal Girl
videos.overview: Tiwari refuses to pay INR 50,000 to Tillu. Later, Tillu requests Tiwari and Vibhuti to pose as his family and help him marry Marjina, the daughter of 'Nawabs'. Tiwari convinces Angoori and Anita convinces Vibhuti to pretend as Tillu's family.

videos.title: Marjina's Father Zaleeluddin's Stubbornness
videos.overview: Saxena gives Urdu lessons to all. Tiwari and Vibhuti welcome Marjina's father Zaleeluddin, while maintaining the pretence of being 'Nawabs'. Later, they keep arguing about who'll first enter the house. Anita uses her wit to end it.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti's Attempt At 'shayari'
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti recite 'shayari' before Zaleeluddin. Saxena shows up as Tillu's mother. Later, Tiwari and Vibhuti keep praising each other's wives. Tiwari stops Angoori from presenting a 'shayari' to entertain Zaleeluddin.

videos.title: Tillu and Marjina's Wedding
videos.overview: Zaleeluddin finalises Tillu and Marjina's wedding date. Later, the Modern Colony residents give dance performances at their wedding. At night, Teeka and Malkhan feel shocked to see a devastated Tillu and they rush him to Vibhuti.

videos.title: Marjina Assaults Tillu
videos.overview: Tillu reveals to everyone how Marjina assaulted him. As suggested by Happu, Tillu goes back to Marjina and gets thrashed again in an attempt to collect some evidence. Later, Anita suggests an idea that helps Tillu divorce Marjina.

videos.title: Vibhuti Cheats Tiwari
videos.overview: Tiwari insults Vibhuti in Anita's presence. Tiwari later refuses to take Angoori shopping. Prem tells Teeka and his friends to decorate Modern Colony for his sister-in-law. Vibhuti extracts some money from Tiwari for buying a gift for Anita.

videos.title: Dhanteras' Celebration At Vibhuti's House
videos.overview: Vibhuti lies to Anita about the money given to her. Ammaji learns about Tiwari refusing Angoori to go shopping and scolds him for it. Later, on the occasion of 'Dhanteras', the Modern Colony residents plan to play cards at Vibhuti's house.

videos.title: Vibhuti Steals From Tiwari's House
videos.overview: Tiwari tells Anita about how he was defrauded. Tiwari curses Vibhuti for cheating him of his money. Later, he uses a disguise to extract money from Vibhuti. On learning Tiwari's truth, Vibhuti steals from his house.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Lose For Love
videos.overview: Tiwari tries to extract his money from Vibhuti but gets outsmarted. Saxena introduces Teeka to Shalu and suggests him to take her for shopping. Modern Colony residents later play a game wherein Tiwari and Vibhuti lose because of each other's wives.

videos.title: Angoori and Anita's Fiery Argument
videos.overview: Tiwari reveals to Anita about Vibhuti cheating him. She questions Tiwari's judgements and supports Vibhuti, which gives rise to an argument between Anita and Angoori. After Diwali celebrations, Tillu, Teeka and Malkhan curse Prem for not being paid.

videos.title: Prem's Death Leaves Vibhuti Shocked
videos.overview: Vibhuti and Prem insult each other, but Anita intervenes and gets upset about it. The next morning, Happu reveals that Prem is no more and Vibhuti goes into a shock. While everyone tries to console him, Angoori hides something from Tiwari.

videos.title: Condolence Meet At Vibhuti's House
videos.overview: Modern Colony residents join Vibhuti for Prem's condolence meet. Happu arrives there and reveals that he has failed in finding Prem's corpse. Teeka plans to fake a suicide with Dr. Gupta to test Tillu and Malkhan but they get to know about it.

videos.title: Prem's Death Depresses Vibhuti
videos.overview: Vibhuti finds Prem at Angoori's house, but she tells him that it just a hallucination. Saxena becomes a psychiatrist and suggests Vibhuti to commit suicide. Meanwhile, Teeka feels upset on seeing Tillu and Malkhan's indifference towards him.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Party In Prem's Remembrance
videos.overview: Tiwari tries to console a dejected Vibhuti by insulting him like Prem, instead it makes him angry. Anita organises a party on Vibhuti's insistence wherein he forces Modern Colony residents to give energetic dance performances on sad, slow pace songs.Tiwari tries to console a dejected Vibhuti by insulting him like Prem, instead it makes him angry. Anita organises a party on Vibhuti's insistence wherein he forces Modern Colony residents to give energetic dance performances on sad, slow pace songs.

videos.title: Cow Dung Crisis On 'chhat Puja'
videos.overview: Prem reveals to Vibhuti and Tiwari about the reason behind his pretence. The next day, Anita and Angoori request Tiwari and Vibhuti to arrange cow dung for 'Chhat Puja'. They later bribe Tillu for his 'Palak Ka Saag' and present it as cow dung.

videos.title: Tiwari Decides to Set Up a Factory
videos.overview: Agrawal places an order of innerwear worth INR 3 crores with Tiwari's shop. As per Anita's suggestion, Tiwari partners with her and Prem to start a new factory. Later, Modern Colony residents visit Tiwari for job interviews.

videos.title: Happu Demands Inr 5 Lakhs From Tiwari
videos.overview: Tiwari, Anita and Prem interview Vibhuti for a job opportunity. Tiwari punishes Vibhuti for reaching late to the workplace. Later, Happu demands a bribe of INR 5 lakhs from Tiwari by accusing him of illegally starting up a handloom.

videos.title: Vibhuti Motivates The Employees
videos.overview: On Tiwari's request, Happu gets convinced for a bribe of INR 10,000. Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan fight among each other for an employee Rekha in the factory. Later, Tiwari's announcement of sharing his profit with all employees makes Vibhuti motivate them.

videos.title: Tiwari's Employees Go On a Strike
videos.overview: Vibhuti overhears Tiwari and Prem scheming against the employees and goes on a strike with them. Angoori doesn't bother to convince them otherwise and joins the strike. Later, Prem and Tiwari try to bribe Vibhuti to turn him against the employees.

videos.title: Rocky Thrashes Vibhuti
videos.overview: Prem's recruit Rocky thrashes Vibhuti and tells him that Anita sent him for it. Vibhuti arrives home and whines about it. Anita asks Prem and Tiwari to apologise to Vibhuti. Later, Tiwari gets a shocking news from Mr. Agrawal.

videos.title: Kalavati Disturbs Tiwari and Vibhuti's Life
videos.overview: Anita and Angoori meet writer Kalavati Sharma at an event, who recommends them to keep an eye on their husbands. Later, Anita and Angoori question their husbands on women perfumes. Teeka and friends begin an extortion business by the name 'T Company'.

videos.title: Saxena's Strange Request
videos.overview: Saxena sprays a women's perfume on Tiwari and Vibhuti. Kalavati expresses that she doubts Tiwari and Vibhuti's intentions. As per Prem's recommendation, Tiwari and Vibhuti meet Baba Komalnath. Saxena requests Tillu and Malkhan to break his leg.

videos.title: Ammaji Thrashes Tiwari
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti get outnumbered by some thieves. To evade Anita's questions, Vibhuti tells her that he was with his friend Ghatotkachh Moinuddin D'mello. Anita and Angoori suspect that Vibhuti is lying. Ammaji thrashes Tiwari to extract the truth.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti's Successful Plan
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti pay Teeka and his friends to abduct a man known as Gupta. They then introduce Gupta as Ghatotkachh Moinuddin D'mello to their wives. Later, Angoori meets real Ghatotkachh which leaves Tiwari and Vibhuti perplexed.

videos.title: Anita and Angoori's Doubt Vanishes Away
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti bring Gupta home and reveal the truth to their wives. Happu visits Tiwari and informs him about confiscating the looted belongings. Anita and Angoori try to console their husbands. Happu orders a shut down of T Company.

videos.title: Baba Predicts Angoori's Death
videos.overview: Malang Baba forecasts Angoori's death due to a road accident by three boys. When Vibhuti finds Angoori with her new scooter he begins to fear for her life. Later, a skeptical Vibhuti stops Teeka and his friends from driving a vehicle.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Plea to Yamraj
videos.overview: By the time Vibhuti comes with money, Teeka and his friends leave with the vehicle. Vibhuti struggles to stop Angoori while she is riding the scooter and Tillu hits her with the vehicle. Later, Vibhuti tells Yamraj to stay away from Angoori.

videos.title: Yamraj Accepts Vibhuti's Plea
videos.overview: Vibhuti tampers with Angoori's scooter. Tillu hits him again with his vehicle. Anita and Tiwari jointly play a prank on Tiwari to win a competition. Later, Vibhuti pleads Yamraj to forgive Angoori, which he finally agrees to.

videos.title: Angoori's Death Infuriates Vibhuti
videos.overview: Anita calls Tiwari home to scare him. Yamraj tells Vibhuti that he has no option but to take Angoori's life. Later, Tiwari tells Vibhuti that Angoori is no more. Vibhuti loses his temper and thrashes Teeka and his friends.

videos.title: Yamraj's True Identity Revealed
videos.overview: The news of Angoori being alive brings great joy to Vibhuti's life. Saxena tells Vibhuti that Yamraj is none other than his friend Kallan. Later, due to the strike of rickshaw drivers, Tiwari and Vibhuti try different ways to help Anita and Angoori.

videos.title: Anita Gets Rich Overnight
videos.overview: Faqira, a lawyer, tells Anita that she has inherited a ring worth INR 1.5 crores from her maternal uncle. The boss of Teeka and his friends ousts him from his house. Later, Modern Colony residents arrive at Anita's party to take a look at the ring.

videos.title: Vibhuti Swallows 1.5 Crore Inr Ring
videos.overview: Tiwari's prank makes Vibhuti swallow the expensive ring. Anita and Vibhuti visit Dr. Gupta for help and he suggests operating him. Angoori recommends feeding him a decoction. Prem hires Teeka and his friends to abduct Vibhuti.

videos.title: Vibhuti Gets Abducted
videos.overview: Tiwari and Angoori forcefully feed Vibhuti a concoction. When it does not help, Angoori makes a phone call to Ammaji. Teeka and his friends abduct Vibhuti wearing face masks. Tiwari apprises Anita of this incident and she loses her temper.

videos.title: Vibhuti Returns Home
videos.overview: Teeka tries to extract the ring from Vibhuti's body. Happu brings Vibhuti back home. Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan learn that Prem had hired them to abduct Vibhuti. Anita, Tiwari and Angoori once again feed Vibhuti a concoction.

videos.title: Anita's Ring Comes Out As Fake
videos.overview: Vibhuti comes out of the toilet and informs that he has flushed out the ring. However, Tiwari manages to get it from the sewer. Later, a jeweller scrutinizes it and tells that it is artificial. Saxena pays Teeka and his friends to thank them.

videos.title: Who will Become Tiwari's Father?
videos.overview: Anita daydreams about currency notes raining on her. Tiwari tells Angoori that he is unsure about who is his real father. Ammaji tells Angoori and Tiwari that someone has to become Tiwari's father for 15 days for the happiness of the family.

videos.title: Vibhuti Adopts Tiwari
videos.overview: Tiwari tells Anita that on legal terms, he wants to make Vibhuti his father. Anita, being tempted by the money, says yes. Saxena announces this to everyone in the colony. Later, Tiwari and Vibhuti trouble each other.

videos.title: Vibhuti Completely Accepts Tiwari
videos.overview: Vibhuti tries to overpower Tiwari. Anita asks Tiwari for the payment he had promised. When Prem makes fun of Tiwari's father, Vibhuti begins to take Tiwari as his son. Teeka and Tillu visit the police station with their girlfriends.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Tiwari Visit a Movie Theatre
videos.overview: Vibhuti takes Tiwari to a movie theatre. Later, they both share their love stories with each other. Anita brings Vibhuti back home out of anger. Meanwhile, Angoori curses Tiwari for spending so much time with Vibhuti.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti's Relationship Ends Forever
videos.overview: Ammaji thrashes Tiwari in Vibhuti's presence. Happu scolds Tiwari and Vibhuti, who are trying to run away from their houses. Anita achieves success in her plan to turn them both against each other. Saxena helps them end their father-son relationship.

videos.title: Tiwari's Uncle Lands Him In Trouble
videos.overview: Tiwari's maternal uncle Annu Awasthi calls him to ask for money. Anita learns about a 'Kachchha-Baniyan' gang prevailing in Kanpur. Annu visits Tiwari wearing only undergarments. He curses Tiwari for not dressing up like him.

videos.title: Teeka and His Friends Rob Annu
videos.overview: Annu explains the importance of undergarments to Vibhuti. As instructed by Vibhuti, Teeka and his friends rob Annu's jewellery. Anita's friend thrashes Vibhuti but she goes to lodge a complaint against Annu and Tiwari assuming that they did it.

videos.title: Annu and Tiwari's Arrest
videos.overview: Tiwari calls Happu to lodge a police complaint for the robbery but Annu scolds him for doing so. Anita's complaint makes Happu arrest Tiwari and Annu. The real culprit later gets caught, following which Annu leaves from Tiwari's house.

videos.title: Teeka's Birthday Celebration
videos.overview: Anita and Vibhuti blame each other for the poor management of household expenses. Tillu and Malkhan request Prem some money for organising Teeka's birthday party but he refuses to give it. Teeka loses heart on learning about this.

videos.title: Teeka Pleads Tiwari and Vibhuti
videos.overview: Teeka requests Vibhuti and Tiwari to help him organise his birthday party but they refuse to help. Later, they all give him a surprise by organising a party for him. Tiwari and Vibhuti get angry at Angoori and Anita for spending money on the party.

videos.title: Vibhuti Becomes Bangle Seller For Angoori
videos.overview: Vibhuti learns that Angoori loves bangles. Prem lends Teeka and his friends money for their business on a condition that they pay double the amount. Vibhuti gives them a business idea and becomes a bangle seller. Angoori later buys bangles from him.

videos.title: Vibhuti Cheats Angoori
videos.overview: Vibhuti cheats Angoori, which makes Tiwari mad at her. He visits Anita to complain about it. Vibhuti explains his profit to Teeka and his friends. Vibhuti again cheats Angoori while selling the bangles. Prem demands from the trio his first installment.

videos.title: Teeka and His Friends Threaten Tiwari
videos.overview: Anita finds Vibhuti with Gulfam and scolds him for spending time with her. Tiwari approaches Happu to lodge a complaint against Vibhuti for cheating Angoori. Later, as instructed by Vibhuti, Teeka and his friends threaten Tiwari to buy bangles.

videos.title: Tiwari Compelled to Dance Wearing Bangles
videos.overview: Tiwari visits Vibhuti's store and buys bangles from him. Later, the threats by Teeka and his friends force Tiwari to dance and entertain them which leaves Angoori shocked. Prem takes back the capital that he had lent to Teeka and his friends.

videos.title: Happu Arrests Teeka and His Friends
videos.overview: On Anita's insistence, Happu comes up with a plan to shut Vibhuti's business. Teeka and his friends fall prey to the plan and soon get arrested. Anita proudly tells Vibhuti that she actively participated in the plan to shut his business.

videos.title: Anita Becomes The Mayor
videos.overview: Ammaji asks Tiwari to begin a new business. The civil servant team's chief Satyapal Shrivastava requests Anita to join as the Mayor and she happily agrees to it. Tiwari and Angoori visit Anita to congratulate her. Teeka and his friends become homeless.

videos.title: Vibhuti Recommends Tiwari to Anita
videos.overview: Vibhuti gives Tiwari a proposal to build a bridge. Later, he discusses it with Anita and then explains Tiwari the benefits of his proposal. Tiwari begins Angoori Construction Company. Saxena becomes the Santa and gives presents to Teeka and friends.

videos.title: Tiwari Gets a Bridge-building Contract
videos.overview: Anita gives the bridge's contract to Tiwari, who assigns Prem to build it and hires Teeka and his friends as his labourers. Vibhuti wishes Anita on their wedding anniversary. Later, Anita and Angoori being busy makes Vibhuti feel lonely.

videos.title: Angoori Scolds Tiwari For His Carelessness
videos.overview: Anita's assistant doesn't let Vibhuti in her office. Prem along with Teeka and his friends jointly attempt to steal cement. Vibhuti fails at his plan to go for dinner with Anita. Angoori scolds Tiwari and advises him to focus on his work.

videos.title: Angoori Gets Arrested
videos.overview: Tiwari gets the news that the bridge made by him has collapsed. Happu arrests Angoori as she is the owner of the construction company. Fed up of the work, Anita quits her job. Later, Angoori gets released and exposes the culprit behind the accident.

videos.title: Vibhuti's 'nalle Ka Halwa'
videos.overview: Everyone praises the sweet dish prepared by Vibhuti and Minal suggests him to open a shop of his own. He agrees for it after Anita convinces him and names it as 'Nalle Ka Halwa'. Later, Saxena serves Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan a bull dung soup.

videos.title: Tiwari's New Year Party to Get Disastrous
videos.overview: Ammaji scolds Tiwari on being unable to impregnate Angoori. Makhmal reveals that he was demoted due to his rivalry with Resham Pal. Vibhuti refuses to pay a bribe to Happu, who later spoils the sweet dish at Tiwari's new year party for revenge.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Cake Affects Everyone's Health
videos.overview: the residents of Modern colony arrive at Tiwari's New Year party, but Anita has to wait back to look after Anurag. Everyone enjoys Vibhuti's Halwa cake at the party. However, Tiwari along with Teeka and his friends suffer from stomach upset.

videos.title: Happu Spikes Vibhuti's Halwa
videos.overview: Tiwari and others at his party blame Vibhuti for their stomach upset. Happu tells Vibhuti to prepare halwa again and serve them. Later, Happu adds poison to Vibhuti's halwa and once again people who ate it have an upset stomach.

videos.title: Happu Arrests Vibhuti
videos.overview: Happu arrests Vibhuti for spiking his 'halwa'. On Anita's insistence, he releases him. As per Ramphal's suggestion, Ammaji ensures that Angoori and Tiwari maintain distance with each other. Vibhuti learns that Happu has schemed against him.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Unaware Of a Forthcoming Problem
videos.overview: Angoori and Anita promise Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan to get them married soon. Tiwari and Vibhuti lie to their wives to go to Prem's party. However, they are left stranded in a jungle while returning home. Later, Saxena tells everyone that he is fine.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Tiwari Return With Istri
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti bump into Istri. Angoori and Anita worry for both of them. They return home with Istri but there is a strange change in their behaviour. Saxena, Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan are eager to marry Istri. She later organises a 'swayamvar'.

videos.title: Istri's Unique Ritual
videos.overview: Istri chooses Saxena as her groom and asks for a drop of blood from everyone to complete the ritual. Dr Gupta is shocked when he sees Istri outside. Later, everyone takes part in the ceremony. Master Ji tells Happu about the disappearance of Dr Gupta.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti's Frightening Appearance
videos.overview: Istri drinks the blood collected from others and Tiwari and Vibhuti begin to look pale. A scared Anita and Angoori run to Happu for help. He visits them and their changed looks scare him as well. Istri proposes to marry Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan.

videos.title: Guru Ghantal Imprisons Istri In a Cave
videos.overview: Saxena again becomes a psychopath. Guru Ghantal helps Anita and Angoori to get rid of Istri. Once again, two people reopen the cave in which Istri was imprisoned. Later, Modern colony residents enjoy happy moments of kite flying together.

videos.title: Don and Rozy Follow Anita
videos.overview: Don and Rozy keep chasing Bhoja who drops a pen drive in Anita's purse. They then begin following her and Don remembers his friend on seeing Vibhuti. Meanwhile, Vibhuti borrows 3000 INR from Teeka and friends to buy Angoori a saree.

videos.title: Kallu, Vibhuti's Lookalike
videos.overview: Don pays his friend and Vibhuti's lookalike, Kallu 2 lakhs INR to get Vibhuti's pen drive. Anita plans a dinner party at her house. Kallu shocks Don by pulling off Vibhuti's appearance effortlessly. Teeka and friends ask Vibhuti to return their money.

videos.title: Kallu Replaces Vibhuti
videos.overview: Don and Rozy abduct Vibhuti and Kallu takes his place in his home. Later, Don tells Vibhuti about the pen drive and shows him Kallu's doings using a CCTV camera. Vibhuti loses his temper on seeing Kallu holding Angoori's hands.

videos.title: Kallu's Threat Scares Tiwari
videos.overview: Tiwari complains about Vibhuti's doings to Anita. Kallu tells Tiwari that he likes Angoori and will elope with her someday. Kallu asks Anita to bring her purse and she agrees to do so. Teeka and his friends feel scared on hearing Saxena.

videos.title: The Trio Helps Vibhuti Return Home
videos.overview: Tiwari tells Anita about Vibhuti's threat. Kallu thrashes Teeka and his friends. The trio later frees a locked up Vibhuti and takes Happu's help to get Kallu arrested. After returning home, Vibhuti clears Tiwari and Angoori's misconception due to Kallu.

videos.title: Angoori Prepares to Thrash Someone
videos.overview: Ammaji suggests Angoori to thrash any man near a riverbank where clothes are being washed. When Tiwari disagrees to follow the plan, Angoori takes Vibhuti's help. Anita puts on an act to test Vibhuti. Later, Vibhuti and Prem jointly fool Tiwari.

videos.title: Teeka and Friends Become Saxena's Pet
videos.overview: A jobseeker-turned-astrologer Vibhuti suggests Tiwari to feed a purple-skinned dog. Anita continues with her pretence. Angoori and Vibhuti arrive at the laundry bay. Saxena asks Teeka and friends to wear dog collars and later takes them out for a walk.

videos.title: Angoori Beats Vibhuti Up
videos.overview: Angoori thrashes Vibhuti at the laundry bay. At home, Anita bites Vibhuti. Tiwari unknowingly feeds Masterji, who is wearing a costume of a purple dog. Later, Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan try to escape Saxena but he threatens them.

videos.title: Vibhuti Learns About Anita's Pretence
videos.overview: Anita tells Vibhuti that they should get separated. Vibhuti tells Tiwari about Anita behaving like a dog. Angoori once again thrashes Vibhuti. Saxena sets Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan free. Vibhuti learns about Anita's pretence.

videos.title: Mother-in-law's Arrival Bugs Anita
videos.overview: Anita gets worried upon learning about the arrival of Vibhuti's mother. Anita decides to stay at Tiwari's home to avoid her. Anita gets fed up of her mother-in-law's changing decisions. Even Masterji has to temporarily shift due to his mother-in-law.

videos.title: Angoori and Vibhuti's Viral Chikchok Video
videos.overview: Anita requests Angoori to prepare her favourite dish. Angoori forgets to cook it as she gets busy making a Chikchok video. Tiwari gets upset and scolds her for this. Later, Vibhuti and Angoori make a Chikchok video that goes viral on social media.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Idea to Evade Tiwari
videos.overview: Tiwari scolds Vibhuti for making a Chikchok video with Angoori. Vibhuti suggests Angoori to give Tiwari a sedative pill. Happu advises Vibhuti and Angoori to avoid roaming around during the night. Teeka is left stunned to find his hand sprained.

videos.title: Episode 1284
Chik Chok’s Offer
videos.overview: Everyone ignores Annu Awasthi as they are busy enjoying Chik Chok videos. Tillu and Teeka suffer the consequences of using their phones excessively. Chik Chok officials provide an offer to Tiwari, Angoori and Vibhuti for which they must pay INR 25,000.

videos.title: A Lesson Learnt
videos.overview: Anita pays her share of the money she owes Chik Chok through Tiwari. The news of Chik Chok’s scam comes on TV. Annu Awasthi scolds the four for their foolishness and gives them an advice. David tears the will in front of Vibhuti.

videos.title: Anita's Suggestion to Vibhuti
videos.overview: Saxena tells everyone about an invention by a team of scientists overseas. Adding to it, he gives them a piece of good news as well. Vibhuti tells Anita about David's condition. Anita gives Vibhuti an idea to get David's property.

videos.title: Vibhuti Gets Pregnant
videos.overview: Anita tells Tiwari that it is not her but Vibhuti who is pregnant. Vibhuti visits Dr. Harsh Santoshi with Saxena and he begins with his regular pregnancy treatment. Vibhuti's mother Helen comes home to see him and learns that he is pregnant.

videos.title: Angoori's Advice to a Pregnant Vibhuti
videos.overview: Angoori congratulates Vibhuti for his pregnancy and advises him to take care of his health. She later tells that she wants Tiwari to become a mother as well. Meanwhile, David and Helen get into a heated argument due to some old conflicts.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Baby Shower
videos.overview: Angoori insists Tiwari to try and get pregnant. The next morning, seeing Vibhuti's condition, Anita phones Dr. Harsh Santoshi. Later, the Modern Colony residents celebrate Vibhuti's baby shower ceremony.

videos.title: After Vibhuti, Tiwari Gets Pregnant
videos.overview: Amma and Angoori forcibly take Tiwari to a doctor. Teeka and friends commit hooliganism to sell goods. Anita and Helen continue to grumble. David reveals something about the property. Later, everyone's shocked when they see a news on TV.

videos.title: Angoori Intends On Stealing From Vibhuti's House
videos.overview: Ammaji tells Angoori to steal a piece of jewellery from someone's house to nullify a flaw in her horoscope. Helen refuses to give her family jewellery to Anita. Angoori goes to check where Helen keeps her necklace and then plans to steal it.

videos.title: Angoori Steals Helen's Necklace
videos.overview: Vibhuti sees Angoori while she is stealing Helen's necklace. Helen accuses Anita of stealing the necklace. To save Angoori, Vibhuti stops Helen from calling the police. Tiwari finds a necklace at home. Vibhuti learns the reason behind Angoori's theft.

videos.title: Tiwari's Efforts Go to Waste
videos.overview: Helen lodges a police complaint for the missing necklace. Saxena falsely testifies against Teeka and friends. Vibhuti sees Tiwari keeping the necklace back at its place and keeps it back in Angoori's room. Tiwari later comes to inform Helen about it.

videos.title: Tiwari Throws The Necklace In Vibhuti's House
videos.overview: Dr. Gupta tells Helen that the thief who stole the necklace will soon start vomiting. On seeing Anita vomit, Helen calls her a thief again. Tiwari secretly throws the necklace into Vibhuti's house. Ammaji asks Angoori to steal the necklace again.

videos.title: Angoori Returns Helen's Necklace
videos.overview: Angoori again steals Helen's necklace but Tiwari keeps it back. Vibhuti sees him doing so and keeps it back in Angoori's house. Angoori later returns it and tells everyone the reason behind stealing it. Tiwari gives Angoori a surprise.

videos.title: The Week Of Respect
videos.overview: Tiwari tries to arrange the money to repay his debts. Vibhuti tells everyone that the winner of the Tehzeeb competition going on in the city, will be rewarded with 1 lakh rupees. Tiwari organises a party and everyone treats each other respectfully.

videos.title: A Competition Of Insolence
videos.overview: Everyone at the party defines 'tehzeeb' in their own way. During the Tehzeeb Competition, Saxena's uncle Gultaini announces that whoever is the most disrespectful shall be rewarded with 25 lakh INR. Anita tells Vibhuti to participate in it.

videos.title: Insolence Turns Modern Colony Into a Madhouse
videos.overview: Angoori and Anita keep insulting Vibhuti and Tiwari to win the competition. Happu also insults Commissioner. When Helen visits Anita, the latter insults her in Saxena and Gultaini's presence. Teeka and friends cross the limits of insulting everyone.

videos.title: The Competition Of Insolence Bothers Bhoorey
videos.overview: Angoori insults Helen upon seeing Saxena and Gultaini. Vibhuti narrates the incident to Helen. Helen, Vibhuti and Tiwari misbehave with Bhoorey. Later, Agarwal visits Tiwari and tells him that he can return his money whenever he wants.

videos.title: The Winner Of The Competition Of Insolence
videos.overview: Tiwari misbehaves with Agarwal, who had come to help him. Later, everybody disrespects each other in a poetic manner. The Modern Colony residents gather to know who wins the competition. Gultaini eventually announces the winner.

videos.title: The Arrival Of Tiwari's and Vibhuti's Impersonators
videos.overview: Angoori and Anita refuse to recognise Tiwari and Vibhuti and stay with someone else mistaking them to be Tiwari and Vibhuti. When Vibhuti arrives home, his imposter ousts him from there. Meanwhile, Tiwari also faces a similar problem.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Tiwari Recall The Incident In The Cemetery
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti go to the police station but even Happu refuses to recognise them. They both bribe Teeka and friends, asking them to identify them before Angoori and Anita. Later, both recall the incident that happened with them in the cemetery.

videos.title: Who is Conspiring Against Tiwari and Vibhuti?
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti get upset when they see their imposters flirting with Anita and Angoori. A man tries to tell both of them about some conspiracy but someone shoots him. Later, Tiwari and Vibhuti ask the imposters a few questions.

videos.title: Malkhan Falls Prey to The Modern Colony's Conspiracy
videos.overview: Even Masterji and Saxena refuse to recognise Tiwari and Vibhuti. Malkhan tries to tell them something but someone shoots him too. Later, Tiwari and Vibhuti call Ammaji and Helen, but they do not recognise them either.

videos.title: Angoori and Anita Reveal The Truth
videos.overview: Vibhuti goes to his house and tears David's will. Tiwari and Vibhuti get hurt when even Bhoorey doesn't recognise them and consume poison. Later, Angoori and Anita tell them how they planned it all to teach them a lesson.

videos.title: Bhoorey and Helen's Love Story Begins
videos.overview: Helen visits Anita and criticises Anita's clothes. Bhoorey visits Angoori and decides to stay with her for a few days after seeing Helen. On his insistence, Angoori invites Anita, Vibhuti and Helen for a meal. Meanwhile, Prem starts his courier service.

videos.title: Anita's Warning to Vibhuti
videos.overview: Bhoorey and Helen recite poems to praise each other at the dinner table. Anita warns Vibhuti about Helen and Bhoorey which leads to an argument between them. Later, Vibhuti tries to flirt with Angoori and Bhoorey tries to flirt with Helen.

videos.title: Bhoorey Sends a Gift For Helen
videos.overview: Helen sends halwa for Bhoorey with Tiwari. Bhoorey also asks Teeka to courier his gift. Helen jumped with joy on receiving a perfume and a letter as a gift. Vibhuti gets details about Bhoorey and his wife from Angoori.

videos.title: Helen and Bhoorey Get Caught At The Lovers' Park
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti decide to stop Helen and Bhoorey. Masterji tells Vibhuti and Anita that Helen and Bhoorey have gone to watch a film. Later, Happu tells Tiwari and Vibhuti at the police station that Helen and Bhoorey were caught at the Lovers' park.

videos.title: David and Bhoorey Fight Due to Helen
videos.overview: Tiwari bribes Happu to save Bhoorey and Helen from getting arrested. David threatens Bhoorey to stay away from Helen and the two get into a fight. Helen and Bhoorey say that they are just good friends and curse everyone for doubting their relationship.

videos.title: Vibhuti to Make Eco-friendly Colours
videos.overview: Anita refuses to play Holi due to her shoot and Angoori tries to avoid the harmful colours. The doctor brings marriage proposals for Teeka and friends. Vibhuti starts an eco-friendly colours' business with Tiwari. Later, Happu makes a huge mistake.

videos.title: Who are The Men Plotting Against Vibhuti?
videos.overview: Vibhuti makes eco-friendly colours but two men plan to tamper with it. During the inauguration of his shop, Vibhuti and his family argue over the ribbon-cutting. Later, the Modern Colony residents organise a poetry conference.

videos.title: Holi At The Modern Colony
videos.overview: Everyone criticises each other in a poetic manner. While Vibhuti convinces Anita, Tiwari convinces Angoori to play Holi with the eco-friendly colours. Later, the entire Modern Colony plays Holi with colours made by Vibhuti.

videos.title: The Sloganeering Against Vibhuti
videos.overview: Due to adulteration, the colours of Holi do not come off anyone's face and everyone blames Vibhuti. The doctor informs Teeka and his friends that the girls' family is coming to see them. Later, the Modern colony residents protest against Vibhuti.

videos.title: Vibhuti is Proven Innocent
videos.overview: Happu tries to handle the situation and comes to arrest Vibhuti. Teeka and friends are saddened by the failure of their marriage discussions. The real culprit is caught with the help of Matru Dhobi. Saxena gets a solution to take off Holi's colours.

videos.title: Bhabi Ji Sanidhya Tax' In Kanpur
videos.overview: Mantriji declares that everyone in the city will have to pay BST for talking to his sister-in-law. Tiwari and Vibhuti worry as it stops them from talking to Anita and Angoori. Happu explains BST to Teeka and friends. Saxena gets a new job as a CA.

videos.title: Saxena Tells How to Cheat On Bst
videos.overview: A tax officer collects INR 25,000 from Tiwari for talking to Anita. Tiwari talks to Anita through Vibhuti in the manner suggested by Saxena. Teeka and friends become victims of BST. Vibhuti also visits Angoori to talk through Tiwari.

videos.title: Bhoorey and David Fall Prey to Bst
videos.overview: Vibhuti talks to Angoori through Tiwari. Bhoorey is charged a tax of INR 1 lakh 80 thousand for talking to Helen, which Tiwari has to pay. Even David becomes a victim of BST. Later, Vibhuti and Tiwari's new plan fails.

videos.title: Saxena Advises Tiwari and Vibhuti to Rebel
videos.overview: At night, Tiwari visits Anita and Vibhuti visits Angoori. Bhoorey and David arrive to meet Helen but then get into an argument. The next day, the tax officials give a bill of INR 2.5 lakhs to Tiwari and Vibhuti. Saxena asks them both to rebel.

videos.title: Modern Colony's Protest Against Bst
videos.overview: The Modern colony residents protest against BST. Commissioner arrives in disguise with Happu and the rest of the policemen and they beat everyone up. Later, Tiwari and Vibhuti manage to trick Mantriji into ruling out BST.

videos.title: Ammaji Wants Tiwari to Marry a Buffalo
videos.overview: Vibhuti's uncle Ram Ghulam promises to give him INR 50 crores in exchange for letting Reshma stay with him. When Ram Ghulam visits Vibhuti, Anita begins arguing with the latter. Ammaji tells Tiwari to marry a buffalo due to his 'kundali dosha'.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Anita In a Fix
videos.overview: On seeing Reshma, Anita and Vibhuti agree to adopt Reshma. Chhedi refuses to get his buffalo married to Tiwari. Later, Ram Ghulam's INR 50 crores' offer related to Reshma puts Vibhuti and Anita in a fix.

videos.title: Angoori Proposes to Get Tiwari Married to a Buffalo
videos.overview: Vibhuti takes Reshma's marriage proposal to Teeka and friends. They later visit Vibhuti for the wedding interview but Reshma rejects them. Angoori learns about Reshma and she talks to Vibhuti about getting Tiwari and Reshma married.

videos.title: Tiwari and Reshma's Wedding Preparation Begins
videos.overview: Tiwari and Angoori visit Vibhuti with a marriage proposal for Reshma. After a few questions and answers, Reshma agrees to marry Tiwari and everybody plans to get them married soon. David brings a cheque of INR 1 crore, but Vibhuti and Anita avoid him.

videos.title: Tiwari and Reshma's Wedding
videos.overview: The Modern Colony residents gather for Tiwari and Reshma's wedding. They take turns to dance and celebrate. Tiwari places a gold ring on Reshma's horn and the wedding ceremony comes to an end. Later, Tiwari is stunned by the call Ammaji receives.

videos.title: Marrying a Buffalo
videos.overview: In this full episode of Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hai, Tiwari gets rid of his 'grih dosha'. He refuses to marry Reshma, breaking Anita and Vibhuti's dreams. Anita offers INR 5 crores to convince Tiwari, and he agrees. Later, the greed for money lands all of them in trouble.

videos.title: Angoori Sees a Nightmare
videos.overview: Angoori gets scared after seeing a nightmare and tells Vibhuti about it. Meanwhile, Gupta, one of Tiwari's clients, asks Tiwari to take his wife Ramola to see Kanpur. Teeka and friends bring Happu to inaugurate their detective agency.

videos.title: Vibhuti Gets Busy With Spying On Tiwari
videos.overview: Anita gets annoyed at Vibhuti for taking extra interest in the neighbours. She lays down a condition before him. Vibhuti sees Tiwari with Ramola and poisons Angoori's mind against him. Later, Vibhuti tells Teeka and friends to spy on Tiwari.

videos.title: Tiwari's Truth Surfaces Before Angoori
videos.overview: Vibhuti takes Angoori to the hotel where Tiwari is present with Ramola. Vibhuti does not get a gift for Anita. She scolds him after Meenal insults her for it. Later, due to some incidents, Vibhuti feels that Tiwari wants to kill Angoori by feeding her poison.

videos.title: Angoori Hires People to Spy On Tiwari
videos.overview: Tiwari tries to feed Angoori some 'kheer' after mixing the medicine given by Ammaji. Vibhuti shows Anita a few pictures of Tiwari and Ramola and she believes him. Angoori asks Teeka and friends to spy on Tiwari. Anita calls Ammaji and tries to reveal the truth to her.

videos.title: Episode 1332
Angoori Gets Rebuked For Spending Money Carelessly
videos.overview: Tiwari refuses to pay a grocer and the matter is taken to the police. Tiwari scolds Angoori for spending his money extravagantly. Meanwhile, Saxena becomes a crime reporter. A news report about Happu is published in the newspaper. Commissioner thinks of a way to improve the image of the police.

videos.title: Angoori Becomes a Police Officer
videos.overview: Commissioner asks Angoori to join the police force to improve the image of the police department. Tiwari refuses to let her join the police force but he agrees when Vibhuti lists the benefits of Angoori's job. Later, Angoori arrives at the police station and everyone welcomes her.

videos.title: Angoori Allows Teeka and Friends to Commit Crime
videos.overview: Angoori asks a dhaba owner to provide food to Teeka and friends. Tiwari tries to spend time with Angoori. Vibhuti gets excited to see her picture in a newspaper. Crime reporter Saxena asks Angoori a few questions. She allows Teeka and friends to commit minor crimes.

videos.title: Teeka and Friends Plan a Kidnapping
videos.overview: A man brutally beats Tiwari. Teeka and friends plan to kidnap Seth Ghanshyamdas for money. At night, David's essential belongings get stolen from Vibhuti's house. Teeka and friends learn that Seth Ghanshyamdas has died. Angoori visits Vibhuti regarding the theft.

videos.title: Angoori Helps The Robbers
videos.overview: Angoori tells David that she will find the thief but he has to pay half the money to the thief. She later helps two bank robbers. Teeka and friends plan to steal a statue from the museum. Tiwari tells Angoori to quit her job. Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan learn that the statue kept in the museum is fake.

videos.title: Angoori Gets Jailed
videos.overview: Angoori refuses to quit the police job. Commissioner, after helping the robbers, ousts Angoori from her position and gets her jailed. Vibhuti tells Tiwari to offer Commissioner a bribe of INR 10 lakhs to bail Angoori out. Later, Tiwari and Vibhuti tell each other the reason behind drinking alcohol.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Tiwari Promise to Quit Drinking
videos.overview: Anita scolds an intoxicated Tiwari and ousts him from her room. Angoori gets nervous to see Vibhuti in her room. The next day, Angoori refuses to forgive Vibhuti and Anita refuses to forgive Tiwari. They both promise to quit drinking. Later, they plan to drink again.

videos.title: Anita Warns Vibhuti From Consuming Alcohol
videos.overview: Despite Anita's warning, Vibhuti drinks alcohol with Tiwari. Upon reaching home, Tiwari and Vibhuti lie to their respective wives that they have not consumed alcohol. But Anu and Angoori receive a video which states otherwise. Later, Saxena decides to teach a drunk Teeka and his friends a lesson.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti's Excuse For Addiction
videos.overview: Mini suggests Anita to talk to Vibhuti lovingly to make him quit drinking. Ammaji suggests the same to Angoori. The next day, Tiwari and Vibhuti suggest their wives to serve drinks to make them quit it. Saxena thrashes Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan for drinking. Anita and Angoori test their husbands.

videos.title: Liquor Ban Imposed In Kanpur
videos.overview: Anita and Angoori see their husbands secretly drinking. The next day, they threaten liquor minister Chandrabhan of not voting for him, and he declares a liquor ban in Kanpur. This news upsets the men of the city. Saxena distributes sweets to everyone to celebrate the ban.

videos.title: Teeka and Malkhan Steal Liquor From Masterji's House
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti buy liquor from a man from the grey market. A shortage of liquor upsets Teeka and Malkhan. They decide to steal from Masterji's house. Angoori and Anita tell their husbands that the man selling the liquor was Saxena and it was their plan. Teeka and Malkhan steal a liquor bottle.

videos.title: Angoori Gets a Cheque Of Inr 2 Crores
videos.overview: As suggested by a faqir, Tiwari donates 100 bananas to Malkhan because of greediness. Advocate Dayakrupa from Virpur, tells Angoori that her uncle has sent a cheque of INR 2 crores for her. Vibhuti also distributes bananas but he suffers loss in the share market. Angoori decides to donate the money.

videos.title: Tiwari's Plan to Extract Money From Angoori
videos.overview: Tiwari offers Vibhuti INR 10 lakhs in exchange for convincing Angoori to give Tiwari INR 1 crore. The next day, Ammaji tells Angoori to give it to him as a loan. Meanwhile, Vibhuti suggests Tiwari to pretend to get himself abducted. Angoori overhears it and decides to teach them a lesson.

videos.title: Angoori Refuses to Pay Ransom Money For Tiwari
videos.overview: A disguised Vibhuti arrives to abduct Tiwari. Angoori tells him to first play Snakes and Ladders with her. Vibhuti abducts Tiwari and demands ransom from Angoori. She refuses to do his bidding and tells him to kill Tiwari. Teeka and friends start a new job.

videos.title: Tiwari Abducts Vibhuti
videos.overview: Prem tells Vibhuti that Angoori may have fallen in love with someone else and Vibhuti gets happy. He tells Tiwari to kidnap him. Tiwari kidnaps Vibhuti. However, Angoori still refuses to give the ransom money.

videos.title: Angoori Reveals The Truth to Tiwari and Vibhuti
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti are disheartened due to Angoori's behaviour. To reduce their stress, Saxena calls Teeka and friends, but it doesn't help. Angoori tells them that she knew their plan and was deliberately playing a prank.

videos.title: Modern Colony Residents' Dream to Fly
videos.overview: Angoori and Anita express their desire to fly. Saxena tells Tiwari and Vibhuti that he has become a pilot and he can help anyone fly in a helicopter for INR 25 thousand. Teeka and friends ask for money from Masterji.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Buy Helicopter Tickets
videos.overview: Vibhuti arranges INR 25,000 by lying to Anita and gives Angoori 2 helicopter tickets. Even Tiwari visits Anita with helicopter tickets. Anita faints and Dr. Gupta advises her to stay away from heights.

videos.title: Prem Lands In Trouble
videos.overview: Dr. Gupta asks Anita to overcome her fear of heights. Vibhuti practices flying with Angoori. Anita questions Prem about Vibhuti's money after seeing him safe. Tiwari and Vibhuti lie about their respective tickets.

videos.title: Teeka and Friends Trouble Happu
videos.overview: Tiwari asks Anita to climb a table and clean the fan to overcome her fear of heights. However, she falls down while doing so. Teeka and friends unintentionally foil a disguised Happu's plan once again.

videos.title: The Truth About Saxena's Job
videos.overview: Chhedi visits Anita's house and Vibhuti's lie surfaces. Anita tells Vibhuti to return her INR 25,000. Teeka and friends beat up Happu, who is disguised as a goon. Saxena reveals that he does the job of cutting vegetables.

videos.title: Anita Threatens to Divorce Vibhuti
videos.overview: Saxena reveals about his job to Tiwari and Anita. Anita tells Vibhuti on a call that if he wanders around unemployed, she will divorce him. Tiwari terminates Tillu and Angoori tells Tiwari to give this job to Vibhuti.

videos.title: Vibhuti Becomes Tiwari's Servant
videos.overview: Tiwari offers Vibhuti a job and he accepts it. Later, Tiwari treats Vibhuti like a servant during his stint at Tiwari's shop. Out of the fear of losing his job, Vibhuti does the odd jobs at Tiwari's house.

videos.title: Vibhuti Becomes a Millionaire
videos.overview: Tiwari insults Vibhuti and ousts him from his position. Saxena promises an upset Vibhuti to help him. Later, he visits Vibhuti's house and reveals that Vibhuti's uncle Harry has left a property worth INR 110 crores for him.

videos.title: Vibhuti Avenges His Insult
videos.overview: Vibhuti steps out wearing a suit and asks Tiwari a few questions before investing money in his business. Even Helen and David try to impress Vibhuti. Vibhuti visits Tiwari's house for a meal and deliberately insults him.

videos.title: Tiwari Learns Vibhuti's Truth
videos.overview: Tiwari hears Vibhuti telling Angoori that he is not a millionaire. Tiwari plans to expose Vibhuti. Later, he and Helen team up to put up an act of her kidnapping. He demands a ransom of INR 10 crores from Vibhuti.

videos.title: Vibhuti Puts an End to His Pretence
videos.overview: Vibhuti demands INR 10 crore from Tiwari but he refuses. Later, he confesses about his pretence before everyone. Anita calls Tiwari and asks him to fix the wall clock of her house. Saxena starts behaving like a child.

videos.title: Tiwari Starts Behaving Like a Child
videos.overview: Vibhuti drops a hammer on Tiwari's head. Tiwari regains consciousness and starts to behave like a child. Vibhuti tricks Teeka and Malkhan and snatches their money. Later, they disguise as robbers to get their money back.

videos.title: Tiwari's Behaviour Upsets Angoori
videos.overview: Angoori gets upset with Tiwari's behaviour. Tiwari and Saxena become friends. David gives the property papers to Vibhuti. Saxena and Tiwari unknowingly spoil the property papers. Ammaji tells Angoori a superstitious remedy.

videos.title: Teeka and Malkhan Abduct Tiwari
videos.overview: Vibhuti babysits Tiwari to help Angoori. David gets property papers for Vibhuti but Tiwari and Saxena make paper planes out of it. Vibhuti locks Tiwari in bathroom. Teeka and Malkhan abduct Tiwari to get ransom from Vibhuti.

videos.title: Teeka and Friends Abduct Tiwari
videos.overview: Vibhuti gets worried after Tiwari goes missing from his house. Teeka calls as a kidnapper and asks a ransom of INR 1 lakh from Vibhuti for Tiwari's release. Vibhuti leaves with the money but someone snatches it from him.

videos.title: Tiwari's Condition Gets Normal
videos.overview: Vibhuti and David hide about Tiwari's kidnapping from Angoori. Later, Tiwari, who had become a child, becomes normal again and returns home. Vibhuti learns that Teeka and Malkhan had abducted Tiwari.

videos.title: Angoori's Cooking Video Goes Viral
videos.overview: Vibhuti suggests Angoori to make videos of her cooking and upload it on social media. Tiwari discourages her, but Ammaji's fear makes him approve of it. Later, Angoori's cooking video goes viral.

videos.title: Anita Makes a Video
videos.overview: Teeka and friends ask Vibhuti to make them famous as well and Vibhuti asks them about their talents. To prove herself competent, Anita makes a video on female security and beats Tiwari. Ammaji suggests a unique idea.

Both men are attracted to each other’s wives and leave no chance to impress them, which often lands them in funny situations.

videos.title: Happu Opens The Parcel
videos.overview: David tells Teeka and friends to do a big job to join his gang. Tiwari puts the parcel given by David under a tree and as he leaves, Happu opens it. Later, Teeka and friends steal Prem's money.

videos.title: Franchesco Arrives to Take Revenge On Veto

videos.overview: Anita and Angoori tell each other that Tiwari and Vibhuti have gotten back to normal. Saxena takes up the task of bringing a change in the nation. Masterji asks Teeka and friends to prepare 50 clay pots.

videos.title: Tiwari Saves Vibhuti's Life
videos.overview: Tiwari saves Vibhuti's life after a snake bites him. Later, Bhoorey eve teases Helen. This angers David and he visits Tiwari's house to eve tease Ammaji. Helen asks Bhoorey to apologise to her.

videos.overview: Teeka and friends arrive at the Modern Colony to sell pots. Bhoorey and David get into a scuffle which leads to breaking of the pots. Vibhuti tries to return Tiwari's favour but falls prey to his ploy.

videos.title: Angoori Gets Abducted
videos.overview: David and Bhoorey break Teeka and friends' pots while fighting. Helen suggests Vibhuti abduct Tiwari and save him to return Tiwari's favour. However, instead of Tiwari, Angoori gets abducted.

videos.title: Vibhuti Gets Captured While Trying to Save Angoori
videos.overview: A kidnapper asks Tiwari a ransom of INR 5 lakh to free Angoori. Vibhuti goes to save her but learns that the kidnappers are real as they hold him captive. David reveals the truth to Bhoorey and Ammaji.

videos.title: Vibhuti Helps Ammaji Get Rid Of Constipation
videos.overview: With Happu's help, Tiwari rescues Angoori and Vibhuti. Vibhuti mixes laxatives in Ammaji's tea while trying to mix it in Tiwari's tea. Ammaji thanks Vibhuti for helping her in curing the constipation.

videos.title: Ammaji's New Superstitious Remedy
videos.overview: Tiwari demands his money back from Vibhuti. Ammaji tells Tiwari a superstitious remedy for success. According to it, he has to cook food and feed them personally. Angoori apprises Vibhuti of it.

videos.title: The Pretence Of Malkhan's Death
videos.overview: Tiwari gives Vibhuti a two-day extension to return his money. Later, he feeds Teeka and friends, and Malkhan pretends to be ill. Teeka and Tillu lie to Angoori that Malkhan has died.

videos.title: Tiwari Sees Malkhan's Corpse
videos.overview: Teeka, Tillu and Vibhuti accuse Tiwari of Malkhan's murder. On Tiwari insistence, they hand over Malkhan's corpse. Later, Tiwari learns that Malkhan is alive.

videos.title: Vibhuti's New Pretence
videos.overview: Vibhuti, Tillu and Teeka go to collect INR 10 lakhs from Tiwari, who lays down a condition before them. Vibhuti begins the pretence of Malkhan's fake family. Later, Tiwari decides to teach him a lesson.

videos.title: Teeka and Friends Plan to Dupe Saxena
videos.overview: Tiwari tells Vibhuti that he has chosen Saxena for Malkhan's widow. Teeka and friends, along with Vibhuti, plan to extract INR 10 lakhs from Saxena. Tiwari decides to foil their plan.

videos.title: Vibhuti Gets Exposed
