videos.overview: Angoori dreams that she is a resident of planet Mars. She tells Vibhuti about her dream. Anita advises Tiwari to praise Angoori. Teeka and friends prepare to disguise as aliens.

videos.title: The Misadventures Of Manmohan and Vibhuti
videos.overview: Vibhuti tells Angoori that he is an alien from Mars. He tells Anita not to help Tiwari. Later, Vibhuti gets Angoori to see Teeka and friends, who have been roaming around posing as aliens.

videos.title: Episode 1717
Episode 1718
Episode 1719
Angoori Tells Tiwari About Her Pregnancy
videos.overview: Angoori tells Tiwari that she is pregnant, which upsets Vibhuti. Bhoorey recalls his son, Juttan, who was lost soon after he was born. Later, the midwife tells Helen that Vibhuti is not her son.

videos.title: Helen's Revelation Hurts Vibhuti
videos.overview: Helen tells Vibhuti that he is not her son, which breaks his heart. Ammaji thinks of naming Angoori's child as Jummanphal. Later, Modern Colony residents attend Angoori's baby shower celebration.

videos.title: Vibhuti Turns Out to be Angoori's Brother
videos.overview: Vibhuti tells everyone that he is not Helen's son. Bhoorey sees a birthmark and says that Vibhuti is his son, Juttan. David and Helen leave the house. Later, Angoori addresses Vibhuti as a brother.

videos.title: Angoori's Brother Vibhuti Takes Care Of Her
videos.overview: Anita tells Vibhuti that Helen and David have left the house. Bhoorey asks Vibhuti to take care of Angoori as her brother. Teeka and friends ask Prem for money to make arrangements for David's food.

videos.title: Vibhuti Learns The Truth Behind The Mark
videos.overview: When the mark on Vibhuti's body disappears, he realises that he is not Bhoorey's son. Tiwari, David, Helen and Ammaji confess to planning it all. Later, Modern Colony residents celebrate 'Lohri'.

videos.title: The Misadventures Of Manmohan and Vibhuti
videos.overview: Teeka and Malkhan bring Vibhuti home as he faints while watching a film. After regaining consciousness, he behaves like a character of the film 'Jewel Thief' and addresses Angoori as his lover, Mona.

videos.title: The Misadventures Of Manmohan and Vibhuti
videos.overview: Angoori roams around in Mona's guise and Vibhuti asks her to dance. Anita lives like a house help. David tells Vibhuti that he is not the Jewel Thief. Vibhuti asks him to work as a servant too.

videos.title: The Misadventures Of Manmohan and Vibhuti
videos.overview: Vibhuti does not let Angoori go home. Angoori tells Ammaji that Tiwari is behind Vibhuti's condition. At Vibhuti's behest, Teeka and friends steal a pair of slippers, which belongs to Masterji.

videos.title: Masterji Learns About Vibhuti's Pretence
videos.overview: Along with Teeka and friends, Vibhuti executes a robbery at Tiwari's house. Later, Dr Gupta asks Vibhuti for money to lie about his illness and Masterji overhears it. Angoori talks about her problem.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Pretence Gets Exposed
videos.overview: Vibhuti tells Angoori that she can marry anyone but their relationship will remain. Tiwari visits Anita with his complaint, and Masterji tells them the truth. Later, Vibhuti's pretence is exposed.

videos.title: Angoori Finds Her Grandfather's Diary
videos.overview: Angoori finds her grandfather's diary while cleaning an old chest. At Ammaji's behest, Angoori reads the diary and gets engrossed in the tales about her grandma. A distraught Tiwari visits Anita.

videos.title: Angoori Thrashes Happu and Vibhuti
videos.overview: Angoori hallucinates her grandpa. Tiwari is glad to meet Sunny Leona, the commissioner's British brother-in-law. Angoori beats Happu and Vibhuti mistaking them for British. Tiwari seeks Anita's help.

videos.title: Angoori Thrashes Sunny Leona
videos.overview: Tiwari likes his neighbour, Vibhutis ultramodern wife, Anita, and Vibhuti likes Tiwaris simple wife, Angoori. Their quest to impress each others wives often leads to hilarious situations.

videos.title: Angoori's 'mission Azadi'
videos.overview: Angoori refuses to pay taxes to Vibhuti and beats him. Later, she inspires the people of the chawl to fight for freedom. At Tiwari's behest, the commissioner comes home again with Sunny Leona.

videos.title: Vibhuti Tampers With The Diary
videos.overview: Angoori beats Sunny Leona again. Tiwari and Vibhuti tamper with Angoori's diary and she forgets her whim about her grandfather. A goon runs away after beating Happu and Masterji lands in trouble.

videos.title: Tiwari Becomes a Donor
videos.overview: Ammaji asks Angoori to be a miser. David suddenly becomes poor. Baba Khare Khoteshwar advises Tiwari to become a donor. Vibhuti plans to extract money from Tiwari for David.

videos.title: Vibhuti and David Become Beggars
videos.overview: Vibhuti and David become beggars to extract money from Tiwari. Teeka and Tillu are upset when Angoori refuses to give food. Anita instructs them to catch the beggars and shares her plan with Vibhuti.

videos.title: Vibhuti Asks Tiwari For Inr 9 Lakh
videos.overview: Vibhuti and David ask Tiwari for a gold chain, and he gives Angoori's chain. Anita lashes out at Tiwari after seeing him give money to a beggar. Later, Vibhuti and David ask Tiwari for INR 9 lakh.

videos.title: Vibhuti and David Get Exposed
videos.overview: Ammaji hits Vibhuti and David when they ask her for alms. They feel happy to receive money from Tiwari. Vibhuti and David reveal their true identities to everyone when Teeka and Tillu thrash them.

videos.title: It is Important to Get Vaccinated
videos.overview: Vibhuti and Tiwari tell Rusa their plan against Teeka and friends, who avoid taking the vaccine. Later, Rusa invites Teeka, Tillu, and Malkhan to meet one by one and gets them all vaccinated.

videos.title: Angoori is Criticised
videos.overview: Vibhuti promises Angoori to take her to the movies. Later, he learns that she wishes to dine out. Vibhuti initiates a ploy. Tiwari doesn’t take Angoori out for dinner because she is not modern.

videos.title: Angoori's Modern Avatar
videos.overview: Anita Chides Tiwari and tells him that he would give Angoori a make-over. Angoori’s modern avatar angers Tiwari. Later, Ammaji arrives in her modern avatar as well, and David fawns over her.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Plan Backfires
videos.overview: Vibhuti borrows money from Prem to take Angoori and Ammaji to a five-star hotel, but ends up washing utensils to pay the bill. Later, Teeka arrives at Tiwari’s house disguised as Hukum Batata.

videos.title: Tiwari Worries About Angoori's Friends
videos.overview: While Tiwari worries about Angoori’s new African friend, she also brings an Arab friend. Tiwari lovingly talks to effeminate Saxena as Angoori and Vibhuti looks on. Angoori’s new friend arrives.

videos.title: Episode 1744
Angoori’s Devotion For Tiwari
videos.overview: Angoori sings a devotional song for Tiwari, which irks Vibhuti. Anita tells Tiwari that poetry is only good when it is laced with pain, and he begins a quest to get insulted.

videos.title: Episode 1746
Episode 1747
Saxena Exposes Tiwari
videos.overview: On David’s advice, Vibhuti provokes Angoori and she insults him. In front of Zafar, Vibhuti recites his poetry but gets chided. Saxena reveals that Tiwari plagiarised his unpublished book.

videos.title: The Quest For Angoori's Earrings
videos.overview: Vibhuti promises to get Angoori the earrings that she wants. He steals the earrings from Teeka and friends by tricking them. Later, Vibhuti learns that Tiwari has already bought Angoori the earrings.

videos.title: Episode 1750
Episode 1751
Episode 1752
Anita Stops Vibhuti From Entering The House
videos.overview: To protect her reputation before an investor, Anita does not allow Vibhuti to enter the house. The commissioner meets Tillu and Malkhan for Rusa's wedding. The investor is shocked to see Vibhuti.

videos.title: Vibhuti Ousts David From The House
videos.overview: Anita's investor cancels the deal when Vibhuti's truth is revealed. Tiwari and the others apologise to Vibhuti, who throws David out of the house and the latter seeks shelter at Tiwari's house.

videos.title: Vibhuti Wears a Sapphire Ring
videos.overview: Vibhuti wears a sapphire ring to change his luck and is then beaten up by a few goons. Later, he visits Angoori and the pot falls on his head. Tillu and Malkhan fool Masterji.

videos.title: Vibhuti Reluctantly Removes The Ring
videos.overview: A kid adds chilli to the food prepared by Angoori and she feeds it to Vibhuti. Vibhuti removes the ring on David’s insistence. Happu chides Teeka and friends for their mischief.

videos.title: Vibhuti and David Dupe Tiwari
videos.overview: Vibhuti and David dupe Tiwari by selling him the fake sapphire ring. Tiwari learns about their ploy after overhearing their conversation. Rusa gets Teeka and friends thrashed by her ex-boyfriend.

videos.title: Vibhuti Decides to Take Back The Ring
videos.overview: Tiwari teams up with Saxena and Angoori to teach Vibhuti and David a lesson for duping him. Misfortune strikes onto Teeka and friends again. Vibhuti and David decide to take the ring back from Tiwari.

videos.title: Episode 1759
Vibhuti Publishes His Own Magazine
videos.overview: Everyone asks Vibhuti to pay back his debt, and Anita tells them not to lend him any more money. Prem hands over his idle printing press to Vibhuti, and he publishes his own sensational magazine.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Magazine Maligns Tiwari
videos.overview: Vibhuti falsely publishes a story in his magazine, about Masterji getting thrashed by his wife. Anita finds David hidden in the fridge. Later, Vibhuti publishes a sensational article about Tiwari.

videos.title: Happu Falls Prey to 'chalu Chikni Chachi'
videos.overview: Vibhuti clicks Rusa and Happu’s picture and publishes it with a scandalous angle. Later, he learns some gossip from Anita and David's conversation. Happu decides to investigate 'Chalu Chikni Chachi'.

videos.title: Tiwari Plans to Trap 'chalu Chikni Chachi'
videos.overview: Tiwari’s photo in a saree gets published in the magazine, 'Chalu Chikni Chachi'. He deduces Vibhuti to be the culprit in front of Happu and others. With Angoori's help, he sets a trap to catch him.

videos.title: Angoori's Ocd Surfaces
videos.overview: Due to her obsessive-compulsive disorder, Angoori begins to feel repelled by dirt. Vibhuti makes a deal with Teeka and friends to throw dirt on Tiwari, but the tables turn after Angoori gets treated.

videos.title: Episode 1765
Episode 1766
Tiwari Adopts Chustarelal
videos.overview: Vibhuti and David fail to find Anokhelal. Tiwari tells Chustarelal, posing as Anokhelal, about his plan to adopt him, and he agrees. Tiwari throws a party to announce the adoption to everyone.

videos.title: Rusa Breaks Teeka and Friends' Hearts
videos.overview: Tiwari begins to suspect a disguised Chustare's identity after he threatens him and Angoori at gunpoint. Teeka and friends decide to confront Chustare but are left shocked on finding him with Rusa.

videos.title: Anita Finds The Missing Saxena
videos.overview: Rusa asks Chustarelal to seek Happu’s permission to marry her. Chustarelal bribes Happu. Later, Happu finds the money to be fake. Anita finds the real Saxena and Chustarelal’s identity is exposed.

videos.title: Episode 1770
Episode 1771
Episode 1772
The Filthy Holi Perpetrators are Caught
videos.overview: Anita and Tiwari urge Happu to investigate the filthy Holi perpetrators, but he too falls victim to them. Later, Angoori and Vibhuti fall for Anita and Tiwari's trap and the truth is revealed.

videos.title: Modern Colony Celebrates Holi
videos.overview: The Modern Colony residents celebrate Holi by dancing and reciting poetry. When Dr. Gupta recites his poetry, Angori and Anita light-heartedly insult him.

videos.title: Tiwari Bags an Opportunity
videos.overview: The Modern colony residents vie for a literacy grant. Tiwari coddles up to a government officer to get it. Vibhuti plans to work on a start-up idea. Later, Tiwari wins the grant in Angoori's name.

videos.title: Angoori's Honesty Worries Tiwari
videos.overview: Masterji and Saxena complain about Angoori having won the literacy grant. Happu and the government officer visit Tiwari to discuss their bribes but worry about Angoori's honesty.

videos.title: Tiwari Seeks Vibhuti's Help to Teach Angoori
videos.overview: Tiwari asks for Vibhuti's help to educate Angoori. He decides to make her pose as a teacher and bribes Teeka and friends to be her students. Masterji and Saxena come to test her.

videos.title: Vibhuti Teaches Geometry to Angoori
videos.overview: Vibhuti teaches Geometry to Angoori on Tiwari's request. Saxena and Masterji ask her some questions to test her knowledge and are left shocked when she answers them with Vibhuti's help.

videos.title: Teeka and Friends Expose Angoori
videos.overview: Saxena and Masterji expose Angoori's illiteracy in front of a government officer using the information received from Teeka and friends. Teeka and friends get conned by a stranger.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Tiwari Lie to Their Wives
videos.overview: Vibhuti and Tiwari fool Anita and Angoori to escape their suspicion. Rusa insults Teeka and his friends. Later, Angoori and Anita learn the truth and decide to teach Vibhuti and Tiwari a lesson.

videos.title: Anita and Angoori's Revenge
videos.overview: Angoori and Anita trick Vibhuti and Tiwari, respectively, into believing that they are having an extramarital affair. Teeka and friends expose Happu to the commissioner, earning a thrashing.

videos.title: Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hai! - April 06, 2022
videos.overview: Tiwari likes his neighbour, Vibhutis ultramodern wife, Anita, and Vibhuti likes Tiwaris simple wife, Angoori. Their quest to impress each others wives often leads to hilarious situations.

videos.title: Teeka and Friends Get Thrashed
videos.overview: Teeka and friends catcall at Masterji's wife and get thrashed. Tiwari and Vibhuti decide to speak to each others' wives about their extramarital affairs and learn that they are being blackmailed.

videos.title: Angoori and Anita's Act Comes to an End
videos.overview: Angoori and Anita reveal their ploy to Vibhuti and Tiwari. Later, the four of them perform Navratri Puja. Teeka and friends lay wounded at the hospital and Saxena tells them how he got fooled.

videos.title: David Misses Aunt Khajuri
videos.overview: David cries in aunt Khajuri's memory. Teeka and friends drink and cry due to Rusa's betrayal. Angoori tells Anita about the essence of Ram Navmi. Vibhuti asks Saxena to summon aunt Khajuri's spirit.

videos.title: Aunt Khajuri's Spirit Possesses Vibhuti
videos.overview: Tiwari gets upset after Anita calls him 'classless'. Saxena, Vibhuti and David summon aunt Khajuri's spirit, but her spirit possesses Vibhuti. David verifies her identity through several questions.

videos.title: Tiwari to Pose As Anita's Husband
videos.overview: Anita learns about Khajuri's possession of Vibhuti's body and confronts Saxena about it. Later, she asks Tiwari to pose as her husband in front of her guest.

videos.title: Khajuri Leaves Vibhuti's Body
videos.overview: Anita introduces Tiwari as her husband, to her guest, Champaklal. Saxena exorcises Khajuri from Vibhuti. Champaklal visits Tiwari's house and he refuses to accept himself as Angoori's husband.

videos.title: Bhoore Reveals The Truth
videos.overview: Tiwari asks Vibhuti to act as Angoori's husband. Bhoore exposes the husband swap, and Champaklal's wife asks him to end the business deal. Teeka and his friends help Rusa despite her betrayal.

videos.title: The Employment Sage's Miracle
videos.overview: Anita taunts Vibhuti for being unemployed. A man proclaims the presence of the 'Employment Sage' and Vibhuti, Teeka and friends visit him. Soon after, they receive certain job opportunities.

videos.title: Vibhuti Gives Up His Job
videos.overview: Vibhuti, Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan start their first day at work. Later, they learn about a policy that gets money deposited in all unemployed people's bank accounts, and Vibhuti gets himself fired.

videos.title: Tiwari Pretends to be Unempoloyed
videos.overview: Tiwari asks Amma to act like she has usurped his property in order to claim unemployment. Teeka and friends encounter problems at their jobs. Anita confronts Vibhuti about his lost job.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Get Kidnapped
videos.overview: In pursuit of the unemployment scheme, Vibhuti, Tiwari, Teeka and friends get abducted. Anita and Angoori look for Vibhuti and Tiwari and later approach the police. The kidnappers enforce labour.

videos.title: Vibhuti, Tiwari and Others are Rescued
videos.overview: Anita, Angoori and Happu manage to find the kidnappers and get them arrested, rescuing everyone. Vibhuti and Tiwari mistake a legitimate government officer for a fraud and thrash him.

videos.title: Anita Tries to Ignite Romance In Her Marriage
videos.overview: Anita decides that she will not tolerate the lack of romance in her married life. Vibhuti mocks Tiwari for doing manual labour despite having employees. Teeka and friends approach Prem for a job.

videos.title: Tiwari Manipulates Vibhuti
videos.overview: Tiwari praises Vibhuti and gets him to run errands for him. Anita and Vibhuti go out for a movie, but Vibhuti leaves the theatre midway, much to her dismay. Angoori tries to please Tiwari but fails.

videos.title: Tiwari Tells Happu About Vibhuti's Habit
videos.overview: Tiwari interrupts Anita and Vibhuti's romance to get him to fix something. After Happu arrests Vibhuti, Tiwari tells him about Vibhuti's tendency to work for praise.

videos.title: Anita and Angoori Hold Their Husbands Captive
videos.overview: Anita and Angoori lock their husbands in their houses. Teeka and friends continue to make unsuccessful calls as a part of their jobs. Tiwari informs Masterji and Dr. Gupta about Vibhuti's habit.

videos.title: Vibhuti Teaches Tiwari a Lesson
videos.overview: David reveals to Vibhuti, Tiwari's plan of manipulating him. Thereafter, Vibhuti deliberately messes up the tasks given to him by Tiwari and others. Later, Teeka and friends lose their job.

videos.title: Angoori Pulls Pranks On Vibhuti
videos.overview: Angoori mocks Vibhuti's cowardice and pulls pranks on him. Teeka and friends go to thrash Tiwari to get Tillu's pay, but Happu intervenes. Vibhuti visits Angoori disguised as carpenter Janeman Mahua.

videos.title: Vibhuti Threatens Tiwari With a Bomb
videos.overview: Ammaji asks Angoori to spike Tiwari’s food with an aphrodisiac. Vibhuti threatens Tiwari with a bomb, posing as a bomber, Saiyan Psycho. Angoori mistakes Tiwari's fear for his disinterest.

videos.title: Angoori's Uncle Visits Her
videos.overview: Tiwari calls Saxena to help diffuse the bomb under his chair. Angoori's uncle visits her, and Vibhuti welcomes him. Tiwari's rude behaviour upsets him. Tillu attempts to die by suicide.

videos.title: Happu to Help Tiwari
videos.overview: Vibhuti continues to impress Angoori's uncle while Tiwari stays stuck to the chair. Vibhuti questions Saxena about his 'Use me' movement. Happu learns about the bomb and suggests a solution to Tiwari.

videos.title: Tillu Comes Down From The Cliff
videos.overview: With Happu's help, Tiwari learns that the bomb under his chair was fake. He then does the same to Vibhuti, to teach him a lesson. Tillu falls down from the cliff on Happu.

videos.title: Vibhuti Aims His Gun At Teeka
videos.overview: Angoori, Tiwari, Anita, and Vibhuti discuss about a Dubai vacation. Vibhuti aims his gun at Teeka and friends, and Angoori spots him. Anita and Vibhuti give David an ultimatum.

videos.title: The News About Contract Killer 'goli Mishra'
videos.overview: Everyone sees the news article about Vibhuti being the contract killer 'Goli Mishra'. Anita, scared of Vibhuti, asks David to stay for longer. Angoori prepares custard for Tiwari on his birthday.

videos.title: Happu Discovers Manohar's Mistake
videos.overview: Teeka and friends badmouth Happu and tell him the news about Vibhuti. Modern Colony residents flatter Vibhuti in fear. Manohar's mistake comes to light and Happu tries to correct it.

videos.title: Vibhuti Receives a Contract to Commit Murder
videos.overview: Happu and Manohar confess their mistake, and it is learnt that Vibhuti is not 'Goli Mishra'. Later, Vibhuti receives a contract to murder the commissioner and tells Anita and David about it.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Blackmailer is Caught
videos.overview: A stranger blackmails Vibhuti to kill the commissioner. The commissioner invites everyone to his birthday party, where he, along with Vibhuti and Happu, orchestrates an act to nab the blackmailer.

videos.title: Prem Spoils Anita's Plans
videos.overview: Angoori wishes to recite her poetry to Tiwari, but he mocks her. Anita tries to charm Vibhuti, but he gets busy on a phone call with Prem. Frustrated, she vents about it to Tiwari.

videos.title: Kanpur Cricket Club Accepts Teeka and Friends
videos.overview: Angoori tries to recite her poetry to Vibhuti, but he leaves with Prem. Tiwari and Vibhuti chide each other for ignoring their respective wives. Teeka and friends get selected for the cricket club.

videos.title: Prem's Wife Wears Anita's Saree
videos.overview: Tiwari gifts a saree to Anita. Prem asks Vibhuti to arrange a saree as a present for his wife. The next day, Anita recognises her saree while it's worn by Prem's wife.

videos.title: Vibhuti to Throw a Party For Anita
videos.overview: Vibhuti continues to run errands for Prem. Anita chides Vibhuti for stealing her saree and giving it to Prem. Moreover, she decides to leave the house. Later, Tiwari invites Anita to Vibhuti's party.

videos.title: Prem Arrives At Vibhuti's Party Uninvited
videos.overview: As per Anita's bet, Vibhuti does not invite Prem to the party. However, Prem enters the party nonetheless, and Vibhuti tells Prem's wife about his doings. Later, Tiwari gives Prem some advice.

videos.title: Trouble Befalls Teeka and His Friends
videos.overview: Tillu's mischief causes Ammaji to lash out at Angoori. Anita's saree catches fire, and she chides Tillu and Vibhuti for it. Masterji and Dr Gupta taunt Malkhan. Later, a car meets with an accident.

videos.title: Teeka and Friends' Fortunes Change
videos.overview: Ammaji apologises to Angoori. Tiwari hires Chandu. Khosla decides to offer Teeka and his friends a job in America in exchange for saving his life. Teeka and his friends ask Anita for help.

videos.title: Vibhuti and David Pose As Servants
videos.overview: Anita grooms Teeka and friends, who eagerly look forward to leaving for America. Anita requests Vibhuti and David to pose as her servants. Later. Anita's client mocks the two.

videos.title: Modern Colony Attempts to Stop Teeka and Team
videos.overview: Anita's client makes Vibhuti and David dance for him. Angoori recollects the time when Teeka and team had helped her. Modern Colony organises a party for Teeka and team to stop them from leaving.

videos.title: Teeka and Team's Farewell Party
videos.overview: The Modern Colony organises a farewell for Teeka and Team and asks them not to leave. Khosla tells Teeka and Team that they won't be able to go to America. Chandu's charges leave Tiwari stunned.

videos.title: Angoori Falls Prey to Stress
videos.overview: Vibhuti tells Anita that Angoori is in stress. Anita confronts Tiwari about quarrelling with Angoori. Dr. Gupta informs everyone that Angoori is a victim of stress.

videos.title: Vibhuti Becomes Shararat Shikarpuri
videos.overview: Vibhuti asks Angoori to take up dancing. Disguised as a tabla player, Shararat Shikarpuri, he arrives at Angoori's house. Behenji obstructs Teeka and Team's plan. Tiwari meets Shararat Shikarpuri.

videos.title: Tiwari Becomes Anita's Music Teacher
videos.overview: Tiwari disguises himself as a music teacher and arrives at Anita's house. Meanwhile, Vibhuti plays the tabla and Angoori dances. Later, Tiwari advises Anita to flirt with her neighbour.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Tiwari Face a Dilemma
videos.overview: Anita and Angoori,along with their respective husbands, wait for their gurus. Caught in a dilemma, Vibhuti and Tiwari make excuses and leave the house. Later, they both return in disguise.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti's Act Comes Undone
videos.overview: Disguised as teachers, Vibhuti and Tiwari perform a duet. Anita reveals that she has been invited to London for a performance. While their passports get made, Vibhuti and Tiwari's act comes undone.

videos.title: Episode 1825
Anita's Ploy Foils
videos.overview: Anita and Vibhuti pretend to quarrel to make David leave their house. On Ammaji's advice, Angoori dresses up in modern clothes. Following the quarrel, David decides to stay in the house further.

videos.title: Tiwari Gives Anita an Idea
videos.overview: Tiwari gives Anita an idea to oust David from the house. Anita organises a party for David's birthday and Modern Colony attends it. Later, Tiwari puts the lights off at Anita's house for some time.

videos.title: Angoori Gets Accused Of Theft
videos.overview: At the party, Anita's bracelet gets stolen and is found in Angoori's pocket. Angoori's video goes viral, and some ladies call her a thief. Later, the person who made the video viral gets caught.

videos.title: Episode 1829
Happu Becomes a Housemaid
videos.overview: Anita and Angoori decide to hire a house-help to test their husbands. Terrified of wrestler Garra's threat, Happu asks Anita for help. Later, Happu comes to Anita's house as the house-help.

videos.title: Tiwari Hires Malta As House Help
videos.overview: David flirts with a disguised Happu. Later, Happu introduces himself as Malta, a house help and Tiwari hires Malta as house help. Tiwari and Angoori visit Anita. Malta asks Tiwari to sing for her.

videos.title: Episode 1832
Vibhuti and Tiwari Learn Happu's Secret
videos.overview: Malta tries to grow closer to Vibhuti and Tiwari. Vibhuti tells Tiwari that they have been conspired against. They then learn that Happu is indeed Malta, and deliberately flirt with him.

videos.title: Episode 1834
David Falls In Love With Mala
videos.overview: Angoori's aunt Mala visits her. David senses a lack of love in his life. Later, David and Mala fall in love with each other, and he tries to break this news to Anita and Vibhuti.

videos.title: Vibhuti Instigates Bhure Against David
videos.overview: Tiwari learns that Mala loves David. He demands INR two crores for David and Mala's union. Vibhuti instigates Bhure against David, and Bhure refuses to accept David and Mala's relationship.

videos.title: Anita's Plan About David's Marriage
videos.overview: At Angoori's behest, Anita and Vibhuti visit Bhoore to discuss David and Mala's marriage. Anita deliberately causes bad omens. She soon decides not to let David marry Mala and tells Happu her plan.

videos.title: Happu Arrests David For Harrassment
videos.overview: Vibhuti arrives in a woman's disguise and Happu arrests David for harassing him. Bhoore tries to free David by bribing Happu. Later, he approaches the commissioner for help.

videos.title: Episode 1839
Episode 1840
Episode 1841
Episode 1842
Manhus Kanpuri Scares Everyone
videos.overview: The lights go out at night and Manhus Kanpuri scares everyone. Tiwari suggests that a strict action be taken against Vibhuti. Baba Shahrukh Salmani suggests a way to stop Manhus Kanpuri.

videos.title: Tiwari Stabs Vibhuti
videos.overview: The Modern Colony residents gather and recite poetries to Manhoos Kanpuri. As per the plan, Anita and Angoori perform 'mujra' to distract him. Tiwari stabs him and he leaves Vibhuti's body.

videos.title: Anita Pretends to have an Affair With Happu
videos.overview: Minal advises Anita to have an affair with someone to test Vibhuti. Anita asks Tiwari to have an affair with her but then changes her mind. Later, she involves Happu in her pretence.

videos.title: Vibhuti Suspects Anita and Happu
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti see Anita talking to someone on the phone and they get suspicious. Later, both find Happu and Anita at the same place. Vibhuti tells David that Anita and Happu are having an affair.

videos.title: Happu Kisses Anita
videos.overview: Happu visits Anita's house. Later, they pretend to kiss each other and Tiwari is shocked to see this. Vibhuti sees Anita and Happu dancing in his dream. Tiwari is unable to recover from the shock.

videos.title: Happu Comes to Anita's House For Dinner
videos.overview: Anita invites Happu for dinner and makes Vibhuti cook the whole meal. Happu flirts with Anita at the dinner table. This breaks Vibhuti's heart, and David gives him an idea.

videos.title: Episode 1855
Anita's Papers Go Down The Gutter
videos.overview: Tiwari tells Anita that her documents are with Ammaji. Shocked on seeing Ammaji trapped in the gutter, Tiwari brings the municipal officer, Gyanchand. Anita asks Tiwari for her documents.

videos.title: Gyanchand Tells Rusa The Truth
videos.overview: Tiwari, Anita, Angoori and Vibhuti decide to sleep near Ammaji trapped in the gutter. Tiwari imagines dancing with Anita and Vibhuti dreams of dancing with Angoori. Gyanchand tells Rusa the truth.

videos.title: Episode 1852
Episode 1853
The Modern Colony Residents Entrap Vibhuti
videos.overview: Happu, Tiwari and the others at the Modern Colony plan to catch Vibhuti in his lion form. Even Saxena prepares to abduct Vibhuti. Later, everyone entraps Vibhuti together, and he tells the truth.

videos.title: Ammaji is Stuck In The Gutter
videos.overview: Anita gives Tiwari a few important papers. Vibhuti gets Teeka and the team to start cleaning the drains. Ammaji dances over the gutter and gets stuck in it because of the open lid.

videos.title: Gyanchand Tells Rusa The Truth
videos.overview: Tiwari, Anita, Angoori and Vibhuti decide to sleep near Ammaji trapped in the gutter. Tiwari imagines dancing with Anita and Vibhuti dreams of dancing with Angoori. Gyanchand tells Rusa the truth.

videos.title: Anita's Papers Go Down The Gutter
videos.overview: Tiwari tells Anita that her documents are with Ammaji. Shocked on seeing Ammaji trapped in the gutter, Tiwari brings the municipal officer, Gyanchand. Anita asks Tiwari for her documents.

videos.title: Gyanchand Tells Rusa The Truth
videos.overview: Tiwari, Anita, Angoori and Vibhuti decide to sleep near Ammaji trapped in the gutter. Tiwari imagines dancing with Anita and Vibhuti dreams of dancing with Angoori. Gyanchand tells Rusa the truth.

videos.title: Pelu Pulls Ammaji Out Of The Gutter
videos.overview: Gyanchand advises Ammaji to follow a diet. Angoori makes kachoris for Ammaji and Anita asks Vibhuti to steal them. Later, Ammaji comes out of the gutter with Pelu's help.

videos.title: Ammaji Asks Tiwari Not to Fight
videos.overview: Ammaji sees a nightmare. Vibhuti pretends to forget the wedding anniversary in front of Anita. Ammaji asks Tiwari to not fight with anyone. Later, Vibhuti tries to provoke Tiwari.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Murder At Tiwari's Hands
videos.overview: Anita informs Angoori about Vibhuti's actions. David and Ammaji flirt with each other. At Vibhuti's provocation, Tiwari pushes him, and he pretends to be dead. Later, Ammaji and Angoori run away.

videos.title: Happu Interrogates Tiwari
videos.overview: Teeka and team see Tiwari disposing of Vibhuti's body. They inform Happu, who tells David and Anita about it. Happu, David and Anita come to Tiwari's house to interrogate him.

videos.title: Episode 1863
Vibhuti Comes In Front Of Everyone At The Party
videos.overview: At Vibhuti's behest, Angoori feeds Tiwari spicy food. Anita invites Tiwari and Angoori to her and Vibhuti's anniversary celebration. Vibhuti discloses the truth in front of everyone at the party.

videos.title: Episode 1865
Episode 1866
Episode 1867
Episode 1868
Episode 1869
Suresh Kabadi Occupies Modern Colony
videos.overview: The people of Modern Colony learn that Suresh Kabadi owns the colony's land. Suresh Kabadi forcibly enters Tiwari's house. Anita calls Happu, but he does not take action against Suresh Kabadi.

videos.title: Suresh Kabadi's 'quit Game'
videos.overview: The Modern Colony residents gather to demand their rights from Suresh Kabadi. Suresh Kabadi orders everyone to play a 'Quit Game' and gives the first challenge to Masterji. Rusa beats Tika and Tillu.

videos.title: Anita's Plan Against Suresh Kabadi
videos.overview: Masterji fails to complete his task. Suresh Kabadi challenges Prem to ride a bicycle for 75 hours. As per Anita's plan, the commissioner tells Suresh Kabadi that two foreigners wish to buy the colony.

videos.title: Episode 1873
Episode 1874
Vibhuti Deliberately Kisses Gulbiya
videos.overview: Anita notices a kiss mark on Vibhuti's cheek and believes it is Gulbiya's. Vibhuti deliberately kisses Gulbiya, and Anita notices it. Later, Tiwari talks to Anita about this.

videos.title: Episode 1876
A Kiss Mark On Tiwari's Cheek
videos.overview: Tiwari fantasises about dancing with Anita. Vibhuti requests David to give him space in the shop. Angoori puts medicine in Tiwari's eyes. Angoori is taken aback by the kiss mark on Tiwari's cheek.

videos.title: Chumban Kumari's Spirit Possesses Angoori
videos.overview: Professor Pinky Pathak informs Vibhuti about Chumban Kumari, a witch. Chumban Kumari's spirit possesses Angoori, and she kisses Anita. Later, Angoori learns about Chumban Kumari from Vibhuti.

videos.title: Chumban Kumari Threatens to Kill Vibhuti
videos.overview: Vibhuti, Anita and Tiwari talk about Chumban Kumari, who threatens to take Vibhuti's life. Later, Chumban Kumari's lover approaches her and she leaves with him.

videos.title: Episode 1880
Episode 1881
Angoori Acts Like a Monkey
videos.overview: Tiwari gets shocked on seeing Angoori acting like a monkey and informs Anita about it. Tika and the team tell Tiwari about the attack on them. Anita asks Angoori to harass Tiwari's customer.

videos.title: Tiwari Becomes a Monkey For Angoori
videos.overview: Dr Gupta instructs Tiwari to act like a monkey in order to cure Angoori. Professor Vigyaan Agyaani informs Vibhuti that the forest is cursed. Later, Vibhuti sees Tiwari behaving like a monkey.

videos.title: Vibhuti Imprisons Tiwari
videos.overview: Vibhuti declares Tiwari a monkey and imprisons him. Vigyaan Agyaani attempts to murder Vibhuti, but Anita saves him. Later, Anita and Angoori tell Tiwari about their act.

videos.title: Vibhuti Disguises Himself As a Woman
videos.overview: Ammaji tells Angoori that she can't become a mother for the next two years. Teeka and Tillu get jobs in the bank. Tiwari and Angoori think about surrogacy. Later, Vibhuti disguises himself as a woman.

videos.title: Tiwari Gets Trapped In Vibhuti's Plan
videos.overview: Vibhuti disguises himself as a woman and introduces himself to Anita as Prakriti. Tiwari discovers Prakriti is a surrogate mother. Prakriti demands INR 10 lakh from Tiwari to become his surrogate.

videos.title: Anita's Request to Prakriti
videos.overview: Tiwari and Angoori practice how to deal with children. Anita grows suspicious of Prakriti. Prakriti goes to Tika and Tillu's bank for money. Later, Anita asks Prakriti to be her surrogate mother.

videos.title: Prakriti's Voice Shocks Angoori
videos.overview: Anita calls Vibhuti to inform him about the surrogate mother. Tiwari and the others take Prakriti to the doctor for a checkup. Later, Angoori is shocked to hear Prakriti speak in Vibhuti's voice.

videos.title: Episode 1889
Tiwari Lands In Big Trouble
videos.overview: Tiwari lands in trouble while saving the life of a man. Angoori suspects Tiwari’s behaviour. Happu arrives to arrest Tiwari. Meanwhile, Tiwari appoints Vibhuti as his driver.

videos.title: J.k. Blackmails Tiwari
videos.overview: Tiwari gets terrified when Tika informs him about the discovery of a man's corpse. J.K. blackmails Tiwari into working for him by showing him a video. Later, the commissioner plans to apprehend J.K.

videos.title: Tiwari Reveals The Truth to Everyone
videos.overview: Anita and Angoori learn about Tiwari's drug business. They, along with others, put on an act. As a result, Tiwari ends up telling everyone how he got involved in the business.

videos.title: The Police Stop Anita
videos.overview: Tiwari arrives at Anita's house and asks her to deliver the drugs. The police stop Anita during the check, but she saves herself. Later, Vibhuti gets caught by the police, but he escapes.

videos.title: J.k. Gets Arrested
videos.overview: People from Modern Colony disguise themselves to deal with J.K. and arrive at the restaurant. Anita and Angoori engage J.K. in talks. At the same time, the police arrive and arrest J.K.

videos.title: Tiwari Becomes a Filmmaker
videos.overview: Anita tells Tiwari that she will go to Mumbai to pursue acting. Vibhuti tells Angoori about some fellow neighbours’ love story. Later, Vibhuti tells Anita that Tiwari has become a filmmaker.

videos.title: Anita to Play The Lead Role In Tiwari's Movie
videos.overview: Tiwari refuses to give Angoori a role in the film. He chooses Anita to play the lead role in his movie. Vibhuti also joins the film as a writer. Later, Tiwari announces the film in front of the media.

videos.title: Ammaji Tortures Tiwari
videos.overview: Anita is surprised to learn that the film's hero is Prem. When Vibhuti narrates the film story, everyone keeps interrupting. Ammaji tortures Tiwari for not choosing Angoori as the film's heroine.

videos.title: Everyone Points Out Flaws In Vibhuti's Script
videos.overview: Tiwari informs Vibhuti that his film's other heroine is Angoori. When Vibhuti narrates the story of the film, everyone points out its flaws. Vibhuti feeds the creative team to get them on his side.

videos.title: Episode 1899
Will Tiwari be Able to Find Karamchand
videos.overview: Anita starts a new business and Tiwari becomes her business partner. Tiwari brings Pandit Ramphal to Anita’s house. Pandit Ramphal asks them to make Karamchand their third partner.

videos.title: Vibhuti Becomes Karamchand
videos.overview: Angoori tells Tiwari about her love, Lalit. Anita advises Vibhuti to name himself Karamchand. During Lalit's birthday party, Tiwari reveals Vibhuti's new name. Later, Angoori slaps Vibhuti.

videos.title: The Reason For Angoori's Hatred Towards Karamchand
videos.overview: Angoori informs Tiwari that a man named Karamchand made Lalit's korma and ate it. Later, she slaps Vibhuti again. At Anita's behest, Angoori and Tiwari arrive at her place for dinner.

videos.title: Vibhuti Requests to Change His Name
videos.overview: Angoori beats Vibhuti with a stick, worsening his condition. Vibhuti asks Anita to change his name again. Pandit Ramphal explains the financial loss that will occur if they change Vibhuti's name.

videos.title: Vibhuti Brings a Goat For Angoori
videos.overview: Vibhuti brings a goat and convinces Angoori that he is Lalit. As soon as he changes his name from Karamchand to Vibhuti, Anita receives bad news related to business.

videos.title: Tika and Tillu Threaten Tiwari
videos.overview: Anita asks Vibhuti for INR 5 Lakhs in order to purchase a plot of land. Tika and Tillu threaten Tiwari to return Raka's money. Tiwari deceives Anita and ends up getting caught.

videos.title: Raka Visits Tiwari's House
videos.overview: Tika and Tillu beat Dr Gupta for not returning Raka's money. Raka visits Tiwari's house and misses his wife on seeing Angoori. Tiwari requests Vibhuti to pretend to murder him.

videos.title: Vibhuti is Accused Of Murdering Tiwari
videos.overview: Raka instructs Tika and Tillu to kill Tiwari. Tiwari takes everyone on a picnic, where Vibhuti pretends to murder Tiwari. Later, the police arrest Vibhuti.

videos.title: Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hai! - September 29, 2022
videos.overview: Tiwari likes his neighbour, Vibhuti's ultramodern wife, Anita, and Vibhuti likes Tiwari's simple wife, Angoori. Their quest to impress each other’s wives often leads to hilarious situations.

videos.title: Tiwari Recalls His Memories On Seeing Raka
videos.overview: Tiwari romances Angoori while addressing her as a stranger. Furthermore, he teases Anita. Saxena shares his strange plan with Vibhuti. Tiwari recalls his memories on seeing Raka on the television.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Plan to Organise a Dandiya Event
videos.overview: Angoori expresses her wish to play Dandiya in front of Tiwari. Vibhuti intends to organise Dandiya in the colony for Angoori. Later, Tiwari decides to sponsor the program for Anita's sake.

videos.title: Anita's Photo Shoot For Tiwari
videos.overview: Anita refuses to advertise for Tiwari's inner garments brand. Vibhuti tries to convince Anita for the sponsorship. Later, Anita performs a photo shoot for Tiwari's company.

videos.title: Anita Gets Injured During The Photoshoot
videos.overview: Anita falls down during the photoshoot and her hand gets fractured. Tiwari refuses to give money to Vibhooti for the event. Anita’s hand gets healed, and Tiwari rejoices over it.

videos.title: Anita's Hand Gets Injured Due to Saxena
videos.overview: Anita and Angoori practice playing Dandiya. Anita's hand gets injured due to Saxena. On seeing Anita and Angoori all decked up, Tiwari and Vibhuti get mesmerised.

videos.title: Episode 1914
Vibhuti Takes Angoori to The Zoo
videos.overview: Tiwari hits a gorilla instructor with his bike. After regaining consciousness, he demands INR 5 lakh from Tiwari. Vibhuti takes Angoori to the zoo, where they meet a gorilla.

videos.title: Episode 1916
The Gorilla's Strange Demand
videos.overview: The gorilla demands Angoori to dance in front of him. Anita informs Happu that Vibhuti has gone missing. Tika and Tillu express their suspicion about Tiwari. Happu arrives to search Tiwari's house.

videos.title: The Gorilla Releases Vibhuti
videos.overview: The Gorilla demands that Angoori tie a 'rakhi' to Vibhuti. David takes on Vibhuti's identity and talks to the officer. Later, the Gorilla leaves Vibhuti at the instructor's behest.

videos.title: Episode 1919
Tiwari Witnesses Bc Murdering a Man
videos.overview: Tiwari witnesses a gangster named BC murdering a man. In terror, he hides at home, and Angoori spreads rumours about his disappearance. Later, Happu registers a complaint about Tiwari's missing.

videos.title: Episode 1921
Bc's Plan to Kill Tiwari
videos.overview: BC devises a plan to kill Tiwari. Vibhooti sees Angoori and Madan Mohan romancing and tells Anita about it. To investigate this matter, Anita spies on Tiwari’s house.

videos.title: Episode 1923
Tiwari is Exposed and Bc Gets Caught
videos.overview: While cleaning Anita's house, Tika and Tillu find a gun in BC's backpack. Due to an incident, Tiwari reveals the truth to everyone. Later, BC goes to shoot Tiwari, but Tika and Tillu catch him.

videos.title: Episode 1925
Angoori and Anita's Dreadful Words
videos.overview: Anita accuses Vibhuti of meeting Prem. Vibhuti and Tiwari get terrified by Angoori and Anita's words. At the graveyard, Teeka and Tillu sell jalebis to Saxena. Later, Tiwari flees from Anita.

videos.title: Anita and Angoori Meet a Tantrik
videos.overview: Angoori reminds David that he die at any time. A Tantrik secretly observes Angoori and Anita. Later, Tiwari and Vibhuti notice Anita and Angoori with a Tantrik and go to the graveyard.

videos.title: Saxena Gives an Electric Shock to Vibhuti
videos.overview: Saxena gives an electric shock to Vibhuti. Prem and Masterji are surprised by Angoori's harsh words. Later, Tiwari gets into trouble due to Saxena. He grows furious after hearing Angoori's words.

videos.title: Angoori and Anita Reveal The Truth
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti meet Ojha. Angoori and Anita's words grow harsher. Later, they both tell the truth to everyone. On the occasion of Diwali, Saxena teaches everyone to share happiness.

videos.title: Angoori Saves Narang From Getting Robbed
videos.overview: Tiwari gets angry with Angoori about spending money. Anita starts a campaign against alcoholics. At Anita's behest, Masterji beats a drunk David. Angoori stops a thief who flees with Narang's money.

videos.title: Episode 1931
Tiwari is Scared to See Angoori
videos.overview: Tiwari misidentifies Vibhuti as Angoori and gets close to him. Vibhuti sees Angoori's new appearance. Later, Tiwari expresses his grief to Anita. He then goes to the club and is scared to see Angoori.

videos.title: Episode 1933
Happu Arrests Angoori
videos.overview: Happu arrests Angoori after she beats Prem for molesting a girl. Anita tells Prem's wife about his actions and Angoori is released. Later, Tiwari apologises to Angoori.

videos.title: Tiwari Receives a Threatening Letter
videos.overview: Tiwari receives a threatening letter. Tillu tries to smack Tiwari. Later, Tiwari bathes in public because of the letter he receives. Angoori feeds chili to Vibhuti, who then gets a letter.

videos.title: The Modern Colony is In Trouble
videos.overview: Teeka and Tillu carry Rusa in front of the commissioner. A helpless Vibhuti insults Anita. Later, Masterji is assigned a strange task in the letter. The commissioner also gets into trouble.

videos.title: Happu Suspects Pelu
videos.overview: Due to Letterman, Tiwari becomes a dog and barks in front of Anita. Anita, Angoori, and Tiwari visit the police station. Later, Teeka kisses Tiwari. Happu interrogates Pelu as he suspects him.

videos.title: Vibhuti Goes On a Hunger Strike
videos.overview: Due to David’s foolishness, Tiwari gets locked in the bathroom of Anita’s house. Vibhuti goes on a hunger strike against Letterman. Later, everyone beats up Vibhuti feeling scared of Letterman.

videos.title: Letterman Gets Caught
videos.overview: Saxena decides to help others catch Letterman. Happu arrests Saxena and claims that he is Letterman. On learning about it, the real Letterman reveals himself and Happu sends him to the mental asylum.

videos.title: Anita is Fed Up Of David's Actions
videos.overview: Anita gets the bills of David's lavish expenses. He overhears Anita asking Vibhuti to oust him from the house, and Vibhuti talks to him. Teeka and Tillu ask Prem for money to start a fruit business.

videos.title: Angoori Misses Bhoora and Gets Upset
videos.overview: Vibhuti tries to gets David to leave the house. As Angoori misses Bhoora, she makes a statue of him and takes care of it. Dr Gupta tells Tiwari to make an elder person pose as Angoori’s father.

videos.title: David Pretends to have a Heart Attack
videos.overview: David prepares to leave the house. Vibhuti and David put on an act about the latter having a heart attack. Tiwari brings David home for Angoori. Angoori overspends while looking after David.

videos.title: Tiwari Gets Irked With David
videos.overview: Tiwari gets irked because of David and informs Anita about it.  Furthermore, an incident occurs with David, and Tiwari takes him in Saxena's ambulance. Tiwari's words enrage Anita.

videos.title: Anita and Vibhuti Kidnap David
videos.overview: Vibhuti learns that David has won the property case, and Anita regrets it. Tiwari refuses to send David back to Anita's house. Later, Anita and Vibhuti kidnap David.

videos.title: The Investor Shukla Arrives At Anita's House
videos.overview: Anita asks Vibhuti and David to cook food for the investor. Anita is startled to see Tiwari and Angoori also come over for dinner. Later, everyone has dinner with the investor, Shukla.

videos.title: Anita Starts 'mishra Chaat Bhandar'
videos.overview: The investor, Shukla, impressed with Tiwari, decides to invest money in his business and Anita gets enraged. Later, Anita, along with David and Vibhuti, starts 'Mishra Chaat Bhandar'.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Life Changes
videos.overview: A peon from the Income Tax Department warns Tiwari. On the first day of Mishra Chaat Bhandar, Vibhuti earns well. Later, Angoori goes to Mishra Chaat Bhandar, while Anita treats Tiwari rudely.

videos.title: Angoori vs Anita
videos.overview: Anita and Angoori fight over a saree, and Angoori wins by paying a higher price. Anita invites Tiwari and Angoori for dinner. Later, Angoori buys new phones for herself and Tiwari.

videos.title: Saxena's Plan Against Anita and Angoori
videos.overview: The Modern Colony people attend Anita and Vibhuti's anniversary party. On seeing Anita and Angoori competing for money, Saxena devises a plan. Later, 'Mishra Chaat Bhandar' closes down.

videos.title: Angoori Dreams Of Tiwari Being a Pauper
videos.overview: Angoori dreams of Tiwari being a pauper and calls Ammaji. Vibhuti has a dream in which Angoori refers to him as her son. Later, Tiwari's business faces losses. A prediction scares Vibhuti.

videos.title: Tiwari Looks For a Son
videos.overview: Ammaji demands Tiwari adopt a guy over the age of twenty. Anita lashes out at Vibhuti for giving her some rice pudding. Tiwari, with Prem's help, determines if Teeka can be adopted.

videos.title: Episode 1952
Tiwari Slaps Vibhuti
videos.overview: Tiwari completes the adoption process for Vibhuti. Later, Vibhuti puts forth a condition, and everyone accepts it. Enraged with Vibhuti, Tiwari slaps him. Vibhuti starts spending Tiwari's money.

videos.title: Episode 1954
Episode 1955
The Modern Colony Residents Become Beggars
videos.overview: At the sage's behest, the people of Modern Colony, except Anita, agree to become beggars and everyone starts begging. Later, the commissioner orders Happu to rid Kanpur of beggars.

videos.title: Tiwari Begs to Anita For Food
videos.overview: Tiwari begs to Anita for food, and she offers him roti. Teeka and Vibhuti accuse Tiwari of making errors while estimating their collective profits. Saxena gives blankets and food to all the beggars.

videos.title: The Beggars Get Into a Fight
videos.overview: Anita asks Vibhuti to come home to meet her investor, Rohit. As Vibhuti refuses, she introduces David to Rohit. The beggars get into a fight. Later, Happu faces a challenge.

videos.title: Anita Becomes The Murderer Anna
videos.overview: Anita transforms into the murderer Anna and kidnaps Masterji and Angoori. The beggars go to Baba Malinga and learn about Saxena's deeds. Anita presents Masterji and Angoori in front of everyone.

videos.title: Episode 1960
Vibhuti's Chip Gets Damaged
videos.overview: A change occurs in Vibhuti's body after getting an electric shock. A man molests Angoori in front of Tiwari. Mannu tells Anita that Vibhuti's chip has malfunctioned, and he has turned into a robot.

videos.title: Robot Vibhuti Guards Angoori
videos.overview: Tiwari hires robot Vibhuti to guard Angoori, and Anita charges Tiwari a high fee. Vibhuti beats up every man who comes near Angoori. Later, Tiwari makes an offer to Anita.

videos.title: Episode 1963
Vibhuti Turns Into a Time Bomb
videos.overview: Tiwari, Teeka and Tillu get chips installed in their bodies. They give themselves electrocuted to become robots. Later, Mannu tells Anita that Vibhuti has turned into a time bomb.

videos.title: Episode 1965
Tiwari Arrives At Anita's House For Breakfast
videos.overview: Angoori and Tiwari dine at Anita's house. The next day, Tiwari again arrives at Anita's house with Angoori for breakfast. Teeka and Tillu tell Masterji and Dr Gupta about an application.

videos.title: Episode 1967
Vibhuti Puts His Life In Danger to Earn Money
videos.overview: Anita tells Vibhuti that he will have to earn money to feed Angoori and Tiwari. Later, she tells Tiwari about her financial difficulties. Vibhuti puts his life in danger to earn money.

videos.title: Episode 1969
Saxena Hosts a Party At The Graveyard
videos.overview: Saxena hosts a party at the graveyard on a special occasion, and the men of Modern Colony arrive at the party. Saxena invites ghosts to the party, and Hilda's spirit is released from his grave.

videos.title: Hilda Starts His Game
videos.overview: Vibhuti, under the spell cast by Hilda's spirit, says hurtful things to Anita. Angoori repeatedly insults Vibhuti, which makes him sad. Later, Anita kicks David, causing him to fall outside the house.

videos.title: Anita Expresses Her Love For Tiwari
videos.overview: When David compliments Angoori, she kicks him. Later, she regrets her actions. While Angoori flirts with Vibhuti, Anita expresses her love for Tiwari. Hilda meets Saxena.

videos.title: The Modern Colony Becomes Hilda's Family
videos.overview: Pascal tells the Modern Colony about Hilda's spirit. Later, at Pascal's behest, everyone pretends to be a member of Hilda's family. Later, Hilda feels overjoyed on meeting her family.

videos.title: The Modern Colony and Hilda Celebrate Christmas
videos.overview: Vibhuti dances with Hilda. Hilda decides to get Angoori married to Patrick, and Prem plays Patrick's role. Later, Hilda discovers the act of the Modern Colony, and everyone celebrates Christmas.

videos.title: Rocky to Exact Revenge On Tiwari and Vibhuti
videos.overview: Saxena adopts a dog and names it Rocky. Tiwari and Vibhuti make fun of Saxena at Anita's New Year party. Later, Rocky chases Tiwari and Vibhuti to exact revenge on them.

videos.title: Episode 1976
Tiwari and Vibhuti Climb Onto an Electric Pole
videos.overview: Anita goes to work at Vibhuti's office. Later, Tiwari tells the municipal officer that he has another wife, and Angoori ousts him. Scared by Rocky, Tiwari and Vibhuti climb onto an electric pole.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Sleep On a Pole
videos.overview: Anita and Angoori feed Vibhuti and Tiwari, who are sitting on an electric pole. Tiwari and Vibhuti hallucinate about Anita and Angoori. Later, they fall asleep on the pole due to their dread of Rocky.

videos.title: Episode 1979
Vibhuti Becomes The Chief Engineer
videos.overview: A minister appoints Vibhuti as the chief engineer of Kanpur Housing and explains his plan to him. Saxena asks Tiwari to get the chief engineer's signature. Teeka and Tillu decide to become thieves.

videos.title: Saxena Tries to Get Himself Robbed
videos.overview: Anita tells Tiwari that Vibhuti is the chief engineer. Saxena orders Tika and Tillu to rob him. Later, Saxena offers Vibhuti money. Later, Manohar and the Commissioner arrive at Tiwari's house.

videos.title: Episode 1982
David Strikes a Deal With Tiwari
videos.overview: Tiwari dresses Teeka and Tillu as women and sends them to Vibhuti. Anita gets irked on seeing them. Later, David strikes a deal with Tiwari. Sundar tells Angoori about Tiwari's plan to bribe Vibhuti.

videos.title: Anita's Plan to Save Tiwari and Vibhuti
videos.overview: Manohar catches Tiwari and Vibhuti red-handed while taking and giving bribes. To save them, Anita decides to expose Khujjan Khabria. Anita, Angoori and Manohar execute their plan against Khujjan.

videos.title: Vibhuti to Get Gilli and Danda Married.
videos.overview: Vibhuti's cousin Gilli arrives home and tells him about Danda. Tiwari's cousin, Danda expresses his love for Gilli in front of him. Later, Vibhuti promises Gili to get her married to Danda.

videos.title: Tiwari Opposes Gilli and Danda's Alliance
videos.overview: Vibhuti invites Tiwari, Angoori and Danda for lunch. Teeka and Tillu fall in love with Gilli. Later, Tiwari refuses to get Danda and Gilli married. Angoori shares a plan with Vibhuti.

videos.title: Vibhuti Meets With an Accident
videos.overview: Vibhuti offers alcohol to Tiwari and talks about Gilli and Danda's marriage. However, Tiwari ousts him from the house. Vibhuti gets injured in an accident. Anita tells Tiwari about the marriage.

videos.title: Tiwari Demands Dowry From Vibhuti
videos.overview: Tiwari agrees to the marriage when Anita threatens to leave the colony. He demands INR 25 lakh as a dowry from Vibhuti. Vibhuti asks Anita to sell the land and Anita accuses Tiwari of taking dowry.

videos.title: Episode 1989
Angoori Performs Mujra
videos.overview: Ammaji teaches Angoori how to get money by doing Mujra. Vibhuti is surprised to see Angoori performing Mujra in front of Agarwal. Vibhuti informs Tiwari about Angoori's Mujra, but he favours Agarwal.

videos.title: Angoori Invites Vibhuti to Her Party
videos.overview: Vibhuti is devastated as Angoori becomes a courtesan. Angoori invites Vibhuti to see her perform 'mujra'. Later, Tiwari is shocked to see Anita dancing. Anita enquires about Tiwari's problem.

videos.title: Episode 1992
A Disguised Vibhuti Attends The Event
videos.overview: Anita brings Happu to get David arrested. Vibhuti tries unsuccessfully to break Tiwari's leg at Saxena's behest. A disguised Vibhuti comes to the party and a fight breaks out between Agarwal and him.

videos.title: Anita is Shocked to See Tiwari Performing 'mujra'
videos.overview: Angoori dances in front of Vibhuti and Agarwal. Vibhuti tells Anita that Angoori has become a courtesan. Anita goes there with Vibhuti and sees Tiwari dancing. Ammaji tells them the truth.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Tiwari Meet Baba Patwardhan Patau
videos.overview: The municipality excavates the road, creating a trench between Tiwari and Vibhuti's homes. Vibhuti and Tiwari visit Baba Patwardhan Patau. Later, due to a misunderstanding, Vibhuti slaps Tiwari.

videos.title: Tiwari Puts a Flower In David's Hair
videos.overview: Tiwari slaps Vibhuti due to a misunderstanding. Anita is scared to see a disguised David. Later, Tiwari puts the flower offered by Baba Patwardhan Patau in David's hair. Saxena requests Teeka.

videos.title: Episode 1997
Tiwari and Vibhuti Fall Into a Pit
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti fall into a pit while trying to put flowers in Anita and Angoori's hair. They get admitted to the hospital, and Anita brings Vibhuti home. Tiwari asks Angoori to take him home.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Again Fall Into The Pit
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti again fall into the pit and meet Saxena, who is already there. Teeka and Tillu learn that their job is illegal. Later, Baba Patwardhan Patau gets exposed.

videos.title: Episode 2000
Vibhuti Decides to Change Teeka's Lifestyle
videos.overview: Vibhuti observes Masterji while he bathes. Tiwari goes to Anita's house to repair the bathroom glass. Anita confronts Tiwari about his strange behaviour. Vibhuti decides to change Teeka's lifestyle.

videos.title: Vibhuti Suspects Tiwari
videos.overview: Vibhuti examines the tattoo on Teeka's body as he changes clothes. Happu catches the commissioner, believing he is a Piping Tom. Vibhuti assumes that Tiwari is the lost brother of Chimpudas.

videos.title: Episode 2003
The Real Peeping Tom Gets Arrested
videos.overview: At Dr Gupta's behest, Happu arrests Vibhuti, believing him to be Peeping Tom. Vibhuti tells everyone about Chimpudas. The police and the Modern Colony residents together catch the real Peeping Tom.

videos.title: Episode 2005
Vibhuti Receives Permission From Anita
videos.overview: Anita permits Vibhuti to celebrate Valentine's Day with Angoori. Vibhuti requests that Tiwari spend time with Anita. Saxena becomes Teeka and Tillu's girlfriend. Later, JK assigns MK a task.

videos.title: Tiwari Gets a Few Precious Diamonds
videos.overview: Tiwari goes on a date with Anita, and Vibhuti takes Angoori out. Considering Tiwari as a client, MK gives him diamonds. Anita tells Happu that she has diamonds, which he reports to the commissioner.

videos.title: Episode 2008
Happu Arrests Mk, Jk and Lk
videos.overview: MK, JK and LK come to Tiwari's house and ask about the diamonds. Teeka and Tillu arrive there and give the diamonds to David. Later, Happu comes at the right time and arrests MK, JK and LK.

videos.title: Angoori to Make a New Friend
videos.overview: Anita pays the two men who arrive to extort their money from David. Angoori decides to make a new friend. Later, Anita becomes a cultured woman, and Tiwari is surprised to see her.

videos.title: Episode 2011
Saxena Falls In Love With Champa
videos.overview: Tiwari informs Anita about the presence of a woman in her house. Anita returns home, and David tells her that Champa is Vibhuti's sister. Later, Saxena runs into Champa and falls in love with her.

videos.title: Gulabo Behaves Rudely With Anita
videos.overview: Gulabo behaves rudely with Anita. Vibhuti gets surprised on hearing Angoori's language. Tillu recognises Gulabo and Champa. Saxena talks to Vibhuti about marrying Champa.

videos.title: Gulabo and Champa Get Exposed
videos.overview: Gulabo asks Anita to cook non-vegetarian food at home. Saxena tells Happu that Vibhuti is demanding a dowry from him. At Saxena and Champa's party, a man exposes Gulabo and Champa.

videos.title: Episode 2015
Kishore Kumar's Advice to Teeka and Tillu
videos.overview: Anita and Tiwari talk about Vibhuti and Angoori's monotonous lives. Anita convinces Vibhuti and Tiwari entices Angoori to have a romantic relationship. Kishore Kumar Saxena advises Teeka and Tillu.

videos.title: Anita and Tiwari Get Special Powder
videos.overview: Kishore Kumar Saxena meets Anita and Tiwari and offers them some powder. Anita feeds the powder to Vibhuti. Tiwari also makes an attempt to feed it to Angoori. Later, a man beats Teeka and Tillu.

videos.title: The Voices Of Angoori and Vibhuti Get Ruined
videos.overview: The powder has a romantic influence on Angoori and Vibhuti. Further, Vibhuti is stunned to hear Angoori's voice. Anita and David get surprised when Vibhuti's voice transforms into a woman's voice.

videos.title: Angoori's Voice Scares Ammaji
videos.overview: Ammaji gets scared on hearing Angoori's voice. Kishore Kumar Saxena gives medicines to Angoori and Vibhuti. After taking the medicine, Angoori's voice gets cured, but Vibhuti's voice worsens.

videos.title: David Narrates Vibhuti's Dadaji's Stories
videos.overview: David narrates Vibhuti's Dadaji's stories to Anita, who makes a huge portrait of Dadaji and hangs it in her house. Teeka and Tillu collect donations for Holi. Vibhuti recites a poem to Angoori.

videos.title: The Modern Colony Residents Enjoy Holi
videos.overview: The Modern Colony residents learn about Teeka and Tillu's wrongdoings. Later, everyone celebrates Holi and dances together. Vibhuti is possessed by Dadaji's spirit.

videos.title: Dadaji's Wrondoings After Possessing Vibhuti
videos.overview: Vibhuti, possessed by Dadaji, slaps David and tells him that he is his father. David stops Anita from getting close to Vibhuti. Later, Vibhuti blackens Tiwari's face and later thrashes Prem.

videos.title: The Court In The Modern Colony
videos.overview: Anita learns of Dadaji's actions after he appears in front of her, Vibhuti and David. The Modern Colony residents complain about Vibhuti to the commissioner. A court is held regarding Vibhuti.

videos.title: Episode 2024
Episode 2025
Tiwari and Vibhuti Eat Basanti's 'golgappas'
videos.overview: Tiwari eats tasteless food prepared by David. The Modern Colony residents tell Tiwari and Vibhuti about Basanti's 'golgappas'. Both visit Basanti to have them, and Saxena visits Angoori.

videos.title: Basanti Increases The Price Of 'golgappas'
videos.overview: Saxena tells Angoori and Anita that their husbands are having an affair with Basanti. Basanti increases the price of her golgappas. Angoori and Anita ask Saxena to keep an eye on Tiwari and Vibhuti.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Sneak Out Of Their Homes
videos.overview: Angoori and Anita lock Tiwari and Vibhuti in the rooms, but they sneak out and go to Basanti. Saxena tells Angoori and Anita the truth over a video call. However, Tiwari and Vibhuti come home and lie.

videos.title: Basanti is Exposed
videos.overview: Anita and Angoori complain to Happu about Basanti. The residents of Modern Colony oppose Happu. Anita and Angoori tie up their husbands. Basanti gets exposed and is arrested.

videos.title: Oil is Found At Vibhuti's House
videos.overview: Angoori tells Vibhuti her dream. Anita's photo gets printed in a magazine, due to which Tiwari gets beaten up. Later, oil is found at Vibhuti's house. Anita informs Vibhuti and David of her next plan.

videos.title: Anita's Departure Shocks Tiwari
videos.overview: Anita tells Vibhuti and David about her plan, and they leave the house. Tiwari is upset by Anita's absence. Ammaji offers Angoori a solution. Later, Anita, Vibhuti and David disguise themselves.

videos.title: Episode 2032
Teeka and Tillu Smuggle Oil
videos.overview: Anita tells Teeka and Tillu to sell oil and earn money. On Tiwari’s insistence, Saxena dresses up as Anita and talks to him. Teeka and Tillu smuggle oil and Happu ends up doubting them.

videos.title: Tiwari Decides to Leave The City
videos.overview: Vibhuti appears in front of Angoori in his true form, but she does not recognise him. The commissioner exposes Teeka and Tillu. When Tiwari decides to leave the city, Anita and Vibhuti return home.

videos.title: Episode 2035
Episode 2036
Tiwari Gets Enraged With Vibhuti About a Video
videos.overview: Tiwari discovers the truth about the energy drink video and lashes out at Vibhuti. Anita tries to romance Vibhuti, and Tiwari watches it live. Vibhuti live streams Tiwari, who is taking a bath.

videos.title: Vibhuti Gets Arrested Due to Tiwari
videos.overview: Tiwari is shocked when Ammaji shows him his viral video. Anita tells Minal about her being frustrated with Vibhuti's blogging. On the basis of Tiwari's complaint, Happu arrests Vibhuti.

videos.title: Vibhuti Stops Making Blogs
videos.overview: Vibhuti records a video of Happu taking a bribe, and the latter falls at his feet. Anita requests Tiwari to get Vibhuti released. Later, they put on an act to make Vibhuti stop blogging.

videos.title: The People Of Modern Colony Live Like Fishermen
videos.overview: The people of Modern Colony learn about a government scheme for fishermen. Everyone starts living like fishermen. Later, Rusa discovers this and threatens everyone.

videos.title: The Modern Colony's Fish Market
videos.overview: The Modern Colony's fishermen set up a fish market. An officer arrives at the market and briefs everyone on the government scheme before questioning them. Masterji requests for the release of Rusa.

videos.title: Saxena Pulls Hilsa Into His Love Trap
videos.overview: The Modern Colony's people plan to trap Hilsa, the head of the fishermen's society. Saxena poses as a woman to pull Hilsa into his love trap. Vibhuti introduces himself as Saxena's brother to Hilsa.

videos.title: Will Anita Agree to Vibhuti's Marriage?
videos.overview: Hilsa's sister Mandeli falls for Vibhuti, and the neighbours ask Vibhuti to marry her. However, Angoori suggests him otherwise. David and Tiwari try to persuade Anita by instilling greed in her mind.

videos.title: Rusa Exposes Everyone
videos.overview: Vibhuti agrees to marry Hilsa's sister for everyone's sake. Anita decides to break the marriage, but Tiwari misleads her. Rusa reveals the truth, shattering the dreams of Modern Colony residents.

videos.title: Tiwari Decides to Open a General Store
videos.overview: Tiwari has a nightmare and decides to open a general store named after Angoori. Tiwari asks Vibhuti to work at his shop. Later, Anita threatens Vibhuti to work in the shop.

videos.title: Tiwari Inaugurates His Store
videos.overview: Vibhuti accepts a job at the shop. Tiwari inaugurates the 'Angoori General Store' and explains the benefits of buying goods from his store. Anita takes up the responsibility of protecting women.

videos.title: Tiwari Insults Vibhuti
videos.overview: Vibhuti arrives late for work, so Tiwari insults him and gives him a servant's dress. Angoori doesn't approve and opposes Tiwari. Later, Tiwari cleans the store with Vibhuti.

videos.title: Vibhuti Sets Up a New Shop
videos.overview: Tiwari accuses Vibhuti of theft and fires him from the job. Vibhuti sets up his new shop in front of Tiwari's store to take revenge. Later, Angoori starts working in Vibhuti's shop.

videos.title: Vibhuti Insults Angoori
videos.overview: At Angoori's behest, Vibhuti deliberately insults her, and Tiwari gets enraged. He complains to Anita and brings Manohar to get Vibhuti arrested. Later, Angoori reveals the truth to everyone.

videos.title: The Cricket Fever Takes Over Modern Colony
videos.overview: Anita is pleased that Timmy, the cricket team captain, is Vibhuti's brother and will be visiting their house. The upcoming cricket match in Kanpur has everyone excited. Later, everyone brings Timmy.

videos.title: Timmy is Impressed By Angoori
videos.overview: The people stand in a queue to take photos with Timmy. Later, Timmy is impressed by Angoori's cricket knowledge. Anita gets furious at Tiwari's words. Timmy and Angoori's friendship worries Vibhuti.

videos.title: Tiwari Plans to Play a Betting Game
videos.overview: Tiwari tells Vibhuti about his plan to play a betting game. Timmy tells everyone that he will field in the match, but he later changes his decision. Tiwari suffers a loss because of Timmy.

videos.title: Tiwari Gets Shocked Due to Timmy
videos.overview: The team loses because of Timmy, and Tiwari is shocked. The Modern Colony people become Vibhuti's enemies. Angoori shares an anecdote with Anita. Everyone cuts off the electricity of Vibhuti's house.

videos.title: Anita's Shocking Statement On Tv
videos.overview: The Mishra family's situation worsens. Anita claims on TV that she has nothing to do with Vibhuti and Timmy. Vibhuti leaves the house. After Timmy helps India win the match, everyone brings him back.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Promise to Professor Pichkari
videos.overview: The residents are worried about their electricity bills. Tiwari and Anita meet the electricity department official. Vibhuti promises Professor Pichkari to fulfil his wish by generating electricity.

videos.title: Vibhuti Struggles to Generate Electricity
videos.overview: Vibhuti collects money from the people of the Modern Colony to generate electricity. He works hard day and night for many days. Everyone arrives at Vibhuti's house and questions him about electricity.

videos.title: Vibhuti Makes an Electricity Generator
videos.overview: Tiwari and others ask the electricity department official to switch off their electricity. Vibhuti's machine is inaugurated, and the electricity is turned on. Soon, everyone's joy turns into sorrow.

videos.title: The Electricity Goes Off In The Modern Colony
videos.overview: The residents of the Modern Colony spend a night without electricity. David adds alcohol to the food, which Angoori and Anita eat. Tikka falls into the pit in the dark, and Dr Gupta treats him.

videos.title: Vibhuti Discovers Professor Pichkari's Betrayal
videos.overview: Anita and Angoori sleep in each other's house, leaving Tiwari and Vibhuti shocked. Vibhuti discovers Professor Pichkari's betrayal. Everyone apologises to the officials of the electricity department.

videos.title: Tiwari Feels Embarrassed
videos.overview: A few goons harass Anita in front of Tiwari. Angoori calls Tiwari a coward. Tiwari asks Vibhuti to return his money, but Vibhuti threatens him. David prepares to take everyone out for his birthday.

videos.title: Tiwari Slaps Vibhuti Tightly
videos.overview: Tiwari faints at David's party. Later, he beats up the thugs who harass Anita. When Vibhuti refuses to return the money, Tiwari slaps him tightly and his ear gets damaged.

videos.title: Tiwari Makes Vibhuti do His Work
videos.overview: Vibhuti has trouble understanding others' words because of his poor hearing. Tiwari makes Vibhuti do his work, and Anita asks Vibhuti to slap him. Vibhuti goes to Tiwari's house and gets beaten up.

videos.title: Vibhuti Spoils Tiwari's Shirt
videos.overview: Anita asks Vibhuti to befriend Tiwari. Angoori and Tiwari visit Vibhuti for dinner. Vibhuti spoils Tiwari's shirt while serving food. Later, Anita is surprised to see Vibhuti's red cheeks.

videos.title: Tiwari Stops Acting Like Hooligans
videos.overview: A few goons beat up Teeka and Tillu. Angoori tells Anita about Tiwari's dilemma. Everyone puts on an act, and Tiwari stops acting like hooligans. Vibhuti exacts his revenge by slapping Tiwari.

videos.title: Tillu Tells About Baba Nafrateshwar
videos.overview: Angoori woos Tiwari while Anita gets romantic with Vibhuti. Tillu tells Tiwari and Vibhuti about Baba Nafrateshwar. Tiwari, Vibhuti and Saxena climb the mountain to meet Baba Nafrateshwar.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti's Plans Succeed
videos.overview: Baba Nafrateshwar gives some magical ash to Tiwari and Vibhuti, who cleverly apply it to each other. Angoori and Anita hate their husbands. Tiwari and Vibhuti are happy to see each other's condition.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Tiwari Reveal The Truth to Each Other
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti tell each other the truth about their visit to Baba Nafrteshwar. Anita and Angoori talk about their hatred towards their husbands. Tiwari and Vibhuti go to meet Baba Nafrteshwar.

videos.title: Anita and Angoori's Health Deteriorates
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti reveal the truth to their wives. Anita and Angoori contract food poisoning because of eating outside food and further beat up their husbands. Later, Tiwari enters Anita's bedroom.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Meet Prem Baba
videos.overview: Ammaji scolds Vibhuti, who is standing outside Angoori's bathroom. When Vibhuti comes in front of Anita, she beats him up. Saxena tells Tiwari and Vibhuti about Prem Baba, and they visit him.

videos.title: Angoori Gets Irked With Tiwari
videos.overview: Angoori waits for Tiwari, who returns home after eating food at Teeka and Tillu's stall. A drunk Vibhuti refuses to attend a function with Anita. Later, Angoori punishes Tiwari.

videos.title: Kalawati's Advice to Anita and Angoori
videos.overview: Kalawati asks Anita and Angoori to test their husbands. Angoori prepares spicy meal for Tiwari. Vibhuti eats the tasteless chole-bhature made by Anita. Prem and Dr Gupta get into an argument.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti to do The Laundry
videos.overview: Angoori and Anita instruct Tiwari and Vibhuti to do the laundry. Later, they ask their husbands to take them shopping. Tiwari and Vibhuti again arrive at Teeka and Tillu's stall to eat.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Get Annoyed With Their Wives
videos.overview: Anita and Angoori stop testing their husbands. Tiwari and Vibhuti get enraged with their wives over small things. Saxena promises to alleviate Tiwari and Vibhuti's annoyance.

videos.title: Saxena Treats Tiwari and Vibhuti
videos.overview: At Saxena's house, Tiwari and Vibhuti eat strange food to calm their annoyance. During this time, Anita and Angoori get addicted to spicy food. Later, Tiwari and Vibhuti reveal the truth to them.

videos.title: Tiwari and Anita Worry About Money
videos.overview: Anita tells Vibhuti that the fees of her class is increased. Tiwari too gets worried over the monetary issues. Saxena gets a job at an entertainment channel, and he gives Anita and Angoori some news.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Attempt to be a Good Neighbour
videos.overview: Saxena's boss tells Anita and Angoori about their Good Neighbour competition. Vibhuti comes to clean Tiwari's yard to be a good neighbour. Even the rest of the people treat each other well.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti's Ideas
videos.overview: Vibhuti saves Tiwari from slipping and falling down. Tiwari takes coffee for Anita. Later, Tiwari and Vibhuti hire goons to beat up each other. Anita gifts a saree to Angoori.

videos.title: Bad Neighbours to Win The Competition
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti's goons beat them up, but they both pretend to save each other. Vibhuti asks Tiwari for INR 20,000. Later, they realise they have to become bad neighbours to win the competition.

videos.title: The Bad Neighbours Win The Competition
videos.overview: Anita tells Tiwari and Angoori to pretend to be bad neighbours to win a competition. Saxena is impressed by their enmity and declares them as winners. Later, he cancels the competition.

videos.title: Anita and Vibhuti's Haunted College
videos.overview: Prem invites Vibhuti and Tiwari to his birthday party. Saxena opens an Ayurvedic clinic. While returning from the party, Vibhuti and Anita show Tiwari and Angoori their old and haunted college.

videos.title: Tiwari is Possessed By Jhadeshwar's Spirit
videos.overview: Tiwari is possessed by Balmukund Jhadeshwar's spirit. Vibhuti and the rest suddenly start losing hair. Tiwari's long hair takes Anita by surprise. Later, everyone finds Tiwari's behaviour strange.

videos.title: Tiwari Takes Anita On a Date
videos.overview: The residents of Modern Colony suffer hair loss. Angoori tells Anita that Jhadeshwar's spirit has possessed Tiwari. Tiwari takes Anita on a date. Vibhuti decides to promote his shampoo.

videos.title: Vibhuti Talks About His Past Actions
videos.overview: Vibhuti wears the wig and shoots a commercial for the shampoo, but the wig falls off. Jhadeshwar invites everyone for his birthday. Vibhuti tells Angoori and Anita what he had done to Jhadeshwar.

videos.title: Tiwari's Body is Free From Jhadeshwari's Spirit
videos.overview: The residents of Modern Colony attend Jhadeshwar's party. Angoori and Vibhuti meet Jhadeshwar's ex-girlfriend, Sulochana. Everyone devises a plan to free Tiwari's body from Jhadeshwari's spirit.

videos.title: Vibhuti Develops a Passion For Photography
videos.overview: Vibhuti develops a passion for photography. Anita advises him to turn his hobby into a source of income. They approach Tiwari to rent his shop, but he imposes conditions on Vibhuti.

videos.title: Vibhuti Shoots Angoori's Pictures
videos.overview: The Commissioner inaugurates Vibhuti's studio. Angoori calls Vibhuti home to get her photoshoot done. Vibhuti takes a lot of pictures of her, but he makes a terrible error.

videos.title: Vibhuti Clicks Tiwari and Angoori's Photos
videos.overview: Angoori asks Tiwari for money to pay Vibhuti's fees. At Angoori's request, Vibhuti clicks a photo of Tiwari and Angoori sharing a romantic moment. Tiwari is stunned to see Vibhuti hiding in the room.

videos.title: Vibhuti Makes a Video Of Tiwari
videos.overview: Tiwari complains to Anita about Vibhuti and decides to shut down his shop. Vibhuti makes a video of Tiwari to take revenge on him. Later, he demands INR 50,000 from Tiwari to delete the video.

videos.title: Vibhuti is Caught
videos.overview: The residents of Modern Colony complain to the commissioner about them being blackmailed. The commissioner assigns the case to Anita, and Vibhuti is caught. Later, Anita breaks Vibhuti's camera.

videos.title: Tiwari Gets His Grandfather's Car
videos.overview: Tiwari receives his late grandfather's car from a lawyer. David pretends to leave the Modern colony. Tiwari takes Angoori on a road trip to strange places. Anita urges Vibhuti to open a cafe.

videos.title: The Opening Of Anita's Cafe
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti argue during the inauguration of Anita's cafe. Tiwari gives Anita a lift in the car. At Vibhuti's behest, Angoori decides to be a college student. Anita gives Vibhuti an order.

videos.title: Tiwari Gets Angry With Vibhuti
videos.overview: Vibhuti’s guests ruin Tiwari’s car, and he gets furious with Vibhuti. Angoori dresses as a college student and meets with Vibhuti. Later, one guest punishes Teeka as the order arrives late.

videos.title: Tiwari Complains to Happu About Vibhuti
videos.overview: Anita resolves Tiwari and Vibhuti's dispute. Tiwari complains to Happu about Vibhuti's cafe. As the commissioner's wife loves the cafe's coffee, he stops Happu from taking action against the cafe.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Cafe is Shut Down
videos.overview: Tiwari criticises Angoori's new look, and Ammaji scolds him. He entrusts Zorawar Pehalwan with the task of destroying the cafe. While the commissioner closes Vibhuti's cafe, Tiwari's car is snatched.

videos.title: David Loses His Memory
