videos.overview: Tiwari warns Angoori to be careful when he goes out of the city. David becomes a millionaire, but loses his memory due to overwhelming happiness. Later, Rusa taunts Teeka and Tillu.

videos.title: A Dancer Comes to Angoori's House
videos.overview: Vibhuti asks Prem to send a dancer home for David. Teeka and Tillu ask Saxena to teach them the Arabic language. Dancer Dimple mistakenly goes to Angoori's house.

videos.title: Angoori Sees Dimple and Vibhuti Together
videos.overview: Dimple dances for David. Anita suggests Vibhuti to pretend to be in love with Dimple in front of David. The sight of Vibhuti approaching Dimple shocks Angoori. Dimple falls in love with Vibhuti.

videos.title: Saxena Explains The Meaning Of David's Poetry
videos.overview: Angoori tells Ammaji about her suspicions regarding Vibhuti. Saxena gives Teeka and Tillu electric shocks while teaching them Urdu. Saxena explains the meaning of David's poetry. Tiwari returns home.

videos.title: David's Memory Returns
videos.overview: Vibhuti disguises himself and recites his poems in front of David, causing him to faint. When he regains consciousness, his memory returns. Teeka and Tillu share an incident of being beaten up.

videos.title: Tiwari and Angoori Become Homeless
videos.overview: The Modern Colony residents gather to celebrate the anniversary of Tiwari's house. A lawyer comes and reveals that Tiwari's house is in the name of his stepbrother, RK. Vibhuti makes a request to RK.

videos.title: Vibhuti Gives Shelter to Tiwari and Angoori
videos.overview: Tillu and Teeka approach RK for employment. Vibhuti invites Tiwari and Angoori to stay at his house, causing dissatisfaction for Anita. Tiwari requests RK not to pull off the garden's plants.

videos.title: Tiwari and Angoori's Romance At Anita's House
videos.overview: Anita sees Tiwari and Angoori romancing at their house and informs Vibhuti about it. This infuriates Vibhuti. Later, Anita witnesses Tiwari laughing with RK and questions him about it.

videos.title: Anita Frames Tiwari
videos.overview: Anita makes Angoori and Tiwari do the housework. At Anita's behest, David puts her bangle in Tiwari's pocket when the commissioner arrives for lunch. Angoori is upset to find the bangle with Tiwari.

videos.title: Tiwari Exposes Rk
videos.overview: Tiwari and Angoori leave Anita's house. When Tiwari falls sick, Angoori seeks help from everyone. Vibhuti brings them back home. Later, Tiwari proves that RK is not the owner of his house.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Plan to Extort Money From Tiwari
videos.overview: Anita takes the responsibility to eliminate superstitions in Modern Colony. Vibhuti, Teeka, and Tillu conspire to extort money from Tiwari. Later, the three of them begin to scare Tiwari.

videos.title: Vibhuti Demands Money For Exorcism
videos.overview: Tiwari and Angoori flee the house and tell Vibhuti about their problems. To get rid of spirits, Vibhuti asks Tiwari for money. The colony's people also share their experiences.

videos.title: Tiwari Tells Anita About The Ghost
videos.overview: Vibhuti practises excorcism and asks Angoori to dance. Anita berates Tiwari, who tells her about the presence of a ghost in the house. Anita asks Saxena to find those who spread superstitions.

videos.title: Ammaji Ties Tiwari Up With Ropes
videos.overview: Ammaji dances while Vibhuti practises spiritual exorcism. When Tiwari suffers an electric shock, Ammaji believes him to be a ghost and ties him up with ropes. Later, Vibhuti pretends to treat Tiwari.

videos.title: Vibhuti Feels Scared Of Angoori
videos.overview: Vibhuti pretends to expel the spirit that has possessed Tiwari. Later, he is shocked to hear Angoori's words. When Tiwari tells everyone that Angoori has been possessed, Vibhuti gets scared.

videos.title: A Scorching Hot Summer Day For Tiwari and Vibhuti
videos.overview: The sun causes Vibhuti and Tiwari to perspire. Ammaji asks Angoori and Anita to oppress their husbands. Teeka and Tillu become nurses and ask Dr Gupta for a job. Tiwari and Vibhuti cook food.

videos.title: Anita Harasses Vibhuti
videos.overview: Angoori and Anita return home after watching the movie and ignore their husbands. Anita deliberately harasses Vibhuti and he gets upset. Tiwari complains about Angoori to Ammaji.

videos.title: Tiwari Gets Beaten Up Due to Angoori
videos.overview: Angoori regrets torturing Tiwari. At a conference, Angoori accuses Tiwari of being a corrupt official, and people beat him up. Some goons attack Vibhuti, and he goes to the hospital along with Tiwari.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Make a Decision
videos.overview: Angoori slaps Tiwari. Vibhuti and Tiwari decide to divorce their wives. While they spend time with Teeka and Tillu, who are disguised as nurses, Saxena shoots them and shows the video to their wives.

videos.title: Angoori Saves Tiwari and Vibhuti
videos.overview: Vibhuti and Tiwari decide to end their lives. Angoori finds them hanging on a cliff and reveals the truth. She saves Vibhuti and Tiwari with Saxena's help. Tiwari gets into trouble due to Ammaji.

videos.title: Tiwari Gets an Idea
videos.overview: Ammaji suggests Tiwari to indulge in debauchery. Anita taunts Vibhuti of being unemployed. Vibhuti decides to open a club with the help of Teeka, Tilloo, and David.

videos.title: Naughty Girls Come to Tiwari's House
videos.overview: David tells Tiwari about the naughty girls. Teeka, Tilu, Saxena and Vibhuti dress up as naughty girls and come to Tiwari’s house which breaks Angoori’s heart. Masterji punishes Tiwari at his behest.

videos.title: Tiwari Calls The Naughty Girls Once Again
videos.overview: Vibhuti informs David about Tiwari's deeds. Angoori tells Anita about Tiwari having fun with the ladies. Despite promising Anita, Tiwari again calls the naughty girls. Vibhuti gives Angoori advice.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Angoori's Romance
videos.overview: Anita complains to Happu about Tiwari. At Angoori's behest, Vibhuti pretends to flirt with her and Tiwari sees them. Happu finds the commissioner with the naughty girls in a hotel.

videos.title: The Naughty Girls are Exposed
videos.overview: Anita visits Tiwari's house and scolds him for having fun with the girls. The cops arrive, and the naughty girls are exposed. Ammaji reveals the truth to Tiwari and asks him to have fun with the men.

videos.title: Chameli is Angoori's Doppelganger
videos.overview: The Commissioner, Happu, and Manohar see that the underworld don Malik's lover, Chameli, a look alike of Angoori. Vibhuti vows to teach Angoori English. Tikka and Tillu are delighted to get a car.

videos.title: Happu's Advice to Use Angoori to Catch Malik
videos.overview: Happu advises the commissioner to disguise Angoori as Chameli to catch Malik. Vibhuti helps Angoori in speaking English using Bluetooth. Tikka and Tillu get scared on seeing a dead body in the car.

videos.title: Tiwari Blackens Vibhuti's Face
videos.overview: Tiwari blackens Vibhuti's face, and the two get into an argument. The commissioner makes Angoori a part of his mission. Tiwari and Vibhuti are distressed when Angoori goes missing.

videos.title: Tiwari Sees Angoori Dancing At The Club
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti are surprised to see Angoori dancing at the club. They meet Angoori, who introduces herself as Chameli. When Tikka and Tillu try to dispose of a dead body, Masterji arrives there.

videos.title: Malik is Apprehended Due to Angoori
videos.overview: Don Malik mistakes Angoori for Chameli and takes her with him. With Angoori's help, the Commissioner, Happu and Manohar manage to catch Malik. Tiwari and Vibhuti learn about Angoori's mission.

videos.title: Will Tiwari Romance Maryada?
videos.overview: Vibhuti discovers that his cousin Maryada will be staying with him for a few days. At Vibhuti's behest, Angoori asks Tiwari to be romantic with Maryada. Vibhuti also makes a request to Tiwari.

videos.title: Maryada Falls In Love With Tiwari
videos.overview: Tiwari agrees to romance Maryada, who falls in love with him at first sight. Saxena suggests to Masterji that he should harass women as part of the treatment.

videos.title: Maryada's Demand Scares Tiwari
videos.overview: Angoori feels upset when she sees Maryada kissing Tiwari. Maryada takes Tiwari to the bedroom and demands that he apply vermillion to her forehead. The doctor assures Vibhuti that Maryada is fine.

videos.title: The Family Tells The Truth to Maryada
videos.overview: The family informs Maryada that Tiwari is married. The Commissioner's wife accuses Masterji of harassment. Tikka and Tillu reveal Maryada's true identity to Vibhuti and Angoori.

videos.title: Maryada Threatens to Kill Angoori
videos.overview: Maryada ties Vibhuti to her two-wheeler and drags him around the colony. Moreover, she threatens to kill Angoori and shares a plan with Saxena. Later, she gets caught and her mental state improves.

videos.title: A Solution For The Modern Colony's Boredom
videos.overview: As the modern colony is bored, Saxena's friend Nicholas suggests having a celebration. Everyone plans to get someone married. Tiwari asks the commissioner's consent for Teeka and Tillu to marry Rusa.

videos.title: The Commissioner Rejects Teeka and Tillu
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti ask questions to Teeka and Tillu. They take Teeka and Tillu's proposal to the commissioner's daughter, but the commissioner rejects them. Tiwari and Vibhuti try to convince him.

videos.title: The Marriage Of Tiwari and Vibhuti's Plants
videos.overview: Teeka and Tillu jump off the roof in an attempt to commit suicide, injuring their hands and legs. Tiwari and Vibhuti decide to get the plants in their respective houses married and preparations begin.

videos.title: Wedding Preparations In Modern Colony
videos.overview: The modern colony residents prepare for the wedding, and the celebration begins. Everyone asks amusing questions while playing Truth or Dare. David makes fun of Bhure for drinking alcohol.

videos.title: Everyone Argues Due to Ammaji
videos.overview: Bhure informs Tiwari about his humiliation. The groom's family arrives at Vibhuti's house. Due to Ammaji's mistake, the groom's and bride's families start arguing. Later, Ammaji's secret is revealed.

videos.title: Bad News For The Modern Colony Residents
videos.overview: The Modern Colony residents plan to celebrate Independence Day. Saxena informs them that the builder Kuljeet Kulta intends to demolish the Modern Colony. Tiwari and Vibhuti go to talk to Kulta.

videos.title: A Mall to be Built On The Modern Colony Land
videos.overview: Kulta insults Vibhuti and refuses to change his decision. Tiwari and Vibhuti urge everyone to confront Kulta. Kulta's engineer visits the Modern Colony to design a map for the mall's construction.

videos.title: Tiwari's Plan to Send Angoori to Kulta
videos.overview: The people of Modern Colony try to delight the colony's owners, Sir Kuda and Kulta. Tiwari tells Vibhuti about the plan to send Angoori to Kulta. Angoori dances in front of Vibhuti.

videos.title: Kulta Shoots Vibhuti
videos.overview: Angoori coaxes Kulta into revelating about the place where he has kept the colony's documents. Vibhuti and Tiwari steal the documents. Later, Vibhuti confronts Kulta, and the latter shoots him.

videos.title: Kulta Shoots Tiwari As Well
videos.overview: Kulta shoots Tiwari after Vibhuti. Angoori makes a request to everyone to protect them. Dr Gupta does the surgery on Tiwari and Vibhuti. The commissioner felicitates Tiwari, Vibhuti and Angoori.

videos.title: Tiwari's Decision to Invest In The Stock Market
videos.overview: Vibhuti informs Anita about the profits Prem gained from the stock market. At Angoori's behest, Tiwari calls Bhure home to seek advice about the stock market. The colony residents buy shares.

videos.title: Anita Abandons Vibhuti
videos.overview: Bhure helps Tiwari in selecting shares. Vibhuti also buys some shares. Ammaji advises Anita to stay away from Vibhuti for Vibhuti's well-being. Later, Anita leaves the city.

videos.title: Vibhuti Becomes The King Of The Stock Market
videos.overview: Vibhuti gives an interview on Saxena's news channel. Tiwari discovers Vibhuti's strategy for choosing shares. After talking to Anita, Vibhuti incurs losses. Later, Bhure and David argue.

videos.title: Tiwari Suffers Losses In The Stock Market
videos.overview: Vibhuti benefits from the stock market, while Tiwari faces losses. He tells the landlord that he wishes to buy the house. After being evicted from his home, Vibhuti seeks shelter in Tiwari's house.

videos.title: Vibhuti Throws a Splendid Party
videos.overview: Vibhuti gets his house back and throws a splendid party for everyone. Later, he stops Anita from leaving him. The Modern Colony residents suffer significant losses due to the stock market.

videos.title: David Tells About Maharaja Khalbali
videos.overview: David tells Vibhuti that his ancestors were servants of Maharaja Khalbali Tiwari, and Tiwari overhears this. Tiwari steals a photo of Khalbali from David's wallet and makes a large poster of it.

videos.title: David and Vibhuti Become Slaves to Tiwari
videos.overview: David learns that Tiwari is a descendant of Khalbali. He and Vibhuti become slaves to Tiwari and Vibhuti takes Angoori to the market. Teeka and Tillu steal Prem's belongings and sell them to Saxena.

videos.title: Tiwari Hits Vibhuti With a Hunter
videos.overview: Tiwari invites everyone to his house for a feast. Vibhuti makes a mistake and Tiwari hits him with a hunter. David informs Vibhuti about Khalibali's treasure. Vibhuti takes Angoori to the market.

videos.title: David Learns About Tiwari's Plan
videos.overview: Vibhuti teaches a lesson to the thugs. David learns the truth about Tiwari not being the descendant of Khalibali. David and Vibhuti get their revenge on Tiwari by making him eat spicy Gulab Jamuns.

videos.title: David and Vibhuti Plan to Harm Tiwari
videos.overview: Angoori serves spicy gulab jamuns to Tiwari. Vibhuti hits Tiwari with a hunter as a demonstration of strength. David and Vibhuti plan to harm Tiwari, but Tiwari reveals his plan to them.

videos.title: Episode 2150
