Episode 2464
Tiwari and Anita Taunt David
videos.overview: David gets emotional missing his wife, Diana. First Tiwari and then Anita taunt him. David's lawyer friend gives him some good news. Later that night, David takes his revenge by beating up Tiwari.

videos.title: David's Wealth Changes The Way People Treat Him
videos.overview: David wins the property case, and Anita and Vibhuti treat him well. David beats Tiwari in front of everyone again. Angoori complains about David to Anita, but she doesn't listen to her.

videos.title: Angoori Complains to Happu About David
videos.overview: David thrashes Tiwari again and Angoori complains to Happu about him. Soon, Happu comes to arrest Vibhuti. Later, Anita and Vibuti try to get David's money transferred to their account.

videos.title: Tiwari Disguises Himself to Hide From David
videos.overview: Tiwari disguises himself to hide from David. At Anita's party, he comments on David's wife, and David thrashes him again. Later, David tells Vibhuti about the girl of his dreams.

videos.title: Ammaji and David Become Friends
videos.overview: At Vibhuti's behest, Ammaji befriends David and the duo spends time together. Tiwari and Vibhuti make a plan. Later, David loses the property, and Anita and Vibhuti get disheartened.

videos.title: Tiwari Borrows Inr 1 Crore From Gannu Malik
videos.overview: Prem convinces gangster and musician Gannu Malik to lend INR 1 crore to Tiwari. Angoori starts seeing a child in everyone and is left shocked. Prem invests Tiwari's money in the stock market.

videos.title: Tiwari Loses His Money In The Stock Market
videos.overview: Anita tells Vibhuti and David about her business partner Praveen. Ammaji suggest Angoori a way to ask for alms. Tiwari loses his money in the stock market. Angoori tells Vibhuti a lie.

videos.title: Tiwari Scolds Angoori For Begging
videos.overview: Gannu Malik threatens Tiwari and demands his money back. Tiwari scolds Angoori for begging. Teeka and Tillu also become beggars. Tiwari asks Angoori to disguise herself and beg for money.

videos.title: Tiwari Dons a Disguise to Escape Gannu Malik
videos.overview: Tiwari dons a disguise to escape Gannu Malik. Saxena scolds Vibhuti for helping Angoori beg. Teeka and Tillu get frustrated when they don't receive any alms. Anita expresses her wishes to Vibhuti.

videos.title: Angoori and Vibhuti Give an Interview to The Press
videos.overview: A disguised Tiwari romances Angoori, only to be beaten by Vibhuti. Later, Vibhuti and Angoori give an interview to the press about begging. Subsequently, Tiwari profits from the stock market.

videos.title: Ammaji's Arrival Annoys Vibhuti and Tiwari
videos.overview: As Vibhuti recites a poetry to Angoori, and Tiwari dreams about Anita, Ammaji's arrival disturbs them. Desiring grandchildren, Ammaji makes Tiwari eat dry fruits and Vibhuti goes to Angoori's bedroom.

videos.title: Tiwari Asks David to Tease Ammaji
videos.overview: Saxena stops Tiwari from defecating in the open. Tiwari, in an attempt to force Ammaji to leave the house, asks David to eve-tease her. Ammaji cries in front of Tiwari after David does it.

videos.title: Ammaji Flirts With David
videos.overview: Ammaji flirts with David, ruining Tiwari's plan to drive her out of the house. Later, Anita argues with Vibhuti over a minor issue. Tiwari discusses David's actions with Vibhuti.

videos.title: Pandit Ramphal Sees Ammaji With David
videos.overview: Ammaji and David's romance begins to blossom. Anita relieves Tiwari's stress with her dance. At Saxena's suggestion, Pandit Ramphal comes to Modern Colony and finds David with Ammaji.

videos.title: David Distances Himself From Ammaji
videos.overview: Anita and Vibhuti inform David about Diana's condition, leading him to stop flirting with Ammaji. Ammaji meets Pandit Ramphal at Saxena's house. Tiwari suffers from stomach upset caused by Angoori.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Tiwari's Plan to Go to Nainital
videos.overview: Annoyed by Angoori and Anita, Tiwari and Vibhuti, talk badly about them. Prem suggests they go to Nainital and they lie to their families. Teeka and Tillu fall in love with the girls' dolls.

videos.title: Angoori and Anita Make a Big Decision
videos.overview: Angoori and Anita find out about Vibhuti and Tiwari's lies. When the trip is cancelled, Vibhuti and Tiwari return home. Teeka and Tillu marry the dolls. Later, Angoori and Anita make a big decision.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Worry About Their Wives' Happiness
videos.overview: Angoori cooks high-calorie food for David and Anita. Tiwari and Vibhuti get worried seeing Anita and Angoori happy without them. Teeka and Tillu distribute sweets in celebration of becoming fathers.

videos.title: Vibhuti Romances Tiwari
videos.overview: Vibhuti romances Tiwari in his sleep, leaving Angoori shocked. Later, everyone realises their mistake, and Angoori and Vibhuti return to their respective homes. David does something ridiculous.

videos.title: Vibhuti has Eyes On Tiwari's Lucky Shirt
videos.overview: Tiwari wears his lucky shirt, and Vibhuti sees him benefiting from the shirt. After failing to get a job, Vibhuti decides to steal Tiwari's shirt. Meanwhile, Teeka and Tillu land in new trouble.

videos.title: Tiwari Gives His Lucky Shirt to Vibhuti
videos.overview: Vibhuti executes a ploy and proves to Tiwari that the latter's lucky shirt is useless. Consequently, he gives it to Vibhuti. Later, Vibhuti wears the lucky shirt but gets beaten up by a few goons.

videos.title: Tiwari's Lucky Shirt Proves to be Unlucky
videos.overview: Pandit Sarvatra Chaturvedi asks Vibhuti to get rid of the shirt. Ammaji informs Tiwari that the shirt is unlucky. Later, Vibhuti gives it to Tillu, who faces a streak of bad luck after wearing it.

videos.title: Tiwari Takes Back His Lucky Shirt
videos.overview: Anita tries to return Tiwari's shirt to him, but he refuses to take it. Vibhuti convinces Angoori that the shirt brings luck. Accordingly, Tiwari takes back the shirt and his luck changes.

videos.title: Vibhuti Marries Tekayha
videos.overview: Vibhuti returns home after marrying Tekayha, and Anita leaves their home to stay at Tiwari's place. Anita is saddened by Vibhuti's betrayal. Saxena takes Tillu and Teeka to Baba Ainthanand.

videos.title: Anita's Condition Deteriorates Due to Vibhuti's Deceit
videos.overview: Anita's condition deteriorates due to Vibhuti's deceit. At Ammaji's advice, Angoori spends time with Prem, which angers Tiwari. Meanwhile, Baba Ainthanand gives Teeka and Tillu a bizarre therapy.

videos.title: A Drunk Anita Creates a Scene
videos.overview: A drunk Anita creates a scene in front of Vibhuti. Angoori talks to Prem on the phone at night, and Tiwari overhears it. Later, Tiwari and Anita come to Happu asking for help.

videos.title: Anita Decides to Divorce Vibhuti
videos.overview: Vibhuti throws a party for Tekayha and Happu congratulates them. Anita and Tiwari decide to divorce Vibhuti and Angoori. Tekayha reveals to everyone about her and Vibhuti's pretence.

videos.title: Tiwari Becomes Anita's Secret Santa
videos.overview: Tiwari, performing as Secret Santa, gives gifts to Anita, but she thinks someone else gave them. Vibhuti tells Angoori a trick to meet Santa Claus. Teeka and Tillu decorate their Christmas tree.

videos.title: Vibhuti Meets Angoori Dressed As Santa
videos.overview: Vibhuti, disguised as Santa, meets Angoori and makes her believe that Vibhuti can fulfil all her wishes. Tiwari brings a gift for Anita, which David takes. Angoori's wish lands Vibhuti in trouble.

videos.title: Tiwari Fails to Give Anita a Gift
videos.overview: Vibhuti confronts Tiwari for giving a girl's dress as a gift to David. Tiwari, out of compulsion, gives the gift he bought for Anita to David. Teeka and Tillu meet Happu in disguises.

videos.title: Vibhuti Introduces Angoori to a Lion
videos.overview: Vibhuti asks Teeka and Tillu to pretend to be a lion. He then takes Angoori to the forest, and Angoori is delighted to meet Tillu, disguised as a lion. Suddenly, a real lion appears in the forest.

videos.title: Tiwari Calls Angoori Jinxed
videos.overview: Tiwari sees Angoori's face in the morning and suffers a business loss. He calls Angoori jinxed. Vibhuti also gets injured in Angoori's presence. A snake charmer meets Teeka and Tillu.

videos.title: Vibhuti Starts 'photo Tick and Win'
videos.overview: Tiwari tells Anita that Angoori is jinxed. Vibhuti explains a game, 'Photo Tick and Win'. Teeka and Tillu perform a dance taught by a snake charmer, and everyone gathers to play the game.

videos.title: Anita is Frustrated With The Loss In a Game
videos.overview: The residents of Modern Colony play 'Photo Tick and Win'. Anita lashes out at Tiwari for not winning the game. Later, Vibhuti starts the game again. A snake enters Teeka and Tillu's house.

videos.title: Vibhuti is Stopped From Conducting The Game
videos.overview: Tiwari asks Vibhuti to cheat to help Anita win the game. Later, Tiwari is worried after seeing Angoori's condition. The commissioner stops Vibhuti from conducting the game and starts it himself.

videos.title: The Preparations For New Year In Modern Colony
videos.overview: Angoori, Anita, Tiwari and Vibhuti discuss the New Year celebrations. Vibhuti learns magic from Saxena and makes Angoori his partner. Anita decides to start a campaign for women.

videos.title: Modern Colony Residents Perform On The New Year's Eve
videos.overview: Vibhuti explains his magic trick to Angoori. Tiwari and Anita too rehearse their act. Later, the residents of Modern Colony showcase their performances on the New Year’s Eve.

videos.title: Angoori Reaches The Magical World
videos.overview: During Vibhuti's magic trick, Angoori disappears. Saxena tells Tiwari that Angoori has gone to a magical world. An upset Tiwari asks Anita to bring Angoori back.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Weird Plan
videos.overview: Tiwari mistakes an unknown woman for Angoori and hugs her, but she slaps him. Vibhuti plans to roam naked in Modern Colony and Anita gets upset. When Ammaji comes to Tiwari's house, he lies to her.

videos.title: Angoori Returns Home
videos.overview: Vibhuti roams the colony unclothed to carry out the remedy suggested by Saxena. Tiwari reports Angoori's disappearance on the news channel. Khanna brings Angoori back and reveals the whole truth.

videos.title: Angoori and Anita Taunt Their Husbands
videos.overview: At Kalavati's suggestion, Angoori and Anita taunt their husbands about getting old. Teeka tries to help a woman named Sumati. Prem asks Tiwari and Vibhuti to meet Baba Urjanand.

videos.title: Baba Urjanand Gives Medicine to Tiwari and Vibhuti
videos.overview: Baba Urjanand gives Tiwari and Vibhuti a strength-enhancing medicine. Both of them dance in front of their wives and faint while dancing. Teeka and Tillu get into new trouble.

videos.title: Angoori Manages Tiwari's Shop
videos.overview: Anita and Angoori hire Teeka and Tillu to take care of Vibhuti and Tiwari. Later, Angoori manages Tiwari's shop and Vibhuti comes there and dances with her.

videos.title: Teeka Follows Anita At Vibhuti's Behest
videos.overview: Tiwari meets Anita and later gets into an argument with Vibhuti. Angoori deliberately messes up Tiwari's business. At Vibhuti's behest, Teeka follows Anita and sees her meeting Shekhar.

videos.title: Vibhuti Confronts Anita and Shekhar
videos.overview: Tiwari sees Anita leaving the house, and Angoori lies to Tiwari about a fire in the shop. Vibhuti confronts Anita and Shekhar. Later, Angoori and Anita tell the truth to their husbands.

videos.title: Inspector Tara Kumari Arrives In The City
videos.overview: Anita and Angoori fail to woo their husbands with 'time machine' facial. Sub-inspector Tara Kumari arrives in the city to save the girls from the 'Chedu Virus', while Teeku and Tillu eve-tease her.

videos.title: Anita and Angoori's Husbands Upset Them
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti ignore their wives' efforts and lash out at them. Tadka Kumari takes Teeka with her. David advises Vibhuti and later Prem advises Tiwari.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Fail to Appease Their Angry Wives
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti's attempts to appease their angry wives fail. Tadka Kumari asks Tillu to come to her house at night. Tiwari and Vibhuti come up with another idea to reconcile with their wives.

videos.title: Tadka Arrests Tiwari and Vibhuti
videos.overview: Tadka Kumari arrests Vibhuti and Tiwari for eve-teasing Angoori and Anita. Happu asks Tadka to release them, but she blackmails him. Soon, Anita and Angoori try a trick.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Fulfil Tadka Kumari's Condition
videos.overview: Tadka Kumari agrees to release Vibhuti and Tiwari, but she asks them to spend a night at her house. Later, they recall the events that took place at Tadka Kumari's house and burst into tears.

videos.title: Tiwari and Anita Start a Warm Clothing Business
videos.overview: Tiwari and Anita start a warm clothing business. Dr Climate predicts that it won't get cold, and Tiwari informs Anita about this. Subsequently, a cold wave hits, bothering everyone in the colony.

videos.title: Angoori Develops a Hatred For Warm Clothes
videos.overview: Angoori sees David, who has disguised himself, and faints. After regaining consciousness, Angoori starts hating warm clothes. Fearing Angoori, Tiwari comes to sleep at Vibhuti's house.

videos.title: Angoori Threatens to Whip Tiwari
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti discuss the problem Angoori faced. Vibhuti and David manage the warm clothing shop. Later, Angoori threatens to whip Tiwari and forces him to strip.

videos.title: Vibhuti Hypnotises Angoori
videos.overview: Vibhuti hypnotises Angoori, who starts sharing a scary childhood incident. Happu announces in Modern Colony that he won't wear warm clothes. Later, Vibhuti tries a trick to keep himself warm.

videos.title: Vibhuti Helps Angoori Recover
videos.overview: Anita asks Tiwari to lock Angoori in the bathroom and bring her client to her house. Later, Vibhuti dons a new disguise, and Angoori recovers after experiencing another shock.

videos.title: Vibhuti Gets a Pill That Causes Fights
videos.overview: Vibhuti learns about Dr Jineshwar Pandey and gets a pill from him that causes fights. He lies to Angoori and suggests she give the pill to Tiwari. Teeka and Tillu visit Jineshwar.

videos.title: Vibhuti Consumes The Quarrel-inducing Pills
videos.overview: Angoori adds quarrel-inducing pills to Tiwari's lassi, but Vibhuti drinks it instead. Soon, Vibhuti fights with Angoori and the neighbours. Teeka and Tillu accidentally send Jineshwar into a coma.

videos.title: Tiwari Arrives At Jineshwar's Clinic
videos.overview: Vibhuti learns that Angoori had added pills to the lassi and gets angry. Tiwari visits Jineshwar's clinic and Teeka and Tillu give him the medicine he asks for. Later, Happu also comes to the clinic.

videos.title: Tiwari Imagines Anita With a Goat's Face
videos.overview: Due to Jineshwar's medicine, Tiwari imagines Anita with a goat's face. The medicine given by Teeka affects Happu's vision and he points a gun at Teeka. Later, Tiwari comes to Anita with a slate.

videos.title: Jineshwar Comes Out Of The Coma
videos.overview: Teeka and Tillu reveal the truth about Jineshwar to Tiwari and Vibhuti, and they both decide to leave the town. Due to Teeka, Jineshwar comes out of the coma and cures Tiwari and Vibhuti.

videos.title: Vibhuti Celebrates Valentine's Day With Angoori
videos.overview: Vibhuti dreams of celebrating Valentine's Day with Angoori. Angoori asks Tiwari for a surprise. The Commissioner informs Happu about Umesh Utpaati, who is planning to beat up couples in love.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Tiwari Visit Occutist Pyasi
videos.overview: Vibhuti meets Occultist Pyasi, who gives him an anklet to help him win his love. When Tiwari also visits Pyasi, she gives him a locket. David mistakes Happu for a woman and flirts with him.

videos.title: Umesh Utpaati Thrashes Tiwari and Vibhuti
videos.overview: Umesh Utpaati and his goons thrash Vibhuti and Tiwari who were roaming around to celebrate Valentine's Day. Angoori and Anita prepare for Valentine's Day. Happu and Manohar dance with each other.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Disguise Themselves
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti disguise themselves to avoid Umesh Utpaati. Later, Vibhuti helps Angoori wear an anklet and Tiwari gives Anita a locket. The commissioner asks Happu about the park incident.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti's Trick Fails
videos.overview: Angoori scolds Vibhuti, and he is shocked that his trick failed. Anita also attacks Tiwari. Vibhuti and Tiwari revisit Pyaasi, and using her trick, they resolve the issues with Angoori and Anita.

videos.title: Anita Gets Vibhuti Humiliated
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti have a singing competition. Vibhuti gets drunk and acts strangely. Tiwari provokes Anita against Vibhuti, and Anita asks him to humiliate Vibhuti. Soon, everyone humiliates Vibhuti.

videos.title: Emotionally Hurt Vibhuti Takes a Huge Step
videos.overview: Vibhuti, deeply hurt and humiliated by everyone, decides to put an end to his life. Anita and the others read Vibhuti's letter. Vibhuti shares his grief with Saxena, who then advises him.

videos.title: Saxena Disguises As a Baba
videos.overview: Tiwari feels scared after having a bad dream. Happu comes to tell Anita that Vibhuti is missing, and then Vibhuti shows up. David insults Vibhuti, who takes him to Saxena disguised as a baba.

videos.title: Vibhuti Takes David Hostage
videos.overview: Vibhuti stops Angoori from revealing her secret. Happu files a missing report for David, whom Vibhuti has taken hostage. Later, Teeka and Tillu also go missing.

videos.title: Angoori Reveals Vibhuti's Misdeeds
videos.overview: Vibhuti devises another plan and targets Tiwari. Breaking her promise to Vibhuti, Angoori tells Anita and Happu the truth about him. Vibhuti explains to everyone the reason behind his actions.

videos.title: Tiwari's New Attempt to Impress Anita
videos.overview: Anita tells Tiwari how much she loves South Indian culture. Vibhuti risks his life to save Angoori from an accident. Tiwari asks a coconut seller to teach him the South Indian language.

videos.title: Tillu Comes to Anita's House Disguised As a Nurse
videos.overview: Dr Gupta asks Anita to hire a nurse for Vibhuti. Tiwari tells Anita about an action director from southern part of India. Tillu visits Anita's house disguised as a nurse, and David falls for him.

videos.title: Tiwari Meets Anita Disguised As Raskalakkutty
videos.overview: Tiwari comes disguised as Raskalakkutty to impress Anita and saves her from a goon. Angoori is stunned to see Tiwari's new look. Anita invites Raskalakkutty for coffee.

videos.title: Angoori Causes Vibhuti to Fall From The Balcony
videos.overview: Anita finds Rasakalakutti similar to Tiwari. Vibhuti falls from the balcony because of Angoori. Later, Angoori beats Tiwari with a stick. Impressed by Rasakalakutti, Anita invites him for dinner.

videos.title: Manohar Comes to Arrest Raskalakutty
videos.overview: Raskalakutty dances with Anita at her home. David is shocked to see Teeka and Tillu's true colours. Manohar comes to arrest Raskalakutty, and Tiwari tells everyone about his pretence.

videos.title: Tiwari is Scared to Learn About Ammaji's Visit
videos.overview: Bored of her daily routine, Anita lashes out at Vibhuti. Tiwari gets scared upon hearing about Ammaji's visit for Holi. Tika and Tillu challenge Bablu and Chintu to win over two girls.

videos.title: Prem's Revenge Plan Against Vibhuti and Tiwari
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti refuse to attend Prem's Holi party, and the latter decides to teach them a lesson. David flirts with Ammaji. Prem threatens Vibhuti and Tiwari saying that he won't play Holi.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Decide Not to Celebrate Holi
videos.overview: Prem modulates his voice and threatens to shoot Tiwari. Vibhuti and Tiwari discuss the threat calls they received and decide not to celebrate Holi. Later, everyone participates in the Holika Dahan.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Don Disguises For Holi
videos.overview: Vibhuti and Tiwari try a trick to avoid playing Holi. Later, Vibhuti disguises as a woman and approaches Angoori, but Prem threatens him. Even Tiwari dons a disguise to play Holi with Anita.

videos.title: The Fun Holi Of Modern Colony
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti come up with a plan to catch the person who has been threatening them, and Prem gets caught. Later, all the residents of Modern Colony gather to play Holi and have a lot of fun.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Get Drunk
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti have drinks with Prem. Later, they return home and speak ill of their wives. Vibhuti insults Teeka in front of Angoori. Tiwari also insults Tillu.

videos.title: A New Trouble Befalls The Residents Of Modern Colony
videos.overview: David tells everyone that Mani and Ratnam won the Modern Colony land case. Tiwari and Vibhuti visit both of them. Later, everyone takes care of Mani and Ratnam's longlost sons, Teeka and Tillu.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Serve Teeka and Tillu
videos.overview: Vibhuti and Tiwari take Teeka and Tillu to their homes to serve them. Tillu and Teeka mistreat them, and the family joins them. Teeka makes Vibhuti polish his shoes, and Tillu makes Tiwari dance.

videos.title: Teeka and Tillu Slap Tiwari and Vibhuti
videos.overview: Tillu's actions upset Tiwari, so Angoori tries to comfort him. Tillu and Teeka throw a party, where Tiwari and Vibhuti become waiters. Later, the duo slaps Tiwari and Vibhuti.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Learn The Truth
videos.overview: Tillu and Teeka ask Angoori and Anita to divorce their husbands. Tiwari and Vibhuti stop their wives from leaving the house and they reveal Tillu and Teeka's pretence.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti's Vow
videos.overview: Vibhuti and Tiwari get into an argument and vow not to speak to each other. Tiwari informs Angoori about his fight with Vibhuti. Later, Vibhuti visits Tiwari's house with David and Anita.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Mock Each
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti mock each other without conversing. Happu accuses Teeka and Tillu and beats them in jail. Tiwari visits Vibhuti's house as David teases Ammaji.

videos.title: Anita and Angoori's Plan
videos.overview: Tiwari complains to Anita about David. Anita and Angoori share a plan with Teeka and Tillu to resolve the conflict between Tiwari and Vibhuti. Later, a bull injures Happu with its horns.

videos.title: Tiwari does Not Help Vibhuti
videos.overview: Angoori and Anita's plan brings Tiwari and Vibhuti face-to-face. Despite Vibhuti being in trouble, Tiwari does not help him. While Happu buys tomatoes, a bull strikes him with its horns again.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Reconcile
videos.overview: Tillu, dressed as a bull, strikes Tiwari with horns, but Vibhuti doesn't help him. Eventually, Anita pretends to leave the colony. To stop her from leaving, Tiwari reconciles with Vibhuti.

videos.title: Amma Tells Angoori a Remedy For Conceiving a Child
videos.overview: Angoori is impressed by Vibhuti's honesty. Anita tells Tiwari about her friend's husband's deeds. Amma tells Angoori a remedy for conceiving a child. Teeka flirts with the lady ironer, Rasbhari.

videos.title: Tiwari Believes Vibhuti has a Questionable Character
videos.overview: Posing as Rasbhari, Anita romances Vibhuti. Tiwari witnesses it and assumes that Vibhuti is involved with someone else. Later, Tillu and David plan to unite Teeka and Rasbhari.

videos.title: Tiwari and Angoori Enter Vibhuti's Bedroom
videos.overview: Tiwari and Angoori come to Vibhuti's house and forcibly enter his bedroom to look for Rasbhari. Later, Teeka, Tillu and David see Masterji meeting Rashbhari and beat him up.

videos.title: Tiwari Asks Anita to Kill Vibhuti
videos.overview: Anita, in the guise of Rasbhari, romances Vibhut. Misled after watching them, Tiwari brings a gun and asks Anita to kill Vibhuti. Teeka and Tillu beat Prem to dance with Rasbhari.

videos.title: Anita Pretends to Tie a Rakhi to Vibhuti
videos.overview: Tiwari tells Teeka that Vibhuti and Rasbhari are having an affair. Later, Anita, disguised as Rasbhari, pretends to tie a rakhi to Vibhuti, and Tiwari witnesses this. Tiwari then apologises to Anita.

videos.title: Ammaji Comes to Take Angoori With Her
videos.overview: A beggar adds black pepper to Angoori's gulab jamuns, and Angoori feeds them to Vibhuti. Ammaji takes Angoori with her and asks Tiwari to keep a mannequin, believing it is Angoori, with him.

videos.title: Vibhuti Sees Tiwari Dragging a Sack
videos.overview: Vibhuti sees Tiwari dragging a sack. The next day, he asks Tiwari about Angoori going missing. Vibhuti's behaviour surprises David and Anita. Tiwari and Vibhuti get into a heated argument.

videos.title: Anita Discusses Vibhuti With Sunita
videos.overview: Vibhuti sees Tiwari with a mannequin of a woman, and Tiwari convinces him that it is Angoori. Anita shares Vibhuti's strange behaviour with her friend Sunita. Later, Anita calls Angoori.

videos.title: Vibhuti Accuses Tiwari Of Domestic Violence
videos.overview: Vibhuti accuses Tiwari of domestic violence and brings Happu to his house. Later, he is shocked to see Tiwari romancing a mannequin. Tiwari then asks Teeka and Tillu to dig a pit.

videos.title: Vibhuti Gets Tiwari Arrested
videos.overview: Teeka and Tillu try to bury Tiwari's mannequin, but Vibhuti gets all three of them arrested. In jail, Happu thrashes Teeka, Tillu and Tiwari. Eventually, Angoori tells him the truth.

videos.title: Vibhuti Meets His Death In an Accident
videos.overview: Tiwari intentionally gives Vibhuti a faulty scooter, leading to his death. At home, David and Anita anxiously wait for Vibhuti. Unexpectedly, Vibhuti's spirit appears at Tiwari's house.

videos.title: Happu Shares The News Of Vibhuti's Death
videos.overview: Happu tells Anita about Vibhuti's death, but she doesn't believe him. In his grief over Vibhuti's demise, Tiwari jumps off the balcony. Vibhuti requests the angel of death to bring him back to life.

videos.title: Yamraj Tells Vibhuti a Way to Return to Life
videos.overview: Yamraj, the God of Death, tells Vibhuti how to return alive. Tiwari blames himself for Vibhuti's death and is deeply shocked. Later, Yamraj informs Anita and David about Vibhuti's death.

videos.title: Happu Comes to Arrest Angoori
videos.overview: David and Anita insult Yamraj and oust him from the house. Vibhuti requests Yamraj for some additional time. Happu comes to arrest Angoori for attempting to kill Tiwari.

videos.title: Vibhuti Returns to Life Because Of Angoori
videos.overview: Angoori tells Anita and David about Tiwari's actions. Angoori prays to God to send Vibhuti back home, and Yamraj brings him back to life. Vibhuti returns to the colony, and everyone is happy.

videos.title: A Secret Chamber is Discovered In Vibhuti's House
videos.overview: A secret chamber opens in Vibhuti's house, and he, along with David, reads a diary found inside it. Later, Vibhuti hosts a party at his house, and the guests are astonished on seeing the chamber.

videos.title: Vibhuti Finds a Diary In The Secret Chamber
videos.overview: Vibhuti finds a diary in the secret chamber and proves to everyone that everything written in it is coming true. He then reveals that behind a door in the chamber, Chandralekha's spirit is trapped.

videos.title: Vibhuti Announces New Rules to The Colony Residents
videos.overview: Vibhuti instills fear in the colony using Chandralekha's name and enforces rules. He later plans a movie with Angoori. Just as things settle, the opening of the secret chamber shocks everyone.

videos.title: Vibhuti Sees Chandralekha's Spirit
videos.overview: Vibhuti sees Chandralekha's spirit and locks himself in jail to escape it. However, Chandralekha's spirit punishes him for troubling others, leading him to confide in David.

videos.title: Chandralekha Frightens Vibhuti
videos.overview: Vibhuti is terrified as he sees Chandralekha’s spirit in everyone. Later, he witnesses Angoori attacking Tiwari with a knife. Eventually, Anita and the others unveil their act to Vibhuti.

videos.title: Angoori Needs a Lioness' Milk For Tiwari
videos.overview: Ammaji suggests Angoori to feed a lioness' milk to Tiwari. Hearing this, Vibhuti claims that he has a lioness named Pushpa. Meanwhile, Teeka and Tillu celebrate Malkhan's return to the town.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Declaration About The Lioness' Milk
videos.overview: Angoori fills in Tiwari about Vibhuti's pet lioness, while Teeka and Tillu prepare to welcome Malkhan. Later, Vibhuti announces that he will let the Modern Colony residents taste the lioness’ milk.

videos.title: People Queue Up For The Lioness' Milk
videos.overview: Modern Colony residents queue outside Vibhuti's house for the lioness' milk. Teeka and Tillu welcome Malkhan back to town, while Anita discovers Vibhuti and David's misdeeds upon returning home.

videos.title: Anita Askes Everyone to Buy Lioness Milk
videos.overview: Saxena, dressed as a lioness, tries to romance David. Anita encourages everyone to buy lioness milk, while Happu learns about a man-eating lion escaping from the jungle.

videos.title: Happu Asks Vibhuti to Catch a Human-hunting Lion
videos.overview: Happu turns to Vibhuti for help to catch a human-eating lion, but Tiwari discovers Vibhuti's lies. Left with no better plan, the trio hilariously locks themselves in jail to escape the prowling beast!

videos.title: Tiwari Regains Consciousness After Eating Gargunda
videos.overview: Vibhuti asks Anita for money, but she mocks him. Chhajjan Khoya Miyan feeds Gargunda to an unconscious Tiwari after a bicycle accident, reviving him, and Tiwari then asks for more Gargundas.

videos.title: Anita is Enamoured By The Gargundas Fed By Tiwari
videos.overview: Tiwari lies to Anita and feeds her Gargundas, leaving her enamoured by them. Later, he offers the same to Angoori and narrates an intriguing story from his past.

videos.title: Tiwari Sells Gargundas to His Colony Residents
videos.overview: Tiwari serves Gargundas to the Modern Colony residents in exchange for money. Later, he requests Chhajjan Khoya Miya to prepare more Gargundas for him and brings them for Anita.

videos.title: Vibhuti Asks Saxena to Spy On Tiwari
videos.overview: Tiwari raises the prices of the Gargundas despite everyone's plea to not do so. At the same time, Vibhuti begins to suspect that Tiwari is not the one making them and asks Saxena to spy on him.

videos.title: A Protest Against Tiwari
videos.overview: Tiwari takes advance money for the Gargundas but fails to deliver as Chhajjan Khoya Miya leaves the city. In retaliation, the colony members stage a protest against Tiwari, leading to his punishment.

videos.title: Vibhuti is Inspired to Write His Book
videos.overview: Anita mocks Vibhuti for being unemployed. Kalam Prasad Chaube suggests renaming characters as a trick for writing books, inspiring Vibhuti to start his own.

videos.title: Vibhuti Casts Modern Colony’s Residents In His Book
videos.overview: Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan seek everyone's help to make a reel. Meanwhile, Vibhuti notes down his observations about the colony residents based on their conversations and records them in his diary.

videos.title: Anita Steals Vibhuti's Diary
videos.overview: The residents of Modern Colony try to cheer up a sorrowful Ammaji with jokes. Meanwhile, Anita and David steal Vibhuti’s diary, which later ends up in Angoori’s hands.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Book Gets Published Without His Consent
videos.overview: An editor finds Vibhuti's diary and publishes it as a novel, enraging Modern Colony's residents. Later, Vibhuti confronts him, and Saxena enters the fray.

videos.title: Vibhuti Takes Help From a Few Actors
videos.overview: Vibhuti devises a clever plan to avoid defamation charges by turning some theatre actors into characters from his book. Their dramatic entry into Modern Colony leaves everyone shocked.

videos.title: Tiwari Shows Off His New Ac
videos.overview: Tiwari makes a big deal of buying an expensive AC and throws a party. Vibhuti gets upset and leaves the party when he is insulted. Later, at Anita's suggestion, Vibhuti opens a repairing shop.

videos.title: Vibhuti Sabotages Tiwari’s Ac
videos.overview: Happu catches Vibhuti messing with Tiwari’s AC and takes a bribe to stay quiet. Anita insists that Tiwari get Vibhuti to fix it. Meanwhile, Malkhan dresses as a girl to deceive Prem.

videos.title: Tiwari Pleads With Vibhuti to Fix The Ac
videos.overview: Tiwari asks Vibhuti to fix his AC, but Vibhuti charges a hefty fee. Saxena seeks David’s help to repair his heater. Meanwhile, Malkhan, disguised as a girl, spends time with Prem

videos.title: Tiwari and Angoori Come to Sleep At Vibhuti's House
videos.overview: Tiwari and Angoori sleep over at Vibhuti's when their AC breaks down. Tiwari and Vibhuti end up sharing a bed, lost in romantic dreams. Meanwhile, Prem, mistaking Malkhan for a girl, invites him home.

videos.title: Happu Tells Anita About Vibhuti's Misdeeds
videos.overview: Happu reveals to Anita and Tiwari that Vibhuti damaged Tiwari’s AC. While fixing it, Vibhuti causes an explosion. Meanwhile, Prem uncovers Malkhan’s true identity.

videos.title: Anita's Ex-lover Chandan
videos.overview: Anita's former lover Chandan calls her, expressing his desire to meet her. Later, Vibhuti feels uneasy about Chandan's arrival, while Tiwari is troubled by Pundit Ramphal's prediction.

videos.title: Tiwari Saves Chandan From Getting Beaten
videos.overview: At Vibhuti's orders, Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan beat up Chandan, but Tiwari saves him. Later, Chandan visits Anita, revealing his truth to Tiwari, while Saxena arrives with a letter.

videos.title: Chandan Asks Anita to Divorce Vibhuti
videos.overview: Anita learns that Vibhuti separated her from Chandan in the past. Chandan urges her to divorce Vibhuti and join him in business, prompting Anita to seek Angoori’s advice.

videos.title: Tiwari Makes Vibhuti His Partner
videos.overview: Tiwari learns that Anita is planning to divorce Vibhuti and move to London. To stop her, he makes Vibhuti his business partner, helping him become financially capable.

videos.title: Chandan Turns Out to be a Fraud
videos.overview: Anita dislikes Vibhuti partnering with Tiwari in business. She plans to deceive Chandan after divorcing Vibhuti, but soon realises Chandan is actually a fraud.

videos.title: Vibhuti Becomes a Smuggler
videos.overview: Tiwari tries to raise 25 lakhs INR for fulfilling an order. Meanwhile, David's friend gives Vibhuti the responsibility of smuggling a truckload of sandalwood across the border, and he prepares for it.

videos.title: Vibhuti Saves Himself By Bribing Happu
videos.overview: Angoori tries to lift a dejected Tiwari's spirits. David and Vibhuti, along with Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan, chop sandalwood trees in the jungle and bribe Happu to stop him from searching the truck.

videos.title: Tiwari Discovers Vibhuti's Smuggling Secret
videos.overview: Tiwari discovers that Vibhuti is smuggling sandalwood logs and records a video of him bribing Happu. He later calls Vibhuti while pretending to be Muthu Swami.

videos.title: Vibhuti Abducts Tiwari
videos.overview: Tiwari, disguised as Muthu Swami, demands a share in Vibhuti’s business. However, following David’s advice, Vibhuti abducts Tiwari, leaving Angoori worried about his absence.

videos.title: Tiwari Exposes Vibhuti's Smuggling Business
videos.overview: Angoori informs Happu about Tiwari’s disappearance. Seizing the opportunity, Tiwari flees and returns home, where he exposes Vibhuti’s smuggling business to Anita.

videos.title: Vibhuti Becomes a Carpenter
videos.overview: A nail tears Angoori's expensive saree, prompting Tiwari to call a carpenter. Later, Anita sends Vibhuti to Tiwari's house as the carpenter, accompanied by David.

videos.title: Tiwari's Grandfather's Spirit Gives a Command
videos.overview: Tiwari insults Vibhuti and David when they arrive for the carpentry work. Later, Tiwari's grandfather's spirit orders him to fix the ancestral cupboard, prompting him to seek Vibhuti's help.

videos.title: Tiwari is Beaten For Dancing In Front Of Anita
videos.overview: Ammaji tells Tiwari and Angoori to converse with everyone through dance. Angoori dances to explain a wardrobe issue to Vibhuti, while Anita slaps Tiwari for his dancing.

videos.title: Ammaji Tells Anita About Traditional Remedies
videos.overview: Vibhuti tries to flirt with Angoori, while Ammaji tells Anita about her traditional remedies. Later, a dispute erupts between the colony members at Teeka and Tillu’s spice shop.

videos.title: Anita Suffers Because Of Saxena’s Plan
videos.overview: Due to Saxena, chilli powder gets into Anita’s eyes, and she loses her vision. Meanwhile, Vibhuti and David destroy Tiwari’s cupboard, leaving Tiwari shocked to see the mess.

videos.title: Vibhuti Takes Charge Of Kamal Kishore’s Shop
videos.overview: Kamal Kishore hands over his undergarments store to Vibhuti, who then decides to destroy Tiwari's business. Later, Vibhuti hires Angoori to work at his store.

videos.title: Tiwari Fumes Seeing Angoori At Vibhuti's Store
videos.overview: Tiwari fumes seeing Angoori working at Vibhuti’s store and complains to Happu about him. Later, as Tiwari's store loses customers, Angoori tries to help.

videos.title: Tiwari's Plan to have Vibhuti Abducted
videos.overview: Vibhuti bribes Happu to avoid any action against him. Anita tells Vibhuti her decision to cut down expenses. Meanwhile, Tiwari hires Ghanshyam to have Vibhuti abducted.

videos.title: Ghanshyam Mistakenly Kidnaps Happu
videos.overview: Ghanshyam mistakes Happu for Vibhuti, and kidnaps him after beating him up. Tiwari, plotting a comeback, makes Anita his business partner and brings her to the shop to outsmart Vibhuti.

videos.title: A Few Men Thrash Tiwari and Vibhuti
videos.overview: Vibhuti and Tiwari’s actions disrupt a few men’s business, who then thrash the duo. In retaliation, both fire Anita and Angoori. Later, Saxena lifts Anita’s spirits with unexpected good news.

videos.title: Angoori Faces a Deadly Threat
videos.overview: Ammaji asks Tiwari to send Angoori to jail for her safety. Vibhuti saves Angoori's life, and Tiwari calls Happu to search the house. Meanwhile, Teeka and Tillu plan to dig a secret tunnel.

videos.title: Tiwari Gets Angoori Arrested
videos.overview: Tiwari accuses Angoori of stealing Ammaji’s necklace and gets her arrested. Vibhuti opposes her arrest and later brings food for her in jail.

videos.title: Will Anita be Able to Get Angoori Out On Bail?
videos.overview: Vibhuti thrashes Tiwari, blaming him for Angoori’s arrest. Later, Anita and Saxena arrive at court to secure her bail, while Vibhuti also comes to testify.

videos.title: Vibhuti Gets Jailed While Saving Angoori
videos.overview: Vibhuti gives false testimony to save Angoori, but the judge sends him to jail too. To rescue them, Anita asks Teeka and Malkhan to dig a tunnel to the jail.

videos.title: Happu Arrests Anita
videos.overview: After Tiwari exposes Anita's plan, Happu arrests her as well. Soon after, Ammaji arrives at the police station and explains why Angoori was put behind bars.

videos.title: Monsoon Brings a Change In Modern Colony
videos.overview: Vibhuti gets annoyed when the rains cause a power cut, while Tiwari daydreams about Anita feeding him fritters. Later, Angoori confides in Ammaji that she wants to have a child.

videos.title: Ammaji Shares a New Remedy With Angoori
videos.overview: Ammaji gives Angoori a new remedy. While Vibhuti decides to stop her from getting pregnant, Tiwari secretly calls Anita with a disguised identity to offer financial help.

videos.title: Angoori's Plan to Get Close to Tiwari
videos.overview: Angoori plans to charm Tiwari during a rainy evening. Meanwhile, Teeka and Tillu clash over Chhatralekha, and Vibhuti grows anxious about the idea of Angoori getting pregnant.

videos.title: Tiwari Visits Anita Disguised As Prabhudeva Paul
videos.overview: Tiwari, disguised as Prabhudeva Paul, proposes a quirky barter; fritters in exchange of business funds. As Anita heats up the oil for the fritters, Angoori heats up the flirtation with Tiwari.

videos.title: Lightning Strikes Vibhuti
videos.overview: Tiwari disguises as Prabhudeva Paul and visits Anita’s house demanding fritters. Meanwhile, Ammaji instructs Angoori to stop the ritual. Suddenly, lightning strikes Vibhuti, shocking everyone.

videos.title: Tiwari’s Plan Against Bhoorey
videos.overview: At the temple, Vibhuti calls Tiwari a slipper thief. Bhoorey arrives at Angoori’s with INR 35 lakh, but Vibhuti takes him away. Tiwari brings Bhoorey back with Angoori’s help and tells Amma his plan.

videos.title: Tiwari Executes His Plan
videos.overview: Tiwari, along with Ammaji, executes his plan against Bhoorey, leaving him shocked over the stolen money. Anita calls Happu to investigate the matter, and Tiwari shows him a crucial video.

videos.title: Vibhuti Flees to Avoid Arrest
videos.overview: Tiwari confesses to Happu that he stole the money and explains why he blamed Vibhuti. Fearing arrest, Vibhuti flees home, while Tiwari makes a secret promise to Bhoorey.

videos.title: Vibhuti Becomes The Ceo Of a Company
videos.overview: Vibhuti, after disappearing for a while, suddenly reappears as the CEO of Kirti Enterprises. Soon after, a few women try to defame Anita by blackening her face, but Tiwari jumps in and saves the day.

videos.title: Tiwari Admits His Mistake
videos.overview: Tiwari confesses that he framed Vibhuti for theft. Later, to fulfil Kirti Enterprise’s condition, he and Vibhuti attempt to steal INR 3.5 lakh from Bhoorey.

videos.title: Saxena Frees The Spirits Of Choli Lineage
videos.overview: Baba Aatmadhra gives a kalash to Saxena to keep it safe. However, Saxena accidentally frees the spirits of Choli lineage trapped in it, and the freed spirits soon find bodies to possess.

videos.title: Tiwari and Anita are Possessed
videos.overview: The spirit of the handmaid Chhinchhadi possesses Tiwari, and he starts to behave like a woman. Anita also comes under the control of the spirit of King Cheerkat Choli, leaving Vibhuti shocked.

videos.title: Vibhuti Stops Prem From Meeting Angoori
videos.overview: The spirit of Queen Chinmaya Devi possesses Angoori. Saxena tells Vibhuti about the spirits of the Choli dynasty. Vibhuti stops Prem, who is possessed by General Chudamal, from meeting Angoori.

videos.title: Anita Wants to Kill Prem
videos.overview: Possessed by Chudamal’s spirit, Prem goes to meet Angoori, and Anita arrives there to kill Prem. Vibhuti tries to stop Anita, but she and Prem attack each other.

videos.title: Vibhuti Stops Anita From Killing Prem
videos.overview: Possessed by Champi’s spirit, Happu becomes fixated on marrying Tiwari. Vibhuti thwarts Anita’s attack on Prem and, with Saxena’s ingenious tricks, holds the spirits captive.

videos.title: Angoori Unveils Her Stylish Side to Vibhuti
videos.overview: Angoori dons a modern attire and seeks Vibhuti’s opinion on it. Meanwhile, director Aman Cinema signs Tiwari for his film, as Saxena incites the public to attack him.

videos.title: Angoori Grows Worried Over Tiwari's Behaviour
videos.overview: Tiwari rehearses an emotional film scene, and Angoori gets worried thinking it is true. At her request, Anita speaks to Tiwari, while Tillu fakes his death.

videos.title: Anita's Order Regarding Tiwari
videos.overview: Due to a misunderstanding, Anita tells everyone that Tiwari is under stress and asks them to treat him kindly. Confused by the colony’s changed behaviour towards him, Tiwari is left puzzled.

videos.title: Anita Asks Vibhuti to Keep an Eye On Tiwari
videos.overview: Angoori tells Anita that Tiwari is suicidal, prompting Anita to ask Vibhuti to keep an eye on him. Meanwhile, Teeka and Malkhan ask Masterji for money for Tillu's treatment.

videos.title: Vibhuti Sleeps On The Bed With Tiwari
videos.overview: Vibhuti imagines a scene while lying between Tiwari and Angoori. She rushes an unconscious Tiwari to the hospital, where he reveals a film-related truth. Meanwhile, Saxena provokes others to beat him.

videos.title: Teeka Falls In Love With Muskaan
videos.overview: Teeka falls for Muskaan, and her brother Mantraram brings her to discuss marriage. Tiwari and Vibhuti, along with Angoori and Anita, welcome them, while Muskaan goes to make tea for everyone.

videos.title: Teeka Cuts Ties With Muskaan
videos.overview: Teeka discovers Muskaan’s secret and breaks up with her. Reshampal and Happu refuse to act against Mantraram. His two disciples, one male and one female, arrive in Modern Colony with a scheme.

videos.title: Modern Colony Falls Prey to Black Magic
videos.overview: Modern Colony residents visit Tantra Salon for haircuts. Seeking revenge, Mantraram uses black magic on their effigies and soon after, they all begin to behave like animals.

videos.title: Chaos Erupts At Teeka's Wedding
videos.overview: The residents of Modern Colony stage a fake wedding for Teeka as a fun act, but things go wrong due to Mantraram. Later, Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan attempt to attack Happu and the Commissioner.

videos.title: Muskaan Stops Chasing Teeka
videos.overview: Anita and Angoori confront Mantraram for causing them trouble. In Modern Colony, preparations for Teeka and Muskaan’s wedding resume, but she cancels the wedding for Teeka’s sake.

videos.title: Anita and Angoori Test Their Husbands
videos.overview: At Kalavati’s suggestion, Anita and Angoori test their husbands, who fail the challenge. Later, Saxena reveals that he has developed an AI software that can understand women's moods.

videos.title: Saxena Plants Chips In Tiwari and Vibhuti
videos.overview: Saxena implants chips in Tiwari and Vibhuti’s bodies, enabling them to answer their wives’ questions correctly using AI. Later, Saxena gets into a flight with it, and it decides to teach him a lesson.

videos.title: Ai Deepens The Crisis For Tiwari and Vibhuti
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti’s AI-fueled antics while flirting with Angoori and Anita lead to the women complaining to Ammaji and David. Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan head to the police station with their own issue.

videos.title: Saxena Gives Tiwari and Vibhuti Some Bad News
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti behave rudely with Happu. Later, they inform their respective family members about the AI chip. Soon after, Saxena gives them some bad news.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Tiwari Get Rid Of Ai
videos.overview: Vibhuti and Tiwari gather the men of Modern Colony and implant AI chips in them. Later, both their families decide to cut off their hands. Saxena and David find a way out when the power goes out.

videos.title: Tiwari is Startled By Anita's Words
videos.overview: Angoori has a nightmare and shares it with Ammaji. Anita asks Vibhuti to decorate the house for her brother Titu’s Raksha Bandhan visit, and even urges Tiwari to surprise him.

videos.title: Angoori Locks Tiwari In a Room
videos.overview: Angoori locks Tiwari in a room as per Ammaji's remedy. Later, an apsara guides David to the treasure. While Anita inspects Vibhuti's cleaning, Teeka's team helps David unearth the treasure.

videos.title: Tiwari's Mission to have a Fractured Hand!
videos.overview: Tiwari asks Dr. Gupta for a plaster, but is told to break his hand first. He turns to Saxena for help, but in the chaos, it’s Happu who ends up with a fractured hand.

videos.title: Tiwari Hides In The Bathroom to Avoid Anita
videos.overview: Tiwari hides from Anita in the bathroom and later causes Happu to break his other hand. Teeka’s team uncovers a letter during excavation, while Anita stays unimpressed with Vibhuti’s cleaning.

videos.title: Anita's Surprise Makes Tiwari Dance With Joy
videos.overview: Teeka and his team's treasure hunt breaks a pipeline. Saxena mud-soaks Titu, and then Vibhuti beats him for dirtying the house. On Raksha Bandhan, Tiwari dances with joy at Anita’s surprise.

videos.title: Anita and Angoori Worry For Their Husbands' Health
videos.overview: Vibhuti and Tiwari insult Prem over Jalebi. Anita and Angoori stop them from eating sweets, and Prem shows his report. David, Teeka & team fool Masterji for business gains.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Tiwari Undergo Blood Tests
videos.overview: Anita and Angoori get their husbands tested, but Tiwari and Vibhuti indulge in binge eating at Teeka and David's food stalls. Prem alters their reports, while Saxena invites a beating from Happu.

videos.title: Anita and Angoori Get Strict With Their Husbands
videos.overview: Dr Gupta’s report exposes Tiwari and Vibhuti. Anita and Angoori get strict with them, but the men try to fool their wives. Prem uncovers their tricks, and Anita and Angoori give him a task.

videos.title: Prem’s Plan Against Tiwari and Vibhuti
videos.overview: Frustrated by Angoori and Anita’s strict diet, Tiwari and Vibhuti try to eat sweets but are caught by Prem. He later tricks them into cheating on their diet.

videos.title: Prem’s Actions Come to Light
videos.overview: Anita and Angoori’s strictness frustrates Tiwari and Vibhuti. Dr Gupta exposes Prem’s actions. David, Teeka and the team fail to pay Masterji, prompting Happu to shut down their business.

videos.title: The Modern Colony Prepare For Janmashtami
videos.overview: Anita asks Vibhuti to play the role of Lord Krishna in her event. Teeka and his team collect donations for Janmashtami. Vibhuti convinces Angoori that Lord Krishna himself ate the kheer she prepared.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Secret is Exposed In Front Of Angoori
videos.overview: Impressed by Tiwari, Anita asks him to play the role of Krishna in her play. Vibhuti steals the kheer made by Angoori, but gets caught. Teeka and Malkhan don disguises and rob Masterji.

videos.title: Tiwari Aims His Slingshot At Anita
videos.overview: Tiwari aims his slingshot at Anita but when he misses, Anita takes away his role as Krishna. Meanwhile, Teeka and Malkhan rob Prem and Dr Gupta, who then go to Happu to file a complaint.

videos.title: Teeka and Malkhan Realise Their Mistake
videos.overview: Vibhuti tricks Angoori and steals khir from her kitchen. Happu tries to identify the thieves in the colony. Teeka and Malkhan realise their mistake and decide to return the stolen goods.

videos.title: The Modern Colony Residents Celebrate Janmashtami
videos.overview: Vibhuti steals butter from Angoori’s bedroom, and Happu catches him. Masterji brings Teeka and Malkhan to the police station and reports their mischief. The Modern Colony celebrates Janmashtami.

videos.title: Vibhuti Gets The Role Of a Villain
videos.overview: Anita scolds Vibhuti over an issue but praises his nature to Tiwari. A film director offers Vibhuti the role of a villain in his movie and asks him to deeply embody the character.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Antics Annoy Tiwari and Anita
videos.overview: Tiwari grumbles to Anita about Vibhuti, but she dismisses him, until Vibhuti’s antics annoy her too. Meanwhile, Tiwari mistakes Happu for Angoori, leading to a hilarious blunder.

videos.title: Tiwari has a Misunderstanding About Vibhuti
videos.overview: Tiwari has a misunderstanding about Vibhuti and tells Anita that Vibhuti has killed a man. Later, Anita finds a knife with Vibhuti and informs Tiwari about it.

videos.title: Tiwari Poses As a Servant At Anita’s House
videos.overview: To protect Anita, Tiwari enters her house posing as servant Chhajja. Vibhuti threatens him late at night over a misstep. The next morning, Anita and Tiwari seek Happu's help at the police station.

videos.title: Vibhuti Reveals The Truth Behind His Drama
videos.overview: Happu disguises as Chhajja’s wife Lajja and visits Anita. Later that night, Vibhuti threatens Tiwari, but Happu catches him red-handed. Vibhuti then reveals the truth to Happu, Anita and Tiwari.

videos.title: The New Obsession With Micro Drama
videos.overview: Prem casts Vibhuti as the hero in a micro drama and says Director Saxena will choose the heroine. They meet Saxena together, and Vibhuti later talks to Angoori about the role.

videos.title: Anita Bags The Role Of The Heroine In a Drama
videos.overview: Tiwari learns about Vibhuti’s micro drama from Angoori and asks Anita to play the heroine. Both Anita and Angoori audition for the role, and Saxena selects Anita as the heroine.

videos.title: Angoori Wants to Become a Social Media Star Too
videos.overview: Vibhuti and Anita start filming a micro-drama. Following Amma’s advice, Angoori asks Tiwari to write a poem to gain social media fame. He agrees, and the two shoot a video together.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Anita's Series Becomes a Hit
videos.overview: Vibhuti and Anita’s series becomes a hit, but fans shower all their love on Vibhuti. Tiwari gets thrashed by the mob for his poetry and vows to quit, but Angoori and Ammaji urge him to keep writing.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Video Goes Viral
videos.overview: Vibhuti’s viral video boosts his popularity, unsettling Anita. A man threatens self-immolation to stop Tiwari from writing poetry. Later, Anita and Tiwari open up to each other with the truth.

videos.title: Dr Gupta Gives David Some Bad News
videos.overview: David discusses his property case with Saxena, while Dr Gupta delivers troubling news. Meanwhile, Vibhuti and Anita argue over a vegetable, and a quirky ritual leads Tiwari to get thrashed by Angoori.

videos.title: Saxena Gives David The Good News
videos.overview: At the temple, David promises Tiwari INR 10 crore if he wins the case. Anita serves him her homemade dish. Later, Saxena informs both David and Tiwari about his case victory.

videos.title: Anita and Vibhuti Assume David is Dead
videos.overview: David faints after eating Anita’s dish. Mistaking him for dead, Anita and Vibhuti decide to take his thumbprint for the property, but David regains consciousness and quietly slips away.

videos.title: Anita and Vibhuti Take David’s Thumb Impression
videos.overview: David returns home and faints again. As Tiwari reports him being missing, Happu interrogates Vibhuti. Later, Anita and Vibhuti take David’s thumb impression on some papers.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Anita's Secret is Exposed
videos.overview: Vibhuti gets into trouble after giving Saxena the property papers. Teeka and team catch Vibhuti and Anita red-handed with an unconscious David. Their secret is exposed as the doctor reveals the truth.

videos.title: Kalavati's Advice to Anita and Angoori
videos.overview: Anita gets angry at Vibhuti, and Angoori also has a fight with Tiwari. Later, Anita and Angoori tell Kalavati about their arguments with their husbands, and she gives them some advice.

videos.title: Happu Reveals His Plan to Teeka and His Team
videos.overview: Vibhuti daydreams about Angoori. Happu takes Teeka and the team to the police station, while Tiwari and Vibhuti share their sorrows. Happu and Reshampal reveal their plan to Teeka and his team.

videos.title: Tiwari Lashes Out At Angoori
videos.overview: Angoori asks Tiwari about her flaws, while Anita tries to provoke Vibhuti by insulting David. Later, Tiwari vents his frustration on Angoori, triggering Vibhuti’s anger.

videos.title: Vibhuti Scares Tiwari Disguised As a Ghost
videos.overview: Tiwari insults Vibhuti, who avenges by posing as a ghost woman. Anita tries again to help Vibhuti vent, while Happu and Reshampal offer to take the blame for the murder instead of Teeka and his gang.

videos.title: Vibhuti’s Secret is Exposed In Front Of Tiwari
videos.overview: Seeing Tiwari shouting at Angoori, Vibhuti disguises as a ghost and beats him up, only to get exposed. Angoori suggests him Kalavati’s remedy, and on David’s suggestion, Vibhuti insults Anita.

videos.title: Who will Pair Up For 'dandiya' This Season?
videos.overview: Vibhuti dreams of being Angoori’s 'dandiya' partner, while Tiwari hopes to pair with Anita. As the colony prepares for it, Vibhuti refuses to play with Anita, and Tiwari declines Angoori’s request.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Dress As Women For Dandiya
videos.overview: Angoori and Anita refuse to play `dandiya' with Vibhuti and Tiwari. Later, Anita invites Angoori to the Ladies’ Dandiya Fest, prompting Tiwari and Vibhuti to dress as women and join in.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Disguise As Women For Dandiya
videos.overview: Prem harasses Tiwari, disguised as a woman, but Happu intervenes. Anita and Angoori practice dandiya with the girls, and Tiwari and Vibhuti sneak in, disguised. Later, Teeka and his team fight hunger.

videos.title: Anita and Angoori Discover Their Husbands' Pretense
videos.overview: Anita and Angoori discover Vibhuti and Tiwari’s pretense and decide to teach them a lesson. They introduce new dandiya partners, crushing the men's hopes and keeping them jealous.

videos.title: Anita and Angoori Teach Their Husbands a Lesson
videos.overview: Anita and Angoori announce they’ll marry their dandiya partners to make their husbands jealous. As Tiwari and Vibhuti confront them, the truth comes out, and everyone ends up playing dandiya together.

videos.title: David Sees a Flying Saucer
videos.overview: Angoori and Tiwari dine at Vibhuti’s house, where he hints at Tiwari’s secret. Meanwhile, David tells the press about spotting a flying saucer. Angoori questions Tiwari, sparking his anger.

videos.title: Angoori is Shocked to Hear That Tiwari is an Alien
videos.overview: Vibhuti tells Angoori that Tiwari is an alien, and she questions Tiwari. A RAW agent orders Happu to catch the alien. Tiwari shares with Dr. Gupta the changes happening in his body.

videos.title: Angoori Suspects That Tiwari is an Alien
videos.overview: Angoori sees Tiwari's transformation and tells Vibhuti that he is indeed an alien. Later at night, the duo finds Tiwari in the jungle, while a flying saucer passes by.

videos.title: Tiwari's Plan to Take Over Planet Earth
videos.overview: Angoori overhears Tiwari’s plan to take over the Earth and informs Vibhuti. Later, David reveals to Teeka and team that Tiwari is an alien, and they rush to alert Happu.

videos.title: Teeka and Friends Mistake Tiwari For an Alien
videos.overview: Tiwari pretends to be an alien fooling Angoori. Teeka and friends knock him out and take him to the police. When Anita, Vibhuti and Angoori arrive, Tiwari admits it was all an act.

videos.title: Vibhuti's Terrifying Dream
videos.overview: Vibhuti has a terrifying dream and tries to stop Angoori from going on a pilgrimage. David wins a case worth INR 20 crores and decides to transfer the property in Vibhuti and Anita’s name.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Anita Host a Party For David
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti video call Angoori. Teeka and his gang plot to steal INR 50 lakh from the police station. After David becomes a millionaire, Vibhuti and Anita throw him a party at home.

videos.title: David's Daughter Returns to His Life
videos.overview: Charmi, David's daughter, arrives at Vibhuti's house, leading him to refuse to transfer his property to Vibhuti and Anita. Meanwhile, Teeka and team get Happu drunk for a theft at the police station.

videos.title: Tiwari Poses As Charmi's Childhood Friend Montu
videos.overview: Vibhuti tells Anita that Charmi wants to give her property to her childhood friend, Montu. At their advice, Tiwari poses as Montu and meets Charmi, who then expresses her desire to marry him.

videos.title: Charmi Learns About Tiwari and Vibhuti's Plan
videos.overview: Tiwari lies to Angoori about going to London. Charmi learns about his and Vibhuti's plan and refuses the property. The commissioner rewards Teeka and his gang for their honesty.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Clean Each Other’s Houses
videos.overview: Tiwari likes his neighbour, Vibhuti's ultramodern wife, Anita, and Vibhuti likes Tiwari's simple wife, Angoori. Their quest to impress each other’s wives often leads to hilarious situations.

videos.title: Vibhuti Finds an Astonishing Picture
videos.overview: Happu tells Vibhuti that a bandit couple is hiding in the colony. Teeka and the team unknowingly steal a box of grenades. Later, Vibhuti sees a photograph in Angoori’s box and is shocked.

videos.title: Teeka and His Gang Sell a Grenade
videos.overview: Vibhuti tries to tell Happu a secret, but freezes when he sees Tiwari. Anita and Angoori make Tiwari and Vibhuti clean the house. Meanwhile, Teeka and his gang unknowingly sell a real grenade.

videos.title: Tiwari and Angoori Dress As Bandits
videos.overview: On Diwali, Tiwari plans to sell toy guns that shoot firecrackers. For a poster, he and Angoori dress as bandits, which scares Vibhuti. Meanwhile, Teeka and team sell a grenade to Happu.

videos.title: Modern Colony Residents Celebrate Diwali
videos.overview: Vibhuti tells Anita that Tiwari and Angoori are bandits, and their attire stuns him. Meanwhile, Happu pulls the pin on a grenade given by Teeka and the gang. Later, everyone celebrates Diwali.

videos.title: Angoori Becomes Vibhuti’s Juliet
videos.overview: Prem pitches a money-making idea to Vibhuti, who casts Angoori as Juliet in a play, crushing Teeka’s hopes. Meanwhile, Tiwari plans a getaway to Lucknow with Anita.

videos.title: David Fulfils Anita’s Wish to Become Juliet
videos.overview: In Modern Colony, preparations for the MLA’s father’s birthday are in full swing. Anita regrets not being part of the play, but David’s idea helps her fulfill her dream of becoming Juliet.

videos.title: Niyam Kumar Pressures The Modern Colony Residents
videos.overview: David asks Tiwari to play Romeo opposite Anita. Niyam Kumar pressures the Modern Colony residents to change the play. Meanwhile, Saxena uses Malkhan for his latest invention.

videos.title: The Clash Of The Ziddi and Niyam Factions
videos.overview: A fight erupts between the Ziddi and Niyam factions over a play in Modern Colony. To resolve it, Vibhuti and Tiwari turn to Saxena, who later disguises himself as a woman to meet Niyam.

videos.title: Modern Colony Residents Perform In a Play
videos.overview: Saxena, disguised as a woman, accuses Niyam of misconduct. As a result, Niyam agrees to let the colony residents perform the play of their choice. Saxena generates electricity using his invention.

videos.title: Sher Khan Charms Every Woman
videos.overview: Anita feels stuck in her routine life. Meanwhile, Tiwari learns that Sher Khan is in town, known for charming women. Later, Anita panics after spotting a message on her mirror.

videos.title: The Colony Women are Charmed By Sher Khan
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti try to woo their wives with poetry, but later, the colony women are spellbound by Sher Khan's poetry. Mistaking David for Sher Khan, the duo ends up beating him.

videos.title: Junior Chirkin Arrives to Hold Sher Khan Captive
videos.overview: Tiwari and Vibhuti disguise as Sher Khan to impress Anita and Angoori with poetry. To get hold of Sher Khan, the Commissioner calls in famed poet Junior Chirkin, who turns out to be Saxena’s friend.

videos.title: Saxena Finds Out Junior Chirkin's Secret
videos.overview: Angoori and Anita pretend to be hypnotised by Sher Khan in front of their husbands. Tiwari revamps his look to appear younger, while Saxena uncovers a secret about Junior Chirkin.

videos.title: Sher Khan Hypnotises Angoori and Anita
videos.overview: Saxena reveals Junior Chirkin is Sher Khan. Meanwhile, Sher Khan hypnotises Anita, Angoori and other women, holding them captive, only to release them when his lover arrives.

videos.title: A Stomach Ailment Worsens Tiwari’s Condition
videos.overview: Ammaji guides Angoori with a remedy for Tiwari’s stomach. The commissioner sends Happu to retrieve a secret capsule, while Tankeshwar Maharaj reveals a secret to Teeka.

videos.title: Vibhuti Becomes a Detective
videos.overview: Angoori’s mistake upsets Tiwari’s stomach. Happu makes Vibhuti a detective and sends him to retrieve a capsule-stuffed samosa. Later, Teeka is overjoyed to find a buffalo named Laila.

videos.title: Tiwari Eats a Samosa Filled With Capsules
videos.overview: Vibhuti teams up with Angoori to get the capsule-filled samosa, but Tiwari accidentally eats it. The commissioner demands the capsule by any means. Vibhuti, furious over Tiwari’s blunder, scolds him.

videos.title: Vibhuti Asks Tiwari to Take a Laxative
videos.overview: Vibhuti urges Tiwari to take a laxative to retrieve the capsule, but even after multiple tries, his stomach fails to clear, leaving Vibhuti anxious. Meanwhile, Teeka plans to marry Laila, the buffalo.

videos.title: Modern Colony Residents Scare Tiwari
videos.overview: To clear Tiwari’s stomach, the colony residents scare him, and it works. The commissioner then reveals that the capsule is fake, while Teeka tries to marry Laila, the buffalo.

videos.title: Anita's Indifference Puzzles Vibhuti
videos.overview: Anita's cold behaviour leaves Vibhuti puzzled. Tiwari pays no heed to Angoori, prompting her to complain to Ammaji. Meanwhile, Saxena hosts a 'Chidiya Udd' contest in the neighbourhood.

videos.title: Tiwari Hires Vibhuti to Work At His Shop
videos.overview: Tiwari hires Vibhuti to run his shop and enjoys more time at home with Angoori. Anita misses Vibhuti’s presence, while Saxena keeps the 'Chidiya Udd' contest going.

videos.title: Vibhuti Settles Scores With Anita
videos.overview: Angoori turns down Tiwari’s romantic gestures, while Vibhuti avoids Anita by pretending to be busy, leaving her upset. Amidst it all, the ‘Chidiya Udd’ contest enters its next thrilling round.

videos.title: Tiwari Burns Angoori’s Saree
videos.overview: Power gets cut due to Vibhuti’s unpaid bill, triggering a clash with Anita. While Angoori fumes at Tiwari for burning her saree, David drops by their house to use the toilet.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Arrive At The Airport
videos.overview: Anita and Angoori gift fake Thailand tickets to their upset husbands. At the airport, Tiwari and Vibhuti realise the prank, while the wives enjoy their mischief.

videos.title: Prem Urges Vibhuti to Step Into The Betting Market
videos.overview: Prem lures Vibhuti to invest in betting. Tiwari tells Angoori of business losses, while Manish tempts Vibhuti with a daring scheme to profit from cricket wagers.

videos.title: Vibhuti and Tiwari Invest In The Betting Market
videos.overview: Vibhuti asks Anita for money to enter the betting market and convinces Tiwari to join. Soon, wagers are placed on Manish’s brother’s cricket team, as Pappu outlines the betting terms.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Lose Their Money In The Betting Market
videos.overview: Manish’s brother’s cricket team is defeated, and the betting market swallows all the money. Desperate to repay Pappu, Tiwari and Vibhuti become pickpockets, stealing their wives’ purses in shame.

videos.title: Manohar Punishes Tiwari and Vibhuti
videos.overview: Manohar whips Tiwari and Vibhuti for the theft. Angoori dances publicly to earn money, and Vibhuti informs Tiwari, who ends up selling his house to Pappu to clear the debt.

videos.title: Anita Takes Charge As Pappu’s Personal Secretary
videos.overview: Tiwari and Angoori vacate their house. Anita becomes Pappu’s secretary, shocking Tiwari and Vibhuti as they witness her romance, until Anita and Angoori reveal the truth.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Face Off In a Carrom Match
videos.overview: Tiwari defeats Vibhuti in a carrom match, while Saxena invents a device to control human hands. Anita treats Vibhuti coldly and showers praise on Tiwari.

videos.title: Vibhuti Asks Saxena For His Special Device
videos.overview: Vibhuti asks Saxena for his hand‑control device. Tillu begs Tiwari to meet his future in‑laws as his brother. Later, Anita cleverly feeds Tiwari Saxena’s special laddoo.

videos.title: Vibhuti Takes Control Of Tiwari's Hand
videos.overview: Tillu’s future in-laws visit Tiwari’s home. Vibhuti seizes control of Tiwari’s hand, making him act bizarrely before them. Later, Anita complains to Happu that Tiwari misbehaved with a girl.

videos.title: Tillu’s Alliance Breaks Due to Tiwari
videos.overview: Tiwari embraces Tillu’s future mother‑in‑law, breaking Tillu's alliance. As a result, Tillu and Teeka rush to inform Anita about it. Prem tells Tiwari that his hands are being controlled by Saxena.

videos.title: Tiwari Takes Revenge On Vibhuti
videos.overview: Tiwari goes to Saxena, and together they gain control over Vibhuti’s legs. As a result, Vibhuti crushes the foot of Tillu’s would-be father-in-law and is then shocked to see Tiwari with Saxena.

videos.title: Amma’s Memories Tied to Her Favourite Quilt
videos.overview: Amma recalls old memories of her favourite quilt to the children. Later, she angers Rajesh by refusing her earrings, prompting her to take a vow. Meanwhile, at college, Ranbir finds a new love!

videos.title: Angoori’s Strike Spells Trouble For Tiwari
videos.overview: Teeka and friends support Angoori’s strike against Tiwari. Later, Angoori refuses to cook, while Tiwari, desperate to win her back, tries to charm her with romance.

videos.title: Angoori Enters Politics
videos.overview: During the strike, Anita demands a hefty sum from the 'Mukt Mahila Party' leader to join Angoori’s cause, while the 'Swatantra Mahila Party' chief also asks Tiwari about her.

videos.title: Anita is Envious Of Angoori’s Growing Popularity
videos.overview: Tiwari urges Angoori to join the 'Swatantra Mahila Party', but she declines. Anita, stung by Angoori’s rising fame, schemes a twist, while the chairman erupts at Tiwari’s words!

videos.title: Angoori's Insistence Causes Tiwari's Abduction
videos.overview: Angoori refuses the Swatantra Mahila Party, triggering Tiwari’s abduction by its chief. Anita and Angoori mount a daring rescue before stealing the spotlight on Saxena’s podcast.

videos.title: Birthday Bash Chaos and Herb Smoke Twist
videos.overview: Modern Colony unites for David’s birthday bash! Sparks fly as Vibhuti clashes with Tiwari over Angoori, wrecking the party. Later, he inhales Saxena’s rare herb smoke, igniting unexpected chaos.

videos.title: Everyone is Shocked By Vibhuti's Changed Behaviour
videos.overview: Vibhuti suddenly behaves lovingly with everyone, leaving the colony stunned. Dr Kimaka suggests a remedy to Anita, who then seeks Tiwari’s help and he quickly comes up with a plan.

videos.title: Anita Puts On an Act to Cure Vibhuti
videos.overview: Anita’s teasing romance act with Tiwari leaves Vibhuti unfazed. Later, she also pretends to romance Prem, and on seeing them together, Tiwari suffers a heart attack.

videos.title: Prem's Wedding Procession Comes to Anita's House
videos.overview: Vibhuti and Saxena trick Tiwari into inhaling herbal smoke, causing a sudden change in his behaviour. Later, they arrive with Prem’s wedding procession to marry him off to Anita, and Anita helps Prem.

videos.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Get Their Own Houses Robbed
videos.overview: Intoxicated, Tiwari and Vibhuti unknowingly let Teeka and his gang rob their houses. David and Anita report the theft to Manohar and once the herbal haze fades, Tiwari and Vibhuti return to normal.

videos.title: Tiwari and Anita’s Plot to Make a Fortune
videos.overview: Tiwari and Anita dream of a windfall. Later, they visit Minister P.P. Srivastav’s office, who advises them to acquire land near the airport to make a fortune.

videos.title: Anita’s Scheme to Use Prem’s Money
videos.overview: Fearing the tax department, Prem entrusts his money to Vibhuti, and Anita persuades Vibhuti to invest it. Later, Tiwari and Anita unveil a grand plan to make the colony rich.

videos.title: The Residents Of The Colony are Deceived
videos.overview: The airport site is shifted, leaving Modern Colony residents cheated out of their money. Prem confronts Vibhuti for repayment, while Tiwari reports the fraud to the Commissioner.

videos.title: Tiwari Asks Anita to Pose As His Wife
videos.overview: Tiwari schemes to gain his aunt’s property by making Anita pose as his modern wife. When Prem abducts Vibhuti, Anita agrees to act as Tiwari’s wife to save him.

videos.title: Let’s Set Out For Ghoonghatganj!
videos.overview: Angoori decides to go to Ghoonghatganj with Tiwari and Anita, while Vibhuti insists on joining. Tiwari and Anita also rope in Teeka and his gang, taking them along as servants.

videos.title: Saxena Return's Everyone Their Mobile Phone's
